/-- R1 on reachable states (§82.2, §66, §15, §57): under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47),
`r1_read` without invariant hypothesis. -/
theorem r1_read_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ty : Nat → Ty} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {a : Nat}
    {ls : List Nat} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3) (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hpre : Read3Pre s3 a ls)
    {l : Nat} (hl : l ∈ ls)
    (hob : ObR.dec s2 (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l) ∧ ObR.stat s2 (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l)) :
    ∃ al, s2.allocs (L l).alloc = some al ∧ al.live = true ∧ al.InitRange (L l).off (L l).len ∧
      Machine.ReadStep ObR (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l) s2
        (.ok (al.bytesAt (L l).off (L l).len)) :=
  r1_read hR (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr).1 hpre hl hob

/-- R6 on reachable states (§82 preamble, §57): under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47),
`r6` without invariant hypothesis. For `read`, `write` and `writeShared`, the execution is that of
the reads and writes of R1 and R2 (`readOps`, `writeOps`, §82.2). The further conclusions of
`r6_read`, `r6_exit`, `r6_free` and `r6_alloc` on reachable states: `r6_read_reachable`,
`r6_exit_reachable`, `r6_free_reachable`, `r6_alloc_reachable`. -/
theorem r6_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
    {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty} {op : KOp}
    {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3) (hπ : ParamsOK C π) (hR : Repr π.L π.rtok s3 s2)
    (h : OpStep k op s3 s3') (hob : StepObl k C ObR ObW π op s3 s2) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (opsOf π op s3 s2) s2 (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) ∧
      Repr π.L π.rtok s3' (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) :=
  have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst hr
  r6 hπ hR hk.1 hk.2.1.2.2 h hob

/-- Realization of `read` on reachable states (§82 preamble, §82.2, §66, §57): under `DDSound`
(§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), and the parametric obligations along the reads (§20.3), `r6_read`
without invariant hypothesis, its conclusion in full: the reads form an execution of `ok` raw steps, leave the memory state unchanged, and `Repr` holds
after the step. -/
theorem r6_read_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
    {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {ty : Nat → Ty} {L : Layout}
    {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics) (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3)
    (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (h : Read3Step a ls s3 (.ok s3'))
    (hob : OblAlong ObR ObW s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls)) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (readOps s2 L ty ls) s2 (run s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls)) ∧
      run s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls) = s2 ∧ Repr L rtok s3' (run s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls)) :=
  r6_read hR (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr).1 h hob

/-- Realization of `exitFrame` on reachable states (§82 preamble, §82.5, §73, §57): under
`DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), and tokens compatible with themselves (§17.2), `r6_exit`
without invariant hypothesis, its conclusion in full: the deallocations are `ok` raw steps, the allocations of the root places directly owned by
the exiting frame are dead afterwards, and `Repr` holds after the step. -/
theorem r6_exit_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
    {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {L : Layout}
    {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3) (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2)
    (h : ExitStep k s3 (.ok s3')) (htc : ∀ r, C (rtok r) (rtok r)) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (exitOps L rtok s3) s2 (run s2 (exitOps (Ty := Ty) L rtok s3)) ∧
      (∀ r ∈ exitRoots s3, AllocP (run s2 (exitOps (Ty := Ty) L rtok s3)) (L r).alloc
        (·.live = false)) ∧
      Repr L rtok s3' (run s2 (exitOps (Ty := Ty) L rtok s3)) :=
  r6_exit hR (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr).1 h htc

/-- Realization of `free` on reachable states (§82 preamble, §82.4, §70, §17, §57): under
`DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), and the instantiation of `K.FreeCompat` (§80), `r6_free`
without invariant hypothesis, its conclusion in full: the deallocation is an `ok` raw step, the
allocation of the place is dead afterwards, and `Repr` holds after the step. -/
theorem r6_free_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
    {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {L : Layout}
    {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {p auth : Nat} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3) (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2)
    (h : FreeStep k p auth s3 (.ok s3'))
    (hinst : k.FreeCompat p auth → FreeCompatInst C rtok p auth) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (freeOps L p auth) s2 (run s2 (freeOps (Ty := Ty) L p auth)) ∧
      AllocP (run s2 (freeOps (Ty := Ty) L p auth)) (L p).alloc (·.live = false) ∧
      Repr L rtok s3' (run s2 (freeOps (Ty := Ty) L p auth)) :=
  have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst hr
  r6_free hR hk.1 hk.2.1.2.2 h hinst

/-- Realization of `alloc` on reachable states (§82 preamble, §82.4, §71, §9 ¶11, §57): under
`DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), a valid placement and geometries and the layout
obligations of the new places, `r6_alloc` without invariant hypothesis, its conclusion in full:
one allocation is created (`oneRoot`, §71), by an `ok` raw step, and `Repr` holds after the
step. -/
theorem r6_alloc_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
    {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {L : Layout}
    {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
    {pl : Placement} {g : Nat → Geom} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3) (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2)
    (h : AllocStep k pr ow ls s3 (.ok s3')) (hpl : PlacementOK pl) (hg : GeomOK g)
    (hlay : NewLayout L (allocP s3 ow ls) s3.P.length s2.next g (rootIdx ls.toShape)) :
    (allocOps (Ty := Ty) pl g rtok s3.P.length s2 (rootIdx ls.toShape)).length = 1 ∧
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (allocOps pl g rtok s3.P.length s2 (rootIdx ls.toShape)) s2
        (run s2 (allocOps (Ty := Ty) pl g rtok s3.P.length s2 (rootIdx ls.toShape))) ∧
      Repr L rtok s3' (run s2 (allocOps (Ty := Ty) pl g rtok s3.P.length s2
        (rootIdx ls.toShape))) :=
  r6_alloc hR (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr).1 h hpl hg hlay

and `StaticsOK` (§47), `pointer_sound_store` without invariant hypothesis. -/

    {pe : PtrEnc} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State}

    (hover : ¬ Machine.RangeDisjoint (L l).off (L l).len (L l').off (L l').len) :

hypothesis. -/
theorem pinned_address_stable_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty}
    {op : KOp} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)

    (hpin : (∃ (o : Nat) (ob : PinOb), s3.pins[o]? = some ob ∧ ob.active = true ∧
      l ∈ ob.leaves) ∨ k.Pinned l) :
    LiveAlloc s2 (π.L l).alloc ∧ LiveAlloc (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) (π.L l).alloc ∧
      leafAddr (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) π.L l = leafAddr s2 π.L l := by
  have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst hr
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hlq⟩ := reachable_i5 hdd hst hr l hl hlf
    (hpin.elim (fun h => .inr (S3.pin_iff.2 h)) .inl)

theorem optP_of {α : Type} {o : Option α} {y : α} {P : α → Prop} {d : Prop} (h : o = some y)

def OwnerOK (s : S3) : Holder → Prop

  | .place o => o < s.P.length

  cases h <;> unfold OwnerOK <;> infer_instance

/-! ## Executable runs (§58, §60–§75) -/

/-- The preconditions of the `ok` outcome of a kernel operation (§60–§75; for `alloc`, the static
preconditions and `K.Satisfiable`, §71). -/
def OpPre (k : K) : KOp → S3 → Prop
  | .derive src region m, s => DerivePre s src region m
  | .split src rs, s => SplitPre k s src rs
  | .release a, s => ReleasePre s a
  | .transfer src dst, s => TransferPre k s src dst
  | .depend q x, s => DependPre s q x
  | .enter ps ls, s => EnterPre s ps ls
  | .exit, s => ExitPre k s
  | .read a ls, s => Read3Pre s a ls
  | .write a ls _, s => Write3Pre s a ls
  | .writeShared a ls _, s => WriteSharedPre k s a ls
  | .pin p, s => PinPre s p
  | .unpin o, s => UnpinPre k s o
  | .endUse p, s => EndUsePre k s p
  | .free p auth, s => FreePre k s p auth
  | .alloc pr ow ls, s => AllocStatic k s pr ow ls ∧ k.Satisfiable pr ls s
  | .store a p, s => StorePre s a p

/-- The effect of the `ok` outcome of a kernel operation (§60–§75). -/
def opEff3 : KOp → S3 → S3
  | .derive src region m, s => deriveEff s src region m
  | .split src rs, s => splitEff s src rs
  | .release a, s => releaseEff s a
  | .transfer src dst, s => transferEff s src dst
  | .depend q x, s => dependEff s q x
  | .enter ps ls, s => enterEff s ps ls
  | .exit, s => exitEff s
  | .read _ _, s => s
  | .write _ ls _, s => write3Eff s ls
  | .writeShared _ ls _, s => write3Eff s ls
  | .pin p, s => pinEff s p
  | .unpin o, s => unpinEff s o
  | .endUse p, s => endUseEff s p
  | .free p _, s => freeEff s p
  | .alloc _ ow ls, s => allocEff s ow ls
  | .store a p, s => storeEff s a p

/-- The preconditions give the `ok` step to the effect (§58). -/
theorem opStep_of_pre {k : K} {op : KOp} {s : S3} (h : OpPre k op s) :
    OpStep k op s (opEff3 op s) := by
  cases op with
  | alloc => exact .ok h.1 h.2
  | _ => exact .ok h

section Runner

variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of a kernel operation (§60–§75). -/
instance opPreDec (op : KOp) (s : S3) : Decidable (OpPre k op s) := by
  cases op <;> unfold OpPre <;> infer_instance

variable {Ty : Type} (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) [DecidableRel C] (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
  (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) [∀ s o, Decidable (Obl ObR ObW s o)] (π : Params Ty)

/-- Decidability of the obligations of a step (§20.3, §82). -/
instance stepOblDec (op : KOp) (s3 : S3) (s2 : Machine.State) :
    Decidable (StepObl k C ObR ObW π op s3 s2) := by
  unfold StepObl; cases op <;> dsimp only <;> infer_instance

/-- One translated step: when the preconditions and the obligations hold, the effect of the step
and the memory state after its raw operations (§82). -/
def sstep (st : S3 × Machine.State) (op : KOp) : Option (S3 × Machine.State) :=
  if OpPre k op st.1 ∧ StepObl k C ObR ObW π op st.1 st.2
  then some (opEff3 op st.1, run st.2 (opsOf π op st.1 st.2)) else none

/-- A translated run of a list of operations, in order (§82). -/
def srun : S3 × Machine.State → List KOp → Option (S3 × Machine.State)
  | st, [] => some st
  | st, op :: ops => (sstep k C ObR ObW π st op).bind fun st' => srun st' ops

end Runner

/-- A successful translated run extends a `SimRun` (§82 preamble). -/
theorem srun_sound {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')]
    [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone]
    [DecidablePred k.Deallocable] [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)]
    [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)] {Ty : Type} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
    [DecidableRel C] {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty}
    [∀ s o, Decidable (Obl ObR ObW s o)] {π : Params Ty} {statics : Statics} :
    ∀ (ops : List KOp) (st st' : S3 × Machine.State),
      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π st.1 st.2 → srun k C ObR ObW π st ops = some st' →
      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π st'.1 st'.2
  | [], st, st', h, he => by
    simp only [srun, Option.some.injEq] at he; subst he; exact h
  | op :: ops, st, st', h, he => by
    simp only [srun] at he
    cases hs : sstep k C ObR ObW π st op with
    | none => rw [hs] at he; cases he
    | some st₁ =>
      rw [hs] at he
      simp only [Option.bind_some] at he
      unfold sstep at hs
      split at hs
      · rename_i hc
        simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hs; subst hs
        exact srun_sound ops _ st' (.step h (opStep_of_pre hc.1) hc.2) he
      · cases hs

/-- An option known to be `some` is `some` of its value (§82, runs). -/
theorem some_getD {α : Type} {o : Option α} (d : α) (h : o.isSome = true) :
    o = some (o.getD d) := by
  cases o with
  | none => cases h
  | some x => rfl

/-! ## Concrete parameters and runs (non-vacuity; §82, `formal/DESIGN.md` "Layout interface") -/

namespace Runs

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples

/-- Decidability of `K0.Satisfiable` (§48; test contract of the kernel examples). -/
instance : ∀ p ls s, Decidable (K0.Satisfiable p ls s) := fun _ _ _ => instDecidableTrue

/-- Root place of `q`: the last element of its parent chain (§40). -/
def rootOf (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Nat := (chain (parentOf P) q).getLastD q

/-- Number of root places below `r`: the identity of the allocation of the root `r` when every root
place receives one allocation in index order (§9 ¶11, §82.1). -/
def rootRank (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Nat :=
  ((List.range r).filter fun i => decide (i < P.length ∧ parentOf P i = none)).length

/-- Number of leaves of the root of `l` below `l` (§82.1). -/
def leafRank (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Nat :=
  ((List.range l).filter fun i => decide (isLeaf P i ∧ rootOf P i = rootOf P l)).length

/-- Test layout for the places `P` (§82.1): a place in the allocation of its root; a leaf of 8
bytes at 8 times its rank among the leaves of its root; leaves of the roots listed in `z` have
size zero (§71.1, zero physical size). -/
def autoL (P : List Place) (z : List Nat) : Layout := fun q =>
  if rootOf P q ∈ z then ⟨rootRank P (rootOf P q), 0, 0⟩
  else ⟨rootRank P (rootOf P q), 8 * leafRank P q, 8⟩

/-- Test geometry (§9 ¶1): 8 bytes per leaf of the root, aligned on 8; size zero for the roots of
`z`. -/
def autoG (P : List Place) (z : List Nat) : Nat → Geom := fun r =>
  if r ∈ z then ⟨0, 0, 8⟩ else ⟨0, 8 * (footprint P r).length, 8⟩

/-- The test geometry has valid alignments (§9 ¶4). -/
theorem autoG_ok (P : List Place) (z : List Nat) : GeomOK (autoG P z) := fun r => by
  simp only [autoG]; split <;> exact ⟨Nat.succ_pos 7, 3, rfl⟩

/-- Test reference encoding (§82.3): 8 bytes, little-endian, each with the provenance. -/
def pe8 : PtrEnc where
  size := 8
  enc addr prov i := ((addr / 256 ^ i % 256).toUInt8, prov)
  decode f := (List.range 8).foldr (fun i acc => acc + (f i).1.toNat * 256 ^ i) 0
  reads f g h := by
    have key : ∀ l : List Nat, (∀ i ∈ l, i < 8) →
        l.foldr (fun i acc => acc + (f i).1.toNat * 256 ^ i) 0 =
          l.foldr (fun i acc => acc + (g i).1.toNat * 256 ^ i) 0 := by
      intro l hl
      induction l with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons a l ih =>
        simp only [List.foldr_cons]
        rw [ih fun i hi => hl i (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hi), h a (hl a (List.mem_cons_self ..))]
    exact key _ fun i hi => List.mem_range.1 hi

/-- Test obligations of reads (§15 ¶5, §20.3 ¶1): explicit predicates; the decidable part requires
an address aligned on 8 bytes (§15.6), the static part is `True` (sequential runs, §15.7, §18). -/
abbrev obR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Unit := ⟨fun _ ac _ => ac.addr % 8 = 0, fun _ _ _ => True⟩

/-- Test obligations of writes (§16 ¶4, §20.3 ¶1), as `obR`. -/
abbrev obW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Unit := ⟨fun _ ac _ _ => ac.addr % 8 = 0, fun _ _ _ _ => True⟩

/-- Decidability of the test obligations (§20.3 ¶3). -/
instance : ∀ s o, Decidable (Obl obR obW s o) := fun _ o => by
  cases o <;> unfold Obl <;> infer_instance

/-- Test parameters for the final places `P` (§82): layout and geometry above, token `100 + r`
for the root `r`, `topPlacement`, unit types, `pe8`, initial byte `10 l + i` of static leaf `l`. -/
def piOf (P : List Place) (z : List Nat) : Params Unit :=
  ⟨autoL P z, fun r => 100 + r, topPlacement, autoG P z, fun _ => (), pe8,
    fun l i => ((10 * l + i).toUInt8, none)⟩

/-- The test parameters satisfy their obligations, with compatibility by equality (§9 ¶11,
§17.2). -/
theorem piOf_ok (P : List Place) (z : List Nat) : ParamsOK (· = ·) (piOf P z) :=
  ⟨topPlacement_ok, autoG_ok P z, fun _ => rfl⟩

/-- Kernel effects of a list of operations, without checks: computes the final places of a run, on
which the layout parameter is fixed once (§82). -/
def kernelRun : S3 → List KOp → S3
  | s, [] => s
  | s, op :: ops => kernelRun (opEff3 op s) ops

/-- Initial state of a translated run (§47, `repr_init`). -/
def sinit (statics : Statics) (π : Params Unit) : S3 × Machine.State :=
  (S3.init statics, run Machine.State.empty (initOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok π.L π.ty π.ival statics))

/-- Written representation of the runs: byte `i` of leaf `l` is `10 l + i`, no provenance
(§10 ¶4). -/
def wv : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat := fun l i => ((10 * l + i).toUInt8, none)

/-- Address decoded from the range of leaf `l` (§82.3). -/
def decodedAt (π : Params Unit) (s2 : Machine.State) (l : Nat) : Nat :=
  π.pe.decode (bytesOf s2 π.L l)

/-- Under `StaticsOK` (§47), a successful translated run from `S3.init statics` gives the
conclusions of `simulation` for its final states (§82 preamble). -/
theorem sim_of {statics : Statics} {π : Params Unit} {ops : List KOp}
    (hπ : ParamsOK (· = ·) π) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hlay : NewLayout π.L (S3.init statics).P 0 0 π.geom (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))
    (hob : OblAlong obR obW (run Machine.State.empty (allocOps (Ty := Unit) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0
      Machine.State.empty (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) (writeOps (run Machine.State.empty
        (allocOps (Ty := Unit) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0 Machine.State.empty
          (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) π.L π.ty π.ival (initLeaves statics)))
    (h : (srun K0 (· = ·) obR obW π (sinit statics π) ops).isSome = true) :
    (∃ os, Machine.Exec (· = ·) obR obW os Machine.State.empty
      ((srun K0 (· = ·) obR obW π (sinit statics π) ops).getD (sinit statics π)).2) ∧
    Repr π.L π.rtok ((srun K0 (· = ·) obR obW π (sinit statics π) ops).getD (sinit statics π)).1
      ((srun K0 (· = ·) obR obW π (sinit statics π) ops).getD (sinit statics π)).2 ∧
    Access.Reachable K0 statics
      ((srun K0 (· = ·) obR obW π (sinit statics π) ops).getD (sinit statics π)).1 :=
  simulation (fun _ _ h => h.elim) hπ
    (srun_sound ops (sinit statics π) _ (.init hst hlay hob) (some_getD _ h))

/-! ### A run through most kernel operations -/

/-- One static leaf `0`, `Init` (§47). -/
def stD : Statics := [((none, none, 0), true)]

/-- The operations of the run (§60–§75): frame 1 with locals 1, 2, 3; write and pin of 1, unpin of
the obligation 0 installed by that pin (§74, §75); storage 4 allocated from provider 1 for owner 2;
transfer of 1 into 3, end of use of 1, shared write of 1, dependency of 3 on the root of 1;
authority 5 derived from the root of 4, written, read, stored in 3, released; 4 freed; exit of
frame 1. -/
def opsD : List KOp :=
  [.enter [] [(none, 0), (none, 0), (none, 0)], .write 1 [1] wv, .pin 1, .unpin 0,
   .alloc 1 2 [(none, 0)], .transfer 1 3, .endUse 1, .writeShared 1 [1] wv, .depend 3 1,
   .derive 4 [4] .modify, .write 5 [4] wv, .read 5 [4], .store 5 3, .release 5, .free 4 104,
   .exit]

/-- Parameters of the run, fixed once from its final places (§82). -/
def πD : Params Unit := piOf (kernelRun (S3.init stD) opsD).P []

/-- Final kernel and memory states of the run (§82). -/
def finD : S3 × Machine.State :=
  (srun K0 (· = ·) obR obW πD (sinit stD πD) opsD).getD (sinit stD πD)

/-- Every step of the run passes its preconditions (§60–§75) and obligations (§82). -/
theorem runD_ok : (srun K0 (· = ·) obR obW πD (sinit stD πD) opsD).isSome = true := by decide

/-- Non-vacuity of the refinement (§82, `formal/DESIGN.md` "Layout interface"): the run of 16
kernel steps is translated into an execution of `ok` raw steps from the empty state, `Repr` holds
at its end (so the test layout satisfies `LayoutWF` and the parameters `ParamsOK`), and the final
kernel state is reachable. The allocation of the freed storage 4 and the automatic storage of
locals 1, 2, 3 are dead; the static allocation is live (§70, §73, §82.5). -/
theorem runD_sim :
    ((∃ os, Machine.Exec (· = ·) obR obW os Machine.State.empty finD.2) ∧
      Repr πD.L πD.rtok finD.1 finD.2 ∧ Access.Reachable K0 stD finD.1) ∧
    ParamsOK (· = ·) πD ∧ LayoutWF πD.L finD.1 finD.2 ∧ finD.1.P.length = 5 ∧
    (finD.2.allocs (πD.L 4).alloc).map (·.live) = some false ∧
    (∀ r ∈ [1, 2, 3], (finD.2.allocs (πD.L r).alloc).map (·.live) = some false) ∧
    (finD.2.allocs (πD.L 0).alloc).map (·.live) = some true := by
  have h := sim_of (piOf_ok _ []) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) runD_ok
  exact ⟨h, piOf_ok _ [], h.2.1.layout, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

/-! ### Zero physical size (§71.1, §82.4) -/

/-- A run allocating storage of zero physical size, laid out as a one-leaf shape of size zero
(§71.1): frame 1 with locals 0, 1; storage 2 allocated from provider 0 for owner 1. -/
def opsZ : List KOp :=
  [.enter [] [(none, 0), (none, 0)], .write 0 [0] wv, .alloc 0 1 [(none, 0)], .exit]

/-- Parameters of the run, storage 2 of size zero (§71.1). -/
def πZ : Params Unit := piOf (kernelRun (S3.init []) opsZ).P [2]

/-- Final states of the run (§82). -/
def finZ : S3 × Machine.State := (srun K0 (· = ·) obR obW πZ (sinit [] πZ) opsZ).getD (sinit [] πZ)

/-- Every step of the run passes its checks (§60–§75, §82). -/
theorem runZ_ok : (srun K0 (· = ·) obR obW πZ (sinit [] πZ) opsZ).isSome = true := by decide

/-- The zero-physical-size case (§82.4, §71.1, §9 ¶3): `alloc` of a one-leaf shape is realized by
one creation of an allocation of size zero, `ok`, and the run is in `Repr`. -/
theorem runZ_sim :
    ((∃ os, Machine.Exec (· = ·) obR obW os Machine.State.empty finZ.2) ∧
      Repr πZ.L πZ.rtok finZ.1 finZ.2 ∧ Access.Reachable K0 [] finZ.1) ∧
    (finZ.2.allocs (πZ.L 2).alloc).map (·.size) = some 0 ∧ (πZ.L 2).len = 0 :=
  ⟨sim_of (piOf_ok _ [2]) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) runZ_ok, by decide, by decide⟩

/-! ### Corpus case H15: references to empty regions (§82.2, last sentence) -/

/-- The run of corpus case H15 with the library `issue` replaced by its kernel realization
(§82.3; Part XIV preamble: `split` then `store`): frame 1 with locals 0–4; storage 5 with leaf 6,
owned by 0, allocated from provider 1 (its root authority 5 plays `internal`); `split(5, [[]])`
then `store(6, 2)` (an empty block into leaf 2); `split(3, [[]])` then `store(7, 4)`. -/
def ops15 : List KOp :=
  [.enter [] [(none, 0), (none, 0), (none, 0), (none, 0), (none, 0)], .write 1 [1] wv,
   .alloc 1 0 [(none, 0), (some 5, 0)], .split 5 [[]], .store 6 2, .split 3 [[]], .store 7 4]

/-- Parameters of the run, fixed once from its final places (§82). -/
def π15 : Params Unit := piOf (kernelRun (S3.init []) ops15).P []

/-- Final states of the run (§82). -/
def fin15 : S3 × Machine.State :=
  (srun K0 (· = ·) obR obW π15 (sinit [] π15) ops15).getD (sinit [] π15)

/-- Every step of the run passes its checks (§60–§75, §82). -/
theorem run15_ok : (srun K0 (· = ·) obR obW π15 (sinit [] π15) ops15).isSome = true := by decide

/-- **Corpus case H15** (§82.2, last sentence): a reference to an empty region has as
address the base of the allocation of the effective anchor of its authority and as provenance
that allocation. Leaf 2 holds the empty block split from the root of storage 5: it decodes to the
base of the allocation of 5, every byte carries that allocation. Leaf 4 holds the empty region
split from the root of local 3: it decodes to the base of the allocation of 3, with that
provenance. Both bases are nonzero. The run is translated with `Repr`. -/
theorem H15 :
    ((∃ os, Machine.Exec (· = ·) obR obW os Machine.State.empty fin15.2) ∧
      Repr π15.L π15.rtok fin15.1 fin15.2 ∧ Access.Reachable K0 [] fin15.1) ∧
    decodedAt π15 fin15.2 2 = baseOf fin15.2 (π15.L 5).alloc ∧
    (∀ i < 8, (bytesOf fin15.2 π15.L 2 i).2 = some (π15.L 5).alloc) ∧
    baseOf fin15.2 (π15.L 5).alloc ≠ 0 ∧
    decodedAt π15 fin15.2 4 = baseOf fin15.2 (π15.L 3).alloc ∧
    (∀ i < 8, (bytesOf fin15.2 π15.L 4 i).2 = some (π15.L 3).alloc) ∧
    baseOf fin15.2 (π15.L 3).alloc ≠ 0 :=
  ⟨sim_of (piOf_ok _ []) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) run15_ok, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

/-! ### Corpus case H16: lowest address of a region (lowest-address rule, reference realization)
-/

/-- The run of corpus case H16 with `issue` replaced by `split` then `store` (§82.3, Part XIV):
frame 1 with locals 0, 1, 2; storage 3 with leaves 4 (offset 0) and 5 (offset 8), owned by 0;
`split(3, [[5, 4]])` then `store(4, 2)`. -/
def ops16 : List KOp :=
  [.enter [] [(none, 0), (none, 0), (none, 0)], .write 1 [1] wv,
   .alloc 1 0 [(none, 0), (some 3, 0), (some 3, 0)], .split 3 [[5, 4]], .store 4 2]

/-- Parameters of the run, fixed once from its final places (§82). -/
def π16 : Params Unit := piOf (kernelRun (S3.init []) ops16).P []

/-- Final states of the run (§82). -/
def fin16 : S3 × Machine.State :=
  (srun K0 (· = ·) obR obW π16 (sinit [] π16) ops16).getD (sinit [] π16)

/-- Every step of the run passes its checks (§60–§75, §82). -/
theorem run16_ok : (srun K0 (· = ·) obR obW π16 (sinit [] π16) ops16).isSome = true := by decide

/-- **Corpus case H16** (lowest-address rule, a non-normative reference realization; Spec 8 and
Spec 11, §81): the reference to the region `[5, 4]`, whose first listed leaf is not the lowest, has the
lowest address among its leaves of nonzero size, that of leaf 4 (offset 0), not that of the head 5
(offset 8); its provenance is the storage allocation. The run is translated with `Repr`. -/
theorem H16 :
    ((∃ os, Machine.Exec (· = ·) obR obW os Machine.State.empty fin16.2) ∧
      Repr π16.L π16.rtok fin16.1 fin16.2 ∧ Access.Reachable K0 [] fin16.1) ∧
    (π16.L 4).off = 0 ∧ (π16.L 5).off = 8 ∧
    decodedAt π16 fin16.2 2 = baseOf fin16.2 (π16.L 3).alloc ∧
    decodedAt π16 fin16.2 2 ≠ baseOf fin16.2 (π16.L 3).alloc + 8 ∧
    (∀ i < 8, (bytesOf fin16.2 π16.L 2 i).2 = some (π16.L 3).alloc) :=
  ⟨sim_of (piOf_ok _ []) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) run16_ok, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

/-! ### A nonempty region whose leaves all have size zero (§82.2, §71.1) -/

/-- Frame 1 with locals 0, 1, 2; storage 3 of zero physical size (§71.1), owned by 1, allocated
from provider 0; `split(3, [[3]])` gives authority 4 on the nonempty region `[3]` (§61);
`store(4, 2)` writes the reference into leaf 2 (§65). `split` then `store` is how the derived
`issue` is realized (Part XIV). -/
def opsU : List KOp :=
  [.enter [] [(none, 0), (none, 0), (none, 0)], .write 0 [0] wv, .alloc 0 1 [(none, 0)],
   .split 3 [[3]], .store 4 2]

/-- Parameters of the run, fixed once from its final places, storage 3 of size zero (§71.1,
§82). -/
def πU : Params Unit := piOf (kernelRun (S3.init []) opsU).P [3]

/-- Final states of the run (§82). -/
def finU : S3 × Machine.State :=
  (srun K0 (· = ·) obR obW πU (sinit [] πU) opsU).getD (sinit [] πU)

/-- Every step of the run passes its checks (§60–§75, §82). -/
theorem runU_ok : (srun K0 (· = ·) obR obW πU (sinit [] πU) opsU).isSome = true := by decide

/-- **A reference to a nonempty region whose leaves all have zero physical size** (§82.2, last
sentence; §71.1, §65). The run, whose last step stores authority 4 on the region `[3]` into leaf
2, is translated with `Repr`, and its final kernel state is reachable. The region is nonempty and
its only leaf has size zero; the reference has as address the base of the allocation of the
effective anchor (the root authority of storage 3), a nonzero address, and every byte carries
that allocation as provenance. -/
theorem store_zero_size_decided :
    ((∃ os, Machine.Exec (· = ·) obR obW os Machine.State.empty finU.2) ∧
      Repr πU.L πU.rtok finU.1 finU.2 ∧ Access.Reachable K0 [] finU.1) ∧
    finU.1.afp 4 = [3] ∧ (πU.L 3).len = 0 ∧
    decodedAt πU finU.2 2 = baseOf finU.2 (πU.L 3).alloc ∧
    (∀ i < 8, (bytesOf finU.2 πU.L 2 i).2 = some (πU.L 3).alloc) ∧
    baseOf finU.2 (πU.L 3).alloc ≠ 0 :=
  ⟨sim_of (piOf_ok _ [3]) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) runU_ok, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

end Runs

/-- Same footprint, read as two inclusions of lists (§49.6, §49.7). -/
def SameFp (s : S3) (fp : List Nat) (r : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ l ∈ fp, l ∈ footprint s.P r) ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P r, l ∈ fp

/-- Decidability of `SameFp` (§49.6). -/
instance (s : S3) (fp : List Nat) (r : Nat) : Decidable (SameFp s fp r) := by
  unfold SameFp; infer_instance

/-- Bounded §49.2 (§49). -/
def PlacesCheck (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ q < s.P.length, OptP (s.P[q]?) (fun pl => OptP pl.parent (fun r => OptP (s.P[r]?)
    (fun pr => r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q) False) True) True

/-- Bounded §49.3, first two parts (§49). -/
def OwnersCheck (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ q < s.P.length, OptP (s.P[q]?) (fun pl => OwnerOK s pl.owner) True

/-- Bounded §49.4 (§49). -/
def FootprintsCheck (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ a < s.A.length, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun x => ∀ l ∈ x.footprint, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l)
    True

/-- Bounded §49.5 (§49). -/
def OriginsCheck (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ b < s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => OptP y.origin (fun a => a < b) True) True

/-- Root of the chain of an authority covering a leaf (§49.6). -/
def ChainRoot (s : S3) (l x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun z => z.origin = none ∧ ∃ r < s.P.length, RootPlace s.P r ∧ partOf s.P l r ∧
    SameFp s z.footprint r) False

/-- Decidability of `ChainRoot` (§49.6). -/
instance (s : S3) (l x : Nat) : Decidable (ChainRoot s l x) := by
  unfold ChainRoot; infer_instance

/-- Bounded §49.6 `RootChain` (§49). -/
def RootChainCheck (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ a < s.A.length, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => ∀ l ∈ y.footprint, isLeaf s.P l →
    ∃ x ∈ a :: s.ancs a, ChainRoot s l x) True

/-- Root authority of a root place (§49.7). -/
def RootAuthOf (s : S3) (r i : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[i]?) (fun z => z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ z.mode = .modify ∧
    OptP (s.P[r]?) (fun pr => z.holder = pr.owner) False ∧ SameFp s z.footprint r) False

/-- Decidability of `RootAuthOf` (§49.7). -/
instance (s : S3) (r i : Nat) : Decidable (RootAuthOf s r i) := by
  unfold RootAuthOf; infer_instance

/-- Bounded §49.7 `RootHeld` (§49). -/
def RootHeldCheck (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ r < s.P.length, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ i < s.A.length, RootAuthOf s r i

/-- Bounded §49.8 (§49). -/
def HoldersCheck (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ a < s.A.length, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true → HolderLive s y.holder) True

/-- Bounded `WF3` (§49). -/
def WF3Check (s : S3) : Prop :=
  (s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF) ∧ PlacesCheck s ∧ OwnersCheck s ∧
    FootprintsCheck s ∧ OriginsCheck s ∧ RootChainCheck s ∧ RootHeldCheck s ∧ HoldersCheck s

/-- An authority covers no leaf of an unusable place (§54). -/
def CoversUsable (s : S3) (y : Authority) : Prop :=
  ∀ q < s.P.length, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint

/-- Decidability of `CoversUsable` (§54). -/
instance (s : S3) (y : Authority) : Decidable (CoversUsable s y) := by
  unfold CoversUsable; infer_instance

/-- Bounded `NoDangling` (§54). -/
def NoDanglingCheck (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ j < s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → CoversUsable s y) True

/-- Decidability of the bounded clauses (§49, §54). -/
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (PlacesCheck s) := by unfold PlacesCheck; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of the bounded clauses (§49). -/
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (OwnersCheck s) := by unfold OwnersCheck; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of the bounded clauses (§49). -/
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (FootprintsCheck s) := by unfold FootprintsCheck; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of the bounded clauses (§49). -/
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (OriginsCheck s) := by unfold OriginsCheck; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of the bounded clauses (§49). -/
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (RootChainCheck s) := by unfold RootChainCheck; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of the bounded clauses (§49). -/
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (RootHeldCheck s) := by unfold RootHeldCheck; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of the bounded clauses (§49). -/
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (HoldersCheck s) := by unfold HoldersCheck; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of the bounded clauses (§49). -/
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (WF3Check s) := by unfold WF3Check; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of the bounded clauses (§54). -/
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (NoDanglingCheck s) := by unfold NoDanglingCheck; infer_instance

/-- The bounded check implies `WF3` (§49). -/
theorem wf3_of_check {s : S3} (h : WF3Check s) : WF3 s := by
  obtain ⟨hF, hPl, hOw, hFp, hOr, hRC, hRH, hHo⟩ := h
  refine ⟨hF, fun q pl r hq hp => ?_, ⟨fun q pl f hq ho => ?_, fun q pl o hq ho => ?_,
    fun q hu => hu.frameOf⟩, fun a x ha => optP_of ha (hFp a (lt_of_getElem? ha)),
    fun b y a hb ho => ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 := optP_of hq (hPl q (lt_of_getElem? hq))
    have := optP_of hp h1
    cases hr : s.P[r]? with
    | none => rw [hr] at this; exact this.elim
    | some pr => rw [hr] at this; exact ⟨pr, rfl, this⟩
  · have := optP_of hq (hOw q (lt_of_getElem? hq)); rw [ho] at this; exact this
  · have := optP_of hq (hOw q (lt_of_getElem? hq)); rw [ho] at this; exact this
  · have h1 := optP_of hb (hOr b (lt_of_getElem? hb))
    exact optP_of (P := fun a' => a' < b) ho h1
  · intro a y l ha hl hlf
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hc⟩ := optP_of ha (hRC a (lt_of_getElem? ha)) l hl hlf
    unfold ChainRoot at hc
    cases hz : s.A[x]? with
    | none => rw [hz] at hc; exact hc.elim
    | some z =>
      obtain ⟨hzo, r, -, hr, hlr, hf1, hf2⟩ := optP_of hz hc
      exact ⟨x, z, r, List.mem_cons.1 hx, hz, hzo, hr, hlr, fun l' => ⟨hf1 l', hf2 l'⟩⟩
  · intro r hr hu
    obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := hRH r hr.1 hr hu
    unfold RootAuthOf at hi
    cases hz : s.A[i]? with
    | none => rw [hz] at hi; exact hi.elim
    | some z =>
      obtain ⟨za, zo, zm, hh, hf1, hf2⟩ := optP_of hz hi
      cases hpr : s.P[r]? with
      | none => rw [hpr] at hh; exact hh.elim
      | some pr =>
        have h2 : z.holder = pr.owner := by rw [hpr] at hh; exact hh
        exact ⟨i, z, pr, hz, za, zo, zm, rfl, h2, fun l' => ⟨hf1 l', hf2 l'⟩⟩
  · intro a y ha ya
    exact optP_of ha (hHo a (lt_of_getElem? ha)) ya

/-- A place whose footprint is nonempty exists (§40). -/
theorem lt_of_mem_footprint {P : List Place} {q l : Nat} (h : l ∈ footprint P q) :
    q < P.length := by
  obtain ⟨hlP, -, -, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 h
  rcases hlq with rfl | hlq
  · exact hlP
  · exact Nat.lt_trans (chain_lt hlq) hlP

/-- The bounded check implies `NoDangling` (§54). -/
theorem noDangling_of_check {s : S3} (h : NoDanglingCheck s) : NoDangling s := by
  intro j y hy ya q hq l hl hly
  exact optP_of hy (h j (lt_of_getElem? hy)) ya q (lt_of_mem_footprint hl) hq l hl hly

/-- Decidability of `FreeCompatInst` (§70.2, §82.4). -/
instance (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) [DecidableRel C] (rtok : Nat → Nat) (p auth : Nat) :
    Decidable (FreeCompatInst C rtok p auth) := by
  unfold FreeCompatInst; infer_instance

5	/-!
6	# Refinement of the derived arena operations into the memory machine (spec v0.1, §82.7)
7	
8	Source: `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`, §82.7 with Part XIV (§76–§78), the §82
9	preamble, §82.2–§82.5 and §86.
10	
11	* Library operations (`LOp`) and their `ok` steps (`LOpStep`): the kernel operations O1–O16 and
12	  the derived arena operations O17–O19 of `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena`.
13	* The kernel steps realizing a library step (`kexp`, `kexp_path`, Part XIV): none for `newArena`,
14	  `split` then `store` for `issue`, `derive` then `release` for `reset`. The raw operations of a
15	  library step (`lopsOf`) are the raw operations of these kernel steps (`ktrace`).
16	* Per derived operation: realization, reads, writes and lifetimes (`arena_newArena`,
17	  `arena_issue`, `arena_reset`, `reset_split`, `issue_pointer_sound`); the bytes of an issued
18	  region are unchanged by the realization of `issue` (`issue_keeps_bytes`, §86). Theorems with
19	  invariant hypotheses on their pre-state have a `_reachable` corollary without them (§57).
20	* Library runs translated into the memory machine with parameters fixed once per run
21	  (`LSimRun`), with no invariant hypothesis: every such run is a kernel simulation run
22	  (`LSimRun.simRun`); `lsimulation`.
23	* §82.7: the machine trace of a library run is the trace of its kernel steps, and no kernel step
24	  after a legal `reset` uses an authority that the `reset` invalidated (`arena_realized`).
25	
26	The sequential fragment only (§18, §29): no theorem here says anything about concurrency.
27	-/
28	
29	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.RefinementArena
30	
31	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement Ern.MemoryModel.Arena
32	
33	/-! ## Library operations and their kernel steps (Part XIV) -/
34	
35	/-- An operation of a library run (Part XIV): a kernel operation O1–O16 of non-administrative
36	code (§60–§75), or one of the derived arena operations O17–O19 (§76–§78). -/
37	inductive LOp where
38	  /-- A kernel operation O1–O16 (§60–§75). -/
39	  | kernel (op : KOp)
40	  /-- O17 `newArena(storage, internal)` (§76); `others` are the other registries of live
41	  administrations consulted by the guard (§56, §76.4). -/
42	  | newArena (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat)
43	  /-- O18 `issue(arena, region, destination)` of entry `i` (§77). -/
44	  | issue (i : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat)
45	  /-- O19 `reset(arena)` of entry `i` (§78). -/
46	  | reset (i : Nat)
47	
48	/-- The `ok` step of a library operation (Part XIV, §58): a kernel step leaves the registry
49	unchanged (§46); the arena operations are the derived operations (`NewArenaStep`, `IssueD`,
50	`ResetD`). -/
51	def LOpStep (k : K) : LOp → LState → LState → Prop
52	  | .kernel op, L, L' => OpStep k op L.kern L'.kern ∧ L'.arenas = L.arenas
53	  | .newArena others st i, L, L' => NewArenaStep others st i L (.ok L')
54	  | .issue i region dst, L, L' => IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L')
55	  | .reset i, L, L' => ResetD i L (.ok L')
56	
57	/-- A labelled library step is a library step (Part XIV, §76–§78). -/
58	theorem LOpStep.lstep {k : K} {lop : LOp} {L L' : LState} (h : LOpStep k lop L L') :
59	    LStep k L L' := by
60	  cases lop with
61	  | kernel op =>
62	    have h' : OpStep k op L.kern L'.kern ∧ L'.arenas = L.arenas := h
63	    obtain ⟨s', ar⟩ := L'
64	    obtain ⟨hs, ha⟩ := h'
65	    dsimp only at hs ha
66	    subst ha
67	    exact .kernel hs.kstep
68	  | newArena => exact .newArena h
69	  | issue => exact .issue h
70	  | reset => exact .reset h
71	
72	/-- Every kernel step is the `ok` step of a kernel operation (§57, §58); the representations
73	carried by `write` and `writeShared` are not read by the kernel (§10 ¶4). -/
74	theorem kstep_labelled {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KStep k s s') : ∃ op, OpStep k op s s' := by
75	  cases h with
76	  | derive h => exact ⟨.derive _ _ _, h⟩
77	  | split h => exact ⟨.split _ _, h⟩
78	  | release h => exact ⟨.release _, h⟩
79	  | transfer h => exact ⟨.transfer _ _, h⟩
80	  | depend h => exact ⟨.depend _ _, h⟩
81	  | enter h => exact ⟨.enter _ _, h⟩
82	  | exit h => exact ⟨.exit, h⟩
83	  | read h => exact ⟨.read _ _, h⟩
84	  | write h => exact ⟨.write _ _ fun _ _ => (0, none), h⟩
85	  | writeShared h => exact ⟨.writeShared _ _ fun _ _ => (0, none), h⟩
86	  | pin h => exact ⟨.pin _, h⟩
87	  | unpin h => exact ⟨.unpin _, h⟩
88	  | endUse h => exact ⟨.endUse _, h⟩
89	  | free h => exact ⟨.free _ _, h⟩
90	  | alloc h => exact ⟨.alloc _ _ _, h⟩
91	  | store h => exact ⟨.store _ _, h⟩
92	
93	/-- Every library step is the `ok` step of a library operation (Part XIV, §76–§78): labelled
94	steps cover all library runs. -/
95	theorem LStep.labelled {k : K} {L L' : LState} (h : LStep k L L') : ∃ lop, LOpStep k lop L L' := by
96	  cases h with
97	  | kernel hk =>
98	    obtain ⟨op, h⟩ := kstep_labelled hk
99	    exact ⟨.kernel op, h, rfl⟩
100	  | newArena hs => exact ⟨.newArena _ _ _, hs⟩
101	  | issue hs => exact ⟨.issue _ _ _, hs⟩
102	  | reset hs => exact ⟨.reset _, hs⟩
103	
104	/-- The kernel steps realizing a library operation from `L`, each with the kernel state it starts
105	from (Part XIV, §82.7): a kernel operation is its own step; `newArena` has none (§76: it registers
106	an administration without modifying the kernel); `issue` is `split` of `internal` on the region,
107	then `store` of the block, of fresh identity `|A|`, into the destination (§77); `reset` is
108	`derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the storage, then `release` of the derived authority `|A|`
109	(§78). Without an entry, there is no step. -/
110	def kexp : LOp → LState → List (KOp × S3)
111	  | .kernel op, L => [(op, L.kern)]
112	  | .newArena .., _ => []
113	  | .issue i region dst, L => match L.arenas[i]? with
114	    | some E => [(.split E.internal [region], L.kern),
115	        (.store L.kern.A.length dst, splitEff L.kern E.internal [region])]
116	    | none => []
117	  | .reset i, L => match L.arenas[i]? with
118	    | some E => [(.derive E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify, L.kern),
119	        (.release L.kern.A.length,
120	          deriveEff L.kern E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify)]
121	    | none => []
122	
123	/-- A sequence of `ok` kernel steps (§57, §58), each listed with the state it starts from. -/
124	inductive KPath (k : K) : S3 → List (KOp × S3) → S3 → Prop where
125	  | nil (s : S3) : KPath k s [] s
126	  | cons {op : KOp} {s s₁ s' : S3} {t : List (KOp × S3)} :
127	      OpStep k op s s₁ → KPath k s₁ t s' → KPath k s ((op, s) :: t) s'
128	
129	/-- §82.7 (realization by O1–O16; Part XIV): every `ok` library step is the sequence of its
130	kernel steps `kexp`, from the kernel state before it to the kernel state after it. -/
131	theorem kexp_path {k : K} {lop : LOp} {L L' : LState} (h : LOpStep k lop L L') :
132	    KPath k L.kern (kexp lop L) L'.kern := by
133	  cases lop with
134	  | kernel op => exact .cons h.1 (.nil _)
135	  | newArena others st i =>
136	    rw [newArena_kernel (show NewArenaStep others st i L (.ok L') from h)]
137	    exact .nil _
138	  | issue i region dst =>
139	    have h' : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L') := h
140	    cases h' with
141	    | ok hE _ _ hsp hst =>
142	      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp
143	      simp only [kexp, hE]
144	      exact .cons hsp (.cons hst (.nil _))
145	  | reset i =>
146	    have h' : ResetD i L (.ok L') := h
147	    cases h' with
148	    | ok hE hd hrl _ =>
149	      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd
150	      simp only [kexp, hE]
151	      exact .cons hd (.cons hrl (.nil _))
152	
153	/-- The steps of a kernel sequence keep the authorities of its first state (§42, §58), and each
154	is an `ok` step from the state listed with it. -/
155	theorem KPath.mem {k : K} {s s' : S3} {t : List (KOp × S3)} (hp : KPath k s t s') :
156	    ∀ q ∈ t, AKeep s q.2 ∧ ∃ s₁, OpStep k q.1 q.2 s₁ := by
157	  induction hp with
158	  | nil => intro q hq; cases hq
159	  | cons h _ ih =>
160	    intro q hq
161	    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hq with rfl | hq
162	    · exact ⟨akeep_of_eq rfl, _, h⟩
163	    · obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := ih q hq
164	      exact ⟨(kstep_akeep h.kstep).trans hk, hs⟩
165	
166	/-- The steps of a kernel sequence from a reachable state start from reachable states (§57,
167	§58). -/
168	theorem KPath.reach {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s s' : S3} {t : List (KOp × S3)}
169	    (hp : KPath k s t s') (hr : Reachable k statics s) : ∀ q ∈ t, Reachable k statics q.2 := by
170	  induction hp with
171	  | nil => intro q hq; cases hq
172	  | cons h _ ih =>
173	    intro q hq
174	    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hq with rfl | hq
175	    · exact hr
176	    · exact ih (hr.step h.kstep) q hq
177	
178	/-- The kernel steps of a library step start from states satisfying `WF3` and `NoDangling` when
179	the library state does (§49, §54): the states after `split` and after `derive` keep both
180	(§60, §61). -/
181	theorem kexp_inv {k : K} {lop : LOp} {L L' : LState} (h : LOpStep k lop L L') (hw : WF3 L.kern)
182	    (hnd : NoDangling L.kern) : ∀ q ∈ kexp lop L, WF3 q.2 ∧ NoDangling q.2 := by
183	  cases lop with
184	  | kernel op =>
185	    intro q hq
186	    rw [kexp, List.mem_singleton] at hq
187	    subst hq
188	    exact ⟨hw, hnd⟩
189	  | newArena => intro q hq; cases hq
190	  | issue i region dst =>
191	    have h' : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L') := h
192	    cases h' with
193	    | ok hE _ _ hsp _ =>
194	      have e := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp).2
195	      subst e
196	      intro q hq
197	      simp only [kexp, hE, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hq
198	      rcases hq with rfl | rfl
199	      · exact ⟨hw, hnd⟩
200	      · exact ⟨split_preserves_wf3 hw hsp, split_preserves_noDangling hnd hsp⟩
201	  | reset i =>
202	    have h' : ResetD i L (.ok L') := h
203	    cases h' with
204	    | ok hE hd _ _ =>
205	      have e := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd).2
206	      subst e
207	      intro q hq
208	      simp only [kexp, hE, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hq
209	      rcases hq with rfl | rfl
210	      · exact ⟨hw, hnd⟩
211	      · exact ⟨derive_preserves_wf3 hw hd, derive_preserves_noDangling hnd hd⟩
212	
213	/-! ## Raw operations of library steps (§82 preamble, §82.7) -/
214	
215	section Trace
216	
217	variable {Ty : Type}
218	
219	/-- The raw operations realizing a sequence of kernel steps (§82 preamble, §20.3): the raw
220	operations `opsOf` of each step, in the memory state reached by the previous ones. -/
221	def ktrace (π : Params Ty) : List (KOp × S3) → Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty)
222	  | [], _ => []
223	  | (op, s3) :: t, s2 => opsOf π op s3 s2 ++ ktrace π t (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2))
224	
225	/-- The raw operations realizing a library step (§82.7): those of its kernel steps. -/
226	def lopsOf (π : Params Ty) (lop : LOp) (L : LState) (s2 : Machine.State) : List (Machine.Op Ty) :=
227	  ktrace π (kexp lop L) s2
228	
229	/-- The raw operations of composed kernel sequences are composed (§20.3 ¶3). -/
230	theorem ktrace_append (π : Params Ty) (t t' : List (KOp × S3)) (s2 : Machine.State) :
231	    ktrace π (t ++ t') s2 = ktrace π t s2 ++ ktrace π t' (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) := by
232	  induction t generalizing s2 with
233	  | nil => rfl
234	  | cons p t ih =>
235	    obtain ⟨op, s3⟩ := p
236	    simp only [List.cons_append, ktrace, ih, run_append, List.append_assoc]
237	
238	/-- The obligations of each kernel step of a sequence (§20.3, §82; `StepObl`), in the memory
239	state reached by the previous ones. -/
240	def KObl (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
241	    (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (π : Params Ty) : List (KOp × S3) → Machine.State → Prop
242	  | [], _ => True
243	  | (op, s3) :: t, s2 =>
244	    StepObl k C ObR ObW π op s3 s2 ∧ KObl k C ObR ObW π t (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2))
245	
246	/-- The memory state realizing the initial state (§47, §82 preamble; `repr_init`): the creations
247	of the static allocations, then the writes of the static leaves declared `Init`. -/
248	def minit (π : Params Ty) (statics : Statics) : Machine.State :=
249	  run Machine.State.empty (initOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok π.L π.ty π.ival statics)
250	
251	end Trace
252	
253	/-- Realization of a kernel sequence (§82 preamble, R6 of each step): from states satisfying
254	`WF3` and `NoDangling`, under the obligations of each step, the raw operations of the sequence
255	form an execution of `ok` raw steps and `Repr` holds after it. -/
256	theorem r6_path {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
257	    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty} (hπ : ParamsOK C π) {s3 s3' : S3}
258	    {t : List (KOp × S3)} (hp : KPath k s3 t s3') :
259	    ∀ {s2 : Machine.State}, (∀ q ∈ t, WF3 q.2 ∧ NoDangling q.2) → KObl k C ObR ObW π t s2 →
260	      Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok s3 s2 →
261	      Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (ktrace π t s2) s2 (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) ∧
262	        Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok s3' (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) := by
263	  induction hp with
264	  | nil => intro s2 _ _ hR; exact ⟨.nil _, hR⟩
265	  | cons h _ ih =>
266	    intro s2 hinv hob hR
267	    obtain ⟨hw, hnd⟩ := hinv _ (List.mem_cons_self ..)
268	    obtain ⟨hob₁, hob₂⟩ := hob
269	    obtain ⟨hex, hR₁⟩ := r6 hπ hR hw hnd h hob₁
270	    obtain ⟨hex', hR'⟩ := ih (fun q hq => hinv q (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hq)) hob₂ hR₁
271	    simp only [ktrace]
272	    rw [run_append]
273	    exact ⟨exec_append hex hex', hR'⟩
274	
275	/-- Realization of a library step (§82.7, §82 preamble): from a library state whose kernel
276	state satisfies `WF3` and `NoDangling`, under the obligations of its kernel steps, the raw
277	operations of an `ok` library step form an execution of `ok` raw steps and `Repr` holds after
278	it. -/
279	theorem lr6 {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
280	    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty} {lop : LOp} {L L' : LState}
281	    {s2 : Machine.State} (hπ : ParamsOK C π) (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2)
282	    (hw : WF3 L.kern) (hnd : NoDangling L.kern) (h : LOpStep k lop L L')
283	    (hob : KObl k C ObR ObW π (kexp lop L) s2) :
284	    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (lopsOf π lop L s2) s2 (run s2 (lopsOf π lop L s2)) ∧
285	      Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L'.kern (run s2 (lopsOf π lop L s2)) :=
286	  r6_path hπ (kexp_path h) (kexp_inv h hw hnd) hob hR
287	
288	/-- Realization of a kernel sequence from a reachable state (§82 preamble, §57): `r6_path` without
289	invariant hypothesis, under `DDSound(K)` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47); every step of the sequence
290	starts from a reachable state (`KPath.reach`), where `WF3` and `NoDangling` hold
291	(`Access.reachable_kinv`). -/
292	theorem r6_path_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
293	    {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty}
294	    (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics) (hπ : ParamsOK C π) {s3 s3' : S3}
295	    {t : List (KOp × S3)} (hp : KPath k s3 t s3') (hr : Reachable k statics s3)
296	    {s2 : Machine.State} (hob : KObl k C ObR ObW π t s2)
297	    (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok s3 s2) :
298	    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (ktrace π t s2) s2 (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) ∧
299	      Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok s3' (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) :=
300	  r6_path hπ hp (fun q hq =>
301	    have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst (hp.reach hr q hq)
302	    ⟨hk.1, hk.2.1.2.2⟩) hob hR
303	
304	/-- Realization of a library step from a library-reachable state (§82.7, §82 preamble, §57):
305	`lr6` without invariant hypothesis, under `DDSound(K)` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
306	theorem lr6_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
307	    {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty} {lop : LOp}
308	    {L L' : LState} {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
309	    (hL : LReach k statics L) (hπ : ParamsOK C π) (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2)
310	    (h : LOpStep k lop L L') (hob : KObl k C ObR ObW π (kexp lop L) s2) :
311	    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (lopsOf π lop L s2) s2 (run s2 (lopsOf π lop L s2)) ∧
312	      Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L'.kern (run s2 (lopsOf π lop L s2)) :=
313	  r6_path_reachable hdd hst hπ (kexp_path h) hL.ng.reachable hob hR
314	
315	/-! ## R4 transported by the derived operations (§82.5, §54) -/
316	
317	/-- The conclusion of R4 (`r4_no_dead_cover`, §82.5, §54): every leaf covered by an active
318	authority of `s3` is an existing leaf whose allocation in `s2` is live and contains its range. -/
319	def LiveCover (L : Layout) (s3 : S3) (s2 : Machine.State) : Prop :=
320	  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s3.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true → ∀ l ∈ y.footprint,
321	    l < s3.P.length ∧ isLeaf s3.P l ∧
322	      AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => a.live = true ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ a.size
323	
324	/-- R4 (§82.5, §54): `Repr`, `WF3` and `NoDangling` give `LiveCover` (`r4_no_dead_cover`). -/
325	theorem liveCover_of {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State}
326	    (hR : Refinement.Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3) (hnd : NoDangling s3) :
327	    LiveCover L s3 s2 :=
328	  fun _ _ hy ya _ hl => r4_no_dead_cover hR hw hnd hy ya hl
329	
330	/-- R4 on reachable states (§82.5, §54, §57): `liveCover_of` without invariant hypothesis, under
331	`DDSound(K)` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
332	theorem liveCover_reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat}
333	    {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
334	    (hr : Reachable k statics s3) (hR : Refinement.Repr L rtok s3 s2) : LiveCover L s3 s2 :=
335	  fun _ _ hy ya _ hl => r4_no_dead_cover_reachable hdd hst hr hR hy ya hl
336	
337	/-- A live allocation containing a range stays so along raw operations without deallocation
338	(§13 ¶3, §16 ¶3). -/
339	theorem liveWithin_run {Ty : Type} {s2 : Machine.State} (hwf : Machine.WF s2)
340	    {os : List (Machine.Op Ty)} (hn : ∀ o ∈ os, NoDealloc o) {i off len : Nat}
341	    (h : AllocP s2 i fun a => a.live = true ∧ off + len ≤ a.size) :
342	    AllocP (run s2 os) i fun a => a.live = true ∧ off + len ≤ a.size := by
343	  obtain ⟨a, ha, hl, hsz⟩ := h
344	  obtain ⟨a', ha', hl'⟩ := live_run os s2 hwf hn ⟨a, ha, hl⟩
345	  obtain ⟨a'', ha'', -, e, -⟩ := dom_run os s2 hwf i a ha
346	  rw [ha'] at ha''
347	  cases ha''
348	  exact ⟨a', ha', hl', by rw [e]; exact hsz⟩
349	
350	/-- The raw operations of `store` deallocate nothing (§65, §16). -/
351	theorem storeOps_noDealloc {Ty : Type} (pe : PtrEnc) (s2 : Machine.State) (L : Layout)
352	    (ty : Nat → Ty) (s3 : S3) (a p : Nat) : ∀ o ∈ storeOps pe s2 L ty s3 a p, NoDealloc o :=
353	  writeOps_noDealloc _ _ _ _ _
354	
355	/-! ## The derived operations (§76–§78, §82.2–§82.5, §82.7) -/
356	
357	/-- R1, R2, R4, R6 for `newArena` (§76 `ok` effect, §82.7): no kernel step and no raw operation
358	(no read, no write; the registry update has no machine realization, reading recorded at
359	`arena_realized`); `Repr` and `LiveCover` hold after it as before it. -/
360	theorem arena_newArena {Ty : Type} {π : Params Ty} {others : List (List Nat)} {st i : Nat}
361	    {L L' : LState} {s2 : Machine.State} (h : NewArenaStep others st i L (.ok L')) :
362	    kexp (.newArena others st i) L = [] ∧ lopsOf π (.newArena others st i) L s2 = [] ∧
363	    (Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2 → Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L'.kern s2) ∧
364	    (LiveCover π.L L.kern s2 → LiveCover π.L L'.kern s2) := by
365	  rw [newArena_kernel h]
366	  exact ⟨rfl, rfl, id, id⟩
367	
368	/-- The raw operations of the derived `issue` of entry `i` (§77, Part XIV): `split` realizes none
369	(§61), so they are those of `store` of the block into the destination (§65, §82.3). -/
370	theorem issue_ops {Ty : Type} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat}
371	    {dst : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry} {s2 : Machine.State} (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) :
372	    lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2 =
373	      storeOps π.pe s2 π.L π.ty (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length dst := by
374	  simp only [lopsOf, kexp, hE, ktrace, List.append_nil]
375	  rfl
376	
377	/-- R1, R2, R4, R6 for the derived `issue` of entry `i` (§77, Part XIV, §82.2, §82.3, §82.5,
378	§82.7). Under `Repr` and `WF3`, for an `ok` issue and the parametric obligations of the write:
379	`split` realizes no raw operation and `store` realizes exactly one raw write, of the range of the
380	destination, with the bytes of the reference to the block (address `ptrAddr`, decided for every
381	region by §82.2; provenance the allocation of its effective anchor); no read (R1); the write is an
382	`ok` raw step (R2) and `Repr` holds after it (R6); `LiveCover` (R4) is kept, the new block
383	included. -/
384	theorem arena_issue {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
385	    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty} {L L' : LState} {i : Nat}
386	    {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry} {s2 : Machine.State}
387	    (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2) (hw : WF3 L.kern)
388	    (hs : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L'))
389	    (hob : OblAlong ObR ObW s2
390	      (storeOps π.pe s2 π.L π.ty (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length dst)) :
391	    lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2 = [.write (leafAcc s2 π.L .write dst) (π.ty dst)
392	      (π.pe.enc (ptrAddr s2 π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length)
393	        (some (anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length)))] ∧
394	    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2) s2
395	      (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) ∧
396	    Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L'.kern (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) ∧
397	    (LiveCover π.L L.kern s2 →
398	      LiveCover π.L L'.kern (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2))) := by
399	  rw [issue_ops hE]
400	  cases hs with
401	  | @ok E' s₁ s₂ hE' _ _ hsp hst =>
402	  rw [hE] at hE'
403	  cases hE'
404	  have e₁ := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp).2
405	  subst e₁
406	  have hpre := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp).1
407	  have hw₁ := split_preserves_wf3 hw hsp
408	  obtain ⟨hex, hR₂⟩ := r6_store (C := C) (r6_split hR hsp) hw₁ hst hob
409	  have e₂ := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hst).2
410	  subst e₂
411	  refine ⟨rfl, hex, hR₂, ?_⟩
412	  unfold LiveCover
413	  intro hlc j y hy ya l hl
414	  have hwf := hR.adm.wf
415	  have hn := storeOps_noDealloc π.pe s2 π.L π.ty (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region])
416	    L.kern.A.length dst
417	  dsimp only at hy ⊢
418	  rw [← issueKEff_eq] at hy ⊢
419	  have hA : (issueKEff L.kern E region dst).A =
420	      L.kern.A ++ [⟨.modify, some E.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩] := rfl
421	  rw [hA] at hy
422	  show l < L.kern.P.length ∧ isLeaf L.kern.P l ∧ _
423	  by_cases hj : j < L.kern.A.length
424	  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hj] at hy
425	    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hlc j y hy ya l hl
426	    exact ⟨h1, h2, liveWithin_run hwf hn h3⟩
427	  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)] at hy
428	    have hly : l ∈ region := by
429	      cases h0 : j - L.kern.A.length with
430	      | zero =>
431	        rw [h0] at hy
432	        simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at hy
433	        rw [← hy] at hl
434	        exact hl
435	      | succ n => rw [h0] at hy; simp at hy
436	    obtain ⟨hin, -⟩ := hpre.within region (List.mem_singleton_self _) l hly
437	    obtain ⟨yi, hyi, yia⟩ := hpre.active
438	    have hl' : l ∈ yi.footprint := by simpa [S3.afp, hyi] using hin
439	    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hlc _ yi hyi yia l hl'
440	    exact ⟨h1, h2, liveWithin_run hwf hn h3⟩
441	
442	/-- `arena_issue` on library-reachable states (§77, Part XIV, §82.7, §57): without invariant
443	hypothesis, under `DDSound(K)` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
444	theorem arena_issue_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
445	    {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty}
446	    {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry}
447	    {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics) (hL : LReach k statics L)
448	    (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2)
449	    (hs : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L'))
450	    (hob : OblAlong ObR ObW s2
451	      (storeOps π.pe s2 π.L π.ty (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length dst)) :
452	    lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2 = [.write (leafAcc s2 π.L .write dst) (π.ty dst)
453	      (π.pe.enc (ptrAddr s2 π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length)
454	        (some (anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length)))] ∧
455	    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2) s2
456	      (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) ∧
457	    Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L'.kern (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) ∧
458	    (LiveCover π.L L.kern s2 →
459	      LiveCover π.L L'.kern (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2))) :=
460	  arena_issue hE hR (reachable_kinv hdd hst hL.ng.reachable).1 hs hob
461	
462	/-- A write through the access to leaf `p` leaves the bytes of the range of leaf `l` unchanged
463	when the two ranges are in different allocations or disjoint (§16 ¶3, §9 ¶3). -/
464	private theorem bytesOf_write_disjoint {s2 : Machine.State} {L : Layout} {p l : Nat}
465	    {w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat}
466	    (hd : (L p).alloc ≠ (L l).alloc ∨
467	      Machine.RangeDisjoint (L p).off (L p).len (L l).off (L l).len)
468	    {n : Nat} (hn : n < (L l).len) :
469	    bytesOf (s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write p) w) L l n = bytesOf s2 L l n := by
470	  by_cases e : (L l).alloc = (L p).alloc
471	  · cases ha : s2.allocs (L l).alloc with
472	    | none =>
473	      have he : (s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write p) w).allocs (L l).alloc = none := by
474	        rw [write_allocs, ha]; split <;> rfl
475	      simp only [bytesOf, he, ha]
476	    | some a =>
477	      have hpa : s2.allocs (L p).alloc = some a := e ▸ ha
478	      have he : (s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write p) w).allocs (L l).alloc =
479	          some (a.write (L p).off (L p).len w) := by
480	        rw [e, write_allocs, leafAcc_of hpa]
481	        simp only [↓reduceIte, hpa, Option.map_some, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
482	      have hout : ¬ ((L p).off ≤ (L l).off + n ∧ (L l).off + n < (L p).off + (L p).len) :=
483	        fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => hd.elim (fun h => h e.symm)
484	          fun h => h _ h1 h2 (Nat.le_add_right _ _) (Nat.add_lt_add_left hn _)
485	      simp only [bytesOf, he, ha, Machine.Alloc.write_bytes_out a w hout]
486	  · have he : (s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write p) w).allocs (L l).alloc = s2.allocs (L l).alloc := by
487	      rw [write_allocs]; exact ite_eq_right e
488	    simp only [bytesOf, he]
489	
490	/-- v0.1 §86 (bytes): the realization of an accepted derived `issue` (§77, Part XIV, §82.7)
491	modifies no byte of the issued region, so a reissued leaf keeps its bytes. Its raw operations are
492	one write of the range of the destination (`arena_issue`), a leaf that is not in the region
493	(§77.2); under the layout interface (§82.1, §23, part of `Repr`), the range of every leaf of the
494	region is in another allocation or disjoint from it. No invariant hypothesis. -/
495	theorem issue_keeps_bytes {Ty : Type} {k : K} {π : Params Ty} {L L' : LState} {i : Nat}
496	    {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat} {s2 : Machine.State}
497	    (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2) (hs : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L')) :
498	    ∀ l ∈ region, ∀ n < (π.L l).len,
499	      bytesOf (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) π.L l n = bytesOf s2 π.L l n := by
500	  cases hs with
501	  | @ok E s₁ s₂ hE hsta _ _ _ =>
502	  intro l hl n hn
503	  rw [issue_ops hE]
504	  simp only [storeOps, writeOps, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, run, opEff]
505	  obtain ⟨hlP, hlf, -⟩ := mem_footprint.1 (hsta.regionIn l hl)
506	  have hne : dst ≠ l := fun h => hsta.dstNotIn (h ▸ hl)
507	  refine bytesOf_write_disjoint ?_ hn
508	  by_cases e : (π.L dst).alloc = (π.L l).alloc
509	  · exact .inr (hR.layout.disjoint dst l hsta.dstUsable.lt hlP hsta.dstLeaf hlf hne e)
510	  · exact .inl e
511	
512	/-- The issued region and the memory machine (§82.7, §82.3, §77): after an `ok` issue, under
513	`Repr`, `WF3` and `NoDangling`, the address `ad` of the reference to the block and the obligation
514	of the encoding for it (the pointer-size rule and `PtrEncAt`, hypotheses of
515	`pointer_sound_store`), the range of the destination decodes to `ad`, each of its bytes carries the
516	provenance of the allocation of the block's effective anchor, and every leaf of the region lies in
517	that allocation, live and containing the range of the leaf. -/
518	theorem issue_pointer_sound {Ty : Type} {k : K} {π : Params Ty} {L L' : LState} {i : Nat}
519	    {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry} {s2 : Machine.State} {ad : Nat}
520	    (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2) (hw : WF3 L.kern)
