import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main

/-!
# Concurrent authority machine: state, frames, invariants

Exploratory formalization of the concurrent state `S_C = (C, F_C, P, I, A, D)` of the working
candidate `ERN_Concurrency_Model_WC4.md` (WC4 C1–C3, C20) on top of the frozen kernel of
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` (Spec 1 §38–§45, §49–§57).

* contexts with lifecycle states, local stacks and the parent of their initial frame (WC4 C1–C3);
* globally live frames, current frame of a context, extended parent relation `parC` and
  `ancestorC` (WC4 C3);
* the `S3` seen by an executing context (`SC.view`, WC4 C2: current frame = top of its stack,
  liveness = globally live frames), the kernel components alone (`SC.flat`), and the projection
  `SC.toS3` on single-context states (WC4 C24);
* `ConcurrentWF`, `Inv3C`, `AnchorOrderC`, `AnchorOrderHeldC`, `NoOrphanC` (WC4 C20; Spec 1 §44,
  §49–§57 re-indexed);
* membership congruence: the kernel invariants of Spec 1 that read the stack only through
  membership agree on every view (WC4 C2).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## State (WC4 C1–C3) -/

/-- Lifecycle state of an execution context (WC4 C2, C7, C8): live, or completed. -/
inductive Life where
  | live
  | done
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Execution context (WC4 C1–C3): its local frame stack, current frame first; its lifecycle
state; the parent of its initial frame (`none` for the initial context, whose initial frame is
the base frame of Spec 1 §39). -/
structure Ctx where
  stack : List Nat
  life : Life
  parent : Option Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- `S_C = (C, F_C, P, I, A, D)` (WC4 C2). `C` lists the contexts by identity (their index); their
stacks and the parents of their initial frames form `F_C`; `P`, `I`, `A`, `D` keep their Spec 1
meaning (§38); `nF`, `dead` and `pins` are the auxiliary components of `S3` (Spec 1 §38). -/
structure SC where
  C : List Ctx
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  pins : List PinOb

/-- Context `c` is live (WC4 C2). -/
def SC.Live (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop := OptP (s.C[c]?) (fun x => x.life = .live) False

/-- Decidability of `SC.Live` (WC4 C2). -/
instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (s.Live c) := by unfold SC.Live; infer_instance

/-- Local stack of context `c` if it is live, empty otherwise (WC4 C2, C3). -/
def SC.stk (s : SC) (c : Nat) : List Nat :=
  match s.C[c]? with
  | some x => if x.life = .live then x.stack else []
  | none => []

/-- Parent of the initial frame of context `c` (WC4 C3). -/
def SC.ctxParent (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.C[c]?).bind (·.parent)

/-- Globally live frames: the frames of the stacks of live contexts (WC4 C2). -/
def SC.frames (s : SC) : List Nat := (List.range s.C.length).flatMap s.stk

/-- The kernel components of `s` as an `S3` whose stack lists the globally live frames (WC4 C2:
references to live frames consider the globally live frame structure). -/
def SC.flat (s : SC) : S3 :=
  { F := s.frames, nF := s.nF, P := s.P, I := s.I, A := s.A, D := s.D, dead := s.dead,
    pins := s.pins }

/-- The `S3` seen by executing context `c` (WC4 C2): the stack of `c` first, so that the current
frame is the top of its local stack, followed by the other globally live frames. It is the `S₃`
view of WC4 C2 (candidate P1) on which `K.Satisfiable` of an `alloc` executed by `c` is evaluated
(`alloc_ok_satisfiable`, `alloc_fail_unsatisfiable`). -/
def SC.view (s : SC) (c : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s.flat with F := s.stk c ++ s.frames.filter fun f => decide (f ∉ s.stk c) }

/-- Kernel components of an `S3` written back into `s`; contexts unchanged (WC4 C2). -/
def SC.set (s : SC) (t : S3) : SC :=
  { s with nF := t.nF, P := t.P, I := t.I, A := t.A, D := t.D, dead := t.dead, pins := t.pins }

/-! ## Single-context states (WC4 C24) -/

/-- Single-context state (WC4 C24): exactly one context, the initial one, live, without
parent. -/
def SC.Single (s : SC) : Prop := ∃ stk, s.C = [⟨stk, .live, none⟩]

/-- Projection of a state to `S3` (WC4 C24): the stack of context 0. -/
def SC.toS3 (s : SC) : S3 :=
  { F := s.stk 0, nF := s.nF, P := s.P, I := s.I, A := s.A, D := s.D, dead := s.dead,
    pins := s.pins }

/-- The single-context state of an `S3` (WC4 C24). -/
def SC.ofS3 (t : S3) : SC :=
  { C := [⟨t.F, .live, none⟩], nF := t.nF, P := t.P, I := t.I, A := t.A, D := t.D,
    dead := t.dead, pins := t.pins }

/-! ## Extended frame-parent relation and ancestry (WC4 C3) -/

/-- Parent of frame `f` within a stack whose initial frame has parent `par`: the next frame of
the stack, or `par` for the initial frame; `none` if `f` is not in the stack (WC4 C3; Spec 1
§39). -/
def parIn (par : Option Nat) (f : Nat) : List Nat → Option Nat
  | [] => none
  | a :: rest => if a = f then rest.head?.or par else parIn par f rest

/-- The live context whose stack contains `f` (WC4 C3: frame identities are globally unique). -/
def SC.ctxOf (s : SC) (f : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  (List.range s.C.length).find? fun c => (s.stk c).contains f

/-- Extended frame-parent relation `parC` (WC4 C3): the parent of a live frame, following the
links across contexts; `none` for the base frame and for frames that are not live. -/
def SC.parC (s : SC) (f : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  (s.ctxOf f).bind fun c => parIn (s.ctxParent c) f (s.stk c)

/-- Extended `ancestor_C(f₁, f₂)` (WC4 C3; Spec 1 §39): `f₂` is live and `f₁` is `f₂` or one of
its ancestors along `parC`. Chains follow links to smaller identities (Spec 1 §49, last
paragraph: identity order represents well-foundedness, required by `FramesC.parent`). -/
def SC.ancestorC (s : SC) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Prop :=
  f₂ ∈ s.frames ∧ (f₁ = f₂ ∨ f₁ ∈ chain s.parC f₂)

/-- Decidability of `ancestorC` (WC4 C3). -/
instance (s : SC) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Decidable (s.ancestorC f₁ f₂) := by
  unfold SC.ancestorC; infer_instance

/-! ## Anchor order on the extended ancestry (Spec 1 §44, §54 re-indexed; WC4 C2, C3) -/

/-- Spec 1 §44 re-indexed (WC4 C2, C3): the frame of the effective anchor of `x` exists and is
`fd` or one of its ancestors along `ancestorC`. -/
def EffAnchorOKC (s : SC) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[s.flat.effAnchor x]?) (fun z => OptP (s.flat.hframe z.holder)
    (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => s.ancestorC g f) False) False) False

/-- Decidability of `EffAnchorOKC` (Spec 1 §44). -/
instance (s : SC) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (EffAnchorOKC s x fd) := by
  unfold EffAnchorOKC; infer_instance

/-- `AnchorOrder` re-indexed (Spec 1 §44, §54; WC4 C2): for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable
place `q`, the frame of the effective anchor of `x` is an `ancestorC` of the frame of `q`. -/
def AnchorOrderC (s : SC) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrderC` read on the places of `P` (decision procedure for Spec 1 §44). -/
theorem anchorOrderC_iff {s : SC} : AnchorOrderC s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q,
      EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q) :=
  ⟨fun h q _ hq => h q hq, fun h q hq => h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq⟩

/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderC` (Spec 1 §44). -/
instance (s : SC) : Decidable (AnchorOrderC s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderC_iff.symm

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` re-indexed (Spec 1 §44, §54; WC4 C2): the rule of `AnchorOrderC` for every
active authority held by a usable place `q`. -/
def AnchorOrderHeldC (s : SC) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrderHeldC` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A` (decision procedure
for Spec 1 §44). -/
theorem anchorOrderHeldC_iff {s : SC} : AnchorOrderHeldC s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
        EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q)) True := by
  constructor
  · intro h q _ hq x _
    unfold OptP; split
    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy
    · trivial
  · intro h q hq x y hy ya hh
    have := h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
    simp only [OptP, hy] at this; exact this ya hh

/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderHeldC` (Spec 1 §44). -/
instance (s : SC) : Decidable (AnchorOrderHeldC s) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderHeldC_iff.symm

/-! ## Invariants (WC4 C3, C20; Spec 1 §49–§57 re-indexed) -/

/-- Frame structure of `S_C` (WC4 C3, C20; Spec 1 §49.1 re-indexed: "the stack" read as the
globally live frames). -/
structure FramesC (s : SC) : Prop where
  /-- WC4 C3: the initial context, context 0, is live and its initial frame, the base frame of
  Spec 1 §39, has no parent. -/
  initial : OptP (s.C[0]?) (fun x => x.life = .live ∧ x.parent = none) False
  /-- WC4 C3: every live context has a nonempty local stack. -/
  nonempty : ∀ c, s.Live c → s.stk c ≠ []
  /-- WC4 C3: frame identities are globally unique; Spec 1 §49.1: duplicate-free. -/
  nodup : s.frames.Nodup
  /-- Spec 1 §49.1: every frame has a valid identity (below `nF`). -/
  bound : ∀ f ∈ s.frames, f < s.nF
  /-- WC4 C3: the initial frame of a non-initial live context has a parent (the frame that
  created the context, or its reparenting target, WC4 C6). -/
  rooted : ∀ c, c ≠ 0 → s.Live c → s.ctxParent c ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §49.1 re-indexed, WC4 C3: the parent of a live frame is live; the parent precedes
  its child, which represents well-foundedness (Spec 1 §49, last paragraph). -/
  parent : ∀ f ∈ s.frames, ∀ g, s.parC f = some g → g ∈ s.frames ∧ g < f

/-- `ConcurrentWF` (WC4 C20): the frame structure of `FramesC` and `WF3` (Spec 1 §49.1–§49.8)
read with "the stack" as the globally live frames. -/
def ConcurrentWF (s : SC) : Prop := FramesC s ∧ WF3 s.flat

/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` re-indexed (Spec 1 §50–§53, §57; WC4 C2): `I4` reads `Read3Pre`, which
depends on the current frame, so it is required for every executing context. -/
def Inv3baseC (s : SC) : Prop :=
  I1 s.flat ∧ I2 s.flat ∧ I3 s.flat ∧ ∀ c, I4 (s.view c)

/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` re-indexed (Spec 1 §57; WC4 C2). -/
def Inv3C (s : SC) : Prop := Inv3baseC s ∧ AnchorOrderC s ∧ NoDangling s.flat

/-- `NoOrphan` re-indexed (Spec 1 §54; WC4 C2): chains start at a globally live frame. -/
def NoOrphanC (s : SC) : Prop := NoOrphan s.flat

/-- The kernel invariant of Spec 1 §57 re-indexed (WC4 C20, C23):
`ConcurrentWF ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan`. -/
def KInvC (s : SC) : Prop := ConcurrentWF s ∧ Inv3C s ∧ AnchorOrderHeldC s ∧ NoOrphanC s

/-! ## Views: membership and current frame (WC4 C2) -/

/-- Unfolding of `stk` (WC4 C2). -/
theorem SC.stk_of {s : SC} {c : Nat} {x : Ctx} (h : s.C[c]? = some x) (hl : x.life = .live) :
    s.stk c = x.stack := by simp [SC.stk, h, hl]

/-- A context with a nonempty stack is live (WC4 C2). -/
theorem SC.live_of_stk {s : SC} {c : Nat} (h : s.stk c ≠ []) : s.Live c := by
  unfold SC.stk at h; unfold SC.Live
  split at h
  · rename_i x hx; rw [hx]; simp only [OptP]; split at h
    · assumption
    · exact absurd rfl h
  · exact absurd rfl h

/-- A frame of a stack is globally live (WC4 C2). -/
theorem SC.mem_frames_of {s : SC} {c f : Nat} (h : f ∈ s.stk c) : f ∈ s.frames := by
  have hc : c < s.C.length := by
    unfold SC.stk at h; split at h
    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
    · simp at h
  exact List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨c, List.mem_range.2 hc, h⟩

/-- Globally live frames are the frames of some stack (WC4 C2). -/
theorem SC.mem_frames {s : SC} {f : Nat} : f ∈ s.frames ↔ ∃ c, f ∈ s.stk c := by
  constructor
  · intro h; obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.1 h; exact ⟨c, hc⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩; exact SC.mem_frames_of hc

/-- The view of a context lists exactly the globally live frames (WC4 C2). -/
theorem SC.mem_view_F {s : SC} {c f : Nat} : f ∈ (s.view c).F ↔ f ∈ s.frames := by
  simp only [SC.view, SC.flat, List.mem_append, List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | ⟨h, -⟩)
    · exact SC.mem_frames_of h
    · exact h
  · intro h
    by_cases hc : f ∈ s.stk c
    · exact .inl hc
    · exact .inr ⟨h, hc⟩

/-- A block of a duplicate-free concatenation is duplicate-free (WC4 C3). -/
theorem nodup_of_flatMap {α β : Type} {f : α → List β} :
    ∀ {l : List α} {a : α}, (l.flatMap f).Nodup → a ∈ l → (f a).Nodup
  | b :: l, a, h, ha => by
    rw [List.flatMap_cons] at h
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha with rfl | ha
    · exact (List.nodup_append.1 h).1
    · exact nodup_of_flatMap (List.nodup_append.1 h).2.1 ha

/-- Two blocks of a duplicate-free concatenation share no element (WC4 C3: frame identities are
globally unique). -/
theorem disjoint_of_flatMap {α β : Type} {f : α → List β} :
    ∀ {l : List α}, (l.flatMap f).Nodup → l.Nodup → ∀ {a a' : α} {x : β}, a ∈ l → a' ∈ l →
      x ∈ f a → x ∈ f a' → a = a'
  | b :: l, h, hl, a, a', x, ha, ha', hx, hx' => by
    rw [List.flatMap_cons] at h
    obtain ⟨-, h₂, h₃⟩ := List.nodup_append.1 h
    have hl' := (List.nodup_cons.1 hl).2
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha with e₁ | h₁ <;> rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha' with e₂ | h₂'
    · rw [e₁, e₂]
    · subst e₁; exact absurd rfl (h₃ x hx x (List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨a', h₂', hx'⟩))
    · subst e₂; exact absurd rfl (h₃ x hx' x (List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨a, h₁, hx⟩))
    · exact disjoint_of_flatMap h₂ hl' h₁ h₂' hx hx'

/-- The stack of a context is duplicate-free when the live frames are (WC4 C3). -/
theorem SC.stk_nodup {s : SC} (hnd : s.frames.Nodup) (c : Nat) : (s.stk c).Nodup := by
  by_cases hc : c < s.C.length
  · exact nodup_of_flatMap hnd (List.mem_range.2 hc)
  · simp [SC.stk, List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (Nat.le_of_not_lt hc)]

/-- The view of a context is duplicate-free when the live frames are (WC4 C3). -/
theorem SC.view_nodup {s : SC} (hnd : s.frames.Nodup) (c : Nat) : (s.view c).F.Nodup := by
  simp only [SC.view, SC.flat]
  refine List.nodup_append.2 ⟨SC.stk_nodup hnd c, hnd.sublist (List.filter_sublist ..),
    fun a ha b hb e => ?_⟩
  subst e
  simp only [List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq] at hb
  exact hb.2 ha

/-- The current frame of the view of `c` is the top of the stack of `c` (WC4 C2). -/
theorem SC.view_top {s : SC} {c f : Nat} {rest : List Nat} (h : s.stk c = f :: rest) :
    (s.view c).top = f := by
  simp [SC.view, S3.top, h]

/-! ## Membership congruence (WC4 C2)

The clauses of `WF3`, `I1`–`I3`, `NoDangling` and `NoOrphan` (Spec 1 §49–§54) read the stack only
through membership; they agree on states that differ only by the order of the stack. -/

section Congr

variable {t : S3} {F' : Frames}

/-- Usability depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem usable_mem_congr (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) {q : Nat} :
    ({ t with F := F' } : S3).Usable q ↔ t.Usable q :=
  ⟨S3.Usable.mono (s' := { t with F := F' }) (s := t) rfl (fun f h => (hF f).1 h)
    (fun _ h => h),
   S3.Usable.mono (s' := t) (s := { t with F := F' }) rfl (fun f h => (hF f).2 h)
    (fun _ h => h)⟩

/-- Holder liveness depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §49.8). -/
theorem holderLive_mem_congr (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) (h : Holder) :
    HolderLive ({ t with F := F' } : S3) h ↔ HolderLive t h := by
  cases h with
  | frame f => exact hF f
  | place p => exact usable_mem_congr hF

/-- `WF3` depends on the stack only through membership, duplicate-freedom and nonemptiness
(Spec 1 §49). -/
theorem wf3_mem_congr (hw : WF3 t) (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) (hnd : F'.Nodup)
    (hne : F' ≠ []) : WF3 { t with F := F' } where
  frames := ⟨hne, hnd, fun f hf => hw.frames.2.2 f ((hF f).1 hf)⟩
  places := hw.places
  owners := ⟨hw.owners.1, hw.owners.2.1, fun q hq => by
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hw.owners.2.2 q ((usable_mem_congr hF).1 hq)
    exact ⟨f, (FrameOf.congr (s' := { t with F := F' }) (s := t) rfl).2 hf, (hF f).2 hfF⟩⟩
  footprints := hw.footprints
  origins := hw.origins
  rootChain := hw.rootChain
  rootHeld := fun r hr hu => hw.rootHeld r hr ((usable_mem_congr hF).1 hu)
  holders := fun a y hy ya => (holderLive_mem_congr hF _).2 (hw.holders a y hy ya)

/-- `I3` depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §52). -/
theorem i3_mem_congr (h : I3 t) (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) : I3 { t with F := F' } :=
  fun q hq x hx => h q ((usable_mem_congr hF).1 hq) x hx

/-- `NoDangling` depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §54). -/
theorem noDangling_mem_congr (h : NoDangling t) (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) :
    NoDangling { t with F := F' } :=
  fun j y hy ya q hq => h j y hy ya q fun hu => hq ((usable_mem_congr hF).2 hu)

end Congr

/-- The view of a context is the flat state with a reordered stack (WC4 C2). -/
theorem SC.view_eq (s : SC) (c : Nat) :
    s.view c = { s.flat with F := (s.view c).F } := rfl

/-- `WF3` of the flat state carries to every view (WC4 C2). -/
theorem SC.wf3_view {s : SC} (hfr : FramesC s) (hw : WF3 s.flat) {c : Nat} :
    WF3 (s.view c) := by
  rw [SC.view_eq]
  refine wf3_mem_congr hw (fun f => SC.mem_view_F) (SC.view_nodup hfr.nodup c) ?_
  intro he
  have h0 := hfr.initial
  unfold OptP at h0; split at h0
  · rename_i x hx
    have hs := hfr.nonempty 0 (by simp [SC.Live, hx, OptP, h0.1])
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hs
    have := (SC.mem_view_F (c := c)).2 (SC.mem_frames_of hf)
    rw [he] at this; simp at this
  · exact h0.elim

/-- `WF3` of a view carries to the flat state (WC4 C2). -/
theorem SC.wf3_flat_of_view {s : SC} {c : Nat} (hw : WF3 (s.view c)) (hnd : s.frames.Nodup) :
    WF3 s.flat := by
  have := wf3_mem_congr (t := s.view c) (F' := s.frames) hw
    (fun f => SC.mem_view_F.symm) hnd (fun he => by
      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hw.frames.1
      have := SC.mem_view_F.1 hf; rw [he] at this; simp at this)
  exact this

end Ern.Concurrency

1	import Ern.Concurrency.Context
2	
3	/-!
4	# Concurrent authority machine: inherited operations and frame transitions
5	
6	* the kernel operations O1–O16 of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` (§60–§75)
7	  executed by a live context `c` (WC4 C2): every operation reads the view of `c` (current frame =
8	  top of its stack, liveness = globally live frames); the clauses that read `ancestor` (§63.6,
9	  §63.7, §64.3, §65.4, §65.5, §72.4, §73.5) read `ancestorC` instead; O6 pushes the new frame on
10	  the stack of `c`; O7 is `exitFrameC` (WC4 C6: O7 and the reparenting of the context-initial
11	  frames whose parent is the exiting frame);
12	* `spawn` (WC4 C4, modeled on Spec 1 §72), `terminate` (WC4 C7, Spec 1 §73 on the initial frame
13	  of a non-initial context), `join` (WC4 C8);
14	* `CStep`, the union of their `ok` transitions.
15	
16	Waiting (`join` on a live context) has no outcome: the transition is not enabled (WC4 C8).
17	-/
18	
19	namespace Ern.Concurrency
20	
21	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access
22	
23	/-! ## Outcomes (Spec 1 §58) -/
24	
25	/-- Image of an outcome (Spec 1 §58). -/
26	def omap {σ τ : Type} (f : σ → τ) : Outcome3 σ → Outcome3 τ
27	  | .ok s => .ok (f s)
28	  | .reject => .reject
29	  | .fail => .fail
30	
31	/-! ## Operations that do not read `ancestor` (Spec 1 §60–§62, §66–§71, §74, §75; WC4 C2) -/
32	
33	/-- An operation of Spec 1 that reads neither `ancestor` nor the stack beyond its top and its
34	membership, run by context `c` on its view and written back (WC4 C2). The context must be live;
35	otherwise the operation has no outcome. -/
36	def ViewStep (R : S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop) (c : Nat) (s : SC) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
37	  s.Live c ∧ ∃ o₃, R (s.view c) o₃ ∧ o = omap s.set o₃
38	
39	/-! ## O4 `transfer` re-indexed (Spec 1 §63) -/
40	
41	/-- Effect of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63 effect, WC4 C2). -/
42	def transferEffC (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) : SC := s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)
43	
44	/-- Preconditions of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63 re-indexed, WC4 C2): the clauses of
45	`TransferPre` on the view of `c`, with §63.6 and §63.7 read on `ancestorC`. -/
46	structure TransferPreC (k : K) (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) : Prop where
47	  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: `source` is usable. -/
48	  srcUsable : (s.view c).Usable src
49	  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: `destination` is usable. -/
50	  dstUsable : (s.view c).Usable dst
51	  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the source. -/
52	  srcRight : HasRight (s.view c) .modify src
53	  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the destination. -/
54	  dstRight : HasRight (s.view c) .modify dst
55	  /-- Spec 1 §63.2: same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
56	  sameShape : SameShape (s.view c).P src dst
57	  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
58	  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, (s.view c).I l = .init
59	  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/

80	          EffAnchorOKC (transferEffC s c src dst) x

183	/-- Effect of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72 effect, WC4 C2): the effect of Spec 1 on

185	def enterEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : SC :=

189	/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72 re-indexed, WC4 C2). -/
190	structure EnterPreC (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
191	  /-- Spec 1 §72.1 re-indexed: the calling frame, the current frame of `c`, is live. -/
192	  callerLive : s.stk c ≠ []
193	  /-- Spec 1 §72.1: each parameter is an active derived authority held by the caller. -/
194	  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
195	    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
196	  /-- Spec 1 §72.2: the locals form a well-formed shape. -/
197	  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
198	  /-- Spec 1 §72.3 re-indexed: origin protection on entry, in the resulting state, for the
199	  executing context. -/
200	  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((enterEffC s c ps ls).view c) p
201	  /-- Spec 1 §72.4 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) over the resulting state. -/
202	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (enterEffC s c ps ls)

204	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72). -/
205	instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
206	    Decidable (EnterPreC s c ps ls) :=
207	  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
208	      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
209	    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
210	    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((enterEffC s c ps ls).view c) p) ∧
211	    AnchorOrderHeldC (enterEffC s c ps ls))
212	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

214	/-! ## O7 re-indexed: `exitFrameC` (Spec 1 §73; WC4 C6) -/
215	
216	/-- Reparenting (WC4 C6 effect): every live context whose initial frame has parent `f` gets the
217	parent `p`. -/
218	def reparent (C : List Ctx) (f p : Nat) : List Ctx :=
219	  C.map fun x => if x.life = .live ∧ x.parent = some f then { x with parent := some p } else x
220	
221	/-- Effect of `exitFrameC` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §73 effect; WC4 C6 effect): the effect of Spec 1 on
222	the view of `c`, whose surviving frames are the other live frames; the top `f` of the stack of `c`
223	is popped, its caller `p` becomes current again, and the context-initial frames whose parent is
224	`f` are reparented to `p`; the other ancestry links are unchanged (WC4 C6 effect). -/
225	def exitEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) : SC :=
226	  { s.set (exitEff (s.view c)) with
227	    C := reparent (s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := x.stack.tail })
228	      ((s.stk c).headD 0) ((s.stk c).tail.headD 0) }
229	
230	/-- Preconditions of `exitFrameC` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §73 re-indexed; WC4 C6, C6.1: O7.1
231	transposed, O7.2–O7.5 on the global state). The surviving frames are the other globally live
232	frames. -/

234	  /-- Spec 1 §73.1 re-indexed (WC4 C6, first paragraph): the current frame of `c` is not the
235	  initial frame of its context and has a surviving caller in its stack. -/
236	  hasCaller : (s.stk c).tail ≠ []
237	  /-- Spec 1 §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
238	  authority among itself and its origins. -/
239	  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
240	    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none
241	  /-- Spec 1 §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
242	  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
243	    (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none
244	  /-- Spec 1 §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned. -/
245	  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
246	    ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
247	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
248	  /-- Spec 1 §73.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
249	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (exitEffC s c)
250	
251	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `exitFrameC` (Spec 1 §73). -/
252	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (ExitPreC k s c) :=
253	  decidable_of_iff ((s.stk c).tail ≠ [] ∧
254	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
255	      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
256	    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
257	      (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
258	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
259	      ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
260	      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
261	    AnchorOrderHeldC (exitEffC s c))
262	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

264	/-! ## The inherited operations O1–O16 executed by a context (WC4 C2) -/
265	
266	/-- Outcome relation of a kernel operation O1–O16 executed by context `c` (Spec 1 §60–§75
267	re-indexed, WC4 C2). Operations reading `ancestor` or changing the stack have their re-indexed
268	preconditions and effects; the others run on the view of `c`. A context that is not live executes
269	nothing. -/
270	def opStepC (k : K) : KernelOp → Nat → SC → Outcome3 SC → Prop
271	  | .transfer src dst, c, s, o =>
272	    s.Live c ∧ Guarded (TransferPreC k s c src dst) (transferEffC s c src dst) o
273	  | .depend q x, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (DependPreC s c q x) (dependEffC s c q x) o
274	  | .store a p, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (StorePreC s c a p) (storeEffC s c a p) o
275	  | .enter ps ls, c, s, o =>
276	    s.Live c ∧ Guarded (EnterPreC s c ps ls) (enterEffC s c ps ls) o
277	  | .exit, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (ExitPreC k s c) (exitEffC s c) o
278	  | op, c, s, o => ViewStep (op.Step k) c s o

280	/-- WC4 C2 (candidate P1): the `K.Satisfiable` obligation of `alloc` (Spec 1 §71) executed by `c`
281	is evaluated on the view of `c`: an `ok` outcome entails it. -/
282	theorem alloc_ok_satisfiable {k : K} {c pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {s s' : SC}
283	    (h : opStepC k (.alloc pr ow ls) c s (.ok s')) : k.Satisfiable pr ls (s.view c) := by
284	  obtain ⟨-, o₃, hR, ho⟩ := h
285	  change AllocStep k pr ow ls (s.view c) o₃ at hR
286	  cases hR with
287	  | ok _ hsat => exact hsat
288	  | fail => cases ho
289	  | reject => cases ho
290	
291	/-- WC4 C2 (candidate P1): a `fail` outcome of `alloc` (Spec 1 §71) executed by `c` entails that
292	`K.Satisfiable` fails on the view of `c`. -/
293	theorem alloc_fail_unsatisfiable {k : K} {c pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {s : SC}
294	    (h : opStepC k (.alloc pr ow ls) c s .fail) : ¬ k.Satisfiable pr ls (s.view c) := by
295	  obtain ⟨-, o₃, hR, ho⟩ := h
296	  change AllocStep k pr ow ls (s.view c) o₃ at hR
297	  cases hR with
298	  | ok => cases ho
299	  | fail _ hsat => exact hsat
300	  | reject => cases ho

302	/-! ## `spawn` (WC4 C4, on Spec 1 §72) -/
303	
304	/-- Effect of `spawn` executed by `c` (WC4 C4 effect): a new live context of identity `|C|` whose
305	stack is the fresh frame `nF`, parented to the creating frame; the locals of the new frame and
306	their root authorities, and the yielding of the parameters, are the effects of Spec 1 §72 on the
307	view of `c`. -/

309	  { s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with
310	    C := s.C ++ [⟨[s.nF], .live, (s.stk c).head?⟩] }
311	
312	/-- Preconditions of `spawn` without transmitted value (WC4 C4.1–C4.5): the clauses of `EnterPre`
313	(Spec 1 §72, `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Ops`) re-indexed as in `EnterPreC`, with O6.3 read from the
314	current frame of the new context. C4.2 (fresh identities) and C4.4 (yield without duplication)
315	hold by construction of `spawnEff`; C4.6 concerns `spawn` with a value
316	(`Ern.Concurrency.Transfer`); the preservation obligations of WC4 C4 are theorems, not
317	preconditions. -/
318	structure SpawnPre (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
319	  /-- WC4 C4.1 (Spec 1 §72.1 re-indexed): the creating context and its current frame are live. -/
320	  creatorLive : s.stk c ≠ []
321	  /-- WC4 C4.3 (Spec 1 §72.1): every transmitted parameter is an active derived authority held by
322	  the creating frame. -/
323	  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
324	    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
325	  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.2): the locals of the new frame form a well-formed shape. -/
326	  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
327	  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.3): origin protection in the final state, from the current frame of the
328	  new context. -/
329	  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p
330	  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.4): `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the final state. -/
331	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff s c ps ls)
332	
333	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `spawn` (WC4 C4). -/
334	instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
335	    Decidable (SpawnPre s c ps ls) :=
336	  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
337	      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
338	    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
339	    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p) ∧
340	    AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff s c ps ls))
341	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
342	
343	/-- `spawn` executed by `c` (WC4 C4): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not live. -/
344	def SpawnStep (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
345	  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (SpawnPre s c ps ls) (spawnEff s c ps ls) o

347	/-! ## `terminate` (WC4 C7, on Spec 1 §73) -/
348	
349	/-- Effect of `terminate` executed by `c` (WC4 C7): the effect of Spec 1 §73 on the view of `c`
350	for its initial frame `f`, whose surviving frames are the other live frames; `c` leaves the
351	live-context set with the completed lifecycle state; the context-initial frames whose parent is
352	`f` are reparented to the parent of `f` (WC4 C7, C6 effect). -/
353	def termEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) : SC :=
354	  { s.set (exitEff (s.view c)) with
355	    C := reparent (s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := [], life := .done })
356	      ((s.stk c).headD 0) ((s.ctxParent c).getD 0) }
357	
358	/-- Preconditions of `terminate` executed by `c` (WC4 C7: the O7 validity requirements applied to
359	the initial frame of a terminating non-initial context, after its nested call frames have
360	ended). -/
361	structure TermPre (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop where
362	  /-- WC4 C7: a non-initial context (WC4 C3: the base frame never exits). -/
363	  nonInitial : c ≠ 0
364	  /-- WC4 C7: the nested call frames have ended; only the initial frame remains. -/
365	  initialOnly : (s.stk c).length = 1
366	  /-- Spec 1 §73.1 re-indexed: the initial frame has a surviving parent. -/
367	  hasParent : OptP (s.ctxParent c) (fun p => p ∈ s.frames ∧ p ∉ s.stk c) False
368	  /-- Spec 1 §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
369	  authority among itself and its origins. -/
370	  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
371	    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none
372	  /-- Spec 1 §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
373	  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
374	    (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none
375	  /-- Spec 1 §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned. -/
376	  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
377	    ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
378	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
379	  /-- Spec 1 §73.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
380	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (termEffC s c)
381	
382	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `terminate` (WC4 C7). -/
383	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (TermPre k s c) :=
384	  decidable_of_iff (c ≠ 0 ∧ (s.stk c).length = 1 ∧
385	    OptP (s.ctxParent c) (fun p => p ∈ s.frames ∧ p ∉ s.stk c) False ∧
386	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
387	      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
388	    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
389	      (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
390	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
391	      ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
392	      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
393	    AnchorOrderHeldC (termEffC s c))
394	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩,
395	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩⟩
396	
397	/-- `terminate` executed by `c` (WC4 C7): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not live. -/
398	def TermStep (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
399	  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (TermPre k s c) (termEffC s c) o
400	
401	/-! ## `join` (WC4 C8) -/
402	
403	/-- `join d` executed by `c` (WC4 C8): `reject` when `d` is unknown to the execution (no context
404	has identity `d`, identities being the indices of `C`); `ok` with the state unchanged when `d` has
405	the completed lifecycle state; no outcome while `d` is live (WC4 C8: awaiting completion is not an
406	`Outcome3` result). -/
407	inductive JoinStep (s : SC) (c d : Nat) : Outcome3 SC → Prop where
408	  | ok : s.Live c → OptP (s.C[d]?) (fun x => x.life = .done) False → JoinStep s c d (.ok s)
409	  | reject : s.Live c → s.C[d]? = none → JoinStep s c d .reject
410	
411	/-! ## Concurrent kernel steps -/
412	
413	/-- One `ok` transition of the concurrent kernel without synchronization (WC4 C2, C4, C6–C8):
414	an inherited operation O1–O16 executed by a context, `spawn`, `terminate` or `join`. -/
415	inductive CStep (k : K) : SC → SC → Prop where
416	  | kernel {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} : opStepC k op c s (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
417	  | spawn {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
418	      SpawnStep s c ps ls (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
419	  | terminate {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} : TermStep k s c (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
420	  | join {s s' : SC} {c d : Nat} : JoinStep s c d (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
421	
422	end Ern.Concurrency

import Ern.Concurrency.Context

/-!
# Concurrent authority machine: inherited operations and frame transitions

* the kernel operations O1–O16 of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` (§60–§75)
  executed by a live context `c` (WC4 C2): every operation reads the view of `c` (current frame =
  top of its stack, liveness = globally live frames); the clauses that read `ancestor` (§63.6,
  §63.7, §64.3, §65.4, §65.5, §72.4, §73.5) read `ancestorC` instead; O6 pushes the new frame on
  the stack of `c`; O7 is `exitFrameC` (WC4 C6: O7 and the reparenting of the context-initial
  frames whose parent is the exiting frame);
* `spawn` (WC4 C4, modeled on Spec 1 §72), `terminate` (WC4 C7, Spec 1 §73 on the initial frame
  of a non-initial context), `join` (WC4 C8);
* `CStep`, the union of their `ok` transitions.

Waiting (`join` on a live context) has no outcome: the transition is not enabled (WC4 C8).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Outcomes (Spec 1 §58) -/

/-- Image of an outcome (Spec 1 §58). -/
def omap {σ τ : Type} (f : σ → τ) : Outcome3 σ → Outcome3 τ
  | .ok s => .ok (f s)
  | .reject => .reject
  | .fail => .fail

/-! ## Operations that do not read `ancestor` (Spec 1 §60–§62, §66–§71, §74, §75; WC4 C2) -/

/-- An operation of Spec 1 that reads neither `ancestor` nor the stack beyond its top and its
membership, run by context `c` on its view and written back (WC4 C2). The context must be live;
otherwise the operation has no outcome. -/
def ViewStep (R : S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop) (c : Nat) (s : SC) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ ∃ o₃, R (s.view c) o₃ ∧ o = omap s.set o₃

/-! ## O4 `transfer` re-indexed (Spec 1 §63) -/

/-- Effect of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63 effect, WC4 C2). -/
def transferEffC (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) : SC := s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)

/-- Preconditions of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63 re-indexed, WC4 C2): the clauses of
`TransferPre` on the view of `c`, with §63.6 and §63.7 read on `ancestorC`. -/
structure TransferPreC (k : K) (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: `source` is usable. -/
  srcUsable : (s.view c).Usable src
  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: `destination` is usable. -/
  dstUsable : (s.view c).Usable dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the source. -/
  srcRight : HasRight (s.view c) .modify src
  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the destination. -/
  dstRight : HasRight (s.view c) .modify dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.2: same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
  sameShape : SameShape (s.view c).P src dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, (s.view c).I l = .init
  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/
  dstNotInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P dst, (s.view c).I l ≠ .init
  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: source and destination footprints are disjoint. -/
  disjoint : ¬ overlap (s.view c).P src dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.4: no active derived authority covers a source leaf from outside the source,
  except some authority grounding the `Modify` right over the source and its origin chain. -/
  noOutsideDerived : ∃ g ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, Grounds (s.view c) .modify src g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (s.view c) src j →
      RightChain (s.view c) g j
  /-- Spec 1 §63.5: no in-place source leaf is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ (s.view c).pin l = false
  /-- Spec 1 §63.6: dependencies of the usable places following the value are valid. -/
  depsValid : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps (s.view c) src, (s.view c).Active x
  /-- Spec 1 §63.6 re-indexed: `AnchorOrder` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrder : AnchorOrderC (transferEffC s c src dst)
  /-- Spec 1 §63.7 re-indexed: every moved held authority satisfies `AnchorOrderHeld` (on
  `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : ∀ x ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, AnchorMoves (s.view c) src x →
    ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable q →
      OptP ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
        y.holder = .place q →
          EffAnchorOKC (transferEffC s c src dst) x
            ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).pframe q)) True
  /-- Spec 1 §63.8: local self-blocking prevention. -/
  noSelfLock : NoLocalSelfLock (s.view c) src dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.9: `destination` is usable in the resulting state. -/
  dstUsableAfter : (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable dst

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPreC k s c src dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((s.view c).Usable src ∧ (s.view c).Usable dst ∧
    HasRight (s.view c) .modify src ∧ HasRight (s.view c) .modify dst ∧
    SameShape (s.view c).P src dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, (s.view c).I l = .init) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P dst, (s.view c).I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap (s.view c).P src dst ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, Grounds (s.view c) .modify src g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (s.view c) src j →
        RightChain (s.view c) g j) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ (s.view c).pin l = false) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps (s.view c) src, (s.view c).Active x) ∧
    AnchorOrderC (transferEffC s c src dst) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, AnchorMoves (s.view c) src x →
      ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable q →
        OptP ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
          y.holder = .place q →
            EffAnchorOKC (transferEffC s c src dst) x
              ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).pframe q)) True) ∧
    NoLocalSelfLock (s.view c) src dst ∧ (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable dst)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩⟩

/-! ## O5 `depend` re-indexed (Spec 1 §64) -/

/-- Effect of `depend` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §64 effect, WC4 C2). -/
def dependEffC (s : SC) (c q x : Nat) : SC := s.set (dependEff (s.view c) q x)

/-- Preconditions of `depend` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §64 re-indexed, WC4 C2). -/
structure DependPreC (s : SC) (c q x : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §64.1: `result` is usable. -/
  usable : (s.view c).Usable q
  /-- Spec 1 §64.1: exercisable `Modify` over `result`. -/
  right : HasRight (s.view c) .modify q
  /-- Spec 1 §64.2: `anchor` is active. -/
  anchorActive : (s.view c).Active x
  /-- Spec 1 §64.3 re-indexed: the effective anchor's frame is the frame of `result` or an
  `ancestorC` of it. -/
  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOKC s x ((s.view c).pframe q)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `depend` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §64). -/
instance (s : SC) (c q x : Nat) : Decidable (DependPreC s c q x) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((s.view c).Usable q ∧ HasRight (s.view c) .modify q ∧ (s.view c).Active x ∧
    EffAnchorOKC s x ((s.view c).pframe q))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩

/-! ## O8 `store` re-indexed (Spec 1 §65) -/

/-- Effect of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §65 effect, WC4 C2). -/
def storeEffC (s : SC) (c a p : Nat) : SC := s.set (storeEff (s.view c) a p)

/-- Preconditions of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §65 re-indexed, WC4 C2). -/
structure StorePreC (s : SC) (c a p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §65.1: the authority is active, derived, and held by the current frame. -/
  derivedHeld : OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top) False
  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: `target` is usable. -/
  usable : (s.view c).Usable p
  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: `target` is a leaf. -/
  leaf : isLeaf (s.view c).P p
  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: exercisable `Modify` over `target`. -/
  right : HasRight (s.view c) .modify p
  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: `target` holds no active authority. -/
  free : ∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length,
    OptP ((s.view c).A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True
  /-- Spec 1 §65.3: the authority covers no leaf of `target` nor of storage it owns. -/
  noCover : ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P p ∧
    ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, OwnedIn (s.view c).P p q →
      l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P q
  /-- Spec 1 §65.4 re-indexed: the effective anchor respects `AnchorOrder` (on `ancestorC`)
  relative to the frame of `target`. -/
  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOKC s a ((s.view c).pframe p)
  /-- Spec 1 §65.5: in the resulting state, `target` is under exercisable `Modify`. -/
  keepsTarget : HasRight (storeEff (s.view c) a p) .modify p
  /-- Spec 1 §65.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (storeEffC s c a p)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §65). -/
instance (s : SC) (c a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePreC s c a p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
      y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top) False ∧ (s.view c).Usable p ∧ isLeaf (s.view c).P p ∧
    HasRight (s.view c) .modify p ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length,
      OptP ((s.view c).A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P p ∧
      ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, OwnedIn (s.view c).P p q →
        l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P q) ∧
    EffAnchorOKC s a ((s.view c).pframe p) ∧ HasRight (storeEff (s.view c) a p) .modify p ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (storeEffC s c a p))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩⟩

/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` re-indexed (Spec 1 §72) -/

/-- Effect of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72 effect, WC4 C2): the effect of Spec 1 on
the view of `c`; the new frame `nF` is pushed on the stack of `c`. -/
def enterEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : SC :=
  { s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with
    C := s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := s.nF :: x.stack } }

/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72 re-indexed, WC4 C2). -/
structure EnterPreC (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §72.1 re-indexed: the calling frame, the current frame of `c`, is live. -/
  callerLive : s.stk c ≠ []
  /-- Spec 1 §72.1: each parameter is an active derived authority held by the caller. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- Spec 1 §72.2: the locals form a well-formed shape. -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- Spec 1 §72.3 re-indexed: origin protection on entry, in the resulting state, for the
  executing context. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((enterEffC s c ps ls).view c) p
  /-- Spec 1 §72.4 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) over the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (enterEffC s c ps ls)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72). -/
instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
    Decidable (EnterPreC s c ps ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((enterEffC s c ps ls).view c) p) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (enterEffC s c ps ls))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-! ## O7 re-indexed: `exitFrameC` (Spec 1 §73; WC4 C6) -/

/-- Reparenting (WC4 C6 effect): every live context whose initial frame has parent `f` gets the
parent `p`. -/
def reparent (C : List Ctx) (f p : Nat) : List Ctx :=
  C.map fun x => if x.life = .live ∧ x.parent = some f then { x with parent := some p } else x

/-- Effect of `exitFrameC` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §73 effect; WC4 C6 effect): the effect of Spec 1 on
the view of `c`, whose surviving frames are the other live frames; the top `f` of the stack of `c`
is popped, its caller `p` becomes current again, and the context-initial frames whose parent is
`f` are reparented to `p`; the other ancestry links are unchanged (WC4 C6 effect). -/
def exitEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) : SC :=
  { s.set (exitEff (s.view c)) with
    C := reparent (s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := x.stack.tail })
      ((s.stk c).headD 0) ((s.stk c).tail.headD 0) }

/-- Preconditions of `exitFrameC` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §73 re-indexed; WC4 C6, C6.1: O7.1
transposed, O7.2–O7.5 on the global state). The surviving frames are the other globally live
frames. -/
structure ExitPreC (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §73.1 re-indexed (WC4 C6, first paragraph): the current frame of `c` is not the
  initial frame of its context and has a surviving caller in its stack. -/
  hasCaller : (s.stk c).tail ≠ []
  /-- Spec 1 §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
  authority among itself and its origins. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
    (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned. -/
  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
    ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
  /-- Spec 1 §73.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (exitEffC s c)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `exitFrameC` (Spec 1 §73). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (ExitPreC k s c) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((s.stk c).tail ≠ [] ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
      (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
      ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (exitEffC s c))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-! ## The inherited operations O1–O16 executed by a context (WC4 C2) -/

/-- Outcome relation of a kernel operation O1–O16 executed by context `c` (Spec 1 §60–§75
re-indexed, WC4 C2). Operations reading `ancestor` or changing the stack have their re-indexed
preconditions and effects; the others run on the view of `c`. A context that is not live executes
nothing. -/
def opStepC (k : K) : KernelOp → Nat → SC → Outcome3 SC → Prop
  | .transfer src dst, c, s, o =>
    s.Live c ∧ Guarded (TransferPreC k s c src dst) (transferEffC s c src dst) o
  | .depend q x, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (DependPreC s c q x) (dependEffC s c q x) o
  | .store a p, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (StorePreC s c a p) (storeEffC s c a p) o
  | .enter ps ls, c, s, o =>
    s.Live c ∧ Guarded (EnterPreC s c ps ls) (enterEffC s c ps ls) o
  | .exit, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (ExitPreC k s c) (exitEffC s c) o
  | op, c, s, o => ViewStep (op.Step k) c s o

/-- WC4 C2 (candidate P1): the `K.Satisfiable` obligation of `alloc` (Spec 1 §71) executed by `c`
is evaluated on the view of `c`: an `ok` outcome entails it. -/
theorem alloc_ok_satisfiable {k : K} {c pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {s s' : SC}
    (h : opStepC k (.alloc pr ow ls) c s (.ok s')) : k.Satisfiable pr ls (s.view c) := by
  obtain ⟨-, o₃, hR, ho⟩ := h
  change AllocStep k pr ow ls (s.view c) o₃ at hR
  cases hR with
  | ok _ hsat => exact hsat
  | fail => cases ho
  | reject => cases ho

/-- WC4 C2 (candidate P1): a `fail` outcome of `alloc` (Spec 1 §71) executed by `c` entails that
`K.Satisfiable` fails on the view of `c`. -/
theorem alloc_fail_unsatisfiable {k : K} {c pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {s : SC}
    (h : opStepC k (.alloc pr ow ls) c s .fail) : ¬ k.Satisfiable pr ls (s.view c) := by
  obtain ⟨-, o₃, hR, ho⟩ := h
  change AllocStep k pr ow ls (s.view c) o₃ at hR
  cases hR with
  | ok => cases ho
  | fail _ hsat => exact hsat
  | reject => cases ho

/-! ## `spawn` (WC4 C4, on Spec 1 §72) -/

/-- Effect of `spawn` executed by `c` (WC4 C4 effect): a new live context of identity `|C|` whose
stack is the fresh frame `nF`, parented to the creating frame; the locals of the new frame and
their root authorities, and the yielding of the parameters, are the effects of Spec 1 §72 on the
view of `c`. -/
def spawnEff (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : SC :=
  { s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with
    C := s.C ++ [⟨[s.nF], .live, (s.stk c).head?⟩] }

/-- Preconditions of `spawn` without transmitted value (WC4 C4.1–C4.5): the clauses of `EnterPre`
(Spec 1 §72, `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Ops`) re-indexed as in `EnterPreC`, with O6.3 read from the
current frame of the new context. C4.2 (fresh identities) and C4.4 (yield without duplication)
hold by construction of `spawnEff`; C4.6 concerns `spawn` with a value
(`Ern.Concurrency.Transfer`); the preservation obligations of WC4 C4 are theorems, not
preconditions. -/
structure SpawnPre (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- WC4 C4.1 (Spec 1 §72.1 re-indexed): the creating context and its current frame are live. -/
  creatorLive : s.stk c ≠ []
  /-- WC4 C4.3 (Spec 1 §72.1): every transmitted parameter is an active derived authority held by
  the creating frame. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.2): the locals of the new frame form a well-formed shape. -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.3): origin protection in the final state, from the current frame of the
  new context. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p
  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.4): `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the final state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff s c ps ls)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `spawn` (WC4 C4). -/
instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
    Decidable (SpawnPre s c ps ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff s c ps ls))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `spawn` executed by `c` (WC4 C4): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not live. -/
def SpawnStep (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (SpawnPre s c ps ls) (spawnEff s c ps ls) o

/-! ## `terminate` (WC4 C7, on Spec 1 §73) -/

/-- Effect of `terminate` executed by `c` (WC4 C7): the effect of Spec 1 §73 on the view of `c`
for its initial frame `f`, whose surviving frames are the other live frames; `c` leaves the
live-context set with the completed lifecycle state; the context-initial frames whose parent is
`f` are reparented to the parent of `f` (WC4 C7, C6 effect). -/
def termEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) : SC :=
  { s.set (exitEff (s.view c)) with
    C := reparent (s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := [], life := .done })
      ((s.stk c).headD 0) ((s.ctxParent c).getD 0) }

/-- Preconditions of `terminate` executed by `c` (WC4 C7: the O7 validity requirements applied to
the initial frame of a terminating non-initial context, after its nested call frames have
ended). -/
structure TermPre (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- WC4 C7: a non-initial context (WC4 C3: the base frame never exits). -/
  nonInitial : c ≠ 0
  /-- WC4 C7: the nested call frames have ended; only the initial frame remains. -/
  initialOnly : (s.stk c).length = 1
  /-- Spec 1 §73.1 re-indexed: the initial frame has a surviving parent. -/
  hasParent : OptP (s.ctxParent c) (fun p => p ∈ s.frames ∧ p ∉ s.stk c) False
  /-- Spec 1 §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
  authority among itself and its origins. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
    (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned. -/
  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
    ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
  /-- Spec 1 §73.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (termEffC s c)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `terminate` (WC4 C7). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (TermPre k s c) :=
  decidable_of_iff (c ≠ 0 ∧ (s.stk c).length = 1 ∧
    OptP (s.ctxParent c) (fun p => p ∈ s.frames ∧ p ∉ s.stk c) False ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
      (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
      ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (termEffC s c))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩⟩

/-- `terminate` executed by `c` (WC4 C7): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not live. -/
def TermStep (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (TermPre k s c) (termEffC s c) o

/-! ## `join` (WC4 C8) -/

/-- `join d` executed by `c` (WC4 C8): `reject` when `d` is unknown to the execution (no context
has identity `d`, identities being the indices of `C`); `ok` with the state unchanged when `d` has
the completed lifecycle state; no outcome while `d` is live (WC4 C8: awaiting completion is not an
`Outcome3` result). -/
inductive JoinStep (s : SC) (c d : Nat) : Outcome3 SC → Prop where
  | ok : s.Live c → OptP (s.C[d]?) (fun x => x.life = .done) False → JoinStep s c d (.ok s)
  | reject : s.Live c → s.C[d]? = none → JoinStep s c d .reject

/-! ## Concurrent kernel steps -/

/-- One `ok` transition of the concurrent kernel without synchronization (WC4 C2, C4, C6–C8):
an inherited operation O1–O16 executed by a context, `spawn`, `terminate` or `join`. -/
inductive CStep (k : K) : SC → SC → Prop where
  | kernel {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} : opStepC k op c s (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
  | spawn {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      SpawnStep s c ps ls (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
  | terminate {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} : TermStep k s c (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
  | join {s s' : SC} {c d : Nat} : JoinStep s c d (.ok s') → CStep k s s'

end Ern.Concurrency
