import Ern.Concurrency.CapPreserve

/-!
# L1 on `cap5`: the remaining labels

Continuation of `Ern.Concurrency.CapPreserve` for `cap5_drop_own` (L1, WC5 C45, `OB-C17`; brief
of milestone 4, task 4). A transport of `Attr5` restricted to the authorities that carry a mode
somewhere (`Useful`), then one lemma per label: the labels that append authorities (`split`,
`alloc`, `enterFrame`, `spawn`), the composites (`issue`, `reset`, `spawnVal`), the labels that
release or reanchor authorities (`exitFrame`, `terminate`, `endUse`, `free`), and the assembly of
`Cap5DropOwn`.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Transport restricted to useful authorities -/

/-- An authority attributable in mode `m` contributes somewhere: its effective mode permits `m`
on some leaf (Spec 1 §43; WC5 C43). -/
def Useful (s : SC) (u : Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop := ∃ l, Allows (effective s.flat u l) m

/-- Parents precede their children (Spec 1 §49.2). -/
theorem parents_lt {t : S3} (hw : WF3 t) : ∀ q o, parentOf t.P q = some o → o < q := fun q o h => by
  unfold parentOf at h
  cases hq : t.P[q]? with
  | none => rw [hq] at h; cases h
  | some pl =>
    rw [hq] at h
    obtain ⟨_, _, hlt, _⟩ := hw.places q pl o hq h
    exact hlt

/-- Transport of `Attr5` from `s` to `s'` for context `c`, for the useful authorities only (brief
of milestone 4, task 3; WC5 C43): the frames of `c` stay live, the footprints of existing places
do not grow, and every useful authority attributable to `c` keeps its activity, own mode and
holder, stays outside the live `guarded` set, and keeps an effective mode permitting the mode in
which it is attributable. -/
theorem attr5_transport_u {s s' : SC} {reg reg' : SyncReg} {c : Nat} (hw : WF3 s.flat)
    (hstk : ∀ f ∈ s.stk c, f ∈ s'.stk c)
    (hfp : ∀ p, p < s.P.length → ∀ l ∈ footprint s'.P p, l ∈ footprint s.P p)
    (hA : ∀ u m y, Attr5 s reg c u m → Useful s u m → s.A[u]? = some y → ∃ y', s'.A[u]? = some y' ∧
      y'.active = y.active ∧ y'.mode = y.mode ∧ y'.holder = y.holder)
    (hng : ∀ u m, Attr5 s reg c u m → Useful s u m → NotGuarded s' reg' u)
    (heff : ∀ u m l, Attr5 s reg c u m → Allows (effective s.flat u l) m →
      Allows (effective s'.flat u l) m)
    {u : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : Attr5 s reg c u m) (hu : Useful s u m) : Attr5 s' reg' c u m := by
  have hP := parents_lt hw
  induction h with
  | @base a m y f hg hy ha hm hf hin =>
    have hab : Attr5 s reg c a m := .base hg hy ha hm hf hin
    obtain ⟨y', hy', ha', hm', hf'⟩ := hA a m y hab hu hy
    exact .base (hng a m hab hu) hy' (ha'.trans ha) (hm' ▸ hm) (hf'.trans hf) (hstk f hin)
  | @held a p b m y hg hy ha hm hp hb hc ih =>
    have hab : Attr5 s reg c a m := .held hg hy ha hm hp hb hc
    obtain ⟨y', hy', ha', hm', hp'⟩ := hA a m y hab hu hy
    have hup : s.flat.Usable p := by
      have := hw.holders a _ hy ha; rw [hp] at this; exact this
    obtain ⟨l₀, hl₀⟩ := footprint_ne hP _ p (Nat.le_refl _) hup.lt
    refine .held (hng a m hab hu) hy' (ha'.trans ha) (hm' ▸ hm) (hp'.trans hp)
      (ih ⟨l₀, hc l₀ hl₀⟩) fun l hl => heff b m l hb (hc l (hfp p hup.lt l hl))

/-- `cap5` of `c` does not decrease under the hypotheses of `attr5_transport_u`. -/
theorem cap5_transport_u {s s' : SC} {reg reg' : SyncReg} {c : Nat} (hw : WF3 s.flat)
    (hstk : ∀ f ∈ s.stk c, f ∈ s'.stk c)
    (hfp : ∀ p, p < s.P.length → ∀ l ∈ footprint s'.P p, l ∈ footprint s.P p)
    (hA : ∀ u m y, Attr5 s reg c u m → Useful s u m → s.A[u]? = some y → ∃ y', s'.A[u]? = some y' ∧
      y'.active = y.active ∧ y'.mode = y.mode ∧ y'.holder = y.holder)
    (hng : ∀ u m, Attr5 s reg c u m → Useful s u m → NotGuarded s' reg' u)
    (heff : ∀ u m l, Attr5 s reg c u m → Allows (effective s.flat u l) m →
      Allows (effective s'.flat u l) m) (l : Nat) :
    capRank (cap5 s reg c l) ≤ capRank (cap5 s' reg' c l) := by
  refine cap5_rank_mono fun m ⟨x, hx, ha, he⟩ =>
    ⟨x, ?_, attr5_transport_u hw hstk hfp hA hng heff ha ⟨l, he⟩, heff x m l ha he⟩
  have hlt := List.mem_range.1 hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y := ⟨_, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt⟩
  obtain ⟨y', hy', -⟩ := hA x m y ha ⟨l, he⟩ hy
  exact List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy')

/-- A context without frames has no `cap5` (WC5 C43: attribution ends at a live frame). -/
theorem cap5_nil {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c l : Nat} (h : s.stk c = []) :
    cap5 s reg c l = none := by
  have hno : ∀ u m, ¬ Attr5 s reg c u m := fun u m hu => by
    induction hu with
    | base _ _ _ _ _ hin => rw [h] at hin; simp at hin
    | held _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  unfold cap5
  have h1 : ¬ CapAt5 s reg c l .modify := fun ⟨x, _, hx, _⟩ => hno x _ hx
  have h2 : ¬ CapAt5 s reg c l .observe := fun ⟨x, _, hx, _⟩ => hno x _ hx
  simp only [h1, h2, ↓reduceIte]

/-- Fewer covering descendants keep an allowed mode (Spec 1 §43): if every active descendant of
`u` covering `l` in `t'` was an active descendant of `u` covering `l` in `t`, with the same mode,
and `u` keeps its activity, mode and footprint, an effective mode allowed in `t` is allowed in
`t'`. -/
theorem eff_keep_sub {t t' : S3} {u l : Nat} {m : Mode}
    (hu : ∀ z, t.A[u]? = some z → ∃ z', t'.A[u]? = some z' ∧ z'.active = z.active ∧
      z'.mode = z.mode ∧ z'.footprint = z.footprint)
    (hd : ∀ j y, t'.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true → l ∈ y.footprint → u ∈ t'.ancs j →
      ∃ y₀, t.A[j]? = some y₀ ∧ y₀.active = true ∧ l ∈ y₀.footprint ∧ u ∈ t.ancs j ∧
        y₀.mode = y.mode)
    (h : Allows (effective t u l) m) : Allows (effective t' u l) m := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hza, hzl, -⟩ := eff_present (allows_present h)
  obtain ⟨z', hz', ha', hm', hf'⟩ := hu z hz
  rw [effective_eq hz hza hzl] at h
  rw [effective_eq hz' (ha'.trans hza) (hf' ▸ hzl), hm']
  refine allows_effOf_sub (fun md hmd => ?_) h
  obtain ⟨j, y, hy, hya, hyl, hj, rfl⟩ := Ern.MemoryModel.Access.mem_descModes.1 hmd
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hd j y hy hya hyl hj
  exact Ern.MemoryModel.Access.mem_descModes.2 ⟨j, y₀, hy₀, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩

/-- An active `Modify` authority covering `l` below `u` leaves `u` no effective mode on `l`
(Spec 1 §43, case 3). -/
theorem no_eff_below_modify {t : S3} {src u l : Nat} {x : Authority} {m : Mode}
    (hx : t.A[src]? = some x) (hxa : x.active = true) (hxm : x.mode = .modify)
    (hxl : l ∈ x.footprint) (hanc : u ∈ t.ancs src) (h : Allows (effective t u l) m) : False := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hza, hzl, -⟩ := eff_present (allows_present h)
  rw [effective_eq hz hza hzl] at h
  have hin : x.mode ∈ descModes t u l := mem_descModes hx hxa hxl hanc
  rw [hxm] at hin
  rcases allows_effOf h with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨hn, -⟩
  · rw [h0] at hin; simp at hin
  · exact hn hin

/-- `NotGuarded` when the former authorities keep their activity (WC4 C12): an entry live
afterwards was live before, or its `guarded` is a fresh identity. -/
theorem notGuarded_prefix {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg}
    (hact : ∀ j < s.A.length, ∀ y', s'.A[j]? = some y' → y'.active = true → s.flat.Active j)
    {u : Nat} (hu : u < s.A.length) (h : NotGuarded s reg u) : NotGuarded s' reg u :=
  fun e he hl => by
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hya⟩ := hl
    by_cases hlt : e.guarded < s.A.length
    · exact h e he (hact _ hlt y' hy' hya)
    · exact fun h' => hlt (h' ▸ hu)

/-- An attributable authority exists (WC5 C43). -/
theorem Attr5.lt {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c u : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : Attr5 s reg c u m) :
    u < s.A.length := by
  cases h with
  | base _ hy => exact lt_of_getElem? hy
  | held _ hy => exact lt_of_getElem? hy

/-- Origin chains of the former authorities are kept when their origins are (Spec 1 §42). -/
theorem ancs_prefix {t t' : S3} (hold : ∀ i < t.A.length, t'.org i = t.org i) {j : Nat}
    (hj : j < t.A.length) : t'.ancs j = t.ancs j :=
  chain_congr fun i hi => hold i (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hi hj)

/-! ## `split` (Spec 1 §61) -/

/-- The authorities after `split` (Spec 1 §61, `ok` effect): the former ones, then one `Modify`
descendant of `src` per region. -/
theorem split_get {t : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} {j : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (h : (splitEff t src rs).A[j]? = some y) :
    (j < t.A.length ∧ t.A[j]? = some y) ∨
    (t.A.length ≤ j ∧ ∃ r ∈ rs, y = ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame t.top, true⟩) := by
  simp only [splitEff] at h
  by_cases hj : j < t.A.length
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hj] at h; exact .inl ⟨hj, h⟩
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega), List.getElem?_map] at h
    cases hr : rs[j - t.A.length]? with
    | none => rw [hr] at h; cases h
    | some r =>
      rw [hr] at h; cases h
      exact .inr ⟨by omega, r, List.mem_of_getElem? hr, rfl⟩

/-- `split` by context `c'` (Spec 1 §61) does not lower `cap5` of another context `c`: the new
authorities are `Modify` descendants of the source over leaves where the source has effective
`Modify` (§61.1), which excludes, for `c`, the source (`attr_compat`) and its ancestors (Spec 1
§43, case 3). -/
theorem split_cap5_mono {k : K} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} (hF : FramesC s) (hI : I1 s.flat)
    (hw : WF3 s.flat) {c c' src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} (hcc : c ≠ c') (hlive : s.Live c')
    (hp : SplitPre k (s.view c') src rs) (l : Nat) :
    capRank (cap5 s reg c l) ≤ capRank (cap5 (s.set (splitEff (s.view c') src rs)) reg c l) := by
  have hne := hF.nonempty c' hlive
  have hvA : ∀ a l, effective (s.view c') a l = effective s.flat a l :=
    fun a l => effective_of_A rfl a l
  have hc'src : Attr s c' src .modify := attr_of_exercisable hne hp.exercisable
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxa⟩ := hp.active
  have hxm : x.mode = .modify := by
    rcases exer_mode hp.exercisable hx with h | h
    · cases h
    · exact h
  have hsl : src < s.A.length := lt_of_getElem? hx
  have hpre : ∀ j < s.A.length, (splitEff (s.view c') src rs).A[j]? = s.A[j]? :=
    fun j hj => List.getElem?_append_left hj
  have horg : ∀ i < (s.view c').A.length, (splitEff (s.view c') src rs).org i = (s.view c').org i :=
    fun i hi => by unfold S3.org; rw [hpre i hi]; rfl
  refine cap5_transport_u (s' := s.set (splitEff (s.view c') src rs)) (reg' := reg) hw
    (fun f hf => hf) (fun p _ l hl => hl)
    (fun u m y hu _ hy => ⟨y, by show (splitEff (s.view c') src rs).A[u]? = _;
      rw [hpre u hu.lt]; exact hy, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩)
    (fun u m hu _ => notGuarded_prefix (fun j hj y' hy' hya => ⟨y', by
        have : (splitEff (s.view c') src rs).A[j]? = some y' := hy'
        rwa [hpre j hj] at this, hya⟩) hu.lt hu.notGuarded)
    (fun u m l hu hal => ?_) l
  show Allows (effective (splitEff (s.view c') src rs) u l) m
  rw [← hvA] at hal
  refine eff_keep_sub (fun z hz => ⟨z, by rw [hpre u hu.lt]; exact hz, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩)
    (fun j y hy hya hyl hj => ?_) hal
  rcases split_get hy with ⟨hjl, hy'⟩ | ⟨hjl, r, hr, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨y, hy', hya, hyl, by rwa [ancs_prefix horg hjl] at hj, rfl⟩
  · exfalso
    have horg' : (splitEff (s.view c') src rs).org j = some src := by
      unfold S3.org; rw [hy]; rfl
    have hanc : (splitEff (s.view c') src rs).ancs j = src :: (s.view c').ancs src := by
      unfold S3.ancs
      rw [chain_cons horg' (by omega)]
      exact congrArg _ (ancs_prefix horg hsl)
    rw [hanc] at hj
    have hmod : effective s.flat src l = some .modify := by rw [← hvA]; exact hp.modifyOn r hr l hyl
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hj with rfl | hanc'
    · exact attr_compat hF.nodup hI hw (Ne.symm hcc) hc'src rfl _ l m hmod hu.attr
        (by rw [← hvA]; exact hal)
    · have hxl : l ∈ x.footprint := by
        have := (hp.within r hr l hyl).1; unfold S3.afp at this; rw [hx] at this; exact this
      exact no_eff_below_modify hx hxa hxm hxl hanc' hal

/-! ## `alloc` (Spec 1 §71) -/

/-- `alloc` by context `c'` (Spec 1 §71) does not lower `cap5` of another context: the new root
authority has no origin, so it is a descendant of nothing, and the footprints of the former places
are kept (§71, `ok` effect). -/
theorem alloc_cap5_mono {k : K} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} (hw : WF3 s.flat) {c c' pr ow : Nat}
    {ls : LocalShape} (hst : AllocStatic k (s.view c') pr ow ls) (l : Nat) :
    capRank (cap5 s reg c l) ≤ capRank (cap5 (s.set (allocEff (s.view c') ow ls)) reg c l) := by
  have hvA : ∀ a l, effective (s.view c') a l = effective s.flat a l :=
    fun a l => effective_of_A rfl a l
  have hpre : ∀ j < s.A.length, (allocEff (s.view c') ow ls).A[j]? = s.A[j]? :=
    fun j hj => Alloc.A_lt hj
  refine cap5_transport_u (s' := s.set (allocEff (s.view c') ow ls)) (reg' := reg) hw
    (fun f hf => hf)
    (fun p hp l hl => (Alloc.footprint_old (s := s.view c') hst.shapeOK hp l).1 hl)
    (fun u m y hu _ hy => ⟨y, by show (allocEff (s.view c') ow ls).A[u]? = _;
      rw [hpre u hu.lt]; exact hy, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩)
    (fun u m hu _ => notGuarded_prefix (fun j hj y' hy' hya => ⟨y', by
        have : (allocEff (s.view c') ow ls).A[j]? = some y' := hy'
        rwa [hpre j hj] at this, hya⟩) hu.lt hu.notGuarded)
    (fun u m l hu hal => ?_) l
  show Allows (effective (allocEff (s.view c') ow ls) u l) m
  rw [← hvA] at hal
  refine eff_keep_sub (fun z hz => ⟨z, by rw [hpre u hu.lt]; exact hz, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩)
    (fun j y hy hya hyl hj => ?_) hal
  rw [Alloc.ancs_eq hst] at hj
  rcases Alloc.allocA_get hst hy with ⟨-, hy'⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨y, hy', hya, hyl, hj, rfl⟩
  · exfalso
    have : (s.view c').org s.A.length = none := by
      unfold S3.org; rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (Nat.le_refl _)]; rfl
    rw [S3.ancs, chain_none this] at hj; simp at hj

/-! ## `enterFrame` and `spawn` (Spec 1 §72; WC4 C4) -/

/-- The kernel effect of `enterFrame` executed by `c'` (Spec 1 §72), read from another context `c`
holding none of the parameters: `cap5` of `c` does not decrease when the stack of `c` and the
registry are kept. The parameters are held by the current frame of `c'` (§72.1), the new root
authorities have no origin, and the footprints of the former places are kept (§72, `ok`
effect). -/
theorem enter_cap5_mono {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} (hF : FramesC s) (hw : WF3 s.flat)
    {c c' : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} (hcc : c ≠ c') (hne : s.stk c' ≠ [])
    (hparams : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c').A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
      y.holder = .frame (s.view c').top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False)
    (hsh : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape)
    (hk : s'.A = (enterEff (s.view c') ps ls).A ∧ s'.P = (enterEff (s.view c') ps ls).P)
    (hstk : ∀ f ∈ s.stk c, f ∈ s'.stk c) (l : Nat) :
    capRank (cap5 s reg c l) ≤ capRank (cap5 s' reg c l) := by
  have hvA : ∀ a l, effective (s.view c') a l = effective s.flat a l :=
    fun a l => effective_of_A rfl a l
  have hnp : ∀ u m, Attr5 s reg c u m → u ∉ ps := fun u m hu hup => by
    have hpu := hparams u hup
    unfold OptP at hpu
    split at hpu
    · rename_i y hy
      exact not_attr_frame (c := c) (c' := c') hF.nodup hcc hy hpu.2.1 (view_top_mem hne) hu.attr
    · exact hpu.elim
  have hpre : ∀ u m, Attr5 s reg c u m → s'.A[u]? = s.A[u]? := fun u m hu => by
    rw [hk.1, Frames.enter_lt (s := s.view c') hu.lt]
    show Option.map _ (s.A[u]?) = _
    simp [hnp u m hu]
  have hact : ∀ j < s.A.length, ∀ y', s'.A[j]? = some y' → y'.active = true → s.flat.Active j :=
    fun j hj y' hy' hya => by
      rw [hk.1] at hy'
      rcases Frames.enter_get hy' with ⟨-, y, hy, rfl⟩ | ⟨hjl, -⟩
      · refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
        split at hya
        · exact hya
        · exact hya
      · exact absurd hj (Nat.not_lt.2 hjl)
  have heq : ∀ a l, effective s'.flat a l = effective (enterEff (s.view c') ps ls) a l :=
    fun a l => effective_of_A hk.1 a l
  refine cap5_transport_u (s' := s') (reg' := reg) hw hstk
    (fun p hp l hl => by
      rw [show s'.P = _ from hk.2] at hl
      exact (Frames.enter_footprint_old (s := s.view c') hsh hp l).1 hl)
    (fun u m y hu _ hy => ⟨y, by rw [hpre u m hu]; exact hy, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩)
    (fun u m hu _ => notGuarded_prefix hact hu.lt hu.notGuarded)
    (fun u m l hu hal => ?_) l
  rw [heq]
  rw [← hvA] at hal
  refine eff_keep_sub (fun z hz => ⟨z, by rw [← hk.1, hpre u m hu]; exact hz, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩)
    (fun j y hy hya hyl hj => ?_) hal
  rcases Frames.enter_get hy with ⟨hjl, y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ | ⟨hjl, i, -, rfl⟩
  · refine ⟨y₀, hy₀, ?_, ?_, by rwa [Frames.enter_ancs_lt hjl] at hj, ?_⟩ <;>
      split at hya <;> first | exact hya | (split at hyl <;> exact hyl) | (split <;> rfl)
  · exfalso
    have : (enterEff (s.view c') ps ls).org j = none := by unfold S3.org; rw [hy]; rfl
    rw [S3.ancs, chain_none this] at hj; simp at hj

end Ern.Concurrency

theorem derive_cap5_mono {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} (hF : FramesC s) (hI : I1 s.flat)

      capRank (cap5 (s.set (deriveEff (s.view c') src region md)) reg c l) := by
  have hne := hF.nonempty c' hlive
  have hpre : ∀ j < s.A.length, (deriveEff (s.view c') src region md).A[j]? = s.A[j]? :=
    fun j hj => addAuth_lt (s := s.view c') hj
  refine cap5_transport_u (s' := s.set (deriveEff (s.view c') src region md)) (reg' := reg) hw

    {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {c' : Nat} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (htr : EncapsulatedTrace5 k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []) lbls st)
    (h : LStep k L (.kernel c' .exit) st st') (c l : Nat)
    (hd : capRank (cap5 st'.1 st'.2.1 c l) < capRank (cap5 st.1 st.2.1 c l)) :
    (Label.kernel c' .exit).ctx = c := by
  have hk := trace5_kInvCA hdd hst htr
  have hk' := lstep_kInvCA hdd h hk

  have hcc : c ≠ c' := fun e => hctx (e ▸ rfl)

  | @kernel s s' reg ar _ _ hs =>

    cases hR with
    | ok hp =>
      exact absurd hd (Nat.not_lt.2 (exit_cap5_mono hF hw hcc (hF.nonempty c' hlive)
        (exitEffC_pop hF.nodup hp.hasCaller) rfl rfl rfl hk'.1.2.1.2.2 l))

popped as by `exitFrame` (Spec 1 §73). Under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80), from a state reached by an

    {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {c' : Nat} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (htr : EncapsulatedTrace5 k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []) lbls st)
    (h : LStep k L (.terminate c') st st') (c l : Nat)
    (hd : capRank (cap5 st'.1 st'.2.1 c l) < capRank (cap5 st.1 st.2.1 c l)) :
    (Label.terminate c').ctx = c := by
  have hk := trace5_kInvCA hdd hst htr
  have hk' := lstep_kInvCA hdd h hk
  refine Decidable.byContradiction fun hctx => ?_
  have hcc : c ≠ c' := fun e => hctx (e ▸ rfl)
  cases h with
  | @terminate s s' reg ar _ ht =>
    obtain ⟨hF, hw, -⟩ := hk.parts
    obtain ⟨hlive, hR⟩ := ht
    cases hR with
    | ok hp =>
      have hpar : s.ctxParent c' ≠ none := fun he => by
        have := hp.hasParent; rw [he] at this; exact this
      exact absurd hd (Nat.not_lt.2 (exit_cap5_mono hF hw hcc (hF.nonempty c' hlive)
        (termEffC_pop hF.nodup hp.initialOnly hpar) rfl rfl rfl hk'.1.2.1.2.2 l))

+§80), from a state reached by an `EncapsulatedTrace5` from an initial state (Spec 1 §47). -/
+theorem cap5_drop_own_exit {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics} {lbls : List Label}
+    {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {c' : Nat} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
+    (htr : EncapsulatedTrace5 k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []) lbls st)
+    (h : LStep k L (.kernel c' .exit) st st') (c l : Nat)
+    (hd : capRank (cap5 st'.1 st'.2.1 c l) < capRank (cap5 st.1 st.2.1 c l)) :
+    (Label.kernel c' .exit).ctx = c := by

+    cases hR with

+popped as by `exitFrame` (Spec 1 §73). Under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80), from a state reached by an

+theorem cap5_drop_own_terminate {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics} {lbls : List Label}
+    {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {c' : Nat} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
+    (htr : EncapsulatedTrace5 k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []) lbls st)
+    (h : LStep k L (.terminate c') st st') (c l : Nat)
+    (hd : capRank (cap5 st'.1 st'.2.1 c l) < capRank (cap5 st.1 st.2.1 c l)) :
+    (Label.terminate c').ctx = c := by
+  have hk := trace5_kInvCA hdd hst htr
+  have hk' := lstep_kInvCA hdd h hk
+  refine Decidable.byContradiction fun hctx => ?_
+  have hcc : c ≠ c' := fun e => hctx (e ▸ rfl)
+  cases h with
+  | @terminate s s' reg ar _ ht =>
+    obtain ⟨hF, hw, -⟩ := hk.parts
+    obtain ⟨hlive, hR⟩ := ht
+    cases hR with
+    | ok hp =>

+        have := hp.hasParent; rw [he] at this; exact this

+        (termEffC_pop hF.nodup hp.initialOnly hpar) rfl rfl rfl hk'.1.2.1.2.2 l))

/-! ## Authorities that are only released (§69, §70) -/

/-- The authorities of `s₁` are those of `s`, some of them made inactive (§69, §70 `ok` effects:
authorities are released, never created or changed otherwise). -/
def OnlyReleases (s s₁ : S3) : Prop :=
  s₁.A.length = s.A.length ∧ ∀ (j : Nat) (z : Authority), s₁.A[j]? = some z →
    ∃ y, s.A[j]? = some y ∧ z.mode = y.mode ∧ z.origin = y.origin ∧ z.footprint = y.footprint ∧
      z.holder = y.holder ∧ (z.active = true → y.active = true)

/-- Mapping the authorities by a function that keeps an authority or makes it inactive only
releases authorities (§69, §70). -/
theorem map_releases {s s₁ : S3} {g : Authority → Authority} (hA : s₁.A = s.A.map g)
    (hg : ∀ y, g y = y ∨ g y = { y with active := false }) : OnlyReleases s s₁ := by
  refine ⟨by rw [hA, List.length_map], fun j z hz => ?_⟩
  rw [hA, List.getElem?_map] at hz
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at hz; cases hz
  | some y =>
    rw [hy] at hz; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hz; subst hz
    refine ⟨y, rfl, ?_⟩
    rcases hg y with e | e <;> rw [e] <;> simp

/-- Releases compose (§69, §70: release, then release the authorities whose holder died). -/
theorem OnlyReleases.trans {s s₁ s₂ : S3} (h₁ : OnlyReleases s s₁) (h₂ : OnlyReleases s₁ s₂) :
    OnlyReleases s s₂ := by
  refine ⟨h₂.1.trans h₁.1, fun j z hz => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y₁, hy₁, m₁, o₁, f₁, h₁', a₁⟩ := h₂.2 j z hz
  obtain ⟨y, hy, m, o, f, hh, a⟩ := h₁.2 j y₁ hy₁
  exact ⟨y, hy, m₁.trans m, o₁.trans o, f₁.trans f, h₁'.trans hh, fun h => a (a₁ h)⟩

/-- Every authority of `s` has a counterpart after releases, with the same fields but its
activity (§69, §70). -/
theorem OnlyReleases.get' {s s₁ : S3} (h : OnlyReleases s s₁) {j : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s.A[j]? = some y) : ∃ z, s₁.A[j]? = some z ∧ z.mode = y.mode ∧ z.origin = y.origin ∧
      z.footprint = y.footprint ∧ z.holder = y.holder := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z, s₁.A[j]? = some z :=
    ⟨_, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.2 ⟨by rw [h.1]; exact lt_of_getElem? hy, rfl⟩⟩

    ∃ y, s.A[j]? = some y ∧ z.mode = y.mode ∧ z.origin = y.origin ∧ z.footprint = y.footprint ∧

/-- Mapping the authorities by a function that keeps an authority or makes it inactive only
releases authorities (§69, §70). -/
theorem map_releases {s s₁ : S3} {g : Authority → Authority} (hA : s₁.A = s.A.map g)
    (hg : ∀ y, g y = y ∨ g y = { y with active := false }) : OnlyReleases s s₁ := by
  refine ⟨by rw [hA, List.length_map], fun j z hz => ?_⟩

  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at hz; cases hz
  | some y =>
    rw [hy] at hz; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hz; subst hz

/-- The authorities after `endUseS` (§69, `ok` effect): those held within `p` are inactive. -/
theorem EndFree.endUseS_get (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : (endUseS s p).A[j]? =
    (s.A[j]?).map fun y => if heldIn s.P p y.holder then { y with active := false } else y := by
  simp [endUseS]

/-- `endUseS` only releases authorities (§69, `ok` effect). -/
theorem EndFree.endUseS_releases (s : S3) (p : Nat) : OnlyReleases s (endUseS s p) :=
  map_releases rfl fun y => by by_cases h : heldIn s.P p y.holder <;> simp [h]

/-- A place usable after `endUseS` was usable before (§69: the effect only adds death
markers). -/
theorem EndFree.endUseS_usable {s : S3} {p q : Nat} (h : (endUseS s p).Usable q) : s.Usable q :=
  S3.Usable.mono (s := s) (s' := endUseS s p) rfl (fun _ h => h)
    (fun q h => by simp only [endUseS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h; exact h.1) h

/-- An active authority after `endUse p` (§69, `ok` effect): active before, not held within `p`,
with a holder live after `endUseS`. -/
theorem EndFree.endUse_active {s : S3} {p j : Nat} {z : Authority}
    (hz : (endUseEff s p).A[j]? = some z) (za : z.active = true) :
    s.A[j]? = some z ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P p z.holder ∧ HolderLive (endUseS s p) z.holder := by
  obtain ⟨hz₁, hl⟩ := cleanup_active hz za
  rw [endUseS_get] at hz₁
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at hz₁; cases hz₁
  | some y =>
    rw [hy] at hz₁
    by_cases hh : heldIn s.P p y.holder
    · simp only [hh, Option.map_some, ↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq] at hz₁
      subst hz₁; simp at za
    · simp only [hh, Option.map_some, ↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq] at hz₁
      subst hz₁; exact ⟨rfl, hh, hl⟩

/-- Under `EndUsePre` (§69.3) and `I3` (§52), every anchor of a place usable after `endUseS`
stays active after `endUse`. -/
theorem EndFree.endUse_anchors {k : K} {s : S3} {p : Nat} (h3 : I3 s) (hpre : EndUsePre k s p) :
    ∀ q, (endUseS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q, (endUseEff s p).Active x := by
  intro q hq x hx
  have hq₀ := endUseS_usable hq
  have hx₀ : x ∈ s.D q := by
    simp only [endUseS] at hx; split at hx
    · simp at hx
    · exact hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := h3 q hq₀ x hx₀
  have hc := hpre.anchors q (List.mem_range.2 hq₀.lt) hq x hx
  unfold EndUseAnchorOK OptP at hc; rw [hy] at hc
  obtain ⟨hnh, -, hl⟩ := hc
  exact ⟨y, by rw [endUseEff, cleanup_get, endUseS_get, hy]; simp [hnh, hl], ya⟩

/-- A place usable before `endUseS` and not after is storage owned by the value at `p`,
transitively (§69 `ok` effect: the places that cease to live are the transitively owned ones;
§40, items 1–3). -/
theorem EndFree.owned_of_endUseS {s : S3} {p q : Nat} (hq : s.Usable q)
    (hq' : ¬ (endUseS s p).Usable q) : OwnedIn s.P p q := by
  induction hq with
  | frame hpl hd ho hf =>
    exact Decidable.byContradiction fun hn => hq' (.frame hpl (by simp [endUseS, hd, hn]) ho hf)
  | @place q o _ hpl hd ho _ ih =>
    refine Decidable.byContradiction fun hn => ?_
    by_cases hou : (endUseS s p).Usable o
    · exact hq' (.place hpl (by simp [endUseS, hd, hn]) ho hou)
    · exact hn (.step hpl ho (ih hou))

/-- At most one authority with no origin lies on an origin chain, its start included (§42, §49.5:
an origin chain ends at a single root authority). -/
theorem EndFree.chain_root_unique {org : Nat → Option Nat}
    (hlt : ∀ i o, org i = some o → o < i) :
    ∀ n i, i < n → ∀ x y, (x = i ∨ x ∈ chain org i) → (y = i ∨ y ∈ chain org i) →
      org x = none → org y = none → x = y
  | 0, _, h, _, _, _, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, i, hi, x, y, hx, hy, hxo, hyo => by
    cases ho : org i with
    | none =>
      rw [chain_none ho] at hx hy
      simp only [List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx hy
      exact hx.trans hy.symm
    | some o =>
      have hoi := hlt i o ho
      rw [chain_cons ho hoi] at hx hy
      have hx' : x = o ∨ x ∈ chain org o := by
        rcases hx with rfl | hx
        · rw [ho] at hxo; cases hxo
        · exact List.mem_cons.1 hx
      have hy' : y = o ∨ y ∈ chain org o := by
        rcases hy with rfl | hy
        · rw [ho] at hyo; cases hyo
        · exact List.mem_cons.1 hy
      exact EndFree.chain_root_unique hlt n o (by omega) x y hx' hy' hxo hyo

/-- An authority through which a step exercises its `Modify` right over a usable place `p` (the
grounding authority or its origin chain, §69.2, §70.3, §63.4) covers no leaf of storage owned by
`p`, under `WF3` (§49): its origin chain ends at the root authority of the structural root place
of `p` (§49.6), so such a leaf would be a part of that root place, and an ownership cycle makes no
place usable (§40). -/
theorem EndFree.rightChain_not_owned {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {p g j l : Nat} {z : Authority}
    (hp : s.Usable p) (hg : Grounds s .modify p g) (hj : RightChain s g j)
    (hz : s.A[j]? = some z) (hlz : l ∈ z.footprint) : ¬ OwnedIn s.P p l := by
  intro hown
  have hlt : ∀ i o, s.org i = some o → o < i := fun i o h => by
    simp only [S3.org] at h
    cases hi : s.A[i]? with
    | none => rw [hi] at h; cases h
    | some y => rw [hi] at h; exact hw.origins i y o hi h
  obtain ⟨lp, hlp⟩ := exists_mem_footprint hw (s.P.length - p + 1) p (by omega) hp.lt
  have hlpleaf := (mem_footprint.1 hlp).2.1
  have hcov : ∃ x, s.A[g]? = some x ∧ lp ∈ x.footprint := by
    have hal := hg.2.2 lp hlp
    cases he : effective s g lp with
    | none => rw [he] at hal; simp [Allows, OptP] at hal
    | some m => obtain ⟨x, hx, -, hpx, -⟩ := effective_some he; exact ⟨x, hx, hpx⟩
  obtain ⟨yg, hyg, hlpg⟩ := hcov
  obtain ⟨xg, wg, rp, hxg, hwg, wgo, hrp, hlprp, hwgf⟩ := hw.rootChain g yg lp hyg hlpg hlpleaf
  obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf⟩ := hw.footprints j z hz l hlz
  obtain ⟨xj, wj, rl, hxj, hwj, wjo, -, hlrl, hwjf⟩ := hw.rootChain j z l hz hlz hleaf
  have hxj' : xj = g ∨ xj ∈ s.ancs g := by
    rcases hj with rfl | hj
    · exact hxj
    · rcases hxj with rfl | hxj
      · exact .inr hj
      · exact .inr (chain_trans hlt (g + 1) g (Nat.lt_succ_self g) j hj xj hxj)
  have e : xj = xg := chain_root_unique hlt (g + 1) g (Nat.lt_succ_self g) xj xg hxj' hxg
    (by simp [S3.org, hwj, wjo]) (by simp [S3.org, hwg, wgo])
  subst e
  rw [hwj] at hwg; cases hwg
  have hlrp : partOf s.P l rp :=
    (mem_footprint.1 ((hwgf l).1 ((hwjf l).2 (mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlrl⟩)))).2.2
  obtain ⟨r', hr', hpr'⟩ := exists_rootPlace hw (p + 1) p (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp.lt
  obtain rfl : rp = r' :=
    rootOf_unique hrp hr' hlprp (mem_footprint.1 (footprint_sub hw hpr' hlp)).2.2
  obtain ⟨pl, prp, hpl, hprp, ho⟩ := hw.ownerOf hlrp
  obtain ⟨pp, prp', hpp, hprp', ho'⟩ := hw.ownerOf hpr'
  rw [hprp] at hprp'; cases hprp'
  exact not_ownedIn_chain hw hp (.inl rfl)
    (ownedIn_of_owner hprp hpp ho' (ownedIn_of_owner hpl hprp ho.symm hown))

/-- `endUse` preserves `NoDangling` (§54, §69), under `WF3` (§49) and `I1` (§50): an active
authority on a leaf of a place that stops being usable is derived, and either blocked by §69.2 or
exempt as an authority through which the step exercises its right, which covers no dying storage
(`rightChain_not_owned`); or a root, held by the owner of the root place of the leaf
(`rootHeldConv_active`), which would stay usable. -/
theorem EndFree.endUse_noDangling {k : K} {s : S3} {p : Nat} (hw : WF3 s) (hnd : NoDangling s)

theorem EndFree.endUse_anchors {k : K} {s : S3} {p : Nat} (h3 : I3 s) (hpre : EndUsePre k s p) :
    ∀ q, (endUseS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q, (endUseEff s p).Active x := by

  have hc := hpre.anchors q (List.mem_range.2 hq₀.lt) hq x hx

  induction hq with
  | frame hpl hd ho hf =>
    exact Decidable.byContradiction fun hn => hq' (.frame hpl (by simp [endUseS, hd, hn]) ho hf)
  | @place q o _ hpl hd ho _ ih =>

    by_cases hou : (endUseS s p).Usable o

    · exact hn (.step hpl ho (ih hou))

theorem EndFree.chain_root_unique {org : Nat → Option Nat}

    cases ho : org i with

      simp only [List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx hy

    | some o =>

        rcases hx with rfl | hx

        · exact List.mem_cons.1 hx

        rcases hy with rfl | hy

        · exact List.mem_cons.1 hy

theorem EndFree.rightChain_not_owned {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {p g j l : Nat} {z : Authority}
    (hp : s.Usable p) (hg : Grounds s .modify p g) (hj : RightChain s g j)
    (hz : s.A[j]? = some z) (hlz : l ∈ z.footprint) : ¬ OwnedIn s.P p l := by

  have hlpleaf := (mem_footprint.1 hlp).2.1

    have hal := hg.2.2 lp hlp
    cases he : effective s g lp with
    | none => rw [he] at hal; simp [Allows, OptP] at hal
    | some m => obtain ⟨x, hx, -, hpx, -⟩ := effective_some he; exact ⟨x, hx, hpx⟩
  obtain ⟨yg, hyg, hlpg⟩ := hcov
  obtain ⟨xg, wg, rp, hxg, hwg, wgo, hrp, hlprp, hwgf⟩ := hw.rootChain g yg lp hyg hlpg hlpleaf
  obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf⟩ := hw.footprints j z hz l hlz
  obtain ⟨xj, wj, rl, hxj, hwj, wjo, -, hlrl, hwjf⟩ := hw.rootChain j z l hz hlz hleaf
  have hxj' : xj = g ∨ xj ∈ s.ancs g := by
    rcases hj with rfl | hj
    · exact hxj
    · rcases hxj with rfl | hxj
      · exact .inr hj
      · exact .inr (chain_trans hlt (g + 1) g (Nat.lt_succ_self g) j hj xj hxj)
  have e : xj = xg := chain_root_unique hlt (g + 1) g (Nat.lt_succ_self g) xj xg hxj' hxg
    (by simp [S3.org, hwj, wjo]) (by simp [S3.org, hwg, wgo])
  subst e

  have hlrp : partOf s.P l rp :=
    (mem_footprint.1 ((hwgf l).1 ((hwjf l).2 (mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlrl⟩)))).2.2
  obtain ⟨r', hr', hpr'⟩ := exists_rootPlace hw (p + 1) p (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp.lt
  obtain rfl : rp = r' :=
    rootOf_unique hrp hr' hlprp (mem_footprint.1 (footprint_sub hw hpr' hlp)).2.2

    (ownedIn_of_owner hprp hpp ho' (ownedIn_of_owner hpl hprp ho.symm hown))

  rw [chain_cons hp hlt]
  constructor

  · rename_i pl hpl; exact ⟨lt_of_getElem? hpl, by simp [parentOf, hpl, h.1]⟩
  · exact h.elim

/-- A part of a root place `r` is a part of `p` exactly when it is `p` or its structural parent is
a part of `p`, for `p` a root place (§40). -/
theorem EndFree.partOf_parent {P : List Place} {q r p : Nat} (hp : parentOf P q = some r)
    (hlt : r < q) (hr : r < P.length) (hroot : parentOf P p = none) :
    partOf P q p ↔ partOf P r p := by
  have hq : q < P.length := by
    simp only [parentOf] at hp
    cases h : P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h] at hp; cases hp
    | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? h
  simp only [partOf, hq, hr, true_and]
  rw [chain_cons hp hlt]
  constructor
  · rintro (rfl | h)
    · rw [hroot] at hp; cases hp
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
      · exact .inl rfl
      · exact .inr h
  · rintro (rfl | h)
    · exact .inr (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    · exact .inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)

/-- A root place that is a part of `p` is `p` (§40). -/
theorem EndFree.eq_of_partOf_root {P : List Place} {r p : Nat} (hr : RootPlace P r)
    (h : partOf P r p) : r = p := by
  obtain ⟨-, e | hc⟩ := h
  · exact e
  · rw [chain_none hr.2] at hc; simp at hc

/-- Under `FreePre` (§70.3) and `I3` (§52), every anchor of a place usable after `freeS` stays
active after `free`. -/
theorem EndFree.free_anchors {k : K} {s : S3} {p auth : Nat} (h3 : I3 s) (hpre : FreePre k s p auth) :
    ∀ q, (freeS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ (freeS s p).D q, (freeEff s p).Active x := by
  intro q hq x hx
  have hq₀ := freeS_usable hq
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := h3 q hq₀ x hx
  have hc := hpre.anchors q (List.mem_range.2 hq₀.lt) hq x hx
  unfold FreeAnchorOK OptP at hc; rw [hy] at hc
  obtain ⟨hcov, hnh, hl⟩ := hc
  have hn : ¬ ((∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∨ heldIn s.P p y.holder) :=
    fun h => h.elim hcov hnh
  exact ⟨y, by rw [freeEff, cleanup_get, freeS_get, hy]; simp only [Option.map_some, hn,
    ↓reduceIte, hl], ya⟩

/-- After `free p`, no active authority covers a leaf of the released unit, and every active
authority has a live holder (§70 `ok` effect, §54). -/
theorem free_no_dangling {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} (h : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s'.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
      (∀ l ∈ y.footprint, ¬ FreedPlace s.P p l) ∧ HolderLive s' y.holder := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  intro j y hy ya
  obtain ⟨-, hc, hl⟩ := free_active hy ya
  exact ⟨fun l hl' hf => hc (.inl ⟨l, hl', hf⟩),
    (HolderLive.congr (s := freeS s p) (s' := freeEff s p) rfl rfl rfl _).2 hl⟩

/-- A place usable before `freeS` and not after belongs to the released unit (§70 `ok` effect:
the places that cease to live are `place` and the storage it owns; §40, items 1–3). -/
theorem EndFree.freed_of_freeS {s : S3} {p q : Nat} (hq : s.Usable q)
    (hq' : ¬ (freeS s p).Usable q) : FreedPlace s.P p q := by
  induction hq with
  | frame hpl hd ho hf =>
    exact Decidable.byContradiction fun hn => hq' (.frame hpl (by simp [freeS, hd, hn]) ho hf)
  | @place q o _ hpl hd ho _ ih =>
    refine Decidable.byContradiction fun hn => ?_
    by_cases hou : (freeS s p).Usable o
    · exact hq' (.place hpl (by simp [freeS, hd, hn]) ho hou)
    · rcases ih hou with h | h
      · exact hn (.inr (.direct hpl ho h))
      · exact hn (.inr (.step hpl ho h))

/-- `free` preserves `NoDangling` (§54, §70), under `WF3` (§49) and `I1` (§50): an active
authority on a leaf of a place that stops being usable is derived, and either blocked by §70.3 or
exempt as an authority through which the step exercises its right, then made inactive since it
covers the released unit (`freed_of_freeS`); or a root, held by the owner of the root place of
the leaf (`rootHeldConv_active`), which would stay usable. -/

    (h1 : I1 s) (hpre : FreePre k s p auth) (hw' : WF3 (freeEff s p)) :

def spawnCreate (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : SC := spawnEff s c [] ls

def transfersEff (c : Nat) : SC → List (Nat × Nat) → SC
  | t, [] => t
  | t, v :: vs => transfersEff c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs

def spawnValEff (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (vs : List (Nat × Nat)) :
    SC :=
  yieldEff (transfersEff c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs) ps s.nF

structure SpawnValPre (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
    (vs : List (Nat × Nat)) : Prop where
  /-- WC4 C4.1: the creating context and its current frame are live. -/
  creatorLive : s.stk c ≠ []
  /-- WC4 C4.3, C5.3 (Spec 1 §72.1): every parameter is an active derived authority held by the
  creating frame before the composite. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.2): the locals form a well-formed shape. -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- WC4 C5 item 2: every destination is a fresh root local of the new frame. -/
  freshDst : ∀ v ∈ vs, FreshRootLocal s ls v.2
  /-- WC4 C5.2, C5 items 1, 3, 4: the transfer phases. -/
  transfers : ValTransfersPre k (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).flat c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs
  /-- WC4 C5 item 5: no parameter covers a leaf of a by-value source, on the declared source
  footprints before consumption. -/
  paramsApart : ∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ v ∈ vs, ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P v.1
  /-- WC4 C5.3 (Spec 1 §72.1): at the beginning of the yield phase, every parameter is active,
  derived and held by the creating frame, in the state produced by the transfers. -/
  paramsAtYield : ∀ a ∈ ps,
    OptP (((transfersEff c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs).view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
      y.holder = .frame ((transfersEff c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs).view c).top ∧
      y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- WC4 C5.4, Spec 1 §63.6, second half: `AnchorOrder` (on `ancestorC`) in the final state. -/
  anchorOrder : AnchorOrderC (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs)
  /-- WC4 C5.4, Spec 1 §63.9: every destination is usable in the final state. -/
  dstUsableAfter : ∀ v ∈ vs, (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).flat.Usable v.2
  /-- WC4 C4.5, C5.4, Spec 1 §72.3: origin protection in the final state, from the current frame of
  the new context. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).view s.C.length) p
  /-- WC4 C4.5, C5.4, Spec 1 §72.4 (`AnchorOrderHeld` on `ancestorC`) in the final state, which
  includes Spec 1 §63.7 for the moved held authorities. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs)

/-- Decidability of `SpawnValPre` (WC4 C4, C5). -/
def SpawnValStep (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
    (vs : List (Nat × Nat)) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (SpawnValPre k s c ps ls vs) (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs) o

/-! ## Steps that only release authorities: `endUse`, `free` (Spec 1 §69, §70) -/

/-- A live frame is in the stack of the view of any context (WC4 C2). -/
theorem mem_view_F {s : SC} {c y : Nat} (hy : y ∈ s.frames) : y ∈ (s.view c).F := by
  show y ∈ s.stk c ++ s.frames.filter fun f => decide (f ∉ s.stk c)
  by_cases h : y ∈ s.stk c
  · exact List.mem_append_left _ h
  · exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hy, decide_eq_true h⟩)

/-- An attributable authority is active (WC5 C43). -/
theorem Attr5.active {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c u : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority}
    (h : Attr5 s reg c u m) (hy : s.A[u]? = some y) : y.active = true := by
  cases h with
  | base _ hy' ha => rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'; exact ha
  | held _ hy' ha => rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'; exact ha

/-- A step that only releases authorities (`OnlyReleases`, Spec 1 §69, §70) and keeps the places
and the frames of `c` does not lower `cap5` of `c` when every useful authority attributable to
`c` stays active: effective modes can only rise. -/
theorem releases_cap5_mono {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} (hw : WF3 s.flat) {c : Nat}
    (hr : OnlyReleases s.flat s'.flat) (hstk : ∀ f ∈ s.stk c, f ∈ s'.stk c) (hP : s'.P = s.P)

    obtain ⟨hlive, o, hR, ho⟩ := hs

+  · exact List.mem_append_left _ h
+  · exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hy, decide_eq_true h⟩)
+/-- An attributable authority is active (WC5 C43). -/
+theorem Attr5.active {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c u : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority}
+    (h : Attr5 s reg c u m) (hy : s.A[u]? = some y) : y.active = true := by
+  cases h with
+  | base _ hy' ha => rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'; exact ha
+  | held _ hy' ha => rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'; exact ha
+/-- A step that only releases authorities (`OnlyReleases`, Spec 1 §69, §70) and keeps the places
+and the frames of `c` does not lower `cap5` of `c` when every useful authority attributable to
+`c` stays active: effective modes can only rise. -/
+theorem releases_cap5_mono {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} (hw : WF3 s.flat) {c : Nat}
+    (hr : OnlyReleases s.flat s'.flat) (hstk : ∀ f ∈ s.stk c, f ∈ s'.stk c) (hP : s'.P = s.P)
+    (hkeep : ∀ u m, Attr5 s reg c u m → Useful s u m → s'.flat.Active u) (l : Nat) :
+    capRank (cap5 s reg c l) ≤ capRank (cap5 s' reg c l) := by
+  have hact : ∀ u m z, Attr5 s reg c u m → Useful s u m → s'.A[u]? = some z → z.active = true :=
+    fun u m z hu hus hz => by
+      obtain ⟨z', hz', hza⟩ := hkeep u m hu hus
+      have : s'.A[u]? = some z' := hz'
+      rw [hz] at this; cases this; exact hza
+  refine cap5_transport_u (s' := s') (reg' := reg) hw hstk (fun q _ l hl => by rwa [hP] at hl)
+    (fun u m y hu hus hy => ?_) (fun u m hu _ e he hl => ?_) (fun u m l hu hal => ?_) l
+  · obtain ⟨z, hz, hm, -, -, hh⟩ := hr.get' (show s.flat.A[u]? = some y from hy)
+    exact ⟨z, hz, by rw [hact u m z hu hus hz, hu.active hy], hm, hh⟩
+  · obtain ⟨y', hy', hya⟩ := hl
+    obtain ⟨y, hy, -, -, -, -, ha⟩ := hr.2 e.guarded y' hy'
+    exact hu.notGuarded e he ⟨y, hy, ha hya⟩
+  · refine eff_keep_sub (t := s.flat) (t' := s'.flat) (fun z hz => ?_) (fun j y hy hya hyl hj => ?_)
+      hal
+    · obtain ⟨z', hz', hm, -, hf, -⟩ := hr.get' hz
+      exact ⟨z', hz', by rw [hact u m z' hu ⟨l, hal⟩ hz', hu.active hz], hm, hf⟩
+    · obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, hm, -, hf, -, ha⟩ := hr.2 j y hy
+      exact ⟨y₀, hy₀, ha hya, hf ▸ hyl, by rwa [hr.ancs] at hj, hm.symm⟩
+/-- `endUse` by context `c'` (Spec 1 §69) keeps active every useful authority attributable to
+another context: it is held neither within the place, over which `c'` exercises `Modify`
+(§69.1; `not_attr_place`), nor by a place that dies, by `NoDangling` after the step (Spec 1 §54,
+theorem endUse_keeps {k : K} {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} (hF : FramesC s) (hI : I1 s.flat)
+    (hw : WF3 s.flat) {c c' p : Nat} (hcc : c ≠ c') (hne : s.stk c' ≠ [])
+    (hp : EndUsePre k (s.view c') p) (hs' : s' = s.set (endUseEff (s.view c') p))
+    (hND : NoDangling s'.flat) {u : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : Attr5 s reg c u m) (hu : Useful s u m) :
+    ∀ y, s.A[u]? = some y → s'.A[u]? = some y := by
+  have hP := parents_lt hw
+  obtain ⟨g, -, hgx, hge⟩ := hp.right
+  have hg : Attr s c' g .modify := attr_of_exercisable hne hgx
+  have hge' : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s.flat g l) .modify :=
+    fun l hl => by rw [← effective_of_A (t := s.view c') (t' := s.flat) rfl]; exact hge l hl
+  have hget : ∀ a y, s.A[a]? = some y → ¬ heldIn s.P p y.holder →
+      HolderLive (endUseS (s.view c') p) y.holder → s'.A[a]? = some y := fun a y hy hnh hl => by
+    subst hs'
+    show (endUseEff (s.view c') p).A[a]? = some y
+    rw [endUseEff, EndFree.cleanup_get, EndFree.endUseS_get,
+      show (s.view c').A[a]? = some y from hy]
+    simp only [Option.map_some, show ¬ heldIn (s.view c').P p y.holder from hnh, ↓reduceIte]
+    simp only [show HolderLive (endUseS (s.view c') p) y.holder from hl, ↓reduceIte]
+  induction h with
+  | @base a m y f₀ hg' hy ha hm hfr hin =>
+    intro y' hy'
+    rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'
+    refine hget a y hy (by rw [hfr]; exact id) ?_
+    rw [hfr]
+    exact mem_view_F (SC.mem_frames_of hin)
+  | @held a q b m y hg' hy ha hm hp' hb hc ih =>
+    intro y' hy'
+    rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'
+    have hup : s.flat.Usable q := by
+      have := hw.holders a _ hy ha; rw [hp'] at this; exact this
+    obtain ⟨l₀, hl₀⟩ := footprint_ne hP _ q (Nat.le_refl _) hup.lt
+    obtain ⟨zb, hzb, -, hzl, -⟩ := eff_present (allows_present (hc l₀ hl₀))
+    have hbk := ih ⟨l₀, hc l₀ hl₀⟩ zb hzb
+    refine hget a y hy (fun hh => ?_) ?_
+    · rw [hp'] at hh
+      exact not_attr_place hF.nodup hI hw hcc hy hp' hg
+        (fun l hl => hge' l (footprint_sub hw hh hl)) (.held hy ha hm hp' hb.attr hc)
+    · rw [hp']
+      refine Decidable.byContradiction fun hnu => ?_
+      have hnu' : ¬ s'.flat.Usable q := fun hu' => hnu (by
+        refine S3.Usable.mono (s := endUseS (s.view c') p) (s' := s'.flat)
+          (by rw [hs']; rfl) (fun f hf => ?_) (fun q hq => by rw [hs'] at hq; exact hq) hu'
+        exact mem_view_F (s := s) (c := c') (by rw [hs'] at hf; exact hf))
+      have hza : zb.active = true := hb.active hzb
+      exact hND b zb hbk hza q hnu' l₀ (by rw [hs']; exact hl₀) hzl
+/-- L1 (`cap5_drop_own`, WC5 C45) for `endUse` (Spec 1 §69). Under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80), from a
+state reached by an `EncapsulatedTrace5` from an initial state (Spec 1 §47). -/
+theorem cap5_drop_own_endUse {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics} {lbls : List Label}
+    {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {c' p : Nat} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
+    (htr : EncapsulatedTrace5 k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []) lbls st)
+    (h : LStep k L (.kernel c' (.endUse p)) st st') (c l : Nat)
+    (hd : capRank (cap5 st'.1 st'.2.1 c l) < capRank (cap5 st.1 st.2.1 c l)) :
+    (Label.kernel c' (.endUse p)).ctx = c := by
+  have hk := trace5_kInvCA hdd hst htr
+  have hk' := lstep_kInvCA hdd h hk
+  refine Decidable.byContradiction fun hctx => ?_
+  have hcc : c ≠ c' := fun e => hctx (e ▸ rfl)
+  cases h with
+  | @kernel s s' reg ar _ _ hs =>
+    obtain ⟨hF, hw, hI⟩ := hk.parts
+    obtain ⟨hlive, o, hR, ho⟩ := hs
+    cases hR with
+    | reject => cases ho
+    | ok hp =>
+      cases ho
+      have hr : OnlyReleases s.flat (s.set (endUseEff (s.view c') p)).flat :=
+        (EndFree.endUseS_releases (s.view c') p).trans (EndFree.cleanup_releases _)
+      refine absurd hd (Nat.not_lt.2 (releases_cap5_mono hw hr (fun f hf => hf) rfl
+        (fun u m hu hus => ?_) l))
+      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, s.A[u]? = some y := ⟨_, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hu.lt⟩
+      exact ⟨y, endUse_keeps hF hI hw hcc (hF.nonempty c' hlive) hp rfl hk'.1.2.1.2.2 hu hus y hy,
+        hu.active hy⟩
end Ern.Concurrency

/-!
# Preservation by `endUse` (O12, §69) and `free` (O13, §70)

Both effects only make authorities inactive and mark places dead, then release the authorities
whose holder died (§69, §70 `ok` effects). The shared argument is in namespace `EndFree`; the
per-operation results state that each step preserves `KInv` (§57 of
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`), separately the auxiliary `KAux` (§40, §49.7) and
`I5` (§57), and the effects of §69 and §70: the ended place stays usable, its leaves become
`Uninit`, transitively owned storage and the released unit are dead, pinned leaves block the step
(§69.4, §70.4).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

namespace EndFree

theorem create_yield {s : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ ps, a < s.A.length) :
    yieldEff (spawnCreate s c ls) ps s.nF = spawnEff s c ps ls := by
  have h0 : mapI (fun j (y : Authority) => if j ∈ ([] : List Nat) then
      { y with holder := .frame (s.view c).nF } else y) 0 (s.view c).A = (s.view c).A :=
    mapI_id 0 _ fun _ _ => by simp
  refine sc_ext rfl rfl rfl rfl ?_ rfl rfl rfl
  show mapI (yieldF ps s.nF) 0 (enterEff (s.view c) [] ls).A = (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls).A
  simp only [enterEff]
  rw [mapI_append, h0]
  congr 1
  exact mapI_id (0 + (s.view c).A.length) _ fun k y => by
    have : 0 + (s.view c).A.length + k ∉ ps := fun h => by
      have h2 := hp _ h
      change 0 + s.A.length + k < s.A.length at h2
      omega
    simp only [yieldF, this, ↓reduceIte]

/-! ## The kernel invariant without the anchor orders -/

/-- The clauses of `KInvCA` other than the anchor orders (Spec 1 §57 re-indexed, WC4 C20). -/
def KBase (s : SC) : Prop :=

namespace TransferPreserveAux

open PreservationAux

/-! ## Yield and transfer commute -/

/-- `mapI` followed by `map` is `map` followed by `mapI` when the two functions commute on each
element. -/
theorem mapI_map_comm {F : Nat → Authority → Authority} {G : Authority → Authority} :
    ∀ (i : Nat) (l : List Authority),
      (∀ (k : Nat) (y : Authority), l[k]? = some y → G (F (i + k) y) = F (i + k) (G y)) →
      (mapI F i l).map G = mapI F i (l.map G)
  | _, [], _ => rfl
  | i, y :: l, h => by
    have h0 : G (F i y) = F i (G y) := by simpa using h 0 y rfl
    have ih := mapI_map_comm (i + 1) l fun k z hz => by
      have := h (k + 1) z (by simpa using hz)
      rwa [show i + (k + 1) = i + 1 + k by omega] at this
    simp only [mapI, List.map_cons, h0, ih]

/-- The yield function of `yieldEff` (WC4 C5.3). -/
def yieldF (ps : List Nat) (f : Nat) (j : Nat) (y : Authority) : Authority :=
  if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame f } else y

/-- The holder map of the transfer effect (Spec 1 §63 effect). -/
def moveF (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) (y : Authority) : Authority :=
  if heldIn P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo P src dst y.holder } else y

/-- A frame holder is never within a place (Spec 1 §63). -/
theorem not_heldIn_frame {P : List Place} {q g : Nat} : ¬ heldIn P q (.frame g) := fun h => h

/-- A parameter held by a frame is not moved by a transfer. -/
theorem yield_move_comm {P : List Place} {ps : List Nat} {f src dst : Nat} {t : SC}
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ y, t.A[a]? = some y → ∃ g, y.holder = .frame g) (j : Nat) (y : Authority)
    (hy : t.A[j]? = some y) :
    moveF P src dst (yieldF ps f j y) = yieldF ps f j (moveF P src dst y) := by
  unfold yieldF moveF
  by_cases hk : j ∈ ps
  · obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hp _ hk y hy
    have h1 : ¬ heldIn P src y.holder := by rw [hg]; exact not_heldIn_frame
    simp only [hk, h1, not_heldIn_frame, ↓reduceIte]
  · simp only [hk, ↓reduceIte]

/-- Extensionality of `S_C` states. -/
theorem sc_ext {a b : SC} (hC : a.C = b.C) (hn : a.nF = b.nF) (hP : a.P = b.P) (hI : a.I = b.I)
    (hA : a.A = b.A) (hD : a.D = b.D) (hd : a.dead = b.dead) (hp : a.pins = b.pins) : a = b := by
  cases a; cases b
  simp only at hC hn hP hI hA hD hd hp
  subst hC hn hP hI hA hD hd hp; rfl

/-- WC4 C5.2–C5.3: when the parameters are held by frames, yielding them before or after one
transfer gives the same state. -/
theorem yield_transfer {t : SC} {ps : List Nat} {f c src dst : Nat}
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ y, t.A[a]? = some y → ∃ g, y.holder = .frame g) :
    transferEffC (yieldEff t ps f) c src dst = yieldEff (transferEffC t c src dst) ps f := by

+/-! ## `spawnVal` (WC4 C4, C5) -/
+open TransferPreserveAux in
+/-- The yield of WC4 C5.3 changes only holders (Spec 1 §42). -/
+theorem yield_skel (t : SC) (ps : List Nat) (f : Nat) : SameSkel t.flat (yieldEff t ps f).flat := by
+  refine ⟨length_mapI _ 0 t.A, fun j => ?_⟩
+  show ((mapI (yieldF ps f) 0 t.A)[j]?).map skel = (t.A[j]?).map skel
+  rw [getElem?_mapI]
+  cases t.A[j]? with
+  | none => rfl
+  | some y => simp only [Option.map_some, yieldF]; split <;> rfl
+open TransferPreserveAux in
+/-- An authority exercisable by `c'` before the yield (Spec 1 §43, WC4 C2) is attributable after
+the yield to `c'` or to the context `d` whose stack holds the yield frame `f` (WC5 C43): the
+yielded parameters are frame-held and move from the current frame of `c'` to `f`. -/
+theorem attr_yield {t : SC} {ps : List Nat} {f c' d g : Nat} {m : Mode} (hne : t.stk c' ≠ [])
+    (hf : f ∈ t.stk d) (hp : ∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ y, t.A[a]? = some y → ∃ g, y.holder = .frame g)
+    (h : (t.view c').ExercisableAt g m) :
+    Attr (yieldEff t ps f) c' g m ∨ Attr (yieldEff t ps f) d g m := by
+  have hget : ∀ a y, t.A[a]? = some y → (yieldEff t ps f).A[a]? = some (yieldF ps f a y) :=
+    fun a y hy => by
+      show (mapI (yieldF ps f) 0 t.A)[a]? = _
+      rw [getElem?_mapI, hy]; simp
+  induction h with
+  | @base a m y hy ha hm hfr =>
+    by_cases hap : a ∈ ps
+    · refine .inr (.base (hget a y hy) ha hm ?_ hf)
+      simp [yieldF, hap]
+    · refine .inl (.base (hget a y hy) ha hm ?_ (view_top_mem hne))
+      simp [yieldF, hap, hfr]
+  | @held a q b m y hy ha hm hq _ hc ih =>
+    have hap : a ∉ ps := fun hap => by
+      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hp a hap y hy
+      rw [hq] at hg; cases hg
+    have hy' : (yieldEff t ps f).A[a]? = some y := by rw [hget a y hy]; simp [yieldF, hap]
+    have hc' : ∀ l ∈ footprint (yieldEff t ps f).P q,
+        Allows (effective (yieldEff t ps f).flat b l) m := fun l hl => by
+      rw [(yield_skel t ps f).effective, ← effective_of_A (t := t.view c') (t' := t.flat) rfl]

+      cases hh' : y.holder with
+      | frame f => rw [hh'] at hh; exact hh

+        rw [hh'] at hh

+          (fun l hl => hge l (footprint_sub hw hh hl)) hu.attr
+  refine cap5_transport_u (s' := transferEffC s c' src dst) (reg' := reg) hw (fun f hf => hf)
+    (fun p _ l hl => by
+      have hl' : l ∈ footprint (transferEff (s.view c') src dst).P p := hl
+      rwa [transfer_footprint] at hl')

+    (fun u m hu _ => notGuarded_of_skel hsk (fun e he => ⟨e, he, rfl⟩) hu.notGuarded)

+  simp only [List.getElem?_map]
+  rw [show (s.view c').A[u]? = some y from hy]

+parameters are already yielded (`yield_transfers`): no phase lowers `cap5` of a context `c` other
+than the creator `c'` and the new context `d`. `KBase` holds at each phase, as in
+`transfers_base`. -/

+        ((yieldEff t ps f).view c').Active x := by
+      intro x hx
+      have hmd : movedDeps ((yieldEff t ps f).view c') v.1 = movedDeps (t.view c') v.1 := by
+        unfold movedDeps

+    have hk₁ := transfer_base hk ((hu _).2 hpre.srcUsable) ((hu _).2 hpre.dstUsable) hdeps

+      (transfer_usable_frameOwned ((hu _).2 hpre.dstUsable) hown₀)
+    obtain ⟨hF, hw, hI, -⟩ := hk
+    have hstep : capRank (cap5 (yieldEff t ps f) reg c l) ≤
+        capRank (cap5 (transferEffC (yieldEff t ps f) c' v.1 v.2) reg c l) := by
+      obtain ⟨g, -, hgx, hge⟩ := hpre.srcRight

+        exact hge l hl

+      · exact transfer_cap5_mono_g hF hI hw hcc hg hge' l
+      · exact transfer_cap5_mono_g hF hI hw hcd hg hge' l

+    · exact transfer_frameOwned (hown w (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw))
+    · obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := transfer_frame_held hy
+      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hp a ha y₀ hy₀

+had no `cap5` before the step. Under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80), from a state reached by an

+    {vs : List (Nat × Nat)} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)

+    (h : LStep k L (.spawnVal c' ps ls vs) st st') (c l : Nat)

+          · exact this.elim

+          rw [create_yield hlt]
+          exact spawn_base hk hpre.creatorLive hpre.params hpre.localsOK

+          rw [show (spawnEff s c' ps' ls).C[c]? = s.C[c]? from List.getElem?_append_left hcl]

+          · exfalso; apply hpre.creatorLive

+        have hnF : s.nF ∈ (spawnCreate s c' ls).stk s.C.length := by
+          unfold SC.stk
+          show s.nF ∈ (match (s.C ++ [⟨[s.nF], .live, (s.stk c').head?⟩])[s.C.length]? with

+          rw [List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_refl _)]

+            (fun f hf => by rw [hstkc]; exact hf) l
+        have h2 := transfers_cap5_mono (reg := reg) (k := k)
+          (fin := (spawnValEff s c' ps ls vs).flat) (f := s.nF) (ps := ps) hcc
+          (Nat.ne_of_lt hcl) l (spawnCreate s c' ls) vs hpre.transfers hb₀

content.content:
## 40. Logical Places, Leaves, and Ownership

A place has an identity, optionally a structural parent, an abstract `kind`, an owner `owner : Frame | Place`, and a logical death marker. Structural parenthood `partOf(p,q)` describes the subplaces of a value; `owner` describes **who keeps the storage** of a root place valid. An owned place may lie outside its owner's direct footprint; ownership and composition are therefore distinct.

A **leaf** is a place with no structural children. `footprint(p)` contains the leaves of `p`, and access rights over a place are evaluated on those leaves. Places transitively owned by a value are not automatically leaves of its `footprint`. A logical unit of the access discipline does not automatically constitute an additional allocation in the elementary memory machine.

A place `p` is **usable** (`Usable(s,p)`) if and only if:

1. `p` exists and is not marked dead;
2. if its owner is a frame, that frame belongs to the stack;
3. if its owner is a place `q`, then `q` is itself usable and the chain terminates at a frame in the stack.

An ownership cycle makes no place usable. `placeFrame(p)` is the terminal frame of this chain when `p` is usable. Structural parts share their parent's owner and death marker. A value may be logically ended by `endUse` without the place that contained it becoming unusable; the substorages it owned may, however, die.

A **root place** has no structural parent. Every **usable** root place has a root authority of own mode `Modify`, with no origin, held exactly by that place's owner (`RootHeld`). This authority cannot be transferred in isolation; root ownership follows a legal transfer of the owning value when necessary.

## 49. WF3 — Well-Formedness of Frames, Places, and Authorities

L1 est prouvé pour les 28 sortes d'étiquettes. `cap5_drop_own : DDSound k → Cap5DropOwn k L` est à `CapDrop.lean:1332` sur `formal/spec2-m4`, avec les seuls axiomes `{propext, Quot.sound}`. Rien n'est poussé, pas de PR.

**Les 11 étiquettes restantes, regroupées par argument :**
- **`split`, `alloc`, `enterFrame`, `spawn` :** ces pas ajoutent des autorités. Les nouvelles autorités ne descendent de rien qu'un autre contexte utilise. Pour `spawn`, le nouveau contexte n'avait pas de `cap5` avant le pas.
- **`issue`, `reset` :** ce sont deux pas noyau à la suite. Les invariants tiennent entre les deux phases par T2.
- **`exitFrame`, `terminate` :** le réancrage ne garde que d'anciens ancêtres. Les autorités utiles des autres contextes survivent, ce que montre `NoDangling` dans l'état d'arrivée.
- **`endUse`, `free` :** ces pas ne font que libérer. Pour `free`, aucune autorité utile d'un autre contexte ne couvre l'unité libérée.
- **`spawnVal` :** il se lit comme un `spawn` avec paramètres suivi des transferts. L'autorité qui fonde chaque transfert appartient au créateur ou au nouveau contexte.

J'ai restreint le lemme de transport aux autorités qui ont un mode effectif quelque part. Sans cette restriction, `free` aurait été un faux contre-exemple : il désactive une racine qu'un autre contexte peut s'attribuer, mais qui n'y a déjà aucun mode effectif.

import Ern.Concurrency.CapDrop

/-!
# Test of a corrected `GuardedExcl`

`GuardedExcl` (brief of milestone 4, task 3) excludes the steps whose authority argument is a live
`guarded`; the third clause of Spec 1 §43 is recursive along the holder chain, and an authority
stored in the protected storage is exercisable through `guarded` (`Corpus/GuardedChain.lean`).
This module tests the correction proposed in `formal/reports/spec2-m4-handoff.md`: the authority
argument of `derive`, `split`, `read`, `write` and `writeShared` must be exercisable from the
current frame by a holder chain that contains no live `guarded` (`Exer5`). It is a proposition of
the report, absent from WC5 and from the brief, tested here and not decided. Beside it, the
definitions of the brief (`GuardedExcl`, `Encap5`, `EncapsulatedTrace5`) are unchanged.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Exercise without a live `guarded` -/

/-- `ExercisableAt` (Spec 1 §43) read from the current frame of `c`, by a holder chain none of whose
authorities is the `guarded` of a live entry of `reg` (WC4 C12). -/
inductive Exer5 (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) : Nat → Mode → Prop where
  | base {a : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : NotGuarded s reg a → s.A[a]? = some y →
      y.active = true → m.le y.mode → y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top → Exer5 s reg c a m
  | held {a p b : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : NotGuarded s reg a → s.A[a]? = some y →
      y.active = true → m.le y.mode → y.holder = .place p → Exer5 s reg c b m →
      (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s.flat b l) m) → Exer5 s reg c a m

/-- One step of `Exer5 · m` read on a Boolean premise (decision procedure, on the pattern of `exR`,
Spec 1 §43). -/
def exer5R (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) (m : Mode) (E : Nat → Bool) (a : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (NotGuarded s reg a) && match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => y.active && decide (m.le y.mode) && match y.holder with
    | .frame f => decide (f = (s.view c).top)
    | .place p => (List.range s.A.length).any fun b =>
        decide (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s.flat b l) m) && E b
  | none => false

/-- `exer5R` is a bounded monotone rule. -/
theorem exer5R_rule (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) (m : Mode) :
    KRule s.A.length (exer5R s reg c m) where
  mono p q hpq a h := by
    unfold exer5R at h ⊢
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h ⊢
    refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩
    have h2 := h.2
    split at h2
    · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h2 ⊢
      refine ⟨h2.1, ?_⟩; split at h2
      · simpa using h2.2
      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.any_eq_true] at h2 ⊢
        obtain ⟨b, hb, hc, he⟩ := h2.2
        exact ⟨b, hb, hc, hpq b he⟩
    · exact h2
  bound p a h := by
    unfold exer5R at h
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h
    have h2 := h.2
    split at h2
    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
    · cases h2
  loc p q hpq a := by
    unfold exer5R; congr 1; split
    · congr 1; split
      · rfl
      · exact any_congr' fun b hb => by rw [hpq b (List.mem_range.1 hb)]
    · rfl

/-- Soundness of the iteration for `Exer5`. -/
theorem exer5_of_kiter (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) (m : Mode) :
    ∀ k a, kiter (exer5R s reg c m) k a = true → Exer5 s reg c a m
  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
  | k + 1, a, h => by
    simp only [kiter, exer5R, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
    obtain ⟨hg, h⟩ := h
    split at h
    · rename_i y hy
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨ha, hm⟩, h⟩ := h
      split at h
      · rename_i f hf; exact .base hg hy ha hm (by simp at h; rw [hf, h])
      · rename_i p hp
        simp only [List.any_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
        obtain ⟨b, -, hc, hb⟩ := h
        exact .held hg hy ha hm hp (exer5_of_kiter s reg c m k b hb) hc
    · cases h

/-- `Exer5` is computed by `|A| + 1` steps of `exer5R`. -/
theorem exer5_iff {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c a : Nat} {m : Mode} :
    Exer5 s reg c a m ↔ kiter (exer5R s reg c m) (s.A.length + 1) a = true := by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, exer5_of_kiter s reg c m _ a⟩
  induction h with
  | base hg hy ha hm hf =>
    simp only [kiter, exer5R, hy, ha, hf, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
    exact ⟨hg, hm, trivial⟩
  | held hg hy ha hm hp _ hc ih =>
    rw [← kiter_fix (exer5R_rule s reg _ _)]
    have hb' := kiter_bound (exer5R_rule s reg _ _) _ _ ih
    simp only [kiter, exer5R, hy, ha, hp, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
      List.any_eq_true, List.mem_range]
    exact ⟨hg, hm, _, hb', hc, ih⟩

/-- Decidability of `Exer5`. -/
instance (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c a : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (Exer5 s reg c a m) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ exer5_iff.symm

/-- An authority exercisable without a live `guarded` from the current frame of a context with a
nonempty stack is attributable to that context without a live `guarded` (WC5 C43). -/
theorem Exer5.attr5 {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c a : Nat} {m : Mode} (hne : s.stk c ≠ [])
    (h : Exer5 s reg c a m) : Attr5 s reg c a m := by
  induction h with
  | base hg hy ha hm hf => exact .base hg hy ha hm hf (view_top_mem hne)
  | held hg hy ha hm hp _ hc ih => exact .held hg hy ha hm hp ih hc

/-- The argument of an `Exer5` is not a live `guarded`. -/
theorem Exer5.notGuarded {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c a : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : Exer5 s reg c a m) :
    NotGuarded s reg a := by
  cases h with
  | base hg => exact hg
  | held hg => exact hg

/-! ## The corrected exclusion -/

/-- `ChainExcl` (correction proposed in `formal/reports/spec2-m4-handoff.md`, tested here): the
authority argument of `derive` (Spec 1 §60.1), `split` (§61.1), `read` (§66.2), `write` (§67.1) and
`writeShared` (§68.2) is exercisable, in the mode the precondition requires, from the current
frame of the executing context by a holder chain without a live `guarded` (`Exer5`). -/
def ChainExcl (st : SC × SyncReg) : Label → Prop
  | .kernel c (.derive a _ m) => Exer5 st.1 st.2 c a m
  | .kernel c (.split a _) => Exer5 st.1 st.2 c a .modify
  | .kernel c (.read a _) => Exer5 st.1 st.2 c a .observe
  | .kernel c (.write a _) => Exer5 st.1 st.2 c a .modify
  | .kernel c (.writeShared a _) => Exer5 st.1 st.2 c a .observe
  | _ => True

/-- Decidability of `ChainExcl`. -/
instance (st : SC × SyncReg) (lbl : Label) : Decidable (ChainExcl st lbl) := by
  unfold ChainExcl; split <;> infer_instance

/-- `Encap5C`: `Encap5` with `ChainExcl` in place of `GuardedExcl`. -/
def Encap5C (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) (lbl : Label) : Prop :=
  Encap L st lbl ∧ ChainExcl st lbl ∧ CtlExcl L st lbl

/-- `ChainExcl` implies `GuardedExcl`: the argument of an `Exer5` is not a live `guarded`. -/
theorem chainExcl_guardedExcl {st : SC × SyncReg} {lbl : Label} (h : ChainExcl st lbl) :
    GuardedExcl st lbl := by
  cases lbl with
  | kernel c op =>
    cases op <;> simp only [ChainExcl, GuardedExcl] at h ⊢ <;>
      first | trivial | exact h.notGuarded
  | _ => trivial

/-- `EncapsulatedTrace5C`: a run every step of which satisfies `Encap5C` in the state where it is
taken. -/
inductive EncapsulatedTrace5C (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) :
    SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg → Prop where
  | nil {st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} : EncapsulatedTrace5C k L st [] st
  | cons {st st₁ st₂ : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbl : Label} {lbls : List Label} :
      Encap5C L (st.1, st.2.1) lbl → LStep k L lbl st st₁ →
      EncapsulatedTrace5C k L st₁ lbls st₂ → EncapsulatedTrace5C k L st (lbl :: lbls) st₂

/-- Every `EncapsulatedTrace5C` is an `EncapsulatedTrace5`: `cap5_compat` and `cap5_drop_own`
apply to it. -/
theorem encapsulatedTrace5C_imp {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (h : EncapsulatedTrace5C k L st lbls st') :
    EncapsulatedTrace5 k L st lbls st' := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | cons he hs _ ih => exact .cons ⟨he.1, chainExcl_guardedExcl he.2.1, he.2.2⟩ hs ih

/-- An `EncapsulatedTrace5C` extended by one step satisfying `Encap5C`. -/
theorem EncapsulatedTrace5C.snoc {k : K} {L : MutexLayout}
    {st st' st'' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbls : List Label} {lbl : Label}
    (h : EncapsulatedTrace5C k L st lbls st') (he : Encap5C L (st'.1, st'.2.1) lbl)
    (hs : LStep k L lbl st' st'') : EncapsulatedTrace5C k L st (lbls ++ [lbl]) st'' := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact .cons he hs .nil
  | cons he' hs' _ ih => exact .cons he' hs' (ih he hs)

/-- An `EncapsulatedTrace5C` with named states. -/
def Run5C (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbls : List Label) :
    Prop :=
  ∀ i (h : i < lbls.length),
    Encap5C L ((σ i).1, (σ i).2.1) lbls[i] ∧ LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1))

/-- Every prefix of a `Run5C` is an `EncapsulatedTrace5C`. -/
theorem run5C_prefix {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (h : Run5C k L σ lbls) :
    ∀ n, n ≤ lbls.length → ∃ ls, EncapsulatedTrace5C k L (σ 0) ls (σ n)
  | 0, _ => ⟨[], .nil⟩
  | n + 1, hn => by
    obtain ⟨ls, hls⟩ := run5C_prefix h n (by omega)
    obtain ⟨he, hs⟩ := h n (by omega)
    exact ⟨ls ++ [lbls[n]], hls.snoc he hs⟩

/-! ## Statements under the corrected exclusion -/

/-- `cap5_sound` with `Encap5C` and `EncapsulatedTrace5C` in place of `Encap5` and
`EncapsulatedTrace5` (same form as `Cap5Sound`). -/
def Cap5SoundC (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : Prop :=
  ∀ (statics : Statics) (lbls : List Label) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (c a : Nat)
    (ls : List Nat) (s' : SC), StaticsOK statics →
    EncapsulatedTrace5C k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []) lbls st →
    (Encap5C L (st.1, st.2.1) (.kernel c (.read a ls)) → opStepC k (.read a ls) c st.1 (.ok s') →
      ∀ l ∈ ls, Allows (cap5 st.1 st.2.1 c l) .observe) ∧
    (Encap5C L (st.1, st.2.1) (.kernel c (.write a ls)) → opStepC k (.write a ls) c st.1 (.ok s') →
      ∀ l ∈ ls, Allows (cap5 st.1 st.2.1 c l) .modify) ∧
    (Encap5C L (st.1, st.2.1) (.kernel c (.writeShared a ls)) →
      opStepC k (.writeShared a ls) c st.1 (.ok s') →
      ∀ l ∈ ls, Allows (cap5 st.1 st.2.1 c l) .observe)

/-- `handoff_loss_exists` with `Run5C` in place of `Run5` (same form as `HandoffLossExists`). -/
def HandoffLossExistsC (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : Prop :=
  ∀ (statics : Statics) (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbls : List Label),
    StaticsOK statics → σ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []) → Run5C k L σ lbls →
    ∀ (i j c c' l : Nat) (m m' : Mode) (hi : i < j) (hj : j < lbls.length), c ≠ c' →
      lbls[i].Access c' l m → lbls[j].Access c l m' → (m = .modify ∨ m' = .modify) →
      ∃ k', ∃ hk : k' < lbls.length, i < k' ∧ k' < j ∧ lbls[k'].ctx = c' ∧
        capRank (cap5 (σ (k' + 1)).1 (σ (k' + 1)).2.1 c' l) <
          capRank (cap5 (σ k').1 (σ k').2.1 c' l)

/-! ## `cap5_sound` under `ChainExcl` -/

/-- An attributable authority with a sufficient effective mode bounds `cap5` from below (WC5
C43). -/
theorem cap5_of {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c l x : Nat} {m : Mode} (hx : Attr5 s reg c x m)
    (he : Allows (effective s.flat x l) m) : Allows (cap5 s reg c l) m := by
  have hb : x ∈ List.range s.A.length := List.mem_range.2 hx.lt
  cases m with
  | modify =>
    have h1 : CapAt5 s reg c l .modify := ⟨x, hb, hx, he⟩
    simp only [cap5, h1, ↓reduceIte]; exact Or.inr rfl
  | observe =>
    by_cases h : CapAt5 s reg c l .modify
    · simp only [cap5, h, ↓reduceIte]; exact Or.inl rfl
    · have h2 : CapAt5 s reg c l .observe := ⟨x, hb, hx, he⟩
      simp only [cap5, h, h2, ↓reduceIte]; exact Or.inl rfl

/-- `cap5_sound` holds under `ChainExcl`, for every state whose live contexts have nonempty stacks
(`FramesC`, WC4 C3): the access authority is attributable without a live `guarded`. -/
theorem cap5_sound_state {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c a : Nat}
    {ls : List Nat} (hF : FramesC s) :
    (ChainExcl (s, reg) (.kernel c (.read a ls)) → opStepC k (.read a ls) c s (.ok s') →
      ∀ l ∈ ls, Allows (cap5 s reg c l) .observe) ∧
    (ChainExcl (s, reg) (.kernel c (.write a ls)) → opStepC k (.write a ls) c s (.ok s') →
      ∀ l ∈ ls, Allows (cap5 s reg c l) .modify) ∧
    (ChainExcl (s, reg) (.kernel c (.writeShared a ls)) →
      opStepC k (.writeShared a ls) c s (.ok s') →
      ∀ l ∈ ls, Allows (cap5 s reg c l) .observe) := by
  have _ := L
  refine ⟨fun hx ⟨hl, o, hR, ho⟩ l hl' => ?_, fun hx ⟨hl, o, hR, ho⟩ l hl' => ?_,
    fun hx ⟨hl, o, hR, ho⟩ l hl' => ?_⟩ <;> have hne := hF.nonempty c hl
  · have hp := pre_of_ok (P := Read3Pre (s.view c) a ls) hR ho
    exact cap5_of (Exer5.attr5 hne hx) (allows_observe (hp.effectivePresent l hl'))
  · have hp := pre_of_ok (P := Write3Pre (s.view c) a ls) hR ho
    have he : effective s.flat a l = some .modify := hp.effectiveModify l hl'
    exact cap5_of (Exer5.attr5 hne hx) (by rw [he]; exact Or.inr rfl)
  · have hp := pre_of_ok (P := WriteSharedPre k (s.view c) a ls) hR ho
    exact cap5_of (Exer5.attr5 hne hx) (allows_observe (hp.effectivePresent l hl'))

/-- `cap5_sound` under the corrected exclusion: under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80), on the states
reached by an `EncapsulatedTrace5C` from an initial state (Spec 1 §47). -/
theorem cap5_sound_C {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} (hdd : DDSound k) : Cap5SoundC k L := by
  intro statics lbls st c a ls s' hst htr
  obtain ⟨hF, -, -⟩ := (trace5_kInvCA hdd hst (encapsulatedTrace5C_imp htr)).parts
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := cap5_sound_state (k := k) (L := L) (s' := s') (reg := st.2.1) (c := c)
    (a := a) (ls := ls) hF
  exact ⟨fun he => h1 he.2.1, fun he => h2 he.2.1, fun he => h3 he.2.1⟩

/-! ## `handoff_loss_exists` under `ChainExcl` -/

/-- An access step (Spec 1 §66–§68) admitted by `Encap5C`, from a state reached by an
`EncapsulatedTrace5C` from an initial state, gives the accessing context a `cap5` at least the
required mode on the accessed leaf. -/
theorem access_cap5 {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics} {lbls : List Label}
    {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbl : Label} {d l : Nat} {m : Mode} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (htr : EncapsulatedTrace5C k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []) lbls st)
    (hacc : lbl.Access d l m) (he : Encap5C L (st.1, st.2.1) lbl) (h : LStep k L lbl st st') :
    Allows (cap5 st.1 st.2.1 d l) m := by
  have hsnd := cap5_sound_C (L := L) hdd
  cases lbl with
  | kernel c op =>
    cases op <;> simp only [Label.Access] at hacc
    all_goals
      obtain ⟨rfl, hl, rfl⟩ := hacc
      cases h with
      | kernel hk => first
        | exact (hsnd statics lbls _ _ _ _ _ hst htr).1 he hk l hl
        | exact (hsnd statics lbls _ _ _ _ _ hst htr).2.1 he hk l hl
        | exact (hsnd statics lbls _ _ _ _ _ hst htr).2.2 he hk l hl
  | _ => simp only [Label.Access] at hacc

/-- A function on `Nat` that is smaller at `b` than at `a ≤ b` decreases at some step of
`[a, b)`. -/
theorem exists_drop (f : Nat → Nat) {a : Nat} :
    ∀ b, a ≤ b → f b < f a → ∃ k, a ≤ k ∧ k < b ∧ f (k + 1) < f k
  | 0, hab, h => by
    obtain rfl : a = 0 := by omega
    exact absurd h (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
  | b + 1, hab, h => by
    by_cases hb : f (b + 1) < f b
    · by_cases hab' : a ≤ b
      · exact ⟨b, hab', Nat.lt_succ_self b, hb⟩
      · obtain rfl : a = b + 1 := by omega
        exact absurd h (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
    · have hab' : a ≤ b := by
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge b a with h' | h'
        · obtain rfl : a = b + 1 := by omega
          exact absurd h (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
        · exact h'
      obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2, hk3⟩ := exists_drop f b hab' (by omega)
      exact ⟨k, hk1, by omega, hk3⟩

/-- `capRank` is at most 2. -/
theorem capRank_le (o : Option Mode) : capRank o ≤ 2 := by
  rcases o with _ | _ | _ <;> simp [capRank]

/-- `handoff_loss_exists` under the corrected exclusion: under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80), on every
`EncapsulatedTrace5C` from an initial state, the loss marker exists. From `cap5_sound_C` at the
earlier access, `cap5_compat` at the later one, the invariance of `cap5` under an access step
(`inert_effect`), and `cap5_drop_own` at the first drop between them. -/
theorem handoff_loss_exists_C {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} (hdd : DDSound k) :
    HandoffLossExistsC k L := by
  intro statics σ lbls hst h0 hr i j c c' l m m' hij hj hcc hai haj hmod
  have hil : i < lbls.length := Nat.lt_trans hij hj
  have htr : ∀ n, n ≤ lbls.length → ∃ ls,
      EncapsulatedTrace5C k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []) ls (σ n) := fun n hn => by
    rw [← h0]; exact run5C_prefix hr n hn
  let f : Nat → Nat := fun n => capRank (cap5 (σ n).1 (σ n).2.1 c' l)
  -- the earlier access
  obtain ⟨lsi, htri⟩ := htr i (Nat.le_of_lt hil)
  obtain ⟨hei, hsi⟩ := hr i hil
  have hci := access_cap5 hdd hst htri hai hei hsi
  have hwi := (trace5_kInvCA hdd hst (encapsulatedTrace5C_imp htri)).parts.2.1
  have hinert : Label.Inert lbls[i] := by
    revert hai; cases lbls[i] with
    | kernel _ op => cases op <;> simp [Label.Access, Label.Inert]
    | _ => simp [Label.Access]
  obtain ⟨hA, hP, hC, hreg⟩ := inert_effect hinert hsi
  have hfi : f i ≤ f (i + 1) := cap5_same hwi hA hP hC hreg c' l
  -- the later access
  obtain ⟨lsj, htrj⟩ := htr j (Nat.le_of_lt hj)
  obtain ⟨hej, hsj⟩ := hr j hj
  have hcj := access_cap5 hdd hst htrj haj hej hsj
  have hcompat := fun {x y : Nat} (hxy : x ≠ y) =>
    cap5_compat (l := l) hdd hst (encapsulatedTrace5C_imp htrj) hxy
  have hdrop : f j < f (i + 1) := by
    rcases hmod with rfl | rfl
    · have h2 : f i = 2 := by
        show capRank (cap5 (σ i).1 (σ i).2.1 c' l) = 2
        rw [allows_modify hci]; rfl
      have hlt : f j < 2 := by
        show capRank (cap5 (σ j).1 (σ j).2.1 c' l) < 2
        cases hcj' : cap5 (σ j).1 (σ j).2.1 c' l with
        | none => simp [capRank]
        | some md =>
          cases md with
          | observe => simp [capRank]
          | modify =>
            have := hcompat (Ne.symm hcc) hcj'
            rw [this] at hcj; exact hcj.elim
      have := capRank_le (cap5 (σ (i + 1)).1 (σ (i + 1)).2.1 c' l)
      omega
    · have h0' : f j = 0 := by
        show capRank (cap5 (σ j).1 (σ j).2.1 c' l) = 0
        rw [hcompat hcc (allows_modify hcj)]; rfl
      have h1 : 1 ≤ f i := by
        show 1 ≤ capRank (cap5 (σ i).1 (σ i).2.1 c' l)
        cases hc : cap5 (σ i).1 (σ i).2.1 c' l with
        | none => rw [hc] at hci; exact hci.elim
        | some md => cases md <;> simp [capRank]
      omega
  obtain ⟨k', hk1, hk2, hk3⟩ := exists_drop f j hij hdrop
  have hk : k' < lbls.length := Nat.lt_trans hk2 hj
  obtain ⟨lsk, htrk⟩ := htr k' (Nat.le_of_lt hk)
  obtain ⟨hek, hsk⟩ := hr k' hk
  refine ⟨k', hk, by omega, hk2, ?_, hk3⟩
  exact cap5_drop_own hdd statics lsk (σ k') (σ (k' + 1)) lbls[k'] c' l hst
    (encapsulatedTrace5C_imp htrk) ⟨hek.1, chainExcl_guardedExcl hek.2.1, hek.2.2⟩ hsk hk3

end Ern.Concurrency
