parent : Option Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- `S_C = (C, F_C, P, I, A, D)` (WC4 C2). `C` lists the contexts by identity (their index); their
stacks and the parents of their initial frames form `F_C`; `P`, `I`, `A`, `D` keep their Spec 1
meaning (§38); `nF`, `dead` and `pins` are the auxiliary components of `S3` (Spec 1 §38). -/
structure SC where
  C : List Ctx
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  pins : List PinOb

/-- Context `c` is live (WC4 C2). -/
def SC.Live (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop := OptP (s.C[c]?) (fun x => x.life = .live) False

/-- Decidability of `SC.Live` (WC4 C2). -/
instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (s.Live c) := by unfold SC.Live; infer_instance

/-- Local stack of context `c` if it is live, empty otherwise (WC4 C2, C3). -/
def SC.stk (s : SC) (c : Nat) : List Nat :=
  match s.C[c]? with
  | some x => if x.life = .live then x.stack else []
  | none => []

/-- Parent of the initial frame of context `c` (WC4 C3). -/
def SC.ctxParent (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.C[c]?).bind (·.parent)

/-- Globally live frames: the frames of the stacks of live contexts (WC4 C2). -/
def SC.frames (s : SC) : List Nat := (List.range s.C.length).flatMap s.stk

/-- The kernel components of `s` as an `S3` whose stack lists the globally live frames (WC4 C2:
references to live frames consider the globally live frame structure). -/
def SC.flat (s : SC) : S3 :=
  { F := s.frames, nF := s.nF, P := s.P, I := s.I, A := s.A, D := s.D, dead := s.dead,
    pins := s.pins }

/-- The `S3` seen by executing context `c` (WC4 C2): the stack of `c` first, so that the current
frame is the top of its local stack, followed by the other globally live frames. It is the `S₃`
view of WC4 C2 (candidate P1) on which `K.Satisfiable` of an `alloc` executed by `c` is evaluated
(`alloc_ok_satisfiable`, `alloc_fail_unsatisfiable`). -/
def SC.view (s : SC) (c : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s.flat with F := s.stk c ++ s.frames.filter fun f => decide (f ∉ s.stk c) }

/-- Kernel components of an `S3` written back into `s`; contexts unchanged (WC4 C2). -/
def SC.set (s : SC) (t : S3) : SC :=
  { s with nF := t.nF, P := t.P, I := t.I, A := t.A, D := t.D, dead := t.dead, pins := t.pins }

/-! ## Single-context states (WC4 C24) -/

/-- Single-context state (WC4 C24): exactly one context, the initial one, live, without
parent. -/
def SC.Single (s : SC) : Prop := ∃ stk, s.C = [⟨stk, .live, none⟩]

/-- Projection of a state to `S3` (WC4 C24): the stack of context 0. -/
def SC.toS3 (s : SC) : S3 :=
  { F := s.stk 0, nF := s.nF, P := s.P, I := s.I, A := s.A, D := s.D, dead := s.dead,
    pins := s.pins }

/-- The single-context state of an `S3` (WC4 C24). -/
def SC.ofS3 (t : S3) : SC :=
  { C := [⟨t.F, .live, none⟩], nF := t.nF, P := t.P, I := t.I, A := t.A, D := t.D,
    dead := t.dead, pins := t.pins }

/-! ## Extended frame-parent relation and ancestry (WC4 C3) -/

/-- Parent of frame `f` within a stack whose initial frame has parent `par`: the next frame of
the stack, or `par` for the initial frame; `none` if `f` is not in the stack (WC4 C3; Spec 1

/-- WC4 C2 (candidate P1): a `fail` outcome of `alloc` (Spec 1 §71) executed by `c` entails that
`K.Satisfiable` fails on the view of `c`. -/
theorem alloc_fail_unsatisfiable {k : K} {c pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {s : SC}
    (h : opStepC k (.alloc pr ow ls) c s .fail) : ¬ k.Satisfiable pr ls (s.view c) := by
  obtain ⟨-, o₃, hR, ho⟩ := h
  change AllocStep k pr ow ls (s.view c) o₃ at hR
  cases hR with
  | ok => cases ho
  | fail _ hsat => exact hsat
  | reject => cases ho

/-! ## `spawn` (WC4 C4, on Spec 1 §72) -/

/-- Effect of `spawn` executed by `c` (WC4 C4 effect): a new live context of identity `|C|` whose
stack is the fresh frame `nF`, parented to the creating frame; the locals of the new frame and
their root authorities, and the yielding of the parameters, are the effects of Spec 1 §72 on the
view of `c`. -/
def spawnEff (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : SC :=
  { s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with
    C := s.C ++ [⟨[s.nF], .live, (s.stk c).head?⟩] }

/-- Preconditions of `spawn` without transmitted value (WC4 C4.1–C4.5): the clauses of `EnterPre`
(Spec 1 §72, `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Ops`) re-indexed as in `EnterPreC`, with O6.3 read from the
current frame of the new context. C4.2 (fresh identities) and C4.4 (yield without duplication)
hold by construction of `spawnEff`; C4.6 concerns `spawn` with a value
(`Ern.Concurrency.Transfer`); the preservation obligations of WC4 C4 are theorems, not
preconditions. -/
structure SpawnPre (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- WC4 C4.1 (Spec 1 §72.1 re-indexed): the creating context and its current frame are live. -/
  creatorLive : s.stk c ≠ []
  /-- WC4 C4.3 (Spec 1 §72.1): every transmitted parameter is an active derived authority held by
  the creating frame. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.2): the locals of the new frame form a well-formed shape. -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.3): origin protection in the final state, from the current frame of the
  new context. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p
  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.4): `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the final state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff s c ps ls)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `spawn` (WC4 C4). -/
instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
    Decidable (SpawnPre s c ps ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff s c ps ls))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `spawn` executed by `c` (WC4 C4): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not live. -/
def SpawnStep (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (SpawnPre s c ps ls) (spawnEff s c ps ls) o

/-! ## `terminate` (WC4 C7, on Spec 1 §73) -/

/-- Effect of `terminate` executed by `c` (WC4 C7): the effect of Spec 1 §73 on the view of `c`
for its initial frame `f`, whose surviving frames are the other live frames; `c` leaves the
live-context set with the completed lifecycle state; the context-initial frames whose parent is
`f` are reparented to the parent of `f` (WC4 C7, C6 effect). -/
def termEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) : SC :=
  { s.set (exitEff (s.view c)) with
    C := reparent (s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := [], life := .done })
      ((s.stk c).headD 0) ((s.ctxParent c).getD 0) }

/-- Preconditions of `terminate` executed by `c` (WC4 C7: the O7 validity requirements applied to
the initial frame of a terminating non-initial context, after its nested call frames have
ended). -/
structure TermPre (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- WC4 C7: a non-initial context (WC4 C3: the base frame never exits). -/
  nonInitial : c ≠ 0
  /-- WC4 C7: the nested call frames have ended; only the initial frame remains. -/
  initialOnly : (s.stk c).length = 1
  /-- Spec 1 §73.1 re-indexed: the initial frame has a surviving parent. -/
  hasParent : OptP (s.ctxParent c) (fun p => p ∈ s.frames ∧ p ∉ s.stk c) False
  /-- Spec 1 §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
  authority among itself and its origins. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
    (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned. -/
  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
    ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
  /-- Spec 1 §73.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (termEffC s c)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `terminate` (WC4 C7). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (TermPre k s c) :=
  decidable_of_iff (c ≠ 0 ∧ (s.stk c).length = 1 ∧
    OptP (s.ctxParent c) (fun p => p ∈ s.frames ∧ p ∉ s.stk c) False ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
      (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
      ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (termEffC s c))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩⟩

/-- `terminate` executed by `c` (WC4 C7): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not live. -/
def TermStep (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (TermPre k s c) (termEffC s c) o

/-! ## `join` (WC4 C8) -/

/-- `join d` executed by `c` (WC4 C8): `reject` when `d` is unknown to the execution (no context
has identity `d`, identities being the indices of `C`); `ok` with the state unchanged when `d` has
the completed lifecycle state; no outcome while `d` is live (WC4 C8: awaiting completion is not an
`Outcome3` result). -/
inductive JoinStep (s : SC) (c d : Nat) : Outcome3 SC → Prop where
  | ok : s.Live c → OptP (s.C[d]?) (fun x => x.life = .done) False → JoinStep s c d (.ok s)
  | reject : s.Live c → s.C[d]? = none → JoinStep s c d .reject

/-! ## Concurrent kernel steps -/

/-- One `ok` transition of the concurrent kernel without synchronization (WC4 C2, C4, C6–C8):
an inherited operation O1–O16 executed by a context, `spawn`, `terminate` or `join`. -/
inductive CStep (k : K) : SC → SC → Prop where
  | kernel {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} : opStepC k op c s (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
  | spawn {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      SpawnStep s c ps ls (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
  | terminate {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} : TermStep k s c (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
  | join {s s' : SC} {c d : Nat} : JoinStep s c d (.ok s') → CStep k s s'

parent : Option Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- `S_C = (C, F_C, P, I, A, D)` (WC4 C2). `C` lists the contexts by identity (their index); their
stacks and the parents of their initial frames form `F_C`; `P`, `I`, `A`, `D` keep their Spec 1
meaning (§38); `nF`, `dead` and `pins` are the auxiliary components of `S3` (Spec 1 §38). -/
structure SC where
  C : List Ctx
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  pins : List PinOb

/-- Context `c` is live (WC4 C2). -/
def SC.Live (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop := OptP (s.C[c]?) (fun x => x.life = .live) False

/-- Decidability of `SC.Live` (WC4 C2). -/
instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (s.Live c) := by unfold SC.Live; infer_instance

/-- Local stack of context `c` if it is live, empty otherwise (WC4 C2, C3). -/
def SC.stk (s : SC) (c : Nat) : List Nat :=
  match s.C[c]? with
  | some x => if x.life = .live then x.stack else []
  | none => []

/-- Parent of the initial frame of context `c` (WC4 C3). -/
def SC.ctxParent (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.C[c]?).bind (·.parent)

/-- Globally live frames: the frames of the stacks of live contexts (WC4 C2). -/
def SC.frames (s : SC) : List Nat := (List.range s.C.length).flatMap s.stk

/-- The kernel components of `s` as an `S3` whose stack lists the globally live frames (WC4 C2:
references to live frames consider the globally live frame structure). -/
def SC.flat (s : SC) : S3 :=
  { F := s.frames, nF := s.nF, P := s.P, I := s.I, A := s.A, D := s.D, dead := s.dead,
    pins := s.pins }

/-- The `S3` seen by executing context `c` (WC4 C2): the stack of `c` first, so that the current
frame is the top of its local stack, followed by the other globally live frames. It is the `S₃`
view of WC4 C2 (candidate P1) on which `K.Satisfiable` of an `alloc` executed by `c` is evaluated
(`alloc_ok_satisfiable`, `alloc_fail_unsatisfiable`). -/
def SC.view (s : SC) (c : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s.flat with F := s.stk c ++ s.frames.filter fun f => decide (f ∉ s.stk c) }

/-- Kernel components of an `S3` written back into `s`; contexts unchanged (WC4 C2). -/
def SC.set (s : SC) (t : S3) : SC :=
  { s with nF := t.nF, P := t.P, I := t.I, A := t.A, D := t.D, dead := t.dead, pins := t.pins }

/-! ## Single-context states (WC4 C24) -/

/-- Single-context state (WC4 C24): exactly one context, the initial one, live, without
parent. -/
def SC.Single (s : SC) : Prop := ∃ stk, s.C = [⟨stk, .live, none⟩]

/-- Projection of a state to `S3` (WC4 C24): the stack of context 0. -/
def SC.toS3 (s : SC) : S3 :=
  { F := s.stk 0, nF := s.nF, P := s.P, I := s.I, A := s.A, D := s.D, dead := s.dead,
    pins := s.pins }

/-- The single-context state of an `S3` (WC4 C24). -/
def SC.ofS3 (t : S3) : SC :=
  { C := [⟨t.F, .live, none⟩], nF := t.nF, P := t.P, I := t.I, A := t.A, D := t.D,
    dead := t.dead, pins := t.pins }

/-! ## Extended frame-parent relation and ancestry (WC4 C3) -/

/-- Parent of frame `f` within a stack whose initial frame has parent `par`: the next frame of
the stack, or `par` for the initial frame; `none` if `f` is not in the stack (WC4 C3; Spec 1

/-- WC4 C2 (candidate P1): a `fail` outcome of `alloc` (Spec 1 §71) executed by `c` entails that
`K.Satisfiable` fails on the view of `c`. -/
theorem alloc_fail_unsatisfiable {k : K} {c pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {s : SC}
    (h : opStepC k (.alloc pr ow ls) c s .fail) : ¬ k.Satisfiable pr ls (s.view c) := by
  obtain ⟨-, o₃, hR, ho⟩ := h
  change AllocStep k pr ow ls (s.view c) o₃ at hR
  cases hR with
  | ok => cases ho
  | fail _ hsat => exact hsat
  | reject => cases ho

/-! ## `spawn` (WC4 C4, on Spec 1 §72) -/

/-- Effect of `spawn` executed by `c` (WC4 C4 effect): a new live context of identity `|C|` whose
stack is the fresh frame `nF`, parented to the creating frame; the locals of the new frame and
their root authorities, and the yielding of the parameters, are the effects of Spec 1 §72 on the
view of `c`. -/
def spawnEff (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : SC :=
  { s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with
    C := s.C ++ [⟨[s.nF], .live, (s.stk c).head?⟩] }

/-- Preconditions of `spawn` without transmitted value (WC4 C4.1–C4.5): the clauses of `EnterPre`
(Spec 1 §72, `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Ops`) re-indexed as in `EnterPreC`, with O6.3 read from the
current frame of the new context. C4.2 (fresh identities) and C4.4 (yield without duplication)
hold by construction of `spawnEff`; C4.6 concerns `spawn` with a value
(`Ern.Concurrency.Transfer`); the preservation obligations of WC4 C4 are theorems, not
preconditions. -/
structure SpawnPre (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- WC4 C4.1 (Spec 1 §72.1 re-indexed): the creating context and its current frame are live. -/
  creatorLive : s.stk c ≠ []
  /-- WC4 C4.3 (Spec 1 §72.1): every transmitted parameter is an active derived authority held by
  the creating frame. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.2): the locals of the new frame form a well-formed shape. -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.3): origin protection in the final state, from the current frame of the
  new context. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p
  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.4): `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the final state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff s c ps ls)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `spawn` (WC4 C4). -/
instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
    Decidable (SpawnPre s c ps ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff s c ps ls))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `spawn` executed by `c` (WC4 C4): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not live. -/
def SpawnStep (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (SpawnPre s c ps ls) (spawnEff s c ps ls) o

/-! ## `terminate` (WC4 C7, on Spec 1 §73) -/

/-- Effect of `terminate` executed by `c` (WC4 C7): the effect of Spec 1 §73 on the view of `c`
for its initial frame `f`, whose surviving frames are the other live frames; `c` leaves the
live-context set with the completed lifecycle state; the context-initial frames whose parent is
`f` are reparented to the parent of `f` (WC4 C7, C6 effect). -/
def termEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) : SC :=
  { s.set (exitEff (s.view c)) with
    C := reparent (s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := [], life := .done })
      ((s.stk c).headD 0) ((s.ctxParent c).getD 0) }

/-- Preconditions of `terminate` executed by `c` (WC4 C7: the O7 validity requirements applied to
the initial frame of a terminating non-initial context, after its nested call frames have
ended). -/
structure TermPre (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- WC4 C7: a non-initial context (WC4 C3: the base frame never exits). -/
  nonInitial : c ≠ 0
  /-- WC4 C7: the nested call frames have ended; only the initial frame remains. -/
  initialOnly : (s.stk c).length = 1
  /-- Spec 1 §73.1 re-indexed: the initial frame has a surviving parent. -/
  hasParent : OptP (s.ctxParent c) (fun p => p ∈ s.frames ∧ p ∉ s.stk c) False
  /-- Spec 1 §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
  authority among itself and its origins. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
    (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned. -/
  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
    ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
  /-- Spec 1 §73.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (termEffC s c)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `terminate` (WC4 C7). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (TermPre k s c) :=
  decidable_of_iff (c ≠ 0 ∧ (s.stk c).length = 1 ∧
    OptP (s.ctxParent c) (fun p => p ∈ s.frames ∧ p ∉ s.stk c) False ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
      (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
      ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (termEffC s c))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩⟩

/-- `terminate` executed by `c` (WC4 C7): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not live. -/
def TermStep (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (TermPre k s c) (termEffC s c) o

/-! ## `join` (WC4 C8) -/

/-- `join d` executed by `c` (WC4 C8): `reject` when `d` is unknown to the execution (no context
has identity `d`, identities being the indices of `C`); `ok` with the state unchanged when `d` has
the completed lifecycle state; no outcome while `d` is live (WC4 C8: awaiting completion is not an
`Outcome3` result). -/
inductive JoinStep (s : SC) (c d : Nat) : Outcome3 SC → Prop where
  | ok : s.Live c → OptP (s.C[d]?) (fun x => x.life = .done) False → JoinStep s c d (.ok s)
  | reject : s.Live c → s.C[d]? = none → JoinStep s c d .reject

/-! ## Concurrent kernel steps -/

/-- One `ok` transition of the concurrent kernel without synchronization (WC4 C2, C4, C6–C8):
an inherited operation O1–O16 executed by a context, `spawn`, `terminate` or `join`. -/
inductive CStep (k : K) : SC → SC → Prop where
  | kernel {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} : opStepC k op c s (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
  | spawn {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      SpawnStep s c ps ls (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
  | terminate {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} : TermStep k s c (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
  | join {s s' : SC} {c d : Nat} : JoinStep s c d (.ok s') → CStep k s s'

import Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.Frames

/-!
# Corpus of milestone 3, handoff witnesses

`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §2 bis: W-HO, W-HO′ and W-HO″, traces of the authority machine alone. One
theorem per verdict, written from `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §2 bis, preconditions by `decide`. Each
trace is an `EncapsulatedTrace` from the initial state of Spec 1 §47 (no mutex, empty registries),
so `KInvC` holds at its final state by `encapsulated_inv`. Lean names: `W_HO` (W-HO), `W_HO2`
(W-HO′), `W_HO3` (W-HO″).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.Handoff

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency Ern.Concurrency.Corpus
open Ern.Concurrency.Traces (L0)

/-! ## W-HO (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §2 bis W-HO) -/

/-- `c1 : write3(X)` via `a` (O10), from the state of S13 after `spawn c1` yielding `a`
(`Corpus.t2`). -/
def h1 : SC := t2.set (write3Eff (t2.view 1) [1, 2])
/-- `c1 : release(a)` (O3). -/
def h2 : SC := h1.set (releaseEff (h1.view 1) 1)
/-- `c0 : write3(X)` via `root_X` (O10). -/
def h3 : SC := h2.set (write3Eff (h2.view 0) [1, 2])

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §2 bis W-HO, step 1, `ok` (O10.1): `c1 : write3(X)` via `a`. -/
theorem W_HO_1_ok : opStepC KF (.write 1 [1, 2]) 1 t2 (.ok h1) :=
  ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §2 bis W-HO, step 2, `ok` (O3.1–O3.3): `c1 : release(a)`. -/
theorem W_HO_2_ok : opStepC KF (.release 1) 1 h1 (.ok h2) :=
  ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §2 bis W-HO, step 3, `ok` (O10.1; §40 `RootHeld`; §43.2; §62 effect):
`c0 : write3(X)` via `root_X`, context 1 live, with neither `terminate` nor `join`. The twin is
`Corpus.S13_2_ok`; the negative case is `Corpus.S13_1_reject`. -/
theorem W_HO_3_ok : h2.Live 1 ∧ opStepC KF (.write 0 [1, 2]) 0 h2 (.ok h3) :=
  ⟨by decide, by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §2 bis W-HO as an `EncapsulatedTrace` from the initial state of S13;
`KInvC` holds at its final state (`encapsulated_inv`). -/
theorem w_ho_trace : EncapsulatedTrace KF L0 (t0, [], [])
      [.kernel 0 (.derive 0 [1, 2] .modify), .spawn 0 [1] [], .kernel 1 (.write 1 [1, 2]),
       .kernel 1 (.release 1), .kernel 0 (.write 0 [1, 2])] (h3, [], []) ∧ KInvC h3 := by
  obtain ⟨h0, hs, -⟩ := S13_1_reject
  have ht : EncapsulatedTrace KF L0 (t0, [], [])
      [.kernel 0 (.derive 0 [1, 2] .modify), .spawn 0 [1] [], .kernel 1 (.write 1 [1, 2]),
       .kernel 1 (.release 1), .kernel 0 (.write 0 [1, 2])] (h3, [], []) :=
    .cons (fun e he => by cases he) (.kernel h0) <| .cons trivial (.spawn hs) <|
    .cons trivial (.kernel W_HO_1_ok) <| .cons trivial (.kernel W_HO_2_ok) <|
    .cons trivial (.kernel W_HO_3_ok.2) .nil
  exact ⟨ht, (encapsulated_inv (ddKC []) (by decide : StaticsOK xst) ht).1⟩

/-! ## W-HO′ (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §2 bis W-HO′) -/

/-- Initial state: the local `X` (place 0), `Init`, root authority 0 (`Corpus.yst`). -/
def k0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init yst)
/-- `a := derive(root_X, Modify)`, authority 1 (O1). -/
def k1 : SC := k0.set (deriveEff (k0.view 0) 0 [0] .modify)
/-- `b := derive(a, Modify)`, authority 2, held by frame 0 (O1). -/
def k2 : SC := k1.set (deriveEff (k1.view 0) 1 [0] .modify)
/-- `spawn c1` yielding `a` while `b` stays held by frame 0 (WC4 C4): context 1, frame 1. -/
def k3 : SC := spawnEff k2 0 [1] []
/-- `c0 : write3(X)` via `b` (O10). -/
def k4 : SC := k3.set (write3Eff (k3.view 0) [0])
/-- `c0 : release(b)` (O3). -/
def k5 : SC := k4.set (releaseEff (k4.view 0) 2)
/-- `c1 : write3(X)` via `a` (O10). -/
def k6 : SC := k5.set (write3Eff (k5.view 1) [0])

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §2 bis W-HO′, setup, `ok` (WC4 C4.3: `a` is active, derived and held by the
creating frame; C4.5, O6.3: `root_X` is exercisable in no mode from the frame of the child): the
`spawn` yielding `a` while its derivative `b` stays held by frame 0. -/
theorem W_HO2_0_ok : opStepC KF (.derive 0 [0] .modify) 0 k0 (.ok k1) ∧
    opStepC KF (.derive 1 [0] .modify) 0 k1 (.ok k2) ∧ SpawnStep k2 0 [1] [] (.ok k3) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩,
    ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §2 bis W-HO′, step 1, `reject` (O10.1: no effective mode, §43.3, the
active `Modify` descendant `b`): `c1 : write3(X)` via `a`. -/
theorem W_HO2_1_reject : opStepC KF (.write 1 [0]) 1 k3 .reject ∧ effective k3.flat 1 0 = none :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, _, .reject (by decide), rfl⟩, by decide⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §2 bis W-HO′, step 2, `ok` (O10.1): `c0 : write3(X)` via `b`. -/
theorem W_HO2_2_ok : opStepC KF (.write 2 [0]) 0 k3 (.ok k4) :=
  ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §2 bis W-HO′, step 3, `ok` (O3): `c0 : release(b)`. -/
theorem W_HO2_3_ok : opStepC KF (.release 2) 0 k4 (.ok k5) :=
  ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §2 bis W-HO′, step 4, `ok` (§43.2): `c1 : write3(X)` via `a`. -/
theorem W_HO2_4_ok : opStepC KF (.write 1 [0]) 1 k5 (.ok k6) :=
  ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §2 bis W-HO′ as an `EncapsulatedTrace` from the initial state; `KInvC`
holds at its final state (`encapsulated_inv`). -/
theorem w_ho2_trace : EncapsulatedTrace KF L0 (k0, [], [])
      [.kernel 0 (.derive 0 [0] .modify), .kernel 0 (.derive 1 [0] .modify), .spawn 0 [1] [],
       .kernel 0 (.write 2 [0]), .kernel 0 (.release 2), .kernel 1 (.write 1 [0])] (k6, [], []) ∧

/-- Labels whose `ok` effect changes neither the authorities, the places, the contexts nor the
`guarded` identities of the registry: `read3`, `write3`, `writeShared` (Spec 1 §66–§68:
initialization states only), `depend` (§64: anchors only), `pin`, `unpin` (§74, §75: pinning
obligations only), `join` (WC4 C8: no change), `resetLock` (WC4 C18: the grant record only),
`newArena` (Spec 1 §76: the arena registry only). -/
def Label.Inert : Label → Prop
  | .kernel _ (.read _ _) | .kernel _ (.write _ _) | .kernel _ (.writeShared _ _)
  | .kernel _ (.depend _ _) | .kernel _ (.pin _) | .kernel _ (.unpin _) | .join _ _
  | .resetLock _ _ | .newArena _ _ _ => True
  | _ => False

/-- The `ok` effect of an inert label (Spec 1 §64, §66–§68, §74–§76; WC4 C8, C18). -/
theorem inert_effect {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    (hi : lbl.Inert) (h : LStep k L lbl st st') :
    st'.1.A = st.1.A ∧ st'.1.P = st.1.P ∧ st'.1.C = st.1.C ∧
      ∀ e' ∈ st'.2.1, ∃ e ∈ st.2.1, e.guarded = e'.guarded := by
  have same : ∀ (reg : SyncReg), ∀ e' ∈ reg, ∃ e ∈ reg, e.guarded = e'.guarded :=
    fun _ e' he' => ⟨e', he', rfl⟩
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg ar c op hk =>
    cases op <;> simp only [Label.Inert] at hi
    · obtain ⟨-, hR⟩ := hk
      cases hR; exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, same reg⟩
    · obtain ⟨-, o, hR, ho⟩ := hk
      cases hR with
      | ok => cases ho; exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, same reg⟩
      | reject => cases ho
    · obtain ⟨-, o, hR, ho⟩ := hk
      cases hR with
      | ok => cases ho; exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, same reg⟩
      | reject => cases ho
    · obtain ⟨-, o, hR, ho⟩ := hk
      cases hR with
      | ok => cases ho; exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, same reg⟩
      | reject => cases ho
    · obtain ⟨-, o, hR, ho⟩ := hk
      cases hR with
      | ok => cases ho; exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, same reg⟩
      | reject => cases ho
    · obtain ⟨-, o, hR, ho⟩ := hk
      cases hR with
      | ok => cases ho; exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, same reg⟩
      | reject => cases ho
  | join hj =>
    cases hj; exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, same _⟩
  | @resetLock s reg ar c i st₁ hr =>
    obtain ⟨-, e, he, -, -, -, rfl⟩ := hr
    refine ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, fun e' he' => ?_⟩
    rcases List.mem_or_eq_of_mem_set he' with h | h
    · exact ⟨e', h, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨e, List.mem_of_getElem? he, by rw [h]⟩
  | newArena hn =>
    obtain ⟨-, hR⟩ := hn
    cases hR; exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, same _⟩
  | _ => simp only [Label.Inert] at hi

/-- L1 (`cap5_drop_own`, WC5 C45) for the inert labels: from a state reached by an
`EncapsulatedTrace` from an initial state (Spec 1 §47), under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80), an inert
step lowers no `cap5`, so the implication of `Cap5DropOwn` holds for it. -/
theorem cap5_drop_own_inert {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics} {lbls : List Label}
    {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbl : Label} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (htr : EncapsulatedTrace5 k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []) lbls st) (hi : lbl.Inert)
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (c l : Nat)
    (hd : capRank (cap5 st'.1 st'.2.1 c l) < capRank (cap5 st.1 st.2.1 c l)) : lbl.ctx = c := by
  obtain ⟨⟨-, hw⟩, -⟩ := (encapsulated_inv hdd hst (encapsulatedTrace5_imp htr)).1
  obtain ⟨hA, hP, hC, hreg⟩ := inert_effect hi h
  exact absurd hd (Nat.not_lt.2 (cap5_same hw hA hP hC hreg c l))

/-- An exercisable authority's own mode permits the requested mode (Spec 1 §43). -/
theorem exer_mode {t : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} (h : t.ExercisableAt a m)
    (hy : t.A[a]? = some y) : m.le y.mode := by
  cases h with
  | base hy' _ hm => rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'; exact hm
  | held hy' _ hm => rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'; exact hm

/-- Adding an `Observe` descendant keeps an effective `Observe` (Spec 1 §43, case 4). -/
theorem allows_effOf_obs {o : Mode} {ds : List Mode} (h : Allows (effOf o ds) .observe) :
    Allows (effOf o (ds ++ [.observe])) .observe := by
  have hn : Mode.modify ∉ ds := by
      · rename_i f hf; exact .base hg hy ha hm hf (by simpa using h)
      · rename_i p hp
        simp only [List.any_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
        obtain ⟨b, -, hc, hb⟩ := h
        exact .held hg hy ha hm hp (attr5_of_kiter s reg c m k b hb) hc
    · cases h

/-- The frame-held case of `attr5R`. -/
theorem attr5R_base {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a f : Nat}
    {y : Authority} (hg : NotGuarded s reg a) (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true)
    (hm : m.le y.mode) (hf : y.holder = .frame f) (hin : f ∈ s.stk c) :
    attr5R s reg c m E a = true := by
  simp only [attr5R, hy, ha, hf, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  exact ⟨hg, hm, hin⟩

/-- The place-held case of `attr5R`. -/
theorem attr5R_held {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a p b : Nat}
    {y : Authority} (hg : NotGuarded s reg a) (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true)
    (hm : m.le y.mode) (hp : y.holder = .place p) (hb : b < s.A.length)
    (hc : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s.flat b l) m) (hE : E b = true) :
    attr5R s reg c m E a = true := by
  simp only [attr5R, hy, ha, hp, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
    List.any_eq_true, List.mem_range]
  exact ⟨hg, hm, b, hb, hc, hE⟩

/-- `Attr5` is computed by `|A| + 1` steps of `attr5R`. -/
theorem attr5_iff {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c a : Nat} {m : Mode} :
    Attr5 s reg c a m ↔ kiter (attr5R s reg c m) (s.A.length + 1) a = true := by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, attr5_of_kiter s reg c m _ a⟩
  induction h with
  | base hg hy ha hm hf hin => exact attr5R_base hg hy ha hm hf hin
  | held hg hy ha hm hp _ hc ih =>
    rw [← kiter_fix (attr5R_rule s reg c _)]
    exact attr5R_held hg hy ha hm hp (kiter_bound (attr5R_rule s reg c _) _ _ ih) hc ih

/-- Decidability of `Attr5`. -/
instance (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c a : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (Attr5 s reg c a m) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ attr5_iff.symm

/-- `CapAt` with `Attr5` (brief of milestone 4, task 3). -/
def CapAt5 (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c l : Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
  ∃ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, Attr5 s reg c x m ∧ Allows (effective s.flat x l) m

/-- Decidability of `CapAt5`. -/
instance (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c l : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (CapAt5 s reg c l m) := by
  unfold CapAt5; infer_instance

/-- `cap5` (brief of milestone 4, task 3): `cap` (WC5 C43) with `Attr5`. -/
def cap5 (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c l : Nat) : Option Mode :=
  if CapAt5 s reg c l .modify then some .modify else if CapAt5 s reg c l .observe then some .observe
  else none

end Ern.Concurrency

import Ern.Concurrency.Encap5C
import Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.GuardedChain

/-!
# Witnesses of the corrected exclusion `ChainExcl`

Test of `ChainExcl` (`Ern.Concurrency.Encap5C`), the correction of `GuardedExcl` proposed in
`formal/reports/spec2-m4-handoff.md`, on the counterexample of `Corpus/GuardedChain.lean` and on
W-GR (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` v4 §2 ter), by `decide`: the reads through `guarded` are excluded; the
same access to `Y` made by context 1 while it holds the grant is admitted, and the loss marker is
its own `unlock` (WC5 C45).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.GuardedChainC

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency Ern.Concurrency.Corpus
open Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.GuardedChain
open Ern.Concurrency.Traces (L0)

/-- `ChainExcl` excludes the read of the counterexample (`gc_read`): `z` is exercisable by context
1 only through `guarded` (Spec 1 §43, third clause). -/
theorem gc_read_excluded : ¬ ChainExcl (gc6, greg) (.kernel 1 (.read 3 [4])) := by decide

/-- `ChainExcl` excludes step 1 of W-GR (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` v4 §2 ter): `read3(T)` with
`access = guarded` by context 1 from `MX₄`. -/
theorem W_GR_1_excluded : ¬ ChainExcl (x4, regX) (.kernel 1 (.read 3 [3])) := by decide

/-- `c1 : acquire(e)`: grant `g₁`, authority 6, held by frame 1 (WC4 C16). -/
def lc7 : SC := deriveSyncEff gc6 1 4
/-- `c1 : read3(Y)` via `z` (O9): the state is unchanged. -/
def lc8 : SC := lc7.set (lc7.view 1)
/-- `c1 : unlock(e)`: `g₁` released (O3, WC4 C17). -/
def lc9 : SC := lc8.set (releaseEff (lc8.view 1) 6)
/-- `c0 : acquire(e)`: grant `g₂`, authority 7, held by frame 0 (WC4 C16). -/
def lc10 : SC := deriveSyncEff lc9 0 4
/-- `c0 : write3(Y)` via `z` (O10). -/
def lc11 : SC := lc10.set (write3Eff (lc10.view 0) [4])

/-- The labels of the locked trace. -/
def lcLbls : List Label :=
  [.kernel 0 (.derive 2 [4] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 3 3), .kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify),

/-- L2, state form, on one state (WC5 C45): under the frame uniqueness of WC4 C3, `I1` and `WF3`,
for `c ≠ c'`, never `cap5 c l = Modify` with `cap5 c' l ≠ none`. -/
theorem cap5_compat_state {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} (hnd : s.frames.Nodup) (hI : I1 s.flat)
    (hw : WF3 s.flat) {c c' l : Nat} (hcc : c ≠ c') (hm : cap5 s reg c l = some .modify) :
    cap5 s reg c' l = none := by
  cases hc' : cap5 s reg c' l with
  | none => rfl
  | some m' =>
    exfalso
    obtain ⟨x, -, hx, hex⟩ := cap5_modify hm
    obtain ⟨m, y, -, hy, hey⟩ := cap5_present (by rw [hc']; exact Option.some_ne_none _)
    exact attr_compat hnd hI hw hcc hx.attr rfl y l m (allows_modify hex) hy.attr hey

/-- `cap5_compat` (L2, state form, WC5 C45, `OB-C18`; brief of milestone 4, task 4): on the states
reached by an `EncapsulatedTrace5` from an initial state (Spec 1 §47), under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80),
for `c ≠ c'`, never `cap5 c l = Modify` with `cap5 c' l ≠ none`. -/
theorem cap5_compat {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics} {lbls : List Label}
    {st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (h : EncapsulatedTrace5 k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []) lbls st) {c c' l : Nat}
    (hcc : c ≠ c') (hm : cap5 st.1 st.2.1 c l = some .modify) : cap5 st.1 st.2.1 c' l = none := by
  obtain ⟨⟨hF, hw⟩, ⟨⟨hI, -⟩, -⟩, -⟩ := (encapsulated_inv hdd hst (encapsulatedTrace5_imp h)).1
  exact cap5_compat_state hF.nodup hI hw hcc hm

/-! ## L1: per-label lemmas -/

/-- Transport of `Attr5` (brief of milestone 4, task 3) from `s` to `s'` for context `c`: the
frames of `c` stay live, the footprints of existing places are unchanged, and every authority
attributable to `c` keeps its activity, own mode and holder, stays outside the live `guarded` set,
and keeps an effective mode permitting the mode in which it is attributable (Spec 1 §43; WC5
C43). -/
theorem attr5_transport {s s' : SC} {reg reg' : SyncReg} {c : Nat} (hw : WF3 s.flat)
    (hstk : ∀ f ∈ s.stk c, f ∈ s'.stk c)
    (hfp : ∀ p, p < s.P.length → footprint s'.P p = footprint s.P p)
    (hA : ∀ u m y, Attr5 s reg c u m → s.A[u]? = some y → ∃ y', s'.A[u]? = some y' ∧
      y'.active = y.active ∧ y'.mode = y.mode ∧ y'.holder = y.holder)
    (hng : ∀ u m, Attr5 s reg c u m → NotGuarded s' reg' u)
    (heff : ∀ u m l, Attr5 s reg c u m → Allows (effective s.flat u l) m →
      Allows (effective s'.flat u l) m)
    {u : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : Attr5 s reg c u m) : Attr5 s' reg' c u m := by
  induction h with
  | @base a m y f hg hy ha hm hf hin =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', ha', hm', hf'⟩ := hA a m y (.base hg hy ha hm hf hin) hy
    exact .base (hng a m (.base hg hy ha hm hf hin)) hy' (ha'.trans ha) (hm' ▸ hm) (hf'.trans hf)
      (hstk f hin)
  | @held a p b m y hg hy ha hm hp hb hc ih =>
    have hab : Attr5 s reg c a m := .held hg hy ha hm hp hb hc
    obtain ⟨y', hy', ha', hm', hp'⟩ := hA a m y hab hy
    have hu : s.flat.Usable p := by
      have := hw.holders a _ hy ha; rw [hp] at this; exact this
  rcases o with _ | _ | _ <;> simp [capRank]

/-- `handoff_loss_exists` under the corrected exclusion: under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80), on every
`EncapsulatedTrace5C` from an initial state, the loss marker exists. From `cap5_sound_C` at the
earlier access, `cap5_compat` at the later one, the invariance of `cap5` under an access step
(`inert_effect`), and `cap5_drop_own` at the first drop between them. -/
theorem handoff_loss_exists_C {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} (hdd : DDSound k) :
    HandoffLossExistsC k L := by
  intro statics σ lbls hst h0 hr i j c c' l m m' hij hj hcc hai haj hmod
  have hil : i < lbls.length := Nat.lt_trans hij hj
  have htr : ∀ n, n ≤ lbls.length → ∃ ls,
      EncapsulatedTrace5C k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []) ls (σ n) := fun n hn => by
    rw [← h0]; exact run5C_prefix hr n hn
  let f : Nat → Nat := fun n => capRank (cap5 (σ n).1 (σ n).2.1 c' l)
  -- the earlier access
  obtain ⟨lsi, htri⟩ := htr i (Nat.le_of_lt hil)
  obtain ⟨hei, hsi⟩ := hr i hil
  have hci := access_cap5 hdd hst htri hai hei hsi
  have hwi := (trace5_kInvCA hdd hst (encapsulatedTrace5C_imp htri)).parts.2.1
  have hinert : Label.Inert lbls[i] := by
    revert hai; cases lbls[i] with
    | kernel _ op => cases op <;> simp [Label.Access, Label.Inert]
    | _ => simp [Label.Access]
  obtain ⟨hA, hP, hC, hreg⟩ := inert_effect hinert hsi
  have hfi : f i ≤ f (i + 1) := cap5_same hwi hA hP hC hreg c' l
  -- the later access
  obtain ⟨lsj, htrj⟩ := htr j (Nat.le_of_lt hj)
  obtain ⟨hej, hsj⟩ := hr j hj
  have hcj := access_cap5 hdd hst htrj haj hej hsj
  have hcompat := fun {x y : Nat} (hxy : x ≠ y) =>
    cap5_compat (l := l) hdd hst (encapsulatedTrace5C_imp htrj) hxy
  have hdrop : f j < f (i + 1) := by
    rcases hmod with rfl | rfl
    · have h2 : f i = 2 := by
        show capRank (cap5 (σ i).1 (σ i).2.1 c' l) = 2
        rw [allows_modify hci]; rfl
      have hlt : f j < 2 := by
        show capRank (cap5 (σ j).1 (σ j).2.1 c' l) < 2
        cases hcj' : cap5 (σ j).1 (σ j).2.1 c' l with
        | none => simp [capRank]
        | some md =>
          cases md with
          | observe => simp [capRank]
          | modify =>
            have := hcompat (Ne.symm hcc) hcj'
            rw [this] at hcj; exact hcj.elim
      have := capRank_le (cap5 (σ (i + 1)).1 (σ (i + 1)).2.1 c' l)
      omega
    · have h0' : f j = 0 := by
        show capRank (cap5 (σ j).1 (σ j).2.1 c' l) = 0
        rw [hcompat hcc (allows_modify hcj)]; rfl

        cases hc : cap5 (σ i).1 (σ i).2.1 c' l with
        | none => rw [hc] at hci; exact hci.elim
        | some md => cases md <;> simp [capRank]
      omega

  have hk : k' < lbls.length := Nat.lt_trans hk2 hj
  obtain ⟨lsk, htrk⟩ := htr k' (Nat.le_of_lt hk)
  obtain ⟨hek, hsk⟩ := hr k' hk
  refine ⟨k', hk, by omega, hk2, ?_, hk3⟩
  exact cap5_drop_own hdd statics lsk (σ k') (σ (k' + 1)) lbls[k'] c' l hst
    (encapsulatedTrace5C_imp htrk) ⟨hek.1, chainExcl_guardedExcl hek.2.1, hek.2.2⟩ hsk hk3

theorem cap5_compat {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics} {lbls : List Label}
    {st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (h : EncapsulatedTrace5 k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []) lbls st) {c c' l : Nat}

/-! ## Operations that do not read `ancestor` (Spec 1 §60–§62, §66–§71, §74, §75; WC4 C2) -/

/-- An operation of Spec 1 that reads neither `ancestor` nor the stack beyond its top and its
membership, run by context `c` on its view and written back (WC4 C2). The context must be live;
otherwise the operation has no outcome. -/
def ViewStep (R : S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop) (c : Nat) (s : SC) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ ∃ o₃, R (s.view c) o₃ ∧ o = omap s.set o₃

/-! ## O4 `transfer` re-indexed (Spec 1 §63) -/

/-- Effect of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63 effect, WC4 C2). -/
def transferEffC (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) : SC := s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)

/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` re-indexed (Spec 1 §72) -/

/-- Effect of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72 effect, WC4 C2): the effect of Spec 1 on
the view of `c`; the new frame `nF` is pushed on the stack of `c`. -/
def enterEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : SC :=
  { s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with
    C := s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := s.nF :: x.stack } }

/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72 re-indexed, WC4 C2). -/
structure EnterPreC (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §72.1 re-indexed: the calling frame, the current frame of `c`, is live. -/
  callerLive : s.stk c ≠ []
  /-- Spec 1 §72.1: each parameter is an active derived authority held by the caller. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- Spec 1 §72.2: the locals form a well-formed shape. -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- Spec 1 §72.3 re-indexed: origin protection on entry, in the resulting state, for the
  executing context. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((enterEffC s c ps ls).view c) p
  /-- Spec 1 §72.4 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) over the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (enterEffC s c ps ls)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72). -/
instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
    Decidable (EnterPreC s c ps ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((enterEffC s c ps ls).view c) p) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (enterEffC s c ps ls))

clauses of `Arena.NewArenaBase` on the view of `c`, §76.6 being read on the concurrent kernel state

    (o : Outcome3 (SC × ArenaReg)) : Prop :=

derived operation, on the pattern of `Arena.IssueD`): the static checks (§77.1, §77.2) and the
availability `fail` (§77.4) on the view of `c`; then `split` of `internal` on the region (O2) and

(`Arena.issueMeta`). A context that is not live executes nothing. -/

    (dst : Nat) : Outcome3 (SC × ArenaReg) → Prop where
  | noEntry : s.Live c → ar[i]? = none → IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst .reject
  | static {E : Arena.ArenaEntry} : s.Live c → ar[i]? = some E →
      ¬ Arena.IssueStatic (s.view c) E region dst → IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst .reject
  | fail {E : Arena.ArenaEntry} : s.Live c → ar[i]? = some E →
      Arena.IssueStatic (s.view c) E region dst → ¬ Arena.Avail E region →
      IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst .fail

      IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst .reject

      Arena.IssueStatic (s.view c) E region dst → Arena.Avail E region →
      opStepC k (.split E.internal [region]) c s (.ok s₁) →
      opStepC k (.store s.A.length dst) c s₁ .reject → IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst .reject
  | ok {E : Arena.ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : SC} : ar[i]? = some E →
      Arena.IssueStatic (s.view c) E region dst → Arena.Avail E region →
      opStepC k (.split E.internal [region]) c s (.ok s₁) →
      opStepC k (.store s.A.length dst) c s₁ (.ok s₂) →

  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>

/-! ## Derived arena operations executed by a context (Spec 1 §76–§78; WC4 C2, C19) -/

/-- Preconditions of `newArena(storage, internal)` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §76; WC4 C2): the
clauses of `Arena.NewArenaBase` on the view of `c`, §76.6 being read on the concurrent kernel state
(WC4 C2, C3, C20: `WF3` and `I1` over the globally live frames, `AnchorOrder` and
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o⟩⟩

/-- `newArena(storage, internal)` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §76, §58: `ok` or `reject`): the entry of
`Arena.newArenaEff` is registered; the kernel state and the synchronization registry are
unchanged (§76 `ok` effect). A context that is not live executes nothing. -/
def NewArenaStepC (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (ar : ArenaReg) (c storage internal : Nat)
    (o : Outcome3 (SC × ArenaReg)) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (NewArenaPreC s reg ar c storage internal)
    (s, ar ++ [⟨storage, internal, footprint s.P storage, []⟩]) o

/-- `issue(arena, region, destination)` of entry `i` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §77, §58; Part XIV: a
derived operation, on the pattern of `Arena.IssueD`): the static checks (§77.1, §77.2) and the
availability `fail` (§77.4) on the view of `c`; then `split` of `internal` on the region (O2) and
`store` of the block, of fresh identity `|A|`, into the destination (O8), both as executed by `c`
(`opStepC`; WC4 C2, C3: §65.4 and §65.5 read `ancestorC`); the metadata is updated on `ok`
(`Arena.issueMeta`). A context that is not live executes nothing. -/
inductive IssueStepC (k : K) (s : SC) (ar : ArenaReg) (c i : Nat) (region : List Nat)
    (dst : Nat) : Outcome3 (SC × ArenaReg) → Prop where
  | noEntry : s.Live c → ar[i]? = none → IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst .reject
  | static {E : Arena.ArenaEntry} : s.Live c → ar[i]? = some E →
      ¬ Arena.IssueStatic (s.view c) E region dst → IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst .reject
  | fail {E : Arena.ArenaEntry} : s.Live c → ar[i]? = some E →
      Arena.IssueStatic (s.view c) E region dst → ¬ Arena.Avail E region →
      IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst .fail
  | split {E : Arena.ArenaEntry} : ar[i]? = some E → Arena.IssueStatic (s.view c) E region dst →
      Arena.Avail E region → opStepC k (.split E.internal [region]) c s .reject →
      IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst .reject
  | store {E : Arena.ArenaEntry} {s₁ : SC} : ar[i]? = some E →
      Arena.IssueStatic (s.view c) E region dst → Arena.Avail E region →
      opStepC k (.split E.internal [region]) c s (.ok s₁) →
      opStepC k (.store s.A.length dst) c s₁ .reject → IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst .reject
  | ok {E : Arena.ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : SC} : ar[i]? = some E →
      Arena.IssueStatic (s.view c) E region dst → Arena.Avail E region →
      opStepC k (.split E.internal [region]) c s (.ok s₁) →
      opStepC k (.store s.A.length dst) c s₁ (.ok s₂) →
      IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst (.ok (s₂, ar.set i (Arena.issueMeta s.flat E region)))

/-- `reset(arena)` of entry `i` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §78, §58; Part XIV): the derived operation
`Arena.ResetD` (`derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the storage, `release`, the check of §78.3)
on the view of `c`, written back (WC4 C2); `derive` and `release` read neither `ancestor` nor the
stack beyond its top and its membership. A context that is not live executes nothing. -/
def ResetStepC (s : SC) (ar : ArenaReg) (c i : Nat) (o : Outcome3 (SC × ArenaReg)) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ ∃ o₃, Arena.ResetD i ⟨s.view c, ar⟩ o₃ ∧
    o = omap (fun L' => (s.set L'.kern, L'.arenas)) o₃

/-- Writing back into `s` an `S3` whose stack is that of the view of `c`, then taking the view of
`c`, gives that `S3` back (WC4 C2). -/
theorem SC.view_set {s : SC} {c : Nat} {t : S3} (hF : t.F = (s.view c).F) :
    (s.set t).view c = t := by
  have h : (s.set t).view c = { t with F := (s.view c).F } := rfl
  rw [h, ← hF]
    OptP (((transfersEff c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs).view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
      y.holder = .frame ((transfersEff c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs).view c).top ∧
      y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- WC4 C5.4, Spec 1 §63.6, second half: `AnchorOrder` (on `ancestorC`) in the final state. -/
  anchorOrder : AnchorOrderC (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs)
  /-- WC4 C5.4, Spec 1 §63.9: every destination is usable in the final state. -/
  dstUsableAfter : ∀ v ∈ vs, (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).flat.Usable v.2
  /-- WC4 C4.5, C5.4, Spec 1 §72.3: origin protection in the final state, from the current frame of
  the new context. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).view s.C.length) p
  /-- WC4 C4.5, C5.4, Spec 1 §72.4 (`AnchorOrderHeld` on `ancestorC`) in the final state, which
  includes Spec 1 §63.7 for the moved held authorities. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs)

/-- Decidability of `SpawnValPre` (WC4 C4, C5). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
    (vs : List (Nat × Nat)) : Decidable (SpawnValPre k s c ps ls vs) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧ (∀ v ∈ vs, FreshRootLocal s ls v.2) ∧
    ValTransfersPre k (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).flat c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs ∧
    (∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ v ∈ vs, ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P v.1) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ ps,
      OptP (((transfersEff c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs).view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
        y.holder = .frame ((transfersEff c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs).view c).top ∧
        y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
    AnchorOrderC (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs) ∧
    (∀ v ∈ vs, (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).flat.Usable v.2) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).view s.C.length) p) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l⟩⟩

/-- The by-value composite executed by `c` (WC4 C5): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not
live. -/
def SpawnValStep (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
    (vs : List (Nat × Nat)) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (SpawnValPre k s c ps ls vs) (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs) o

/-- Without a live `guarded`, every authority exercisable from the current frame of `c` (Spec 1
§43) satisfies `Exer5`. -/
theorem exer5_of_exercisable {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c a : Nat} {m : Mode}
    (hng : ∀ e ∈ reg, ¬ e.Live s) (h : (s.view c).ExercisableAt a m) : Exer5 s reg c a m := by
  have hg : ∀ x, NotGuarded s reg x := fun x e he hl => absurd hl (hng e he)

import Ern.Concurrency.Encap5R
import Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.GuardedStore

/-!
# Witnesses of the extended exclusion `PlaceExcl`

Brief of milestone 4, task 3: test of `PlaceExcl` (`Ern.Concurrency.Encap5R`) on W-GS
(`corpus-spec2-m3.md` v6 §2 sexies), on the locked trace of `Corpus/GuardedChainC.lean`, and on the
legitimate uses of `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v6 §1 (S2, S3 up to `issue`, S4, S10), replayed from the
initial state of Spec 1 §47, by `decide`.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.PlaceExclWitness

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency Ern.Concurrency.Corpus
open Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.GuardedStore
open Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.GuardedChain (gc0 gc6 greg)
open Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.GuardedChainC (lc7 lc8 lc9 lc10 lc11 lcLbls)
open Ern.Concurrency.Traces (L0 q0 q6 s4_steps)
open Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples (K0)

/-! ## W-GS -/

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v6 §2 sexies W-GS, step 1, under the extended rule: `store(z2, T)` by
context 0 without the grant is an `ok` step of the kernel (O8) admitted by `Encap5C`, and excluded
by `PlaceExcl`: the right over `T` holds neither before the store (Spec 1 §65.2) nor in the
resulting state (§65.5) without `guarded`, the only authority with effective `Modify` on `T`. -/

/-- Decidability of `PlaceExcl`. -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg)
    (lbl : Label) : Decidable (PlaceExcl k L st lbl) := by
  unfold PlaceExcl; split <;> infer_instance

/-- `Encap5R` (brief of milestone 4, task 2): `Encap5C` and `PlaceExcl`. -/
def Encap5R (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbl : Label) : Prop :=
  Encap5C L (st.1, st.2.1) lbl ∧ PlaceExcl k L st lbl

/-- `EncapsulatedTrace5R`: a run every step of which satisfies `Encap5R` in the state where it is
taken. -/
inductive EncapsulatedTrace5R (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) :
    SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg → Prop where
  | nil {st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} : EncapsulatedTrace5R k L st [] st
  | cons {st st₁ st₂ : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbl : Label} {lbls : List Label} :
      Encap5R k L st lbl → LStep k L lbl st st₁ →
      EncapsulatedTrace5R k L st₁ lbls st₂ → EncapsulatedTrace5R k L st (lbl :: lbls) st₂

/-- Every `EncapsulatedTrace5R` is an `EncapsulatedTrace5C`: `cap5_compat`, `cap5_drop_own` (through
`encapsulatedTrace5C_imp`), `cap5_sound_C` and `handoff_loss_exists_C` (through `run5C_of_trace`)
apply to it. -/
theorem encapsulatedTrace5R_imp {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (h : EncapsulatedTrace5R k L st lbls st') :
    EncapsulatedTrace5C k L st lbls st' := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | cons he hs _ ih => exact .cons he.1 hs ih

/-- An `EncapsulatedTrace5R` extended by one step satisfying `Encap5R`. -/
theorem EncapsulatedTrace5R.snoc {k : K} {L : MutexLayout}
    {st st' st'' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbls : List Label} {lbl : Label}
    (h : EncapsulatedTrace5R k L st lbls st') (he : Encap5R k L st' lbl)
    (hs : LStep k L lbl st' st'') : EncapsulatedTrace5R k L st (lbls ++ [lbl]) st'' := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact .cons he hs .nil
  | cons he' hs' _ ih => exact .cons he' hs' (ih he hs)

/-! ## Without a live entry -/

/-- Without a live entry, `HasRight` (Spec 1 §43) from the view of `c` is `HasRight5`. -/
theorem hasRight5_of_noLive {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c q : Nat} {m : Mode}
        rw [hy] at h1; cases h1; rw [hh] at hv; cases hv
        exact hasRight5_of_noLive hng ⟨_, List.mem_range.2 (Arena.exercisable_lt hb), hb, hall⟩

/-- Without a live entry in the synchronization registry, every registered `guarded` identity
existing (WC5 C21.6, `RegBound`), every `ok` step satisfies `PlaceExcl`: the extension leaves the
traces without a live mutex unchanged. `RegBound` keeps the creation phase of the by-value
composite from making an entry live (WC5 C21.6). -/
theorem placeExcl_of_noLive {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg}
    {ar : ArenaReg} {st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} (hb : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.guarded < s.A.length)
    (hng : ∀ e ∈ reg, ¬ e.Live s) (h : LStep k L lbl (s, reg, ar) st') :
    PlaceExcl k L (s, reg, ar) lbl := by
  cases h with
  | @kernel _ s' _ _ c op hk =>
    cases op with
    | release a =>
      obtain ⟨-, o, hR, ho⟩ := hk
