/-! ## Events -/

/-- Event of a trace (WC5.1 C26, C28; brief, "Événements"): `step i`, the event of step `i`, of
context `Label.ctx`; `start i`, the marker `start(c)` of the context created by step `i` when this
step is a `spawn` or a `spawnVal`. -/
inductive Ev where
  | step (i : Nat)
  | start (i : Nat)
deriving DecidableEq

/-- Position of an event (brief, task 1): `start(c)` is placed at its `spawn`, right after it. -/
def Ev.pos : Ev → Nat
  | .step i => 2 * i
  | .start i => 2 * i + 1

/-- The event at a position. -/
def Ev.ofPos (p : Nat) : Ev := if p % 2 = 0 then .step (p / 2) else .start (p / 2)

/-- `Ev.ofPos` inverts `Ev.pos`. -/
theorem Ev.ofPos_pos : ∀ e : Ev, Ev.ofPos e.pos = e
  | .step i => by
    have h : 2 * i % 2 = 0 := by omega
    simp only [Ev.ofPos, Ev.pos, h, ↓reduceIte, Ev.step.injEq]; omega
  | .start i => by
    have h : ¬ (2 * i + 1) % 2 = 0 := by omega
    simp only [Ev.ofPos, Ev.pos, h, ↓reduceIte, Ev.start.injEq]; omega

/-- `Ev.pos` inverts `Ev.ofPos`. -/
theorem Ev.pos_ofPos (p : Nat) : (Ev.ofPos p).pos = p := by
  unfold Ev.ofPos
  split
  · show 2 * (p / 2) = p; omega
  · show 2 * (p / 2) + 1 = p; omega

/-- Step `lbl` creates a context: `spawn` (WC5.1 C4) or `spawnVal` (WC5.1 C5). -/
def Label.creates : Label → Bool
  | .spawn .. | .spawnVal .. => true
  | _ => false

/-- The context terminated by `lbl` (WC5.1 C7). -/
def Label.termOf : Label → Option Nat
  | .terminate c => some c
  | _ => none

/-- The context joined by `lbl` (WC5.1 C8). -/
def Label.joinOf : Label → Option Nat
  | .join _ d => some d
  | _ => none

/-- The entry unlocked by `lbl` (WC5.1 C17). -/
def Label.unlockOf : Label → Option Nat
  | .unlock _ i => some i
  | _ => none

/-- The entry acquired by `lbl` (WC5.1 C16). -/
def Label.acquireOf : Label → Option Nat
  | .acquire _ i => some i
  | _ => none

/-- Identity of the context created by step `i`, a `spawn` or a `spawnVal`: the fresh identity of
WC5.1 C4 item 2, `|C|` in the state where the step is taken (`spawnEff`; `spawnCreate` for the
create phase of WC5.1 C5). -/
def created (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (i : Nat) : Nat := (σ i).1.C.length

/-- `po` (WC5.1 C28; brief, "po"): between two steps of the same context, in trace order;
`start(c)` precedes every step of `c`. The clause `i < j` of the second case holds on every trace
(`po_start_iff`). -/
def PO (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbls : List Label) : Ev → Ev → Prop
  | .step i, .step j =>
    i < j ∧ j < lbls.length ∧ (lbls[i]?).map Label.ctx = (lbls[j]?).map Label.ctx
  | .start i, .step j =>
    i < j ∧ j < lbls.length ∧ (lbls[i]?).map Label.creates = some true ∧
      (lbls[j]?).map Label.ctx = some (created σ i)
  | _, _ => False

/-- Decidability of `PO`. -/
instance (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbls : List Label) (e e' : Ev) :
    Decidable (PO σ lbls e e') := by
  unfold PO; split <;> infer_instance

/-- `sw` (WC5.1 C32 items 2 and 3, C47, C48; brief, "sw"): from the step `spawn` or `spawnVal`
creating `c` to `start(c)`; from `terminate(c)` to every `join` of `c` after it; from `unlock(e)`
to the first `acquire(e)` after it. -/
def SW (lbls : List Label) : Ev → Ev → Prop
  | .step i, .start j => i = j ∧ (lbls[i]?).map Label.creates = some true
  | .step i, .step j =>
    i < j ∧ j < lbls.length ∧
      (OptP ((lbls[i]?).bind Label.termOf) (fun d => (lbls[j]?).bind Label.joinOf = some d) False ∨
       OptP ((lbls[i]?).bind Label.unlockOf) (fun e => (lbls[j]?).bind Label.acquireOf = some e ∧
         ∀ p ∈ List.range j, i < p → (lbls[p]?).bind Label.acquireOf ≠ some e) False)
  | _, _ => False

/-- Decidability of `SW`. -/
instance (lbls : List Label) (e e' : Ev) : Decidable (SW lbls e e') := by
  unfold SW; split <;> infer_instance

/-- An edge of `po ∪ sw`. -/
def Edge (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbls : List Label) (e e' : Ev) : Prop :=
  PO σ lbls e e' ∨ SW lbls e e'

/-- Decidability of `Edge`. -/
instance (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbls : List Label) (e e' : Ev) :
    Decidable (Edge σ lbls e e') := by
  unfold Edge; infer_instance

/-- `hb` (WC5.1 C33; brief, "hb"): the transitive closure of `po ∪ sw`. -/
def HB (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbls : List Label) : Ev → Ev → Prop :=
  Relation.TransGen (Edge σ lbls)

/-- A step of `lbls` exists. -/
theorem lt_of_map_some {α : Type} {lbls : List Label} {i : Nat} {f : Label → α} {a : α}
    (h : (lbls[i]?).map f = some a) : i < lbls.length := by
  cases hi : lbls[i]? with
  | none => rw [hi] at h; cases h
  | some x => exact (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hi).1

/-- Every edge of `po ∪ sw` goes to a later position of the trace. -/
theorem edge_pos {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbls : List Label} {e e' : Ev}
    (h : Edge σ lbls e e') : e.pos < e'.pos ∧ e'.pos < 2 * lbls.length := by
  rcases h with h | h
  · cases e <;> cases e' <;> simp only [PO] at h
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2, -⟩ := h; exact ⟨by simp only [Ev.pos]; omega, by simp only [Ev.pos]; omega⟩
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2, -⟩ := h; exact ⟨by simp only [Ev.pos]; omega, by simp only [Ev.pos]; omega⟩
  · cases e <;> cases e' <;> simp only [SW] at h
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2, -⟩ := h; exact ⟨by simp only [Ev.pos]; omega, by simp only [Ev.pos]; omega⟩
    · obtain ⟨rfl, h2⟩ := h
      have := lt_of_map_some h2
      exact ⟨by simp only [Ev.pos]; omega, by simp only [Ev.pos]; omega⟩

/-- Brief, task 1: `hb` only relates events in increasing position. -/
theorem hb_pos {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbls : List Label} {e e' : Ev}
    (h : HB σ lbls e e') : e.pos < e'.pos := by
  induction h with
  | single h => exact (edge_pos h).1
  | tail _ h ih => exact Nat.lt_trans ih (edge_pos h).1

/-- Brief, task 1: `hb` is irreflexive (WC5.1 C33: acyclicity). -/
theorem hb_irrefl {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbls : List Label} (e : Ev) :
    ¬ HB σ lbls e e :=
  fun h => Nat.lt_irrefl _ (hb_pos h)

/-! ## Decision of `hb` -/

/-- Reachability from `src` along `R` of the positions below `n`, computed in one pass by
increasing position. -/
def reachList (R : Ev → Ev → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (src : Ev) : Nat → List Bool
  | 0 => []
  | n + 1 =>
    let v := reachList R src n
    v ++ [decide (R src (Ev.ofPos n)) ||
      (List.range n).any fun r => (v[r]?).getD false && decide (R (Ev.ofPos r) (Ev.ofPos n))]

/-- `reachList R src n` has `n` entries. -/
theorem reachList_length (R : Ev → Ev → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (src : Ev) :
    ∀ n, (reachList R src n).length = n
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by simp [reachList, reachList_length R src n]

/-- When `R` increases positions, `reachList` computes the transitive closure of `R`. -/
theorem reachList_spec (R : Ev → Ev → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (src : Ev)
    (hmono : ∀ e e', R e e' → e.pos < e'.pos) :
    ∀ n q, q < n → (((reachList R src n)[q]?).getD false = true ↔
      Relation.TransGen R src (Ev.ofPos q))
  | 0, _, hq => absurd hq (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, q, hq => by
    have ih := reachList_spec R src hmono n
    have hlen := reachList_length R src n
    simp only [reachList]
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge q n with h | h
    · rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by rw [hlen]; exact h)]
      exact ih q h
    · obtain rfl : q = n := by omega
      rw [List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_of_eq hlen), hlen, Nat.sub_self]
      simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.getD_some, Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
        List.any_eq_true, List.mem_range, Bool.and_eq_true]
      constructor
      · rintro (h1 | ⟨r, hr, h2, h3⟩)
        · exact .single h1
        · exact .tail ((ih r hr).1 h2) h3
      · intro ht
        cases ht with
        | single h1 => exact Or.inl h1
        | @tail y _ hy h3 =>
          have hp := hmono _ _ h3
          rw [Ev.pos_ofPos] at hp
          refine Or.inr ⟨y.pos, hp, (ih y.pos hp).2 (by rw [Ev.ofPos_pos]; exact hy), ?_⟩
          rw [Ev.ofPos_pos]; exact h3

/-- `hb` as computed by `reachList`. -/
theorem hb_iff_reach {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbls : List Label} {e e' : Ev} :
    HB σ lbls e e' ↔ ((reachList (Edge σ lbls) e (e'.pos + 1))[e'.pos]?).getD false = true := by
  rw [reachList_spec _ _ (fun _ _ h => (edge_pos h).1) _ _ (Nat.lt_succ_self _), Ev.ofPos_pos]
  rfl

/-- Decidability of `hb` on a finite trace (brief, "hb"). -/
instance (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbls : List Label) (e e' : Ev) :
    Decidable (HB σ lbls e e') :=
  decidable_of_iff _ hb_iff_reach.symm

/-! ## Exclusive pairs, races, loss step, `HandoffOrdered` -/

/-- Exclusive pair `(i, j, l)` (brief, "Paire exclusive"; WC5.1 C44): `i < j`, distinct contexts,
both steps access the leaf `l` (`Label.Access`), at least one of them requiring `Modify`. -/
def ExclPair (lbls : List Label) (i j l : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ (hij : i < j) (hj : j < lbls.length) (c c' : Nat) (m m' : Mode), c ≠ c' ∧
    (lbls[i]'(Nat.lt_trans hij hj)).Access c' l m ∧ lbls[j].Access c l m' ∧
    (m = .modify ∨ m' = .modify)

/-- `Race` (brief, "Race"; WC5.1 C33 restricted to the accesses `read3`, `write3`, `writeShared`
and to the pairs with a member requiring `Modify`, C44): an exclusive pair without `hb`. -/
def Race (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbls : List Label) : Prop :=
  ∃ i j l, ExclPair lbls i j l ∧ ¬ HB σ lbls (.step i) (.step j)

/-- Mode required by an access step, as in `Label.Access` (Spec 1 §66.2, §67.1, §68.2). -/
def Label.accMode : Label → Option Mode
  | .kernel _ (.read _ _) => some .observe
  | .kernel _ (.write _ _) => some .modify
  | .kernel _ (.writeShared _ _) => some .observe
  | _ => none

/-- A capability `o` is compatible with the mode `m` of a later access of another context (brief,
"Pas de perte"; WC5.1 C45): `none` if `m` is `Modify`, other than `Modify` if `m` is `Observe`. -/
def CapCompat : Option Mode → Mode → Bool
  | none, _ => true
  | some .observe, .observe => true
  | _, _ => false

/-- Loss step `r(i, j, l)` (brief, "Pas de perte"; WC5.1 C45): the first step `k > i` of the trace
at the issue of which `cap5` of the context of step `i` on `l` is compatible with the mode of step
`j`; `none` if there is none. -/
def lossStep (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbls : List Label) (i j l : Nat) :
    Option Nat :=
  match (lbls[i]?).map Label.ctx, (lbls[j]?).bind Label.accMode with
  | some c', some m' => (List.range lbls.length).find? fun k =>
      decide (i < k) && CapCompat (cap5 (σ (k + 1)).1 (σ (k + 1)).2.1 c' l) m'
  | _, _ => none

/-- `HandoffOrdered` for one pair (brief, "HandoffOrdered"; WC5.1 C46): the loss step exists and is
`hb`-before step `j`. A missing marker is a failure, not a vacuous success (WC5.1 C46). -/
def HandoffOrderedAt (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbls : List Label) (i j l : Nat) :
    Prop :=
  ∃ r, lossStep σ lbls i j l = some r ∧ HB σ lbls (.step r) (.step j)

/-- `HandoffOrderedAt` as an `OptP` on the loss step. -/
theorem handoffOrderedAt_iff {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbls : List Label}
    {i j l : Nat} : HandoffOrderedAt σ lbls i j l ↔
      OptP (lossStep σ lbls i j l) (fun r => HB σ lbls (.step r) (.step j)) False := by
  unfold HandoffOrderedAt
  cases lossStep σ lbls i j l with
  | none => simp [OptP]
  | some r => simp [OptP]

/-- Decidability of `HandoffOrderedAt`. -/
instance (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbls : List Label) (i j l : Nat) :
    Decidable (HandoffOrderedAt σ lbls i j l) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ handoffOrderedAt_iff.symm

/-- `HandoffOrdered` (brief, "HandoffOrdered"; WC5.1 C46): every exclusive pair satisfies
`HandoffOrderedAt`. -/
def HandoffOrdered (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbls : List Label) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j l, ExclPair lbls i j l → HandoffOrderedAt σ lbls i j l

/-! ## `po` from `start(c)` on a trace -/

/-- On the `ok` steps of a trace, every step of the context created by step `i` comes after step
`i`: the created context has the fresh identity `|C|` (WC5.1 C4 item 2, `spawnEff`), only a live
context steps (`lstep_lifes`), and `C` never shrinks (`len_mono`). -/
theorem step_after_create {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (hs : ∀ i (h : i < lbls.length), LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1)))
    {i j : Nat} (hi : (lbls[i]?).map Label.creates = some true) (hj : j < lbls.length)
    (hc : (lbls[j]?).map Label.ctx = some (created σ i)) : i < j := by
  have hil := lt_of_map_some hi
  refine Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hji => ?_
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj, Option.map_some] at hc
  have hlive := (lstep_lifes (hs j hj)).1
  rw [Option.some.inj hc] at hlive
  have h1 := SC.lt_of_live hlive
  have h2 := len_mono hs i hji (Nat.le_of_lt hil)
  exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le h1 h2)

/-- On the `ok` steps of a trace, `po` from `start(c)` is the clause of the brief, "`start(c)`
précède tous les pas de `c`", without the order clause. -/
theorem po_start_iff {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (hs : ∀ i (h : i < lbls.length), LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1)))
    {i j : Nat} : PO σ lbls (.start i) (.step j) ↔ j < lbls.length ∧
      (lbls[i]?).map Label.creates = some true ∧ (lbls[j]?).map Label.ctx = some (created σ i) :=
  ⟨fun ⟨_, h2, h3, h4⟩ => ⟨h2, h3, h4⟩,
   fun ⟨h2, h3, h4⟩ => ⟨step_after_create hs h3 h2 h4, h2, h3, h4⟩⟩

end Ern.Concurrency

import Ern.Concurrency.Events

/-!
# The strict mutex edge

Brief of milestone 4, strict mutex edge, task 3 (`formal/reports/spec2-m4-events.md`, § Arête
stricte du mutex). The edge of the mutex of `Ern.Concurrency.Events` goes from an `unlock(e)` to the
next successful `acquire(e)`; WC5.1 requires the `acquire` to read directly, on the same atomic
unit, the publication of the `unlock` (WC5.1 C32 item 1, C48). The strict edge keeps it only when
no `resetLock(e)` lies between the two steps (WC5.1 C18 effect, C49) and the controller of `e`
designates the same leaf in every state between them (WC5.1 C21 item 3; `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9
§2 octies). The strict graph has the same `po` and the same `spawn` and `join` edges. Nothing of
`Ern.Concurrency.Events` is changed.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Definitions -/

/-- The entry reset by `lbl` (WC5.1 C18). -/
def Label.resetLockOf : Label → Option Nat
  | .resetLock _ i => some i
  | _ => none

/-- The controller of entry `i` in the state `σ k`, as the model computes it (`ControlOf`, WC5.1
C21 item 3); `none` if there is no entry `i` or no controller. -/
def ctlAt (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (L : MutexLayout) (i k : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  ((σ k).2.1[i]?).bind (ControlOf L (σ k).1)

/-- The conditions of the strict mutex edge from an `unlock(e)` at step `u` to an `acquire(e)` at
step `a` (brief, "Arête stricte du mutex"): no `resetLock(e)` at a step strictly between `u` and
`a`; and the controller of `e` designates the same leaf in every state from the issue of step `u`
(`σ (u + 1)`) to the entry of step `a` (`σ a`): it is defined at `σ (u + 1)` and equal to that
leaf at every state up to `σ a`. -/
def MutexGap (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (L : MutexLayout) (lbls : List Label)
    (e u a : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ p ∈ List.range a, u < p → (lbls[p]?).bind Label.resetLockOf ≠ some e) ∧
    ctlAt σ L e (u + 1) ≠ none ∧
    ∀ k ∈ List.range (a + 1), u + 1 ≤ k → ctlAt σ L e k = ctlAt σ L e (u + 1)

/-- Decidability of `MutexGap`. -/
instance (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (L : MutexLayout) (lbls : List Label)
    (e u a : Nat) : Decidable (MutexGap σ L lbls e u a) := by
  unfold MutexGap; infer_instance

/-- Strict `sw` (brief, "Graphe strict"): the edges of `SW` from `spawn` or `spawnVal` to
`start(c)` and from `terminate(c)` to a later `join` of `c`, unchanged; the strict mutex edge, from
`unlock(e)` to the first later `acquire(e)` when `MutexGap` holds between them. -/
def SWS (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (L : MutexLayout) (lbls : List Label) :
    Ev → Ev → Prop
  | .step i, .start j => i = j ∧ (lbls[i]?).map Label.creates = some true
  | .step i, .step j =>
    i < j ∧ j < lbls.length ∧
      (OptP ((lbls[i]?).bind Label.termOf) (fun d => (lbls[j]?).bind Label.joinOf = some d) False ∨
       OptP ((lbls[i]?).bind Label.unlockOf) (fun e => (lbls[j]?).bind Label.acquireOf = some e ∧
         (∀ p ∈ List.range j, i < p → (lbls[p]?).bind Label.acquireOf ≠ some e) ∧
         MutexGap σ L lbls e i j) False)
  | _, _ => False

/-- Decidability of `SWS`. -/
instance (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (L : MutexLayout) (lbls : List Label) (e e' : Ev) :
    Decidable (SWS σ L lbls e e') := by
  unfold SWS; split <;> infer_instance

/-- An edge of the strict graph: `po` or strict `sw`. -/
def EdgeS (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (L : MutexLayout) (lbls : List Label)
    (e e' : Ev) : Prop :=
  PO σ lbls e e' ∨ SWS σ L lbls e e'

/-- Decidability of `EdgeS`. -/
instance (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (L : MutexLayout) (lbls : List Label) (e e' : Ev) :
    Decidable (EdgeS σ L lbls e e') := by
  unfold EdgeS; infer_instance

/-- Strict `hb` (brief, "Graphe strict"): the transitive closure of `po` and strict `sw`. -/
def HBS (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (L : MutexLayout) (lbls : List Label) :
    Ev → Ev → Prop :=
  Relation.TransGen (EdgeS σ L lbls)

/-- Strict `Race` (brief): `Race` read on strict `hb`. -/
def RaceS (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (L : MutexLayout) (lbls : List Label) : Prop :=
  ∃ i j l, ExclPair lbls i j l ∧ ¬ HBS σ L lbls (.step i) (.step j)

/-- Strict `HandoffOrderedAt` (brief): `HandoffOrderedAt` read on strict `hb`; `lossStep` is
unchanged. -/
def HandoffOrderedAtS (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (L : MutexLayout) (lbls : List Label)
    (i j l : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ r, lossStep σ lbls i j l = some r ∧ HBS σ L lbls (.step r) (.step j)

/-- Strict `HandoffOrdered` (brief): every exclusive pair satisfies `HandoffOrderedAtS`. -/
def HandoffOrderedS (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (L : MutexLayout)
    (lbls : List Label) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j l, ExclPair lbls i j l → HandoffOrderedAtS σ L lbls i j l

/-! ## Inclusion into the graph of `Ern.Concurrency.Events` -/

/-- Brief, task 3: every strict `sw` edge is an `sw` edge. -/
theorem sws_sw {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {L : MutexLayout} {lbls : List Label}
    {e e' : Ev} (h : SWS σ L lbls e e') : SW lbls e e' := by
  cases e with
  | step i =>
    cases e' with
    | step j =>
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3 | h3⟩ := h
      · exact ⟨h1, h2, Or.inl h3⟩
      · refine ⟨h1, h2, Or.inr ?_⟩
        revert h3
        cases (lbls[i]?).bind Label.unlockOf with
        | none => exact id
        | some e => exact fun ⟨a, b, _⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩
    | start j => exact h
  | start i => cases e' <;> exact False.elim h

/-- Every edge of the strict graph is an edge of the graph. -/
theorem edgeS_edge {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {L : MutexLayout} {lbls : List Label}
    {e e' : Ev} (h : EdgeS σ L lbls e e') : Edge σ lbls e e' :=
  h.imp id sws_sw

/-- Brief, task 3: strict `hb` entails `hb`. -/
theorem hbS_hb {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {L : MutexLayout} {lbls : List Label}
    {e e' : Ev} (h : HBS σ L lbls e e') : HB σ lbls e e' := by
  induction h with
  | single h => exact .single (edgeS_edge h)
  | tail _ h ih => exact .tail ih (edgeS_edge h)

/-- Brief, task 3: `Race` entails strict `Race`. -/
theorem race_raceS {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {L : MutexLayout} {lbls : List Label}
    (h : Race σ lbls) : RaceS σ L lbls := by
  obtain ⟨i, j, l, hp, hnb⟩ := h
  exact ⟨i, j, l, hp, fun hs => hnb (hbS_hb hs)⟩

/-- Strict `HandoffOrderedAt` entails `HandoffOrderedAt`. -/
theorem handoffOrderedAtS_imp {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {L : MutexLayout}
    {lbls : List Label} {i j l : Nat} (h : HandoffOrderedAtS σ L lbls i j l) :
    HandoffOrderedAt σ lbls i j l := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hb⟩ := h
  exact ⟨r, hr, hbS_hb hb⟩

/-- Brief, task 3: strict `HandoffOrdered` entails `HandoffOrdered`. -/
theorem handoffOrderedS_imp {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {L : MutexLayout}
    {lbls : List Label} (h : HandoffOrderedS σ L lbls) : HandoffOrdered σ lbls :=
  fun i j l hp => handoffOrderedAtS_imp (h i j l hp)

/-! ## Order, irreflexivity, decision -/

/-- Brief, task 3: strict `hb` only relates events in increasing position. -/
theorem hbS_pos {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {L : MutexLayout} {lbls : List Label}
    {e e' : Ev} (h : HBS σ L lbls e e') : e.pos < e'.pos :=
  hb_pos (hbS_hb h)

/-- Brief, task 3: strict `hb` is irreflexive (WC5.1 C33: acyclicity). -/
theorem hbS_irrefl {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {L : MutexLayout} {lbls : List Label}
    (e : Ev) : ¬ HBS σ L lbls e e :=
  fun h => Nat.lt_irrefl _ (hbS_pos h)

/-- Strict `hb` as computed by `reachList`. -/
theorem hbS_iff_reach {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {L : MutexLayout} {lbls : List Label}
    {e e' : Ev} : HBS σ L lbls e e' ↔
      ((reachList (EdgeS σ L lbls) e (e'.pos + 1))[e'.pos]?).getD false = true := by
  rw [reachList_spec _ _ (fun _ _ h => (edge_pos (edgeS_edge h)).1) _ _ (Nat.lt_succ_self _),
    Ev.ofPos_pos]
  rfl

/-- Brief, task 3: decidability of strict `hb` on a finite trace. -/
instance (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (L : MutexLayout) (lbls : List Label) (e e' : Ev) :
    Decidable (HBS σ L lbls e e') :=
  decidable_of_iff _ hbS_iff_reach.symm

/-- `HandoffOrderedAtS` as an `OptP` on the loss step. -/
theorem handoffOrderedAtS_iff {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {L : MutexLayout}
    {lbls : List Label} {i j l : Nat} : HandoffOrderedAtS σ L lbls i j l ↔
      OptP (lossStep σ lbls i j l) (fun r => HBS σ L lbls (.step r) (.step j)) False := by
  unfold HandoffOrderedAtS
  cases lossStep σ lbls i j l with
  | none => simp [OptP]
  | some r => simp [OptP]

/-- Decidability of `HandoffOrderedAtS`. -/
instance (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (L : MutexLayout) (lbls : List Label)
    (i j l : Nat) : Decidable (HandoffOrderedAtS σ L lbls i j l) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ handoffOrderedAtS_iff.symm

end Ern.Concurrency

no `resetLock(e)` lies between the two steps (WC5.1 C18 effect, C49) and the controller of `e`
designates the same leaf in every state between them (WC5.1 C21 item 3; `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9
§2 octies). The strict graph has the same `po` and the same `spawn` and `join` edges. Nothing of
`Ern.Concurrency.Events` is changed.
-/

/-- The entry reset by `lbl` (WC5.1 C18). -/
def Label.resetLockOf : Label → Option Nat
  | .resetLock _ i => some i
  | _ => none

C21 item 3); `none` if there is no entry `i` or no controller. -/
def ctlAt (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (L : MutexLayout) (i k : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  ((σ k).2.1[i]?).bind (ControlOf L (σ k).1)

`a`; and the controller of `e` designates the same leaf in every state from the issue of step `u`
(`σ (u + 1)`) to the entry of step `a` (`σ a`): it is defined at `σ (u + 1)` and equal to that

import Ern.Concurrency.EventModel.Closure

/-!
# Event fragment: graphs, relations, consistency, races

Brief of milestone 4, slice 2 (layer E), task 1 (`formal/reports/spec2-m4-eventmodel.md`): the
"ERN fragment" level of WC5.1 corrigé C53, independent of the authority machine. One atomic unit
`x` and one ordinary leaf `d` per graph; `po`, `rf`, `mo`, `sw` by direct read (WC5.1 corrigé C32
item 1, C48), `hb` (C33), `EventConsistent` (C31) and races (C30, C33). `seq_cst` only acts as a
release and an acquire (C40); no global constraint, no release sequence, no `NoThinAir_RC11`
(C34).

Representation: event `0` is the initial write of `x`, events `i + 1` are the entries of `evs`;
`po` is the listing order of the events of a context; `rf` and `mo` are finite relations given as
lists of pairs, read on the events of the graph.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Ern.Concurrency.EventModel

/-! ## Events -/

/-- Memory orders (WC5.1 corrigé C40). -/
inductive MOrd where
  | rlx | rel | acq | acqRel | sc
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Kinds of the events other than the initial write (WC5.1 corrigé C31, C36, C37, C39):
`read3(d)`, `write3(d)` (no value, C36); `read3(x)` with the value read, `write3(x, v)` (non-atomic
accesses to the atomic unit, C36, C42); `readShared(x, o)` with the value read (C37);
`writeShared(x, v, o)` (C39); a successful RMW on `x` with the value read, the value written and
an order (C39). A failed compare-exchange is a `readShared` (C39). -/
inductive Kind where
  | readD
  | writeD
  | readX (v : Nat)
  | writeX (v : Nat)
  | rsh (o : MOrd) (v : Nat)
  | wsh (o : MOrd) (v : Nat)
  | rmw (o : MOrd) (vr vw : Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An event other than the initial write: its context and its kind. -/
structure Ev where
  ctx : Nat
  kind : Kind
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- A finite graph: the value of the initial write of `x` (event `0`, of no context, non-atomic,
exactly one, WC5.1 corrigé C31), the other events (event `i + 1` is `evs[i]`), and the relations
`rf` and `mo` as lists of pairs. -/
structure Graph where
  init : Nat
  evs : List Ev
  rf : List (Nat × Nat)
  mo : List (Nat × Nat)

namespace Graph

variable (g : Graph)

/-- Number of events, the initial write included. -/
def size : Nat := g.evs.length + 1

/-- Event `i`, if it is not the initial write. -/
def ev? (i : Nat) : Option Ev := if i = 0 then none else g.evs[i - 1]?

/-- Kind of event `i`, if it is not the initial write. -/
def kind? (i : Nat) : Option Kind := (g.ev? i).map (·.kind)

/-- Context of event `i`; `none` for the initial write. -/
def ctx? (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (g.ev? i).map (·.ctx)

/-- Event `i` is on the atomic unit `x`. -/
def onX (i : Nat) : Bool :=
  i = 0 || match g.kind? i with
    | some (.readX _) | some (.writeX _) | some (.rsh _ _) | some (.wsh _ _)
    | some (.rmw _ _ _) => true
    | _ => false

/-- Event `i` is on the ordinary leaf `d`. -/
def onD (i : Nat) : Bool :=
  match g.kind? i with
  | some .readD | some .writeD => true
  | _ => false

/-- Event `i` is a modification of `x` (WC5.1 corrigé C31): the initial write, `writeShared`, a
successful RMW, `write3(x, v)`. -/
def isMod (i : Nat) : Bool :=
  i = 0 || match g.kind? i with
    | some (.writeX _) | some (.wsh _ _) | some (.rmw _ _ _) => true
    | _ => false

/-- Event `i` reads `x` (brief, "rf"): `readShared`, the read component of an RMW, `read3(x)`. -/
def isReadX (i : Nat) : Bool :=
  match g.kind? i with
  | some (.readX _) | some (.rsh _ _) | some (.rmw _ _ _) => true
  | _ => false

/-- Event `i` is a successful RMW (WC5.1 corrigé C39). -/
def isRMW (i : Nat) : Bool :=
  match g.kind? i with
  | some (.rmw _ _ _) => true
  | _ => false

/-- Event `i` writes or modifies its location (WC5.1 corrigé C30). -/
def isWrite (i : Nat) : Bool := g.isMod i || g.kind? i == some .writeD

/-- Event `i` is atomic (WC5.1 corrigé C36, C37, C39): `readShared`, `writeShared`, RMW. -/
def isAtomic (i : Nat) : Bool :=
  match g.kind? i with
  | some (.rsh _ _) | some (.wsh _ _) | some (.rmw _ _ _) => true
  | _ => false

/-- Value written by event `i`. -/
def valW (i : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  if i = 0 then some g.init else
  match g.kind? i with
  | some (.writeX v) | some (.wsh _ v) | some (.rmw _ _ v) => some v
  | _ => none

/-- Value read by event `i`. -/
def valR (i : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  match g.kind? i with
  | some (.readX v) | some (.rsh _ v) | some (.rmw _ v _) => some v
  | _ => none

/-- Event `i` is release-capable (WC5.1 corrigé C32 item 1, C40): `writeShared` in `release` or
`seq_cst`, RMW in `release`, `acq_rel` or `seq_cst`. -/
def relCap (i : Nat) : Bool :=
  match g.kind? i with
  | some (.wsh .rel _) | some (.wsh .sc _) | some (.rmw .rel _ _) | some (.rmw .acqRel _ _)
  | some (.rmw .sc _ _) => true
  | _ => false

/-- Event `i` is acquire-capable (WC5.1 corrigé C32 item 1, C40): `readShared` in `acquire` or
`seq_cst`, RMW in `acquire`, `acq_rel` or `seq_cst`. -/
def acqCap (i : Nat) : Bool :=
  match g.kind? i with
  | some (.rsh .acq _) | some (.rsh .sc _) | some (.rmw .acq _ _) | some (.rmw .acqRel _ _)
  | some (.rmw .sc _ _) => true
  | _ => false

end Graph

/-! ## Typing of the orders -/

/-- The order of an event is in its row (WC5.1 corrigé C40). -/
def Kind.OrdOk : Kind → Prop
  | .rsh o _ => o = .rlx ∨ o = .acq ∨ o = .sc
  | .wsh o _ => o = .rlx ∨ o = .rel ∨ o = .sc
  | _ => True

/-- Decidability of `Kind.OrdOk`. -/
instance (k : Kind) : Decidable k.OrdOk := by unfold Kind.OrdOk; split <;> infer_instance

/-- A graph is well typed when every event has an order of its row (WC5.1 corrigé C40). Typing is
not a consistency conjunct. -/
def WellTyped (g : Graph) : Prop := ∀ e ∈ g.evs, e.kind.OrdOk

/-- Decidability of `WellTyped`. -/
instance (g : Graph) : Decidable (WellTyped g) := by unfold WellTyped; infer_instance

/-! ## Relations -/

/-- `po` (brief): events of the same context, in listing order; the initial write has no
context. -/
def PO (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  0 < a ∧ a < b ∧ b < g.size ∧ g.ctx? a = g.ctx? b

/-- `rf`, read on the events of the graph. -/
def RF (g : Graph) (w r : Nat) : Prop := (w, r) ∈ g.rf ∧ w < g.size ∧ r < g.size

/-- `mo`, read on the events of the graph. -/
def MO (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Prop := (a, b) ∈ g.mo ∧ a < g.size ∧ b < g.size

/-- `sw` by direct read (WC5.1 corrigé C32 item 1, C48): `rf` from a release-capable event to an
acquire-capable event. The initial write and `write3(x, v)` are never release-capable (C31). -/
def SW (g : Graph) (w r : Nat) : Prop := RF g w r ∧ g.relCap w = true ∧ g.acqCap r = true

/-- `po ∪ sw`. -/
def PoSw (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Prop := PO g a b ∨ SW g a b

/-- `hb` (brief; WC5.1 corrigé C33): the transitive closure of `po ∪ sw`, plus the initial write
`hb`-before every other event, a convention of the fragment for the state built before the
contexts start. -/
def HB (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  Relation.TransGen (PoSw g) a b ∨ (a = 0 ∧ 0 < b ∧ b < g.size)

/-- `rb = (rf⁻¹ ; mo) \ id` (brief). -/
def RB (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Prop := (∃ w ∈ List.range g.size, RF g w a ∧ MO g w b) ∧ a ≠ b

/-- `rf ∪ mo ∪ rb`. -/
def EcoBase (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Prop := RF g a b ∨ MO g a b ∨ RB g a b

/-- `eco = (rf ∪ mo ∪ rb)⁺` (brief). -/
def ECO (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Prop := Relation.TransGen (EcoBase g) a b

/-- Decidability of `PO`. -/
instance (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Decidable (PO g a b) := by unfold PO; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of `RF`. -/
instance (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Decidable (RF g a b) := by unfold RF; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of `MO`. -/
instance (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Decidable (MO g a b) := by unfold MO; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of `SW`. -/
instance (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Decidable (SW g a b) := by unfold SW; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of `PoSw`. -/
instance (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Decidable (PoSw g a b) := by unfold PoSw; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of `RB`. -/
instance (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Decidable (RB g a b) := by unfold RB; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of `EcoBase`. -/
instance (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Decidable (EcoBase g a b) := by
  unfold EcoBase; infer_instance

/-- The edges of `po ∪ sw` join events of the graph. -/
theorem poSw_lt {g : Graph} {a b : Nat} (h : PoSw g a b) : a < g.size ∧ b < g.size := by
  rcases h with ⟨_, h2, h3, _⟩ | ⟨⟨_, h1, h2⟩, _⟩
  · exact ⟨Nat.lt_trans h2 h3, h3⟩
  · exact ⟨h1, h2⟩

/-- The edges of `rf ∪ mo ∪ rb` join events of the graph. -/
theorem ecoBase_lt {g : Graph} {a b : Nat} (h : EcoBase g a b) : a < g.size ∧ b < g.size := by
  rcases h with ⟨_, h1, h2⟩ | ⟨_, h1, h2⟩ | ⟨⟨w, -, ⟨_, -, ha⟩, ⟨_, -, hb⟩⟩, -⟩
  · exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · exact ⟨ha, hb⟩

/-- A transitive closure of a decidable relation on the events is decidable. -/
def decTransGen (g : Graph) (R : Nat → Nat → Prop) [∀ a b, Decidable (R a b)]
    (hR : ∀ a b, R a b → a < g.size ∧ b < g.size) (a b : Nat) :
    Decidable (Relation.TransGen R a b) :=
  have hR' : ∀ a b, decide (R a b) = true → a < g.size ∧ b < g.size :=
    fun a b h => hR a b (of_decide_eq_true h)
  have heq : (fun a b => decide (R a b) = true) = R := by
    funext a b; exact propext decide_eq_true_iff
  decidable_of_iff (reach g.size (fun a b => decide (R a b)) a b = true)
    (by rw [← transGen_iff_reach hR', heq])

/-- Decidability of the transitive closure of `po ∪ sw`. -/
instance (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Decidable (Relation.TransGen (PoSw g) a b) :=
  decTransGen g (PoSw g) (fun _ _ h => poSw_lt h) a b

/-- Decidability of `HB`. -/
instance (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Decidable (HB g a b) := by unfold HB; infer_instance

/-- Decidability of `ECO`. -/
instance (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Decidable (ECO g a b) :=
  decTransGen g (EcoBase g) (fun _ _ h => ecoBase_lt h) a b

/-! ## `EventConsistent` -/

/-- Conjunct 1, `rf` well formed (brief; WC5.1 corrigé C31): every `rf` edge goes from a
modification of `x` to a read of `x` with the same value, and every read of `x` has exactly one
source. -/
def RfWF (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  (∀ w ∈ List.range g.size, ∀ r ∈ List.range g.size, RF g w r →
      g.isMod w = true ∧ g.isReadX r = true ∧ g.valW w = g.valR r) ∧
    ∀ r ∈ List.range g.size, g.isReadX r = true →
      ∃ w ∈ List.range g.size, RF g w r ∧ ∀ w' ∈ List.range g.size, RF g w' r → w' = w

/-- Conjunct 2 (brief; WC5.1 corrigé C31): `mo` is a strict total order on the modifications of
`x`, the initial write included. -/
def MoTotal (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  (∀ a ∈ List.range g.size, ∀ b ∈ List.range g.size, MO g a b →
      g.isMod a = true ∧ g.isMod b = true) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range g.size, ¬ MO g a a) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range g.size, ∀ b ∈ List.range g.size, ∀ c ∈ List.range g.size,
      MO g a b → MO g b c → MO g a c) ∧
    ∀ a ∈ List.range g.size, ∀ b ∈ List.range g.size, g.isMod a = true → g.isMod b = true →
      a ≠ b → MO g a b ∨ MO g b a

/-- Conjunct 3, atomicity of the RMWs (brief; WC5.1 corrigé C31): the `rf` source of a successful
RMW is its immediate predecessor in `mo`. -/
def RmwAtomic (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  ∀ m ∈ List.range g.size, g.isRMW m = true → ∀ w ∈ List.range g.size, RF g w m →
    MO g w m ∧ ∀ c ∈ List.range g.size, ¬ (MO g w c ∧ MO g c m)

/-- Conjunct 4, coherence (brief): `hb ; eco?` is irreflexive. -/
def Coherent (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ List.range g.size, ¬ HB g a a ∧ ∀ b ∈ List.range g.size, HB g a b → ¬ ECO g b a

/-- Conjunct 5 (brief): `hb` is irreflexive. -/
def HbIrrefl (g : Graph) : Prop := ∀ a ∈ List.range g.size, ¬ HB g a a

/-- `EventConsistent` (brief; WC5.1 corrigé C31, C33): the five conjuncts. -/
def EventConsistent (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  RfWF g ∧ MoTotal g ∧ RmwAtomic g ∧ Coherent g ∧ HbIrrefl g

/-- Decidability of `RfWF`. -/
instance (g : Graph) : Decidable (RfWF g) := by unfold RfWF; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of `MoTotal`. -/
instance (g : Graph) : Decidable (MoTotal g) := by unfold MoTotal; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of `RmwAtomic`. -/
instance (g : Graph) : Decidable (RmwAtomic g) := by unfold RmwAtomic; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of `Coherent`. -/
instance (g : Graph) : Decidable (Coherent g) := by unfold Coherent; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of `HbIrrefl`. -/
instance (g : Graph) : Decidable (HbIrrefl g) := by unfold HbIrrefl; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of `EventConsistent`. -/
instance (g : Graph) : Decidable (EventConsistent g) := by
  unfold EventConsistent; infer_instance

/-! ## Conflicts and races -/

/-- Conflict (brief; WC5.1 corrigé C30): two events of distinct contexts on the same location,
one of them at least a write or a modification. The initial write has no context and is in no
conflict. -/
def Conflict (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  g.ctx? a ≠ none ∧ g.ctx? b ≠ none ∧ g.ctx? a ≠ g.ctx? b ∧
    ((g.onX a = true ∧ g.onX b = true) ∨ (g.onD a = true ∧ g.onD b = true)) ∧
    (g.isWrite a = true ∨ g.isWrite b = true)

/-- Race on a pair (brief; WC5.1 corrigé C33): a conflict with a non-atomic member, without `hb`
in either direction. -/
def RaceOn (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  Conflict g a b ∧ (g.isAtomic a = false ∨ g.isAtomic b = false) ∧ ¬ HB g a b ∧ ¬ HB g b a

/-- The graph has a race. -/
def Racy (g : Graph) : Prop := ∃ a ∈ List.range g.size, ∃ b ∈ List.range g.size, RaceOn g a b

/-- Decidability of `Conflict`. -/
instance (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Decidable (Conflict g a b) := by
  unfold Conflict; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of `RaceOn`. -/
instance (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Decidable (RaceOn g a b) := by unfold RaceOn; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of `Racy`. -/
instance (g : Graph) : Decidable (Racy g) := by unfold Racy; infer_instance

end Ern.Concurrency.EventModel

source. -/
def RfWF (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  (∀ w ∈ List.range g.size, ∀ r ∈ List.range g.size, RF g w r →
      g.isMod w = true ∧ g.isReadX r = true ∧ g.valW w = g.valR r) ∧
    ∀ r ∈ List.range g.size, g.isReadX r = true →
      ∃ w ∈ List.range g.size, RF g w r ∧ ∀ w' ∈ List.range g.size, RF g w' r → w' = w

/-- Conjunct 2 (brief; WC5.1 corrigé C31): `mo` is a strict total order on the modifications of
`x`, the initial write included. -/
def MoTotal (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  (∀ a ∈ List.range g.size, ∀ b ∈ List.range g.size, MO g a b →
      g.isMod a = true ∧ g.isMod b = true) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range g.size, ¬ MO g a a) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range g.size, ∀ b ∈ List.range g.size, ∀ c ∈ List.range g.size,
      MO g a b → MO g b c → MO g a c) ∧
    ∀ a ∈ List.range g.size, ∀ b ∈ List.range g.size, g.isMod a = true → g.isMod b = true →
      a ≠ b → MO g a b ∨ MO g b a

/-- Conjunct 3, atomicity of the RMWs (brief; WC5.1 corrigé C31): the `rf` source of a successful
RMW is its immediate predecessor in `mo`. -/
def RmwAtomic (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  ∀ m ∈ List.range g.size, g.isRMW m = true → ∀ w ∈ List.range g.size, RF g w m →
    MO g w m ∧ ∀ c ∈ List.range g.size, ¬ (MO g w c ∧ MO g c m)

/-- Conjunct 4, coherence (brief): `hb ; eco?` is irreflexive. -/
def Coherent (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ List.range g.size, ¬ HB g a a ∧ ∀ b ∈ List.range g.size, HB g a b → ¬ ECO g b a

/-- Conjunct 5 (brief): `hb` is irreflexive. -/
def HbIrrefl (g : Graph) : Prop := ∀ a ∈ List.range g.size, ¬ HB g a a

/-- `EventConsistent` (brief; WC5.1 corrigé C31, C33): the five conjuncts. -/
def EventConsistent (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  RfWF g ∧ MoTotal g ∧ RmwAtomic g ∧ Coherent g ∧ HbIrrefl g

/-- Decidability of `RfWF`. -/
instance (g : Graph) : Decidable (RfWF g) := by unfold RfWF; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of `MoTotal`. -/
instance (g : Graph) : Decidable (MoTotal g) := by unfold MoTotal; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of `RmwAtomic`. -/
instance (g : Graph) : Decidable (RmwAtomic g) := by unfold RmwAtomic; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of `Coherent`. -/
instance (g : Graph) : Decidable (Coherent g) := by unfold Coherent; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of `HbIrrefl`. -/
instance (g : Graph) : Decidable (HbIrrefl g) := by unfold HbIrrefl; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of `EventConsistent`. -/
instance (g : Graph) : Decidable (EventConsistent g) := by
  unfold EventConsistent; infer_instance

/-! ## Conflicts and races -/

/-- Conflict (brief; WC5.1 corrigé C30): two events of distinct contexts on the same location,
one of them at least a write or a modification. The initial write has no context and is in no
conflict. -/
def Conflict (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  g.ctx? a ≠ none ∧ g.ctx? b ≠ none ∧ g.ctx? a ≠ g.ctx? b ∧
    ((g.onX a = true ∧ g.onX b = true) ∨ (g.onD a = true ∧ g.onD b = true)) ∧
    (g.isWrite a = true ∨ g.isWrite b = true)

/-- Race on a pair (brief; WC5.1 corrigé C33): a conflict with a non-atomic member, without `hb`
in either direction. -/
def RaceOn (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  Conflict g a b ∧ (g.isAtomic a = false ∨ g.isAtomic b = false) ∧ ¬ HB g a b ∧ ¬ HB g b a

/-- The graph has a race. -/
def Racy (g : Graph) : Prop := ∃ a ∈ List.range g.size, ∃ b ∈ List.range g.size, RaceOn g a b

/-- Decidability of `Conflict`. -/
instance (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Decidable (Conflict g a b) := by
  unfold Conflict; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of `RaceOn`. -/
instance (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Decidable (RaceOn g a b) := by unfold RaceOn; infer_instance
/-- Decidability of `Racy`. -/
instance (g : Graph) : Decidable (Racy g) := by unfold Racy; infer_instance

end Ern.Concurrency.EventModel

/-!
# Witnesses of the event fragment

Brief of milestone 4, slice 2 (layer E), task 3 (`formal/reports/spec2-m4-eventmodel.md`): the
graphs G1 to G19, given explicitly with their events, `rf` and `mo`; facts written from the brief
(WC5.1 corrigé), decided by `decide`. Event `0` is the initial write `init`, of value `0`; events
`1, 2, …` follow the listing of the brief; contexts `c0` and `c1` are `0` and `1`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Ern.Concurrency.EventModel

/-- The strict total order that lists its elements in this order: every pair `(a, b)` with `a`
before `b`. -/
def chain : List Nat → List (Nat × Nat)
  | [] => []
  | a :: l => l.map (fun b => (a, b)) ++ chain l

/-- No `sw` edge in the graph. -/
def NoSW (g : Graph) : Prop := ∀ a ∈ List.range g.size, ∀ b ∈ List.range g.size, ¬ SW g a b

/-- Decidability of `NoSW`. -/
instance (g : Graph) : Decidable (NoSW g) := by unfold NoSW; infer_instance

/-! ## Message passing (WC5.1 corrigé C32 item 1, C33, C40) -/

/-- Message passing: `c0` : `a = write3(d)` (1), `b = writeShared(x, 1, ob)` (2); `c1` :
`e = readShared(x, oe)` (3) reading `1` from `b`, `g = read3(d)` (4); `mo` : `init < b`. -/
def mp (ob oe : MOrd) : Graph :=
  { init := 0,
    evs := [⟨0, .writeD⟩, ⟨0, .wsh ob 1⟩, ⟨1, .rsh oe 1⟩, ⟨1, .readD⟩],
    rf := [(2, 3)], mo := chain [0, 2] }

/-- G1 (brief): `b` in `release`, `e` in `acquire`: well typed, consistent, `sw(b, e)`,
`hb(a, g)`, no race. -/
theorem G1 : WellTyped (mp .rel .acq) ∧ EventConsistent (mp .rel .acq) ∧ SW (mp .rel .acq) 2 3 ∧
    HB (mp .rel .acq) 1 4 ∧ ¬ Racy (mp .rel .acq) := by
  decide

/-- G2 graph: as G1, but `e` reads `0` from `init` and there is no `g`. -/
def g2 : Graph :=
  { init := 0, evs := [⟨0, .writeD⟩, ⟨0, .wsh .rel 1⟩, ⟨1, .rsh .acq 0⟩],
    rf := [(0, 3)], mo := chain [0, 2] }

/-- G2 (brief): well typed, consistent, no `sw` edge, no race. -/
theorem G2 : WellTyped g2 ∧ EventConsistent g2 ∧ NoSW g2 ∧ ¬ Racy g2 := by decide

/-- G3 (brief): `relaxed`, `relaxed`: well typed, consistent, no `sw`, race `(a, g)`. -/
theorem G3 : WellTyped (mp .rlx .rlx) ∧ EventConsistent (mp .rlx .rlx) ∧ NoSW (mp .rlx .rlx) ∧
    RaceOn (mp .rlx .rlx) 1 4 := by
  decide

/-- G4 (brief): `release`, `relaxed`: well typed, consistent, no `sw`, race `(a, g)`. -/
theorem G4 : WellTyped (mp .rel .rlx) ∧ EventConsistent (mp .rel .rlx) ∧ NoSW (mp .rel .rlx) ∧
    RaceOn (mp .rel .rlx) 1 4 := by
  decide

/-- G5 (brief): `relaxed`, `acquire`: well typed, consistent, no `sw`, race `(a, g)`. -/
theorem G5 : WellTyped (mp .rlx .acq) ∧ EventConsistent (mp .rlx .acq) ∧ NoSW (mp .rlx .acq) ∧
    RaceOn (mp .rlx .acq) 1 4 := by
  decide

/-- G6 (brief): `seq_cst`, `seq_cst`, only in their release and acquire roles (WC5.1 corrigé C40):
well typed, consistent, `sw(b, e)`, no race. -/
theorem G6 : WellTyped (mp .sc .sc) ∧ EventConsistent (mp .sc .sc) ∧ SW (mp .sc .sc) 2 3 ∧
    ¬ Racy (mp .sc .sc) := by
  decide

/-! ## Mixed accesses (WC5.1 corrigé C30, C31, C33, C36, C42) -/

/-- G7 graph: `c0` : `s = writeShared(x, 1, relaxed)` (1); `c1` : `r = read3(x)` (2) reading `0`
from `init`; `mo` : `init < s`. -/
import Ern.Concurrency.EventModel.Graph

/-!
# General lemmas of the event fragment

Brief of milestone 4, slice 2 (layer E), task 2 (`formal/reports/spec2-m4-eventmodel.md`): six
statements for every graph, with no hypothesis on its shape. Each docstring names the conjuncts of
`EventConsistent` that the proof uses.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Ern.Concurrency.EventModel

/-- Brief, task 2: conjunct 5 follows from conjunct 4. -/
theorem hbIrrefl_of_coherent {g : Graph} (h : Coherent g) : HbIrrefl g :=
  fun a ha => (h a ha).1

/-- A successful RMW is a modification of `x` (WC5.1 corrigé C31). -/
theorem isMod_of_isRMW {g : Graph} {m : Nat} (h : g.isRMW m = true) : g.isMod m = true := by
  unfold Graph.isRMW at h
  unfold Graph.isMod
  cases hk : g.kind? m with
  | none => rw [hk] at h; cases h
  | some k => cases k <;> rw [hk] at h <;> first | exact Bool.or_true _ | cases h

/-- Brief, task 2: in a consistent graph, the initial write is minimal for `mo`. Uses conjunct 2
(irreflexivity of `mo`) and conjunct 4 (coherence), with the convention that the initial write is
`hb`-before every other event. -/
theorem init_mo_minimal {g : Graph} (h : EventConsistent g) (m : Nat) : ¬ MO g m 0 := by
  intro hm
  obtain ⟨-, ⟨-, hirr, -⟩, -, hcoh, -⟩ := h
  have hlt : m < g.size := hm.2.1
  have h0 : 0 < g.size := hm.2.2
  have hne : m ≠ 0 := fun he => by subst he; exact hirr 0 (List.mem_range.2 h0) hm
  have hhb : HB g 0 m := Or.inr ⟨rfl, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hne, hlt⟩
  exact (hcoh 0 (List.mem_range.2 h0)).2 m (List.mem_range.2 hlt) hhb
    (.single (Or.inr (Or.inl hm)))

/-- Brief, task 2: in a consistent graph, no read reads a modification that follows it in `hb`.
Uses conjunct 4 (coherence) only. -/
theorem rf_not_hb_later {g : Graph} (h : EventConsistent g) {w r : Nat} (hrf : RF g w r) :
    ¬ HB g r w := by
  intro hhb
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hcoh, -⟩ := h
  exact (hcoh r (List.mem_range.2 hrf.2.2)).2 w (List.mem_range.2 hrf.2.1) hhb
    (.single (Or.inl hrf))

/-- Brief, task 2: in a consistent graph, two distinct successful RMWs do not read the same
modification, whatever their orders (WC5.1 corrigé C31). Uses conjunct 2 (totality of `mo`) and
conjunct 3 (atomicity of the RMWs). -/
theorem rmw_sources_distinct {g : Graph} (h : EventConsistent g) {w m₁ m₂ : Nat}
    (h₁ : g.isRMW m₁ = true) (h₂ : g.isRMW m₂ = true) (hne : m₁ ≠ m₂) (hr₁ : RF g w m₁)
    (hr₂ : RF g w m₂) : False := by
  obtain ⟨-, ⟨-, -, -, htot⟩, hat, -, -⟩ := h
  have hw : w ∈ List.range g.size := List.mem_range.2 hr₁.2.1
  have hm₁ : m₁ ∈ List.range g.size := List.mem_range.2 hr₁.2.2
  have hm₂ : m₂ ∈ List.range g.size := List.mem_range.2 hr₂.2.2
  obtain ⟨hw₁, himm₁⟩ := hat m₁ hm₁ h₁ w hw hr₁
  obtain ⟨hw₂, himm₂⟩ := hat m₂ hm₂ h₂ w hw hr₂
  rcases htot m₁ hm₁ m₂ hm₂ (isMod_of_isRMW h₁) (isMod_of_isRMW h₂) hne with h12 | h21
  · exact himm₂ m₁ hm₁ ⟨hw₁, h12⟩
  · exact himm₁ m₂ hm₂ ⟨hw₂, h21⟩

/-- Brief, task 2: two atomic events are never in a race (WC5.1 corrigé C33 item 3). -/
theorem atomic_no_race {g : Graph} {a b : Nat} (ha : g.isAtomic a = true)
    (hb : g.isAtomic b = true) : ¬ RaceOn g a b := by
  rintro ⟨-, h | h, -⟩
  · rw [ha] at h; cases h
  · rw [hb] at h; cases h

/-- Brief, task 2: a conflicting pair ordered by `hb` is not in a race (WC5.1 corrigé C33
item 4). -/
theorem hb_no_race {g : Graph} {a b : Nat} (h : HB g a b ∨ HB g b a) : ¬ RaceOn g a b := by
  rintro ⟨-, -, hab, hba⟩
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact hab h
  · exact hba h

end Ern.Concurrency.EventModel

import Ern.Concurrency.Encap5C

/-!
# Exclusion extended to the rights over places

Brief of milestone 4, "étendre l'exclusion aux droits sur les places". `ChainExcl`
(`Ern.Concurrency.Encap5C`) reads the authority argument of `derive`, `split`, `read`, `write` and
`writeShared`; it does not read the right over a place (`HasRight`, Spec 1 §43) of the other
operations, and W-GS (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` v6 §2 sexies) writes the protected data without the lock
through such a right. `PlaceExcl` requires the right premises of the preconditions to hold without
a live `guarded` on the holder chain (`HasRight5`). It is a proposition of the brief, tested here
and not decided; the existing definitions, `ChainExcl` and `Encap5C` included, are unchanged.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Rights over places without a live `guarded` -/

/-- `HasRight(s, m, q)` (Spec 1 §43) read from the current frame of `c`, with `Exer5` in place of
`ExercisableAt` (brief of milestone 4, task 2): some authority exercisable by a holder chain without
a live `guarded` has, over every leaf of `q`'s footprint, an effective mode permitting `m`. -/
def HasRight5 (st : SC × SyncReg) (c : Nat) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ a ∈ List.range st.1.A.length, Exer5 st.1 st.2 c a m ∧
    ∀ l ∈ footprint st.1.P q, Allows (effective st.1.flat a l) m

/-- Decidability of `HasRight5`. -/
instance (st : SC × SyncReg) (c : Nat) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Decidable (HasRight5 st c m q) := by
  unfold HasRight5; infer_instance

/-- `HolderRight` (Spec 1 §62.2) with `HasRight5` in its place case. -/
def HolderRight5 (st : SC × SyncReg) (c : Nat) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame _ => True
  | .place p => HasRight5 st c .modify p

/-- Decidability of `HolderRight5`. -/
instance (st : SC × SyncReg) (c : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderRight5 st c h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderRight5 <;> infer_instance

/-- `CtrlRight` (WC5 C14.3, read with the access condition of Spec 1 §68.2) from the current frame
of `c`, with `Exer5` in place of `ExercisableAt`. -/
def CtrlRight5 (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) (e : SyncEntry) (c : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (ControlOf L st.1 e) (fun ctl => ∃ a ∈ List.range st.1.A.length,
    Exer5 st.1 st.2 c a .observe ∧ effective st.1.flat a ctl ≠ none) False

/-- Decidability of `CtrlRight5`. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) (e : SyncEntry) (c : Nat) :
    Decidable (CtrlRight5 L st e c) := by
  unfold CtrlRight5; infer_instance

/-- `MetaRight` (Spec 1 §36, §77.1, §78.1) with `HasRight5` over the arena value, when the arena
value exists. -/
def MetaRight5 (st : SC × SyncReg) (c : Nat) (E : Arena.ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  OptP (Arena.arenaValue st.1.flat E) (fun v => HasRight5 st c .modify v) True

/-- Decidability of `MetaRight5`. -/
instance (st : SC × SyncReg) (c : Nat) (E : Arena.ArenaEntry) : Decidable (MetaRight5 st c E) := by
  unfold MetaRight5; infer_instance

/-- The right premise of each transfer phase of the by-value composite (WC5 C5.2, C5 item 1, Spec 1
§63.1: `ValTransferPre.srcRight`) as `HasRight5`, each on the state produced by the earlier
transfers, in the declared order. -/
def ValRights5 (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) : SC → List (Nat × Nat) → Prop
  | _, [] => True
  | t, v :: vs => HasRight5 (t, reg) c .modify v.1 ∧ ValRights5 reg c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs

/-- Decidability of `ValRights5`. -/
instance instDecidableValRights5 (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) :
    (t : SC) → (vs : List (Nat × Nat)) → Decidable (ValRights5 reg c t vs)
  | _, [] => isTrue trivial
  | t, v :: vs =>
    haveI := instDecidableValRights5 reg c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs
    inferInstanceAs (Decidable (HasRight5 (t, reg) c .modify v.1 ∧ _))

/-! ## The extended exclusion -/

/-- `PlaceExcl` (brief of milestone 4, task 2): each right premise over a place of the precondition
holds as `HasRight5` on the same place, in the state where the premise is read:
`release` (Spec 1 §62.2, place-held case), `transfer` (§63.1, source and destination), `depend`
(§64), `store` (§65.2 before, §65.5 in the resulting state), `endUse` (§69), `free` (§70), `alloc`
(§71.2 provider, with the `writeShared` branch of §68 exercised by `Exer5`; §71.3 owner), `pin`
(§74), `unpin` (§75); `issue` and `reset`, `MetaRight` over the arena value (§36, §77.1, §78.1);
`spawnVal`, the source right of each transfer phase (WC5 C5.2); `acquire`, the controller access of
WC5 C14.3 (`CtrlRight5`). The other labels are unconstrained. -/
def PlaceExcl (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) : Label → Prop
  | .kernel c (.release a) =>
      OptP (st.1.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight5 (st.1, st.2.1) c y.holder) True
  | .kernel c (.transfer src dst) =>
      HasRight5 (st.1, st.2.1) c .modify src ∧ HasRight5 (st.1, st.2.1) c .modify dst
  | .kernel c (.depend q _) => HasRight5 (st.1, st.2.1) c .modify q
  | .kernel c (.store a p) =>
      HasRight5 (st.1, st.2.1) c .modify p ∧ HasRight5 (storeEffC st.1 c a p, st.2.1) c .modify p
  | .kernel c (.endUse p) => HasRight5 (st.1, st.2.1) c .modify p
  | .kernel c (.free p _) => HasRight5 (st.1, st.2.1) c .modify p
  | .kernel c (.alloc pr ow _) =>
      (HasRight5 (st.1, st.2.1) c .modify pr ∨ ∃ via ∈ List.range st.1.A.length,
        WriteSharedPre k (st.1.view c) via (footprint st.1.P pr) ∧
          Exer5 st.1 st.2.1 c via .observe) ∧
      HasRight5 (st.1, st.2.1) c .modify ow
  | .kernel c (.pin p) => HasRight5 (st.1, st.2.1) c .modify p
  | .kernel c (.unpin o) =>
      OptP (st.1.pins[o]?) (fun ob => HasRight5 (st.1, st.2.1) c .modify ob.place) True
  | .spawnVal c _ ls vs => ValRights5 st.2.1 c (spawnCreate st.1 c ls) vs
  | .acquire c i => OptP (st.2.1[i]?) (fun e => CtrlRight5 L (st.1, st.2.1) e c) True
  | .issue c i _ _ => OptP (st.2.2[i]?) (fun E => MetaRight5 (st.1, st.2.1) c E) True
  | .reset c i => OptP (st.2.2[i]?) (fun E => MetaRight5 (st.1, st.2.1) c E) True
  | _ => True

/-- Decidability of `PlaceExcl`. -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg)
    (lbl : Label) : Decidable (PlaceExcl k L st lbl) := by
  unfold PlaceExcl; split <;> infer_instance

/-- `Encap5R` (brief of milestone 4, task 2): `Encap5C` and `PlaceExcl`. -/
def Encap5R (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbl : Label) : Prop :=
  Encap5C L (st.1, st.2.1) lbl ∧ PlaceExcl k L st lbl

/-- `EncapsulatedTrace5R`: a run every step of which satisfies `Encap5R` in the state where it is
taken. -/
inductive EncapsulatedTrace5R (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) :
    SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg → Prop where
  | nil {st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} : EncapsulatedTrace5R k L st [] st
  | cons {st st₁ st₂ : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbl : Label} {lbls : List Label} :
      Encap5R k L st lbl → LStep k L lbl st st₁ →
      EncapsulatedTrace5R k L st₁ lbls st₂ → EncapsulatedTrace5R k L st (lbl :: lbls) st₂

/-- Every `EncapsulatedTrace5R` is an `EncapsulatedTrace5C`: `cap5_compat`, `cap5_drop_own` (through
`encapsulatedTrace5C_imp`), `cap5_sound_C` and `handoff_loss_exists_C` (through `run5C_of_trace`)
apply to it. -/
theorem encapsulatedTrace5R_imp {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (h : EncapsulatedTrace5R k L st lbls st') :
    EncapsulatedTrace5C k L st lbls st' := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | cons he hs _ ih => exact .cons he.1 hs ih

/-- An `EncapsulatedTrace5R` extended by one step satisfying `Encap5R`. -/
theorem EncapsulatedTrace5R.snoc {k : K} {L : MutexLayout}
    {st st' st'' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbls : List Label} {lbl : Label}

import Ern.Concurrency.CapDrop

/-!
# Test of a corrected `GuardedExcl`

`GuardedExcl` (brief of milestone 4, task 3) excludes the steps whose authority argument is a live
`guarded`; the third clause of Spec 1 §43 is recursive along the holder chain, and an authority
stored in the protected storage is exercisable through `guarded` (`Corpus/GuardedChain.lean`).
This module tests the correction proposed in `formal/reports/spec2-m4-handoff.md`: the authority
argument of `derive`, `split`, `read`, `write` and `writeShared` must be exercisable from the
current frame by a holder chain that contains no live `guarded` (`Exer5`). It is a proposition of
the report, absent from WC5 and from the brief, tested here and not decided. Beside it, the
definitions of the brief (`GuardedExcl`, `Encap5`, `EncapsulatedTrace5`) are unchanged.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Exercise without a live `guarded` -/

/-- `ExercisableAt` (Spec 1 §43) read from the current frame of `c`, by a holder chain none of whose
authorities is the `guarded` of a live entry of `reg` (WC4 C12). -/
inductive Exer5 (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) : Nat → Mode → Prop where
  | base {a : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : NotGuarded s reg a → s.A[a]? = some y →
      y.active = true → m.le y.mode → y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top → Exer5 s reg c a m
  | held {a p b : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : NotGuarded s reg a → s.A[a]? = some y →
      y.active = true → m.le y.mode → y.holder = .place p → Exer5 s reg c b m →
      (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s.flat b l) m) → Exer5 s reg c a m

/-- One step of `Exer5 · m` read on a Boolean premise (decision procedure, on the pattern of `exR`,
Spec 1 §43). -/
def exer5R (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) (m : Mode) (E : Nat → Bool) (a : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (NotGuarded s reg a) && match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => y.active && decide (m.le y.mode) && match y.holder with
    | .frame f => decide (f = (s.view c).top)
    | .place p => (List.range s.A.length).any fun b =>
        decide (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s.flat b l) m) && E b
  | none => false

/-- `exer5R` is a bounded monotone rule. -/
theorem exer5R_rule (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) (m : Mode) :
    KRule s.A.length (exer5R s reg c m) where
  mono p q hpq a h := by
    unfold exer5R at h ⊢
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h ⊢
    refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩
    have h2 := h.2
    split at h2
    · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h2 ⊢
      refine ⟨h2.1, ?_⟩; split at h2
      · simpa using h2.2
      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.any_eq_true] at h2 ⊢
        obtain ⟨b, hb, hc, he⟩ := h2.2
        exact ⟨b, hb, hc, hpq b he⟩
    · exact h2
  bound p a h := by
    unfold exer5R at h
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h
    have h2 := h.2
    split at h2
    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
    · cases h2
  loc p q hpq a := by
    unfold exer5R; congr 1; split
    · congr 1; split
      · rfl
      · exact any_congr' fun b hb => by rw [hpq b (List.mem_range.1 hb)]
    · rfl

/-- Soundness of the iteration for `Exer5`. -/
theorem exer5_of_kiter (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) (m : Mode) :
    ∀ k a, kiter (exer5R s reg c m) k a = true → Exer5 s reg c a m
  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
  | k + 1, a, h => by
    simp only [kiter, exer5R, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
    obtain ⟨hg, h⟩ := h
    split at h
    · rename_i y hy
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨ha, hm⟩, h⟩ := h
      split at h
      · rename_i f hf; exact .base hg hy ha hm (by simp at h; rw [hf, h])
      · rename_i p hp
        simp only [List.any_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
        obtain ⟨b, -, hc, hb⟩ := h
        exact .held hg hy ha hm hp (exer5_of_kiter s reg c m k b hb) hc
    · cases h

/-- The frame-held case of `exer5R`. -/
theorem exer5R_base {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a : Nat}
    {y : Authority} (hg : NotGuarded s reg a) (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true)
    (hm : m.le y.mode) (hf : y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top) : exer5R s reg c m E a = true := by
  simp only [exer5R, hy, ha, hf, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  exact ⟨hg, hm, trivial⟩

/-- The place-held case of `exer5R`. -/
theorem exer5R_held {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a p b : Nat}
    {y : Authority} (hg : NotGuarded s reg a) (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true)
    (hm : m.le y.mode) (hp : y.holder = .place p) (hb : b < s.A.length)
    (hc : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s.flat b l) m) (hE : E b = true) :
    exer5R s reg c m E a = true := by
  simp only [exer5R, hy, ha, hp, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
    List.any_eq_true, List.mem_range]
  exact ⟨hg, hm, b, hb, hc, hE⟩

/-- `Exer5` is computed by `|A| + 1` steps of `exer5R`. -/
theorem exer5_iff {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c a : Nat} {m : Mode} :
    Exer5 s reg c a m ↔ kiter (exer5R s reg c m) (s.A.length + 1) a = true := by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, exer5_of_kiter s reg c m _ a⟩
  induction h with
  | base hg hy ha hm hf => exact exer5R_base hg hy ha hm hf
  | held hg hy ha hm hp _ hc ih =>
    rw [← kiter_fix (exer5R_rule s reg c _)]
    exact exer5R_held hg hy ha hm hp (kiter_bound (exer5R_rule s reg c _) _ _ ih) hc ih

/-- Decidability of `Exer5`. -/
instance (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c a : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (Exer5 s reg c a m) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ exer5_iff.symm

/-- An authority exercisable without a live `guarded` from the current frame of a context with a
nonempty stack is attributable to that context without a live `guarded` (WC5 C43). -/
theorem Exer5.attr5 {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c a : Nat} {m : Mode} (hne : s.stk c ≠ [])
    (h : Exer5 s reg c a m) : Attr5 s reg c a m := by
  induction h with
  | base hg hy ha hm hf => exact .base hg hy ha hm hf (view_top_mem hne)
  | held hg hy ha hm hp _ hc ih => exact .held hg hy ha hm hp ih hc

/-- The argument of an `Exer5` is not a live `guarded`. -/
theorem Exer5.notGuarded {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c a : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : Exer5 s reg c a m) :
    NotGuarded s reg a := by
  cases h with
  | base hg => exact hg
  | held hg => exact hg

/-- `ChainExcl` (correction proposed in `formal/reports/spec2-m4-handoff.md`, tested here): the
authority argument of `derive` (Spec 1 §60.1), `split` (§61.1), `read` (§66.2), `write` (§67.1) and
`writeShared` (§68.2) is exercisable, in the mode the precondition requires, from the current
frame of the executing context by a holder chain without a live `guarded` (`Exer5`). -/
def ChainExcl (st : SC × SyncReg) : Label → Prop
  | .kernel c (.derive a _ m) => Exer5 st.1 st.2 c a m
  | .kernel c (.split a _) => Exer5 st.1 st.2 c a .modify
  | .kernel c (.read a _) => Exer5 st.1 st.2 c a .observe
  | .kernel c (.write a _) => Exer5 st.1 st.2 c a .modify
  | .kernel c (.writeShared a _) => Exer5 st.1 st.2 c a .observe
  | _ => True

/-- Decidability of `ChainExcl`. -/
instance (st : SC × SyncReg) (lbl : Label) : Decidable (ChainExcl st lbl) := by
  unfold ChainExcl; split <;> infer_instance

/-- `Encap5C`: `Encap5` with `ChainExcl` in place of `GuardedExcl`. -/
def Encap5C (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) (lbl : Label) : Prop :=
  Encap L st lbl ∧ ChainExcl st lbl ∧ CtlExcl L st lbl

/-- `ChainExcl` implies `GuardedExcl`: the argument of an `Exer5` is not a live `guarded`. -/
theorem chainExcl_guardedExcl {st : SC × SyncReg} {lbl : Label} (h : ChainExcl st lbl) :
    GuardedExcl st lbl := by
  cases lbl with
  | kernel c op =>
    cases op <;> simp only [ChainExcl, GuardedExcl] at h ⊢ <;>

  | _ => trivial

taken. -/
inductive EncapsulatedTrace5C (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) :
    SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg → Prop where

/-!
# Test of a corrected `GuardedExcl`

`GuardedExcl` (brief of milestone 4, task 3) excludes the steps whose authority argument is a live
`guarded`; the third clause of Spec 1 §43 is recursive along the holder chain, and an authority
stored in the protected storage is exercisable through `guarded` (`Corpus/GuardedChain.lean`).
This module tests the correction proposed in `formal/reports/spec2-m4-handoff.md`: the authority
argument of `derive`, `split`, `read`, `write` and `writeShared` must be exercisable from the
current frame by a holder chain that contains no live `guarded` (`Exer5`). It is a proposition of
the report, absent from WC5 and from the brief, tested here and not decided. Beside it, the
definitions of the brief (`GuardedExcl`, `Encap5`, `EncapsulatedTrace5`) are unchanged.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Exercise without a live `guarded` -/

/-- `ExercisableAt` (Spec 1 §43) read from the current frame of `c`, by a holder chain none of whose
authorities is the `guarded` of a live entry of `reg` (WC4 C12). -/
inductive Exer5 (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) : Nat → Mode → Prop where
  | base {a : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : NotGuarded s reg a → s.A[a]? = some y →
      y.active = true → m.le y.mode → y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top → Exer5 s reg c a m
  | held {a p b : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : NotGuarded s reg a → s.A[a]? = some y →
      y.active = true → m.le y.mode → y.holder = .place p → Exer5 s reg c b m →
      (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s.flat b l) m) → Exer5 s reg c a m

/-- One step of `Exer5 · m` read on a Boolean premise (decision procedure, on the pattern of `exR`,
Spec 1 §43). -/
def exer5R (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) (m : Mode) (E : Nat → Bool) (a : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (NotGuarded s reg a) && match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => y.active && decide (m.le y.mode) && match y.holder with
    | .frame f => decide (f = (s.view c).top)
    | .place p => (List.range s.A.length).any fun b =>
        decide (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s.flat b l) m) && E b
  | none => false

/-- `exer5R` is a bounded monotone rule. -/
theorem exer5R_rule (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) (m : Mode) :
    KRule s.A.length (exer5R s reg c m) where
  mono p q hpq a h := by
    unfold exer5R at h ⊢
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h ⊢
    refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩
    have h2 := h.2
    split at h2
    · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h2 ⊢
      refine ⟨h2.1, ?_⟩; split at h2
      · simpa using h2.2
      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.any_eq_true] at h2 ⊢
        obtain ⟨b, hb, hc, he⟩ := h2.2
        exact ⟨b, hb, hc, hpq b he⟩
    · exact h2
  bound p a h := by
    unfold exer5R at h
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h
    have h2 := h.2
    split at h2
    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
    · cases h2
  loc p q hpq a := by
    unfold exer5R; congr 1; split
    · congr 1; split
      · rfl
      · exact any_congr' fun b hb => by rw [hpq b (List.mem_range.1 hb)]
    · rfl

/-- Soundness of the iteration for `Exer5`. -/
theorem exer5_of_kiter (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) (m : Mode) :
    ∀ k a, kiter (exer5R s reg c m) k a = true → Exer5 s reg c a m
  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
  | k + 1, a, h => by
    simp only [kiter, exer5R, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
    obtain ⟨hg, h⟩ := h
    split at h
    · rename_i y hy
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨ha, hm⟩, h⟩ := h
      split at h
      · rename_i f hf; exact .base hg hy ha hm (by simp at h; rw [hf, h])
      · rename_i p hp
        simp only [List.any_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
        obtain ⟨b, -, hc, hb⟩ := h
        exact .held hg hy ha hm hp (exer5_of_kiter s reg c m k b hb) hc
    · cases h

/-- The frame-held case of `exer5R`. -/
theorem exer5R_base {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a : Nat}
    {y : Authority} (hg : NotGuarded s reg a) (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true)
    (hm : m.le y.mode) (hf : y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top) : exer5R s reg c m E a = true := by
  simp only [exer5R, hy, ha, hf, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  exact ⟨hg, hm, trivial⟩

/-- The place-held case of `exer5R`. -/
theorem exer5R_held {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a p b : Nat}
    {y : Authority} (hg : NotGuarded s reg a) (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true)
    (hm : m.le y.mode) (hp : y.holder = .place p) (hb : b < s.A.length)
    (hc : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s.flat b l) m) (hE : E b = true) :
    exer5R s reg c m E a = true := by
  simp only [exer5R, hy, ha, hp, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
    List.any_eq_true, List.mem_range]
  exact ⟨hg, hm, b, hb, hc, hE⟩

/-- `Exer5` is computed by `|A| + 1` steps of `exer5R`. -/
theorem exer5_iff {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c a : Nat} {m : Mode} :
    Exer5 s reg c a m ↔ kiter (exer5R s reg c m) (s.A.length + 1) a = true := by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, exer5_of_kiter s reg c m _ a⟩
  induction h with
  | base hg hy ha hm hf => exact exer5R_base hg hy ha hm hf
  | held hg hy ha hm hp _ hc ih =>
    rw [← kiter_fix (exer5R_rule s reg c _)]
    exact exer5R_held hg hy ha hm hp (kiter_bound (exer5R_rule s reg c _) _ _ ih) hc ih

/-- Decidability of `Exer5`. -/
instance (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c a : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (Exer5 s reg c a m) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ exer5_iff.symm

nonempty stack is attributable to that context without a live `guarded` (WC5 C43). -/

    (h : Exer5 s reg c a m) : Attr5 s reg c a m := by

theorem Exer5.notGuarded {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c a : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : Exer5 s reg c a m) :
