import Ern.Concurrency.Events
import Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.MX

/-!
# Interventions on the controller between `unlock` and `acquire`

`corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies: the common prefix P from `MX₄` and the witnesses W-RL₀, W-RL,
W-RL-J, W-TR and W-TR-J, at the level of the authority machine. One theorem per group of verdicts,
written from `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies, preconditions by `decide`, contract `KM`. Each
trace is given with its named states and is a `Run5R` from the initial state of Spec 1 §47.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.MutexEdge

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency Ern.Concurrency.Corpus
open Ern.Concurrency.Traces (L0)

/-! ## The prefix P -/

/-- P, step 4, `c1 : release(o1)` (O3), context 1 staying live. -/
def p4 : SC := x7.set (releaseEff (x7.view 1) 4)

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies, prefix P from `MX₄`: step 1 `c1 : acquire(e)` `ok` (WC5.1
C16), step 2 `c1 : write3(T)` via `g` `ok` (O10), step 3 `c1 : unlock(e)` `ok` (WC5.1 C17),
step 4 `c1 : release(o1)` `ok` (O3.1–O3.3: `o1` is active, derived, held by the current frame of
context 1, without an active descendant). -/
theorem P_ok : AcquireOk KM L0 x4 regX 1 0 (x5, regG) ∧ opStepC KM (.write 5 [3]) 1 x5 (.ok x6) ∧
    UnlockOk L0 x6 regG 1 0 (x7, regX) ∧ opStepC KM (.release 4) 1 x7 (.ok p4) :=
  ⟨S2_1_ok, S2_2_ok, S2_3_ok, ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩⟩

/-- After P, `root_M` has effective `Modify` again on `slot` and `lock` (Spec 1 §43.2; §62
effect), and `ControlOf(e)` is `lock`. -/
theorem P_facts : effective p4.flat 0 1 = some .modify ∧ effective p4.flat 0 2 = some .modify ∧
    ControlOf L0 p4 ⟨3, none⟩ = some 2 := by decide

/-- The labels of block MX up to `MX₄` and of the prefix P. -/
def pLbls : List Label :=
  [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 3 1), .newMutex 0 3,
   .kernel 0 (.derive 0 [1, 2] .observe), .spawn 0 [4] [], .acquire 1 0, .kernel 1 (.write 5 [3]),
   .unlock 1 0, .kernel 1 (.release 4)]

/-- The setup and the prefix P from the initial state, each step admitted by `Encap5R`, followed
by any run from the state after P. -/
theorem prefix_steps {sts : List (SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg)} {lbls : List Label}
    (h : Steps5R KM L0 ((p4, regX, []) :: sts) lbls) :
    Steps5R KM L0 ((x0, [], []) :: (x1, [], []) :: (x2, [], []) :: (x2, regX, []) ::
      (x3, regX, []) :: (x4, regX, []) :: (x5, regG, []) :: (x6, regG, []) :: (x7, regX, []) ::
      (p4, regX, []) :: sts) (pLbls ++ lbls) :=
  .cons ⟨⟨(fun e he => by cases he), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel mx_steps.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel mx_steps.2.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.newMutex mx_steps.2.2.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨(by decide : ∀ e ∈ regX, e.Live x2 → 0 ≠ e.guarded), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
    (.kernel mx_steps.2.2.2.2.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.spawn mx_steps.2.2.2.2.2) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.acquire P_ok.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, by decide, by decide⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel P_ok.2.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.unlock P_ok.2.2.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel P_ok.2.2.2) h

/-! ## W-RL₀ -/

/-- W-RL₀, `c0 : acquire(e)`: grant `g′`, authority `6`, held by frame 0 (WC5.1 C16). -/
def r0a : SC := deriveSyncEff p4 0 3
/-- W-RL₀, `c0 : write3(T)` via `g′` (O10). -/
def r0w : SC := r0a.set (write3Eff (r0a.view 0) [3])

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies W-RL₀, after P: `c0 : acquire(e)` `ok` (WC5.1 C16: C14.1,
C14.2 with `grant = none`, C14.3 through `root_M`), `c0 : write3(T)` via `g′` `ok` (O10). -/
theorem W_RL0_ok : AcquireOk KM L0 p4 regX 0 0 (r0a, [⟨3, some 6⟩]) ∧
    opStepC KM (.write 6 [3]) 0 r0a (.ok r0w) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, ⟨3, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩⟩

/-- The labels of W-RL₀. -/
def rl0Lbls : List Label := pLbls ++ [.acquire 0 0, .kernel 0 (.write 6 [3])]

/-- The states after P in W-RL₀. -/
def rl0Tail : List (SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) := [(r0a, [⟨3, some 6⟩], []), (r0w, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])]

/-- The named states of W-RL₀. -/
def rl0σ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  ([(x0, [], []), (x1, [], []), (x2, [], []), (x2, regX, []), (x3, regX, []), (x4, regX, []),
    (x5, regG, []), (x6, regG, []), (x7, regX, []), (p4, regX, [])] ++ rl0Tail).getD i
    (r0w, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])

/-- W-RL₀ from the initial state is a `Run5R`. -/
theorem W_RL0_run : rl0σ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst), [], []) ∧ Run5R KM L0 rl0σ rl0Lbls := by
  have h : Steps5R KM L0 ((p4, regX, []) :: rl0Tail) [.acquire 0 0, .kernel 0 (.write 6 [3])] :=
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.acquire W_RL0_ok.1) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, by decide, by decide⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel W_RL0_ok.2) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, (prefix_steps h).run _⟩

/-! ## W-RL -/

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies W-RL, after P: `c0 : resetLock(e)` `ok` (WC5.1 C18.1:
`ExercisableAt(guarded, Modify)` by the third clause of Spec 1 §43, `guarded` held by `slot` on
whose leaves `root_M` has effective `Modify`; C18.2; C18.3; no precondition reads the recorded
grant), then `c0 : acquire(e)` `ok` (WC5.1 C16) and `c0 : write3(T)` via `g′` `ok` (O10). -/
theorem W_RL_ok : ResetLockOk L0 p4 regX 0 0 (p4, regX) ∧
    AcquireOk KM L0 p4 regX 0 0 (r0a, [⟨3, some 6⟩]) ∧ opStepC KM (.write 6 [3]) 0 r0a (.ok r0w) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, ⟨3, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, W_RL0_ok⟩

/-- The labels of W-RL. -/
def rlLbls : List Label := pLbls ++ [.resetLock 0 0, .acquire 0 0, .kernel 0 (.write 6 [3])]

/-- The named states of W-RL. -/
def rlσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  ([(x0, [], []), (x1, [], []), (x2, [], []), (x2, regX, []), (x3, regX, []), (x4, regX, []),
    (x5, regG, []), (x6, regG, []), (x7, regX, []), (p4, regX, []), (p4, regX, [])] ++
    rl0Tail).getD i (r0w, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])

/-- W-RL from the initial state is a `Run5R`: `Encap5R` admits the `resetLock`, none of its
conjuncts constraining that label. -/
theorem W_RL_run : rlσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst), [], []) ∧ Run5R KM L0 rlσ rlLbls := by
  have h : Steps5R KM L0 ((p4, regX, []) :: (p4, regX, []) :: rl0Tail)
      [.resetLock 0 0, .acquire 0 0, .kernel 0 (.write 6 [3])] :=
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.resetLock W_RL_ok.1) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.acquire W_RL0_ok.1) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, by decide, by decide⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel W_RL0_ok.2) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, (prefix_steps h).run _⟩

/-! ## W-RL-J -/

/-- W-RL-J, `c1 : terminate` (WC5.1 C7). -/
def jq : SC := termEffC p4 1
/-- W-RL-J, `c0 : acquire(e)` (WC5.1 C16). -/
def jqa : SC := deriveSyncEff jq 0 3
/-- W-RL-J, `c0 : write3(T)` via `g′` (O10). -/
def jqw : SC := jqa.set (write3Eff (jqa.view 0) [3])

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies W-RL-J, after P: `c1 : terminate` `ok` (WC5.1 C7),
`c0 : join(c1)` `ok` (WC5.1 C8), then as W-RL: `resetLock(e)`, `acquire(e)`, `write3(T)`, all
`ok`. -/
theorem W_RLJ_ok : TermStep KM p4 1 (.ok jq) ∧ JoinStep jq 0 1 (.ok jq) ∧
    ResetLockOk L0 jq regX 0 0 (jq, regX) ∧ AcquireOk KM L0 jq regX 0 0 (jqa, [⟨3, some 6⟩]) ∧
    opStepC KM (.write 6 [3]) 0 jqa (.ok jqw) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, .ok (by decide) (by decide),
    ⟨by decide, ⟨3, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩,
    ⟨by decide, ⟨3, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩⟩

/-- The labels of W-RL-J. -/
def rljLbls : List Label :=
  pLbls ++ [.terminate 1, .join 0 1, .resetLock 0 0, .acquire 0 0, .kernel 0 (.write 6 [3])]

/-- The named states of W-RL-J. -/
def rljσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  [(x0, [], []), (x1, [], []), (x2, [], []), (x2, regX, []), (x3, regX, []), (x4, regX, []),
    (x5, regG, []), (x6, regG, []), (x7, regX, []), (p4, regX, []), (jq, regX, []),
    (jq, regX, []), (jq, regX, []), (jqa, [⟨3, some 6⟩], []), (jqw, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])].getD i
    (jqw, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])

/-- W-RL-J from the initial state is a `Run5R`. -/
theorem W_RLJ_run : rljσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst), [], []) ∧ Run5R KM L0 rljσ rljLbls := by
  obtain ⟨ht, hj, hr, ha, hw⟩ := W_RLJ_ok
  have h : Steps5R KM L0 [(p4, regX, []), (jq, regX, []), (jq, regX, []), (jq, regX, []),
      (jqa, [⟨3, some 6⟩], []), (jqw, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])]
      [.terminate 1, .join 0 1, .resetLock 0 0, .acquire 0 0, .kernel 0 (.write 6 [3])] :=
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.terminate ht) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.join hj) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.resetLock hr) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.acquire ha) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, by decide, by decide⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel hw) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, (prefix_steps h).run _⟩

/-! ## W-TR -/

/-- W-TR, `c0 : transfer(M, M′)` (O4): `guarded` is held by `slot′`. -/
def tq : SC := transferEffC p4 0 0 4
/-- W-TR, `c0 : acquire(e)` (WC5.1 C16). -/
def tqa : SC := deriveSyncEff tq 0 3
/-- W-TR, `c0 : write3(T)` via `g′` (O10). -/
def tqw : SC := tqa.set (write3Eff (tqa.view 0) [3])

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies W-TR, after P: `c0 : transfer(M, M′)` `ok` (O4: §63.1 and
§63.4 hold as in `MX₃`, `o1` being inactive), after which `ControlOf(e)` is `lock′`; then
`c0 : acquire(e)` `ok` (WC5.1 C16, C14.3 through `root_M′`) and `c0 : write3(T)` via `g′` `ok`
(O10). -/
theorem W_TR_ok : opStepC KM (.transfer 0 4) 0 p4 (.ok tq) ∧ ControlOf L0 tq ⟨3, none⟩ = some 6 ∧
    AcquireOk KM L0 tq regX 0 0 (tqa, [⟨3, some 6⟩]) ∧ opStepC KM (.write 6 [3]) 0 tqa (.ok tqw) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, by decide, ⟨by decide, ⟨3, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩,
    ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩⟩

/-- The labels of W-TR. -/
def trLbls : List Label :=
  pLbls ++ [.kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4), .acquire 0 0, .kernel 0 (.write 6 [3])]

/-- The named states of W-TR. -/
def trσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  [(x0, [], []), (x1, [], []), (x2, [], []), (x2, regX, []), (x3, regX, []), (x4, regX, []),
    (x5, regG, []), (x6, regG, []), (x7, regX, []), (p4, regX, []), (tq, regX, []),
    (tqa, [⟨3, some 6⟩], []), (tqw, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])].getD i (tqw, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])

/-- W-TR from the initial state is a `Run5R`. -/
theorem W_TR_run : trσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst), [], []) ∧ Run5R KM L0 trσ trLbls := by
  obtain ⟨ht, -, ha, hw⟩ := W_TR_ok
  have h : Steps5R KM L0 [(p4, regX, []), (tq, regX, []), (tqa, [⟨3, some 6⟩], []),
      (tqw, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])]
      [.kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4), .acquire 0 0, .kernel 0 (.write 6 [3])] :=
    .cons ⟨⟨(by decide : TransferExcl L0 (p4, regX) 0), trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩
      (.kernel ht) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.acquire ha) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, by decide, by decide⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel hw) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, (prefix_steps h).run _⟩

/-! ## W-TR-J -/

/-- W-TR-J, `c0 : transfer(M, M′)` after `terminate` and `join` (O4). -/
def uq : SC := transferEffC jq 0 0 4
/-- W-TR-J, `c0 : acquire(e)` (WC5.1 C16). -/
def uqa : SC := deriveSyncEff uq 0 3
/-- W-TR-J, `c0 : write3(T)` via `g′` (O10). -/
def uqw : SC := uqa.set (write3Eff (uqa.view 0) [3])

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies W-TR-J, after P: `c1 : terminate` `ok` (WC5.1 C7),
`c0 : join(c1)` `ok` (WC5.1 C8), then as W-TR: `transfer(M, M′)`, `acquire(e)`, `write3(T)`, all
`ok`. -/
theorem W_TRJ_ok : TermStep KM p4 1 (.ok jq) ∧ JoinStep jq 0 1 (.ok jq) ∧
    opStepC KM (.transfer 0 4) 0 jq (.ok uq) ∧ AcquireOk KM L0 uq regX 0 0 (uqa, [⟨3, some 6⟩]) ∧
    opStepC KM (.write 6 [3]) 0 uqa (.ok uqw) :=
  ⟨W_RLJ_ok.1, W_RLJ_ok.2.1, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩,
    ⟨by decide, ⟨3, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩⟩

/-- The labels of W-TR-J. -/
def trjLbls : List Label :=
  pLbls ++ [.terminate 1, .join 0 1, .kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4), .acquire 0 0,
    .kernel 0 (.write 6 [3])]

/-- The named states of W-TR-J. -/
def trjσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  [(x0, [], []), (x1, [], []), (x2, [], []), (x2, regX, []), (x3, regX, []), (x4, regX, []),
    (x5, regG, []), (x6, regG, []), (x7, regX, []), (p4, regX, []), (jq, regX, []),
    (jq, regX, []), (uq, regX, []), (uqa, [⟨3, some 6⟩], []), (uqw, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])].getD i
    (uqw, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])

/-- W-TR-J from the initial state is a `Run5R`. -/
theorem W_TRJ_run : trjσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst), [], []) ∧ Run5R KM L0 trjσ trjLbls := by
  obtain ⟨ht, hj, htr, ha, hw⟩ := W_TRJ_ok
  have h : Steps5R KM L0 [(p4, regX, []), (jq, regX, []), (jq, regX, []), (uq, regX, []),
      (uqa, [⟨3, some 6⟩], []), (uqw, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])]
      [.terminate 1, .join 0 1, .kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4), .acquire 0 0,
        .kernel 0 (.write 6 [3])] :=
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.terminate ht) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.join hj) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨(by decide : TransferExcl L0 (jq, regX) 0), trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩
      (.kernel htr) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.acquire ha) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, by decide, by decide⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel hw) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, (prefix_steps h).run _⟩

/-! ## The defect of the abstract mutex edge -/

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies W-RL: the write of `T` by context 1 (step 6) and the write of
`T` by context 0 (step 11) form an exclusive pair. -/
theorem W_RL_excl : ExclPair rlLbls 6 11 3 :=
  ⟨by decide, by decide, 0, 1, .modify, .modify, by decide, ⟨rfl, by decide, rfl⟩,
    ⟨rfl, by decide, rfl⟩, Or.inl rfl⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies W-RL, graph of §2 septies: the pair is ordered by the
abstract mutex edge passing over the `resetLock` (step 9), write of context 1 →`po` `unlock(e)`
(step 7) →`sw` `acquire(e)` of context 0 (step 10) →`po` write of context 0, and it satisfies
`HandoffOrderedAt` (WC5.1 C46). This is the defect of the abstract edge, kept as a counterexample
(WC5.1 C45, last paragraph). -/
theorem W_RL_defect : PO rlσ rlLbls (.step 6) (.step 7) ∧ SW rlLbls (.step 7) (.step 10) ∧
    PO rlσ rlLbls (.step 10) (.step 11) ∧ HB rlσ rlLbls (.step 6) (.step 11) ∧
    HandoffOrderedAt rlσ rlLbls 6 11 3 := by
  decide

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies W-TR: the write of `T` by context 1 (step 6) and the write of
`T` by context 0 (step 11) form an exclusive pair. -/
theorem W_TR_excl : ExclPair trLbls 6 11 3 :=
  ⟨by decide, by decide, 0, 1, .modify, .modify, by decide, ⟨rfl, by decide, rfl⟩,
    ⟨rfl, by decide, rfl⟩, Or.inl rfl⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies W-TR, graph of §2 septies: the pair is ordered by the abstract
mutex edge although the controller moved from `lock` to `lock′` at step 9, and it satisfies
`HandoffOrderedAt` (WC5.1 C46). Same defect, kept as a counterexample (WC5.1 C45, last
paragraph). -/
theorem W_TR_defect : PO trσ trLbls (.step 6) (.step 7) ∧ SW trLbls (.step 7) (.step 10) ∧
    PO trσ trLbls (.step 10) (.step 11) ∧ HB trσ trLbls (.step 6) (.step 11) ∧
    HandoffOrderedAt trσ trLbls 6 11 3 := by
  decide

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies, prefix P from `MX₄`: step 1 `c1 : acquire(e)` `ok` (WC5.1
C16), step 2 `c1 : write3(T)` via `g` `ok` (O10), step 3 `c1 : unlock(e)` `ok` (WC5.1 C17),
step 4 `c1 : release(o1)` `ok` (O3.1–O3.3: `o1` is active, derived, held by the current frame of
context 1, without an active descendant). -/
theorem P_ok : AcquireOk KM L0 x4 regX 1 0 (x5, regG) ∧ opStepC KM (.write 5 [3]) 1 x5 (.ok x6) ∧
    UnlockOk L0 x6 regG 1 0 (x7, regX) ∧ opStepC KM (.release 4) 1 x7 (.ok p4) :=
  ⟨S2_1_ok, S2_2_ok, S2_3_ok, ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩⟩

/-- After P, `root_M` has effective `Modify` again on `slot` and `lock` (Spec 1 §43.2; §62
effect), and `ControlOf(e)` is `lock`. -/
theorem P_facts : effective p4.flat 0 1 = some .modify ∧ effective p4.flat 0 2 = some .modify ∧
    ControlOf L0 p4 ⟨3, none⟩ = some 2 := by decide

/-- The labels of block MX up to `MX₄` and of the prefix P. -/
def pLbls : List Label :=
  [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 3 1), .newMutex 0 3,
   .kernel 0 (.derive 0 [1, 2] .observe), .spawn 0 [4] [], .acquire 1 0, .kernel 1 (.write 5 [3]),
   .unlock 1 0, .kernel 1 (.release 4)]

/-- The setup and the prefix P from the initial state, each step admitted by `Encap5R`, followed
by any run from the state after P. -/
theorem prefix_steps {sts : List (SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg)} {lbls : List Label}
    (h : Steps5R KM L0 ((p4, regX, []) :: sts) lbls) :
    Steps5R KM L0 ((x0, [], []) :: (x1, [], []) :: (x2, [], []) :: (x2, regX, []) ::
      (x3, regX, []) :: (x4, regX, []) :: (x5, regG, []) :: (x6, regG, []) :: (x7, regX, []) ::
      (p4, regX, []) :: sts) (pLbls ++ lbls) :=
  .cons ⟨⟨(fun e he => by cases he), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel mx_steps.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel mx_steps.2.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.newMutex mx_steps.2.2.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨(by decide : ∀ e ∈ regX, e.Live x2 → 0 ≠ e.guarded), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
    (.kernel mx_steps.2.2.2.2.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.spawn mx_steps.2.2.2.2.2) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.acquire P_ok.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, by decide, by decide⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel P_ok.2.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.unlock P_ok.2.2.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel P_ok.2.2.2) h

/-! ## W-RL₀ -/

/-- W-RL₀, `c0 : acquire(e)`: grant `g′`, authority `6`, held by frame 0 (WC5.1 C16). -/
def r0a : SC := deriveSyncEff p4 0 3
/-- W-RL₀, `c0 : write3(T)` via `g′` (O10). -/
def r0w : SC := r0a.set (write3Eff (r0a.view 0) [3])

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies W-RL₀, after P: `c0 : acquire(e)` `ok` (WC5.1 C16: C14.1,
C14.2 with `grant = none`, C14.3 through `root_M`), `c0 : write3(T)` via `g′` `ok` (O10). -/
theorem W_RL0_ok : AcquireOk KM L0 p4 regX 0 0 (r0a, [⟨3, some 6⟩]) ∧
    opStepC KM (.write 6 [3]) 0 r0a (.ok r0w) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, ⟨3, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩⟩

/-- The labels of W-RL₀. -/
def rl0Lbls : List Label := pLbls ++ [.acquire 0 0, .kernel 0 (.write 6 [3])]

/-- The states after P in W-RL₀. -/
def rl0Tail : List (SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) := [(r0a, [⟨3, some 6⟩], []), (r0w, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])]

/-- The named states of W-RL₀. -/
def rl0σ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  ([(x0, [], []), (x1, [], []), (x2, [], []), (x2, regX, []), (x3, regX, []), (x4, regX, []),
    (x5, regG, []), (x6, regG, []), (x7, regX, []), (p4, regX, [])] ++ rl0Tail).getD i
    (r0w, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])

/-- W-RL₀ from the initial state is a `Run5R`. -/
theorem W_RL0_run : rl0σ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst), [], []) ∧ Run5R KM L0 rl0σ rl0Lbls := by
  have h : Steps5R KM L0 ((p4, regX, []) :: rl0Tail) [.acquire 0 0, .kernel 0 (.write 6 [3])] :=
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.acquire W_RL0_ok.1) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, by decide, by decide⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel W_RL0_ok.2) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, (prefix_steps h).run _⟩

/-! ## W-RL -/

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies W-RL, after P: `c0 : resetLock(e)` `ok` (WC5.1 C18.1:
`ExercisableAt(guarded, Modify)` by the third clause of Spec 1 §43, `guarded` held by `slot` on
whose leaves `root_M` has effective `Modify`; C18.2; C18.3; no precondition reads the recorded
grant), then `c0 : acquire(e)` `ok` (WC5.1 C16) and `c0 : write3(T)` via `g′` `ok` (O10). -/
theorem W_RL_ok : ResetLockOk L0 p4 regX 0 0 (p4, regX) ∧
    AcquireOk KM L0 p4 regX 0 0 (r0a, [⟨3, some 6⟩]) ∧ opStepC KM (.write 6 [3]) 0 r0a (.ok r0w) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, ⟨3, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, W_RL0_ok⟩

/-- The labels of W-RL. -/
def rlLbls : List Label := pLbls ++ [.resetLock 0 0, .acquire 0 0, .kernel 0 (.write 6 [3])]

/-- The named states of W-RL. -/
def rlσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  ([(x0, [], []), (x1, [], []), (x2, [], []), (x2, regX, []), (x3, regX, []), (x4, regX, []),
    (x5, regG, []), (x6, regG, []), (x7, regX, []), (p4, regX, []), (p4, regX, [])] ++
    rl0Tail).getD i (r0w, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])

/-- W-RL from the initial state is a `Run5R`: `Encap5R` admits the `resetLock`, none of its
conjuncts constraining that label. -/
theorem W_RL_run : rlσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst), [], []) ∧ Run5R KM L0 rlσ rlLbls := by
  have h : Steps5R KM L0 ((p4, regX, []) :: (p4, regX, []) :: rl0Tail)
      [.resetLock 0 0, .acquire 0 0, .kernel 0 (.write 6 [3])] :=
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.resetLock W_RL_ok.1) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.acquire W_RL0_ok.1) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, by decide, by decide⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel W_RL0_ok.2) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, (prefix_steps h).run _⟩

/-! ## W-RL-J -/

/-- W-RL-J, `c1 : terminate` (WC5.1 C7). -/
def jq : SC := termEffC p4 1
/-- W-RL-J, `c0 : acquire(e)` (WC5.1 C16). -/
def jqa : SC := deriveSyncEff jq 0 3
/-- W-RL-J, `c0 : write3(T)` via `g′` (O10). -/
def jqw : SC := jqa.set (write3Eff (jqa.view 0) [3])

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies W-RL-J, after P: `c1 : terminate` `ok` (WC5.1 C7),
`c0 : join(c1)` `ok` (WC5.1 C8), then as W-RL: `resetLock(e)`, `acquire(e)`, `write3(T)`, all
`ok`. -/
theorem W_RLJ_ok : TermStep KM p4 1 (.ok jq) ∧ JoinStep jq 0 1 (.ok jq) ∧
    ResetLockOk L0 jq regX 0 0 (jq, regX) ∧ AcquireOk KM L0 jq regX 0 0 (jqa, [⟨3, some 6⟩]) ∧
    opStepC KM (.write 6 [3]) 0 jqa (.ok jqw) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, .ok (by decide) (by decide),
    ⟨by decide, ⟨3, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩,
    ⟨by decide, ⟨3, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩⟩

/-- The labels of W-RL-J. -/
def rljLbls : List Label :=
  pLbls ++ [.terminate 1, .join 0 1, .resetLock 0 0, .acquire 0 0, .kernel 0 (.write 6 [3])]

/-- The named states of W-RL-J. -/
def rljσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  [(x0, [], []), (x1, [], []), (x2, [], []), (x2, regX, []), (x3, regX, []), (x4, regX, []),
    (x5, regG, []), (x6, regG, []), (x7, regX, []), (p4, regX, []), (jq, regX, []),
    (jq, regX, []), (jq, regX, []), (jqa, [⟨3, some 6⟩], []), (jqw, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])].getD i
    (jqw, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])

/-- W-RL-J from the initial state is a `Run5R`. -/
theorem W_RLJ_run : rljσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst), [], []) ∧ Run5R KM L0 rljσ rljLbls := by
  obtain ⟨ht, hj, hr, ha, hw⟩ := W_RLJ_ok
  have h : Steps5R KM L0 [(p4, regX, []), (jq, regX, []), (jq, regX, []), (jq, regX, []),
      (jqa, [⟨3, some 6⟩], []), (jqw, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])]
      [.terminate 1, .join 0 1, .resetLock 0 0, .acquire 0 0, .kernel 0 (.write 6 [3])] :=
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.terminate ht) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.join hj) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.resetLock hr) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.acquire ha) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, by decide, by decide⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel hw) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, (prefix_steps h).run _⟩

/-! ## W-TR -/

/-- W-TR, `c0 : transfer(M, M′)` (O4): `guarded` is held by `slot′`. -/
def tq : SC := transferEffC p4 0 0 4
/-- W-TR, `c0 : acquire(e)` (WC5.1 C16). -/
def tqa : SC := deriveSyncEff tq 0 3
/-- W-TR, `c0 : write3(T)` via `g′` (O10). -/
def tqw : SC := tqa.set (write3Eff (tqa.view 0) [3])

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies W-TR, after P: `c0 : transfer(M, M′)` `ok` (O4: §63.1 and
§63.4 hold as in `MX₃`, `o1` being inactive), after which `ControlOf(e)` is `lock′`; then
`c0 : acquire(e)` `ok` (WC5.1 C16, C14.3 through `root_M′`) and `c0 : write3(T)` via `g′` `ok`
(O10). -/
theorem W_TR_ok : opStepC KM (.transfer 0 4) 0 p4 (.ok tq) ∧ ControlOf L0 tq ⟨3, none⟩ = some 6 ∧
    AcquireOk KM L0 tq regX 0 0 (tqa, [⟨3, some 6⟩]) ∧ opStepC KM (.write 6 [3]) 0 tqa (.ok tqw) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, by decide, ⟨by decide, ⟨3, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩,
    ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩⟩

/-- The labels of W-TR. -/
def trLbls : List Label :=
  pLbls ++ [.kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4), .acquire 0 0, .kernel 0 (.write 6 [3])]

/-- The named states of W-TR. -/
def trσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  [(x0, [], []), (x1, [], []), (x2, [], []), (x2, regX, []), (x3, regX, []), (x4, regX, []),
    (x5, regG, []), (x6, regG, []), (x7, regX, []), (p4, regX, []), (tq, regX, []),
    (tqa, [⟨3, some 6⟩], []), (tqw, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])].getD i (tqw, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])

/-- W-TR from the initial state is a `Run5R`. -/
theorem W_TR_run : trσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst), [], []) ∧ Run5R KM L0 trσ trLbls := by
  obtain ⟨ht, -, ha, hw⟩ := W_TR_ok
  have h : Steps5R KM L0 [(p4, regX, []), (tq, regX, []), (tqa, [⟨3, some 6⟩], []),
      (tqw, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])]
      [.kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4), .acquire 0 0, .kernel 0 (.write 6 [3])] :=
    .cons ⟨⟨(by decide : TransferExcl L0 (p4, regX) 0), trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩
      (.kernel ht) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.acquire ha) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, by decide, by decide⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel hw) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, (prefix_steps h).run _⟩

/-! ## W-TR-J -/

/-- W-TR-J, `c0 : transfer(M, M′)` after `terminate` and `join` (O4). -/
def uq : SC := transferEffC jq 0 0 4
/-- W-TR-J, `c0 : acquire(e)` (WC5.1 C16). -/
def uqa : SC := deriveSyncEff uq 0 3
/-- W-TR-J, `c0 : write3(T)` via `g′` (O10). -/
def uqw : SC := uqa.set (write3Eff (uqa.view 0) [3])

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies W-TR-J, after P: `c1 : terminate` `ok` (WC5.1 C7),
`c0 : join(c1)` `ok` (WC5.1 C8), then as W-TR: `transfer(M, M′)`, `acquire(e)`, `write3(T)`, all
`ok`. -/
theorem W_TRJ_ok : TermStep KM p4 1 (.ok jq) ∧ JoinStep jq 0 1 (.ok jq) ∧
    opStepC KM (.transfer 0 4) 0 jq (.ok uq) ∧ AcquireOk KM L0 uq regX 0 0 (uqa, [⟨3, some 6⟩]) ∧
    opStepC KM (.write 6 [3]) 0 uqa (.ok uqw) :=
  ⟨W_RLJ_ok.1, W_RLJ_ok.2.1, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩,
    ⟨by decide, ⟨3, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩⟩

/-- The labels of W-TR-J. -/
def trjLbls : List Label :=
  pLbls ++ [.terminate 1, .join 0 1, .kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4), .acquire 0 0,
    .kernel 0 (.write 6 [3])]

/-- The named states of W-TR-J. -/
def trjσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  [(x0, [], []), (x1, [], []), (x2, [], []), (x2, regX, []), (x3, regX, []), (x4, regX, []),
    (x5, regG, []), (x6, regG, []), (x7, regX, []), (p4, regX, []), (jq, regX, []),
    (jq, regX, []), (uq, regX, []), (uqa, [⟨3, some 6⟩], []), (uqw, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])].getD i
    (uqw, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])

/-- W-TR-J from the initial state is a `Run5R`. -/
theorem W_TRJ_run : trjσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst), [], []) ∧ Run5R KM L0 trjσ trjLbls := by
  obtain ⟨ht, hj, htr, ha, hw⟩ := W_TRJ_ok
  have h : Steps5R KM L0 [(p4, regX, []), (jq, regX, []), (jq, regX, []), (uq, regX, []),
      (uqa, [⟨3, some 6⟩], []), (uqw, [⟨3, some 6⟩], [])]
      [.terminate 1, .join 0 1, .kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4), .acquire 0 0,
        .kernel 0 (.write 6 [3])] :=
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.terminate ht) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.join hj) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨(by decide : TransferExcl L0 (jq, regX) 0), trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩
      (.kernel htr) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.acquire ha) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, by decide, by decide⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel hw) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, (prefix_steps h).run _⟩

/-! ## The defect of the abstract mutex edge -/

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies W-RL: the write of `T` by context 1 (step 6) and the write of
`T` by context 0 (step 11) form an exclusive pair. -/
theorem W_RL_excl : ExclPair rlLbls 6 11 3 :=
  ⟨by decide, by decide, 0, 1, .modify, .modify, by decide, ⟨rfl, by decide, rfl⟩,
    ⟨rfl, by decide, rfl⟩, Or.inl rfl⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies W-RL, graph of §2 septies: the pair is ordered by the
abstract mutex edge passing over the `resetLock` (step 9), write of context 1 →`po` `unlock(e)`
(step 7) →`sw` `acquire(e)` of context 0 (step 10) →`po` write of context 0, and it satisfies
`HandoffOrderedAt` (WC5.1 C46). This is the defect of the abstract edge, kept as a counterexample
(WC5.1 C45, last paragraph). -/
theorem W_RL_defect : PO rlσ rlLbls (.step 6) (.step 7) ∧ SW rlLbls (.step 7) (.step 10) ∧
    PO rlσ rlLbls (.step 10) (.step 11) ∧ HB rlσ rlLbls (.step 6) (.step 11) ∧
    HandoffOrderedAt rlσ rlLbls 6 11 3 := by
  decide

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies W-TR: the write of `T` by context 1 (step 6) and the write of
`T` by context 0 (step 11) form an exclusive pair. -/
theorem W_TR_excl : ExclPair trLbls 6 11 3 :=
  ⟨by decide, by decide, 0, 1, .modify, .modify, by decide, ⟨rfl, by decide, rfl⟩,
    ⟨rfl, by decide, rfl⟩, Or.inl rfl⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies W-TR, graph of §2 septies: the pair is ordered by the abstract
mutex edge although the controller moved from `lock` to `lock′` at step 9, and it satisfies
`HandoffOrderedAt` (WC5.1 C46). Same defect, kept as a counterexample (WC5.1 C45, last
paragraph). -/
theorem W_TR_defect : PO trσ trLbls (.step 6) (.step 7) ∧ SW trLbls (.step 7) (.step 10) ∧
    PO trσ trLbls (.step 10) (.step 11) ∧ HB trσ trLbls (.step 6) (.step 11) ∧
    HandoffOrderedAt trσ trLbls 6 11 3 := by
  decide

import Ern.Concurrency.Encap5C
import Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.GuardedChain

/-!
# Witnesses of the corrected exclusion `ChainExcl`

Test of `ChainExcl` (`Ern.Concurrency.Encap5C`), the correction of `GuardedExcl` proposed in
`formal/reports/spec2-m4-handoff.md`, on the counterexample of `Corpus/GuardedChain.lean` and on
W-GR (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` v4 §2 ter), by `decide`: the reads through `guarded` are excluded; the
same access to `Y` made by context 1 while it holds the grant is admitted, and the loss marker is
its own `unlock` (WC5 C45).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.GuardedChainC

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency Ern.Concurrency.Corpus
open Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.GuardedChain
open Ern.Concurrency.Traces (L0)

/-- `ChainExcl` excludes the read of the counterexample (`gc_read`): `z` is exercisable by context
1 only through `guarded` (Spec 1 §43, third clause). -/
theorem gc_read_excluded : ¬ ChainExcl (gc6, greg) (.kernel 1 (.read 3 [4])) := by decide

/-- `ChainExcl` excludes step 1 of W-GR (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` v4 §2 ter): `read3(T)` with
`access = guarded` by context 1 from `MX₄`. -/
theorem W_GR_1_excluded : ¬ ChainExcl (x4, regX) (.kernel 1 (.read 3 [3])) := by decide

/-- `c1 : acquire(e)`: grant `g₁`, authority 6, held by frame 1 (WC4 C16). -/
def lc7 : SC := deriveSyncEff gc6 1 4
/-- `c1 : read3(Y)` via `z` (O9): the state is unchanged. -/
def lc8 : SC := lc7.set (lc7.view 1)
/-- `c1 : unlock(e)`: `g₁` released (O3, WC4 C17). -/
def lc9 : SC := lc8.set (releaseEff (lc8.view 1) 6)
/-- `c0 : acquire(e)`: grant `g₂`, authority 7, held by frame 0 (WC4 C16). -/
def lc10 : SC := deriveSyncEff lc9 0 4
/-- `c0 : write3(Y)` via `z` (O10). -/
def lc11 : SC := lc10.set (write3Eff (lc10.view 0) [4])

/-- The labels of the locked trace. -/
def lcLbls : List Label :=
  [.kernel 0 (.derive 2 [4] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 3 3), .kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify),
   .kernel 0 (.store 4 1), .newMutex 0 4, .kernel 0 (.derive 0 [1, 2] .observe), .spawn 0 [5] [],
   .acquire 1 0, .kernel 1 (.read 3 [4]), .unlock 1 0, .acquire 0 0, .kernel 0 (.write 3 [4])]

import Ern.Concurrency.Realize

/-!
# Corpus of milestone 3, block MX

`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §0 block MX, §1 S2, S5, S7, S8, S9, S11, S12, S15, §2 W-C22.2.

States of the reference mutex of `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §0, block MX, built by labelled steps from
the initial state of Spec 1 §47, and one theorem per verdict of the cases of §1 on these states
(named `S<case>_<n>_<ok|reject|fail|wait|encap>`, twins in this module). Verdicts are written from
`corpus-spec2-m3.md`; preconditions are checked by `decide`. Verdict encodings (§4 of the corpus):
`ok` and `reject` are outcomes of the step relation; `non habilité` (`wait`) is the absence of an
`ok` outcome of a library operation that defines only `ok` (`∀ st', ¬ Op … st'`); for `unlock` and
`resetLock`, which also define only `ok` (WC4 C17, C18), `reject` is the absence of an `ok`
outcome together with the failing clause named by the corpus.

Contract: `KC [lock]`, the test contract of `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples.K0` except that only
the controller leaves are `K.SharedMutable` (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §0: `K.SharedMutable lock`; §1
S5a: `T` not `SharedMutable`).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency.Corpus

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples Ern.Concurrency
open Ern.Concurrency.Traces (L0)

/-! ## Contract -/

/-- Test contract of the corpus (Spec 1 §48): no declared disjointness, the leaves of `sm` are
`SharedMutable`, nothing statically pinned, every external use done, every place deallocable,
every deallocation compatible, every allocation satisfiable. -/
def KC (sm : List Nat) : K :=
  ⟨fun _ _ => False, fun l => l ∈ sm, fun _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => True,
    fun _ _ => True, fun _ _ _ => True⟩

instance (sm : List Nat) : ∀ r r', Decidable ((KC sm).DeclaredDisjoint r r') :=
  fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)
instance (sm : List Nat) : DecidablePred (KC sm).SharedMutable :=
  fun l => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l ∈ sm))
instance (sm : List Nat) : DecidablePred (KC sm).Pinned :=
  fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)
instance (sm : List Nat) : DecidablePred (KC sm).ExternalDone :=
  fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
instance (sm : List Nat) : DecidablePred (KC sm).Deallocable :=
  fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
instance (sm : List Nat) : ∀ p a, Decidable ((KC sm).FreeCompat p a) :=
  fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
instance (sm : List Nat) : ∀ p ls s, Decidable ((KC sm).Satisfiable p ls s) :=
  fun _ _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)

/-- `DDSound` of the corpus contract (Spec 1 §80): nothing is declared disjoint. -/
theorem ddKC (sm : List Nat) : DDSound (KC sm) := fun _ _ h => h.elim

/-! ## Block MX (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §0) -/

/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): `0` the mutex value `M`, `1` its field `slot` (`Uninit`), `2` its field
`lock` (`Init`), `3` the protected root `T` (`Init`), owned by `M`; `4` the mutex-shaped value `M′`
with fields `5` (`slot′`) and `6` (`lock′`), `Uninit`. Root authorities: `0` of `M` (frame 0), `1`
of `T` (held by `M`), `2` of `M′` (frame 0). -/
def mxst : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
   ((none, some 0, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false), ((some 4, none, 0), false),
   ((some 4, none, 0), false)]

/-- The statics are well formed (Spec 1 §47). -/
theorem mxst_ok : StaticsOK mxst := by decide

/-- The corpus contract of block MX: `lock` (place 2) is the only `SharedMutable` leaf. -/
abbrev KM : K := KC [2]

/-- Initial single-context state (Spec 1 §47). -/
def x0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst)
/-- MX step 1: `guarded := derive(root_T, Modify, footprint(T))`, authority 3 (O1). -/
def x1 : SC := x0.set (deriveEff (x0.view 0) 1 [3] .modify)
/-- MX step 2: `store(guarded, slot)` (O8); `slot` becomes `Init`. -/
def x2 : SC := storeEffC x1 0 3 1

def capRank : Option Mode → Nat
  | none => 0
  | some .observe => 1
  | some .modify => 2

/-- Step `lbl` is an access by context `d` to leaf `l` requiring mode `m`: `read3` and
`writeShared` require `Observe` (Spec 1 §66.2, §68.2), `write3` requires `Modify` (§67.1). -/
def Label.Access : Label → Nat → Nat → Mode → Prop
  | .kernel c (.read _ ls), d, l, m => c = d ∧ l ∈ ls ∧ m = .observe
  | .kernel c (.write _ ls), d, l, m => c = d ∧ l ∈ ls ∧ m = .modify
  | .kernel c (.writeShared _ ls), d, l, m => c = d ∧ l ∈ ls ∧ m = .observe
  | _, _, _, _ => False

/-- An `EncapsulatedTrace5` with named states: `σ 0` is the first state, `σ (i + 1)` the state
after step `i`. -/
def Run5 (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbls : List Label) :
    Prop :=
  ∀ i (h : i < lbls.length),
    Encap5 L ((σ i).1, (σ i).2.1) lbls[i] ∧ LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1))

/-- Every `EncapsulatedTrace5` has named states. -/
theorem run5_of_trace {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (h : EncapsulatedTrace5 k L st lbls st') :
    ∃ σ, σ 0 = st ∧ Run5 k L σ lbls ∧ σ lbls.length = st' := by
  induction h with
  | @nil st => exact ⟨fun _ => st, rfl, fun i h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _), rfl⟩
  | @cons st st₁ st₂ lbl lbls he hs _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨σ, h0, hr, hn⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨fun i => match i with | 0 => st | i + 1 => σ i, rfl, fun i hi => ?_, hn⟩
    cases i with
    | zero => exact ⟨he, by show LStep k L lbl st (σ 0); rw [h0]; exact hs⟩
    | succ i => exact hr i (by simpa using hi)

/-- `cap5_sound` (brief of milestone 4, task 4): as `cap_sound`, for the access steps admitted by
`Encap5` from the states reached by an `EncapsulatedTrace5` from an initial state (Spec 1 §47). -/
def Cap5Sound (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : Prop :=
  ∀ (statics : Statics) (lbls : List Label) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (c a : Nat)
    (ls : List Nat) (s' : SC), StaticsOK statics →
    EncapsulatedTrace5 k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []) lbls st →
    (Encap5 L (st.1, st.2.1) (.kernel c (.read a ls)) → opStepC k (.read a ls) c st.1 (.ok s') →
      ∀ l ∈ ls, Allows (cap5 st.1 st.2.1 c l) .observe) ∧
    (Encap5 L (st.1, st.2.1) (.kernel c (.write a ls)) → opStepC k (.write a ls) c st.1 (.ok s') →
      ∀ l ∈ ls, Allows (cap5 st.1 st.2.1 c l) .modify) ∧
    (Encap5 L (st.1, st.2.1) (.kernel c (.writeShared a ls)) →
      opStepC k (.writeShared a ls) c st.1 (.ok s') →
      ∀ l ∈ ls, Allows (cap5 st.1 st.2.1 c l) .observe)

/-- `cap5_drop_own` (L1, WC5 C45, `OB-C17`; brief of milestone 4, task 4): from a state reached by
an `EncapsulatedTrace5` from an initial state, a step admitted by `Encap5` that strictly lowers
`cap5` of context `c` on leaf `l` is a step of `c`. -/
def Cap5DropOwn (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : Prop :=
open TransferWitness in
/-- The ownership-cycle run of §63 is rejected by §63.9: `cyc2` is reachable under a contract
with `DDSound` (§80), `transfer(0, 3)` from it is rejected because its destination would not be
usable, and the resulting state of that transfer, which violates `KInv` (§49.8, §54), is not
reachable (§57). -/
theorem reachable_cycle_rejected : Reachable Examples.K0 cycStatics cyc2 ∧
    TransferStep Examples.K0 0 3 cyc2 .reject ∧ ¬ Reachable Examples.K0 cycStatics cyc3 := by
  obtain ⟨hdd, hr, -, -, -, -, hrej, hn⟩ := transfer_cycle_rejected
  exact ⟨hr, hrej, fun h => hn (reachable_kinv hdd (by decide) h)⟩

/-! ## Initialization history (§59) -/

/-- Operation `op` writes leaf `l` from state `s` (§59): `write3` or `writeShared` of a list
containing `l`, `store` into `l`, or a `transfer` of which `l` is a destination leaf
corresponding to a source leaf `Init` before the step. -/
def KernelOp.Writes (s : S3) (l : Nat) : KernelOp → Prop
  | .write _ ls => l ∈ ls
  | .writeShared _ ls => l ∈ ls
  | .store _ p => l = p
  | .transfer src dst => l ∈ footprint s.P dst ∧
      ∃ l' ∈ footprint s.P src, corr s.P src dst l' = some l ∧ s.I l' = .init
  | _ => False

/-- In every `ok` step, a leaf that becomes `Init` is written by the step (§59): a permitted write
(`write3`, `writeShared`, `store`) or a transfer from a corresponding source leaf already
`Init`. -/
theorem init_only_by_writes {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} {l : Nat}
    (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) (hl : s.I l ≠ .init) (hl' : s'.I l = .init) : op.Writes s l := by
  cases op with
  | derive => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | split => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | release a =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    unfold releaseEff at hl'; split at hl' <;> exact absurd hl' hl
  | transfer src dst =>
    obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have e : (transferEff s src dst).I l = if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
        else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l := rfl
    rw [e] at hl'
    split at hl'
    · rename_i hld
      obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlp⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hld
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hrs, hc⟩ := hpre.sameShape.2 l (List.mem_range.2 hlP) hlp
      have h1 := hpre.sameShape.1 r hr hrs
      rw [hc] at h1
      have hkr : kids s.P r = [] := by
        have : (kids s.P l).length = 0 := by rw [kids_nil_iff.2 hleaf]; rfl
        exact List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by simp only [OptP] at h1; omega)
      have hrf : r ∈ footprint s.P src :=
        mem_footprint.2 ⟨List.mem_range.1 hr, kids_nil_iff.1 hkr, hrs⟩
      exact ⟨hld, r, hrf, hc, hpre.srcInit r hrf⟩
    · split at hl'
      · cases hl'
      · exact absurd hl' hl
  | depend => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | enter ps ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have e : (enterEff s ps ls).I l = if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l := rfl
    rw [e] at hl'; split at hl'
    · cases hl'
    · exact absurd hl' hl
  exact hg ▸ hng e₀ he₀ hl'

/-- Labels whose `ok` effect changes neither the authorities, the places, the contexts nor the
`guarded` identities of the registry: `read3`, `write3`, `writeShared` (Spec 1 §66–§68:
initialization states only), `depend` (§64: anchors only), `pin`, `unpin` (§74, §75: pinning
obligations only), `join` (WC4 C8: no change), `resetLock` (WC4 C18: the grant record only),
`newArena` (Spec 1 §76: the arena registry only). -/
def Label.Inert : Label → Prop
  | .kernel _ (.read _ _) | .kernel _ (.write _ _) | .kernel _ (.writeShared _ _)
  | .kernel _ (.depend _ _) | .kernel _ (.pin _) | .kernel _ (.unpin _) | .join _ _
  | .resetLock _ _ | .newArena _ _ _ => True
  | _ => False

/-- The `ok` effect of an inert label (Spec 1 §64, §66–§68, §74–§76; WC4 C8, C18). -/
theorem inert_effect {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    (hi : lbl.Inert) (h : LStep k L lbl st st') :
    st'.1.A = st.1.A ∧ st'.1.P = st.1.P ∧ st'.1.C = st.1.C ∧
      ∀ e' ∈ st'.2.1, ∃ e ∈ st.2.1, e.guarded = e'.guarded := by
  have same : ∀ (reg : SyncReg), ∀ e' ∈ reg, ∃ e ∈ reg, e.guarded = e'.guarded :=
    fun _ e' he' => ⟨e', he', rfl⟩
  cases h with

import Ern.Concurrency.Repr
import Ern.Concurrency.Reparent
import Ern.Concurrency.Traces

/-!
# Ordinary accesses of distinct contexts do not conflict (Spec 1 §43, §50, §54, §82.8; WC4 C2)

Contexts interleave at the grain of abstract steps. In a state satisfying the re-indexed kernel
invariant `KInvC`, an ordinary write enabled in the view of one context and an ordinary read or
write enabled in the view of another context share no leaf that is not `K.SharedMutable`
(`r4_nonConflict`, R4), so the bytes realizing their non-`SharedMutable` leaves are disjoint under
`LayoutWF` (`r4_bytes`, R4′, Spec 1 §23, §82.8).

This is absence of conflict between enabled abstract steps. It is not a proof of absence of data
races: the ordering of conflicting accesses that the authority machine separates in time (release
of a grant before its re-acquisition, `terminate` before `join`) by a memory-ordering relation is
WC4 OB-C04, OB-C06 and OB-C11.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement

/-- `OrdinaryCrossContextNonConflict` in state `s` (Spec 1 §43, §50, §54, §82.8; WC4 C2): for all
live contexts `c ≠ c′`, all authorities `a`, `b` and all leaf lists `L`, `L′`, if `write` (Spec 1
§67) through `a` on `L` is enabled in the view of `c` and `read` (§66) or `write` through `b` on
`L′` is enabled in the view of `c′`, then every leaf of both `L` and `L′` is `K.SharedMutable`.
`SharedMutable` leaves are excluded from the conclusion, not from the hypotheses. -/
def OrdinaryCrossContextNonConflict (k : K) (s : SC) : Prop :=
  ∀ c c', s.Live c → s.Live c' → c ≠ c' → ∀ (a b : Nat) (L L' : List Nat),
    Write3Pre (s.view c) a L → (Read3Pre (s.view c') b L' ∨ Write3Pre (s.view c') b L') →
    ∀ l ∈ L, l ∈ L' → k.SharedMutable l

namespace NonConflictAux

/-- An effective mode allowing `m` is present (Spec 1 §43). -/
theorem allows_ne_none {e : Option Mode} {m : Mode} (h : Allows e m) : e ≠ none := by
  intro he; rw [he] at h; exact h

/-- An effective mode allowing `Modify` is `Modify` (Spec 1 §43: `Observe ≤ Modify`). -/
theorem allows_modify {e : Option Mode} (h : Allows e .modify) : e = some .modify := by
  cases e with
  | none => exact h.elim
  | some m => cases m with
    | observe => exact absurd h (by simp [Allows, OptP, Mode.le])
    | modify => rfl

import Ern.Concurrency.Repr

/-!
# Ordinary accesses of distinct contexts do not conflict (Spec 1 §43, §50, §54, §82.8; WC4 C2)

Contexts interleave at the grain of abstract steps. In a state satisfying the re-indexed kernel
invariant `KInvC`, an ordinary write enabled in the view of one context and an ordinary read or
write enabled in the view of another context share no leaf that is not `K.SharedMutable`
(`r4_nonConflict`, R4), so the bytes realizing their non-`SharedMutable` leaves are disjoint under
`LayoutWF` (`r4_bytes`, R4′, Spec 1 §23, §82.8).

This is absence of conflict between enabled abstract steps. It is not a proof of absence of data
races: the ordering of conflicting accesses that the authority machine separates in time (release
of a grant before its re-acquisition, `terminate` before `join`) by a memory-ordering relation is
WC4 OB-C04, OB-C06 and OB-C11.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement

/-- `OrdinaryCrossContextNonConflict` in state `s` (Spec 1 §43, §50, §54, §82.8; WC4 C2): for all
live contexts `c ≠ c′`, all authorities `a`, `b` and all leaf lists `L`, `L′`, if `write` (Spec 1
§67) through `a` on `L` is enabled in the view of `c` and `read` (§66) or `write` through `b` on
`L′` is enabled in the view of `c′`, then every leaf of both `L` and `L′` is `K.SharedMutable`.
`SharedMutable` leaves are excluded from the conclusion, not from the hypotheses. -/
def OrdinaryCrossContextNonConflict (k : K) (s : SC) : Prop :=
  ∀ c c', s.Live c → s.Live c' → c ≠ c' → ∀ (a b : Nat) (L L' : List Nat),
    Write3Pre (s.view c) a L → (Read3Pre (s.view c') b L' ∨ Write3Pre (s.view c') b L') →
    ∀ l ∈ L, l ∈ L' → k.SharedMutable l

namespace NonConflictAux

/-- An effective mode allowing `m` is present (Spec 1 §43). -/
theorem allows_ne_none {e : Option Mode} {m : Mode} (h : Allows e m) : e ≠ none := by
  intro he; rw [he] at h; exact h

/-- An effective mode allowing `Modify` is `Modify` (Spec 1 §43: `Observe ≤ Modify`). -/
theorem allows_modify {e : Option Mode} (h : Allows e .modify) : e = some .modify := by
  cases e with
  | none => exact h.elim
  | some m => cases m with
    | observe => exact absurd h (by simp [Allows, OptP, Mode.le])
    | modify => rfl

/-- An authority exercisable in `Modify` from the current frame of `t₁` is exercisable in no mode
from the current frame of `t₂`, when the two states have the same authorities and places, satisfy
`I1` and have distinct current frames (Spec 1 §43, §50). By induction on the derivation of
`ExercisableAt` (§43, the clause recursive along the holder chain, which the inductive
definition makes finite): a frame-held authority is exercisable only from its holder; a
place-held one only through an authority with effective `Modify` on a leaf of its holder, which
`I1` makes the same authority from both frames, one link down the chain. -/
theorem no_double_exercise {t₁ t₂ : S3} (hA : t₂.A = t₁.A) (hP : t₂.P = t₁.P)
    (heff : ∀ x l, effective t₂ x l = effective t₁ x l) (hw : WF3 t₁) (hI1 : I1 t₁)
    (htop : t₁.top ≠ t₂.top) :
    ∀ {a : Nat} {m : Mode}, t₁.ExercisableAt a m → m = .modify →
      ∀ {m' : Mode}, t₂.ExercisableAt a m' → False := by
  intro a m h

theorem reprC_of_flat {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s' : SC} {t : S3} {m : Machine.State}
    (hflat : s'.flat = { t with F := s'.frames }) (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ t.F ↔ f ∈ s'.frames)
    (h : Refinement.Repr L rtok t m) : ReprC L rtok s' m := by
  unfold ReprC; rw [hflat]
  exact (repr_frames_congr fun f => (hF f).symm).2 h

/-- `ReprC` after a step that changes no place, initialization state or death marker, and no
context (WC4 C2; Spec 1 §82.1, §82.3, §82.5). -/
theorem reprC_set_same {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s : SC} {t : S3} {m : Machine.State}
    (hP : t.P = s.P) (hI : t.I = s.I) (hd : t.dead = s.dead) (h : ReprC L rtok s m) :
    ReprC L rtok (s.set t) m :=
  repr_congr (t := s.flat) (t' := (s.set t).flat) h hP hI hd fun _ => Iff.rfl

/-- `ReprC` is kept by the yield of WC4 C5.3, which changes holders only. -/
theorem reprC_yield {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {t : SC} {ps : List Nat} {f : Nat}
    {m : Machine.State} (h : ReprC L rtok t m) : ReprC L rtok (yieldEff t ps f) m :=
  repr_congr (t := t.flat) (t' := (yieldEff t ps f).flat) h rfl rfl rfl fun _ => Iff.rfl

/-! ## Realization of the labels (WC4 C2, C4–C8, C13–C18; Spec 1 §82.2–§82.5) -/

/-- The kernel operation of `Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement` (Spec 1 §60–§75) for an operation
O1–O16, with the representations `w` written by `write` and `writeShared` (Spec 1 §10 ¶4, §16 ¶2),
data of the program that the kernel does not read. -/
def kopOf : KernelOp → (Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) → KOp
  | .derive src region m, _ => .derive src region m
  | .split src rs, _ => .split src rs
  | .release a, _ => .release a
  | .transfer src dst, _ => .transfer src dst
  | .depend q x, _ => .depend q x
  | .enter ps ls, _ => .enter ps ls
  | .exit, _ => .exit
  | .read a ls, _ => .read a ls
  | .write a ls, w => .write a ls w
  | .writeShared a ls, w => .writeShared a ls w
  | .pin p, _ => .pin p
  | .unpin o, _ => .unpin o
  | .endUse p, _ => .endUse p
  | .free p auth, _ => .free p auth
  | .alloc pr ow ls, _ => .alloc pr ow ls
  | .store a p, _ => .store a p

/-- The `ok` step of `kopOf op w` is the `ok` outcome of `op` (Spec 1 §58, §60–§75). -/
theorem opStep_kopOf {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} {t t' : S3} :
    OpStep k (kopOf op w) t t' ↔ op.Step k t (.ok t') := by
  cases op <;> exact Iff.rfl

/-- The raw operations of the transfer phases of the by-value composite (WC4 C5.2): for each
by-value argument in its declared order, the realization of O4 (Spec 1 §63, §82.2, §82.3,
`transferOps`) executed by `c` on the state produced by the earlier transfers, in the memory state
produced by the earlier copies. -/
def valOps {Ty : Type} (π : Refinement.Params Ty) (c : Nat) :
    SC → List (Nat × Nat) → Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty)
  | _, [], _ => []
  | t, v :: vs, m => transferOps π.L π.ty m (t.view c) v.1 v.2 ++
      valOps π c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs (run m (transferOps π.L π.ty m (t.view c) v.1 v.2))

/-- The raw operations realizing a labelled step from `s`, the memory state being `m` (WC4 C2,
C4–C8, C13–C18; Spec 1 §82 preamble, §82.2–§82.5), at the grain of abstract steps:
- an inherited operation O1–O16 executed by `c`: the realization `opsOf` of
  `Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement` on the view of `c` (WC4 C2), with the written representations `w`;
- `spawn` (WC4 C4): the creations of the root locals of O6 (Spec 1 §72, §82.4); the yield of the
  parameters has no memory effect;
- the by-value composite (WC4 C5): its phases in order, the creations of the root locals (C5.1),
  then the realizations of O4 by transfer in the declared order (C5.2), the yield (C5.3) having
  none;
- `terminate` (WC4 C7): the realization of O7 on the view of `c` (Spec 1 §73, §82.5);
  reparenting (WC4 C6) has no memory effect;
- `join` (WC4 C8) and `deriveSync` (WC4 C15, O1 has no storage effect, Spec 1 §60): none;
- `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`, `resetLock` (WC4 C13, C16–C18): none, the registry only; the
  physical controller and its correspondence with the registry are the realization obligation
  WC4 OB-C05, not modelled;
- the arena operations (Spec 1 §76–§78, §82.7; WC4 C19), with the arena registry `ar`: the
  realizations of their kernel steps executed by `c`, in order (Part XIV, as
  `Ern.MemoryModel.RefinementArena.lopsOf`): none for `newArena`; `split` of `internal` (none)
  then `store` of the block into the destination (Spec 1 §82.3) for `issue`; `derive` then
  `release` (none) for `reset`. -/
def realize {Ty : Type} (π : Refinement.Params Ty) (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) :
    Label → SC → ArenaReg → Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty)
  | .kernel c op, s, _, m => opsOf π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m
  | .spawn c _ ls, s, _, m =>
    allocOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok (s.view c).P.length m (rootIdx ls.toShape)
  | .spawnVal c _ ls vs, s, _, m =>
    allocOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok (s.view c).P.length m (rootIdx ls.toShape) ++
      valOps π c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs
        (run m (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok (s.view c).P.length m (rootIdx ls.toShape)))
  | .terminate c, s, _, _ => exitOps π.L π.rtok (s.view c)
  | .join .., _, _, _ => []
  | .deriveSync .., _, _, _ => []
  | .newMutex .., _, _, _ => []
  | .acquire .., _, _, _ => []
  | .unlock .., _, _, _ => []
  | .resetLock .., _, _, _ => []
  | .newArena .., _, _, _ => []
  | .issue c i region dst, s, ar, m =>
    match ar[i]? with
    | some E =>
      opsOf π (kopOf (.split E.internal [region]) w) (s.view c) m ++
        opsOf π (kopOf (.store s.A.length dst) w)
          ((s.set (splitEff (s.view c) E.internal [region])).view c)
          (run m (opsOf π (kopOf (.split E.internal [region]) w) (s.view c) m))
    | none => []
  | .reset c i, s, ar, m =>
    match ar[i]? with
    | some E =>
      opsOf π (kopOf (.derive E.internal (footprint s.P E.storage) .modify) w) (s.view c) m ++
        opsOf π (kopOf (.release s.A.length) w)
          ((s.set (deriveEff (s.view c) E.internal (footprint s.P E.storage) .modify)).view c) m
    | none => []

/-- WC4 OB-C05: `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock` and `resetLock` have no raw operation in this
realization; their physical controller update is not modelled. -/
theorem realize_sync {Ty : Type} (π : Refinement.Params Ty) (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
    (s : SC) (ar : ArenaReg) (m : Machine.State) (c g i : Nat) :
    realize π w (.newMutex c g) s ar m = [] ∧ realize π w (.acquire c i) s ar m = [] ∧
      realize π w (.unlock c i) s ar m = [] ∧ realize π w (.resetLock c i) s ar m = [] :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- The realization of `issue` of a registered entry is the `store` of the block into the
destination on the state after `split` (Spec 1 §77, §82.3; Part XIV): `split` has none. -/
theorem realize_issue {Ty : Type} (π : Refinement.Params Ty)
    (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) {s : SC} {ar : ArenaReg} {m : Machine.State}
    {c i dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} {E : Arena.ArenaEntry} (hE : ar[i]? = some E) :
    realize π w (.issue c i region dst) s ar m =
      storeOps π.pe m π.L π.ty ((s.set (splitEff (s.view c) E.internal [region])).view c)
        s.A.length dst := by
  simp only [realize, hE]; rfl

/-- `newArena` and `reset` have no raw operation (Spec 1 §76, §78; Part XIV: `derive` and
`release` have none, Spec 1 §60, §62). -/
theorem realize_arena_nil {Ty : Type} (π : Refinement.Params Ty)
    (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) (s : SC) (ar : ArenaReg) (m : Machine.State)
    (c st i : Nat) :
    realize π w (.newArena c st i) s ar m = [] ∧ realize π w (.reset c i) s ar m = [] := by
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  simp only [realize]; split <;> rfl

/-- The obligations of one labelled step (Spec 1 §20.3, §82; WC4 C2): for an inherited operation
executed by `c`, those of `Refinement.StepObl` on the view of `c` (the parametric obligations of
its reads and writes, §15, §16; the layout of new places, §82.1, §23; the instantiation of
`K.FreeCompat`, §80, §70.2, §82.4); for `spawn` and the by-value composite, the parametric
obligations of its raw operations and the layout of the new locals (§82.1, §23); for the other
labels, the parametric obligations of their raw operations. -/
def StepOblC {Ty : Type} (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
    (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (π : Refinement.Params Ty)
    (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) : Label → SC → ArenaReg → Machine.State → Prop
  | .kernel c op, s, _, m => StepObl k C ObR ObW π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m

theorem reprC_of_flat {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s' : SC} {t : S3} {m : Machine.State}
    (hflat : s'.flat = { t with F := s'.frames }) (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ t.F ↔ f ∈ s'.frames)
    (h : Refinement.Repr L rtok t m) : ReprC L rtok s' m := by
  unfold ReprC; rw [hflat]
  exact (repr_frames_congr fun f => (hF f).symm).2 h

/-- `ReprC` after a step that changes no place, initialization state or death marker, and no
context (WC4 C2; Spec 1 §82.1, §82.3, §82.5). -/
theorem reprC_set_same {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s : SC} {t : S3} {m : Machine.State}
    (hP : t.P = s.P) (hI : t.I = s.I) (hd : t.dead = s.dead) (h : ReprC L rtok s m) :
    ReprC L rtok (s.set t) m :=
  repr_congr (t := s.flat) (t' := (s.set t).flat) h hP hI hd fun _ => Iff.rfl

/-- `ReprC` is kept by the yield of WC4 C5.3, which changes holders only. -/
theorem reprC_yield {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {t : SC} {ps : List Nat} {f : Nat}
    {m : Machine.State} (h : ReprC L rtok t m) : ReprC L rtok (yieldEff t ps f) m :=
  repr_congr (t := t.flat) (t' := (yieldEff t ps f).flat) h rfl rfl rfl fun _ => Iff.rfl

/-! ## Realization of the labels (WC4 C2, C4–C8, C13–C18; Spec 1 §82.2–§82.5) -/

/-- The kernel operation of `Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement` (Spec 1 §60–§75) for an operation
O1–O16, with the representations `w` written by `write` and `writeShared` (Spec 1 §10 ¶4, §16 ¶2),
data of the program that the kernel does not read. -/
def kopOf : KernelOp → (Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) → KOp
  | .derive src region m, _ => .derive src region m
  | .split src rs, _ => .split src rs
  | .release a, _ => .release a
  | .transfer src dst, _ => .transfer src dst
  | .depend q x, _ => .depend q x
  | .enter ps ls, _ => .enter ps ls
  | .exit, _ => .exit
  | .read a ls, _ => .read a ls
  | .write a ls, w => .write a ls w
  | .writeShared a ls, w => .writeShared a ls w
  | .pin p, _ => .pin p
  | .unpin o, _ => .unpin o
  | .endUse p, _ => .endUse p
  | .free p auth, _ => .free p auth
  | .alloc pr ow ls, _ => .alloc pr ow ls
  | .store a p, _ => .store a p

/-- The `ok` step of `kopOf op w` is the `ok` outcome of `op` (Spec 1 §58, §60–§75). -/
theorem opStep_kopOf {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} {t t' : S3} :
    OpStep k (kopOf op w) t t' ↔ op.Step k t (.ok t') := by
  cases op <;> exact Iff.rfl

/-- The raw operations of the transfer phases of the by-value composite (WC4 C5.2): for each
by-value argument in its declared order, the realization of O4 (Spec 1 §63, §82.2, §82.3,
`transferOps`) executed by `c` on the state produced by the earlier transfers, in the memory state
produced by the earlier copies. -/
def valOps {Ty : Type} (π : Refinement.Params Ty) (c : Nat) :
    SC → List (Nat × Nat) → Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty)
  | _, [], _ => []
  | t, v :: vs, m => transferOps π.L π.ty m (t.view c) v.1 v.2 ++
      valOps π c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs (run m (transferOps π.L π.ty m (t.view c) v.1 v.2))

/-- The raw operations realizing a labelled step from `s`, the memory state being `m` (WC4 C2,
C4–C8, C13–C18; Spec 1 §82 preamble, §82.2–§82.5), at the grain of abstract steps:
- an inherited operation O1–O16 executed by `c`: the realization `opsOf` of
  `Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement` on the view of `c` (WC4 C2), with the written representations `w`;
- `spawn` (WC4 C4): the creations of the root locals of O6 (Spec 1 §72, §82.4); the yield of the
  parameters has no memory effect;
- the by-value composite (WC4 C5): its phases in order, the creations of the root locals (C5.1),
  then the realizations of O4 by transfer in the declared order (C5.2), the yield (C5.3) having
  none;
- `terminate` (WC4 C7): the realization of O7 on the view of `c` (Spec 1 §73, §82.5);
  reparenting (WC4 C6) has no memory effect;
- `join` (WC4 C8) and `deriveSync` (WC4 C15, O1 has no storage effect, Spec 1 §60): none;
- `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`, `resetLock` (WC4 C13, C16–C18): none, the registry only; the
  physical controller and its correspondence with the registry are the realization obligation
  WC4 OB-C05, not modelled;
- the arena operations (Spec 1 §76–§78, §82.7; WC4 C19), with the arena registry `ar`: the
  realizations of their kernel steps executed by `c`, in order (Part XIV, as
  `Ern.MemoryModel.RefinementArena.lopsOf`): none for `newArena`; `split` of `internal` (none)
  then `store` of the block into the destination (Spec 1 §82.3) for `issue`; `derive` then
  `release` (none) for `reset`. -/
def realize {Ty : Type} (π : Refinement.Params Ty) (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) :
    Label → SC → ArenaReg → Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty)
  | .kernel c op, s, _, m => opsOf π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m
  | .spawn c _ ls, s, _, m =>
    allocOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok (s.view c).P.length m (rootIdx ls.toShape)
  | .spawnVal c _ ls vs, s, _, m =>
    allocOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok (s.view c).P.length m (rootIdx ls.toShape) ++
      valOps π c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs
        (run m (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok (s.view c).P.length m (rootIdx ls.toShape)))
  | .terminate c, s, _, _ => exitOps π.L π.rtok (s.view c)
  | .join .., _, _, _ => []
  | .deriveSync .., _, _, _ => []
  | .newMutex .., _, _, _ => []
  | .acquire .., _, _, _ => []
  | .unlock .., _, _, _ => []
  | .resetLock .., _, _, _ => []
  | .newArena .., _, _, _ => []
  | .issue c i region dst, s, ar, m =>
    match ar[i]? with
    | some E =>
      opsOf π (kopOf (.split E.internal [region]) w) (s.view c) m ++
        opsOf π (kopOf (.store s.A.length dst) w)
          ((s.set (splitEff (s.view c) E.internal [region])).view c)
          (run m (opsOf π (kopOf (.split E.internal [region]) w) (s.view c) m))
    | none => []
  | .reset c i, s, ar, m =>
    match ar[i]? with
    | some E =>
      opsOf π (kopOf (.derive E.internal (footprint s.P E.storage) .modify) w) (s.view c) m ++
        opsOf π (kopOf (.release s.A.length) w)
          ((s.set (deriveEff (s.view c) E.internal (footprint s.P E.storage) .modify)).view c) m
    | none => []

/-- WC4 OB-C05: `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock` and `resetLock` have no raw operation in this
realization; their physical controller update is not modelled. -/
theorem realize_sync {Ty : Type} (π : Refinement.Params Ty) (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
    (s : SC) (ar : ArenaReg) (m : Machine.State) (c g i : Nat) :
    realize π w (.newMutex c g) s ar m = [] ∧ realize π w (.acquire c i) s ar m = [] ∧
      realize π w (.unlock c i) s ar m = [] ∧ realize π w (.resetLock c i) s ar m = [] :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- The realization of `issue` of a registered entry is the `store` of the block into the
destination on the state after `split` (Spec 1 §77, §82.3; Part XIV): `split` has none. -/
theorem realize_issue {Ty : Type} (π : Refinement.Params Ty)
    (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) {s : SC} {ar : ArenaReg} {m : Machine.State}
    {c i dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} {E : Arena.ArenaEntry} (hE : ar[i]? = some E) :
    realize π w (.issue c i region dst) s ar m =
      storeOps π.pe m π.L π.ty ((s.set (splitEff (s.view c) E.internal [region])).view c)
        s.A.length dst := by
  simp only [realize, hE]; rfl

/-- `newArena` and `reset` have no raw operation (Spec 1 §76, §78; Part XIV: `derive` and
`release` have none, Spec 1 §60, §62). -/
theorem realize_arena_nil {Ty : Type} (π : Refinement.Params Ty)
    (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) (s : SC) (ar : ArenaReg) (m : Machine.State)
    (c st i : Nat) :
    realize π w (.newArena c st i) s ar m = [] ∧ realize π w (.reset c i) s ar m = [] := by
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  simp only [realize]; split <;> rfl

/-- The obligations of one labelled step (Spec 1 §20.3, §82; WC4 C2): for an inherited operation
executed by `c`, those of `Refinement.StepObl` on the view of `c` (the parametric obligations of
its reads and writes, §15, §16; the layout of new places, §82.1, §23; the instantiation of
`K.FreeCompat`, §80, §70.2, §82.4); for `spawn` and the by-value composite, the parametric
obligations of its raw operations and the layout of the new locals (§82.1, §23); for the other
labels, the parametric obligations of their raw operations. -/
def StepOblC {Ty : Type} (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
    (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (π : Refinement.Params Ty)
    (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) : Label → SC → ArenaReg → Machine.State → Prop
  | .kernel c op, s, _, m => StepObl k C ObR ObW π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m

/-- Effect of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §65 effect, WC4 C2). -/
def storeEffC (s : SC) (c a p : Nat) : SC := s.set (storeEff (s.view c) a p)

/-- Preconditions of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §65 re-indexed, WC4 C2). -/
structure StorePreC (s : SC) (c a p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §65.1: the authority is active, derived, and held by the current frame. -/
  derivedHeld : OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top) False
  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: `target` is usable. -/
  usable : (s.view c).Usable p
  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: `target` is a leaf. -/
  leaf : isLeaf (s.view c).P p
  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: exercisable `Modify` over `target`. -/
  right : HasRight (s.view c) .modify p
  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: `target` holds no active authority. -/
  free : ∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length,
    OptP ((s.view c).A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True
  /-- Spec 1 §65.3: the authority covers no leaf of `target` nor of storage it owns. -/
  noCover : ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P p ∧
    ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, OwnedIn (s.view c).P p q →
      l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P q
  /-- Spec 1 §65.4 re-indexed: the effective anchor respects `AnchorOrder` (on `ancestorC`)
  relative to the frame of `target`. -/
  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOKC s a ((s.view c).pframe p)
  /-- Spec 1 §65.5: in the resulting state, `target` is under exercisable `Modify`. -/
  keepsTarget : HasRight (storeEff (s.view c) a p) .modify p
  /-- Spec 1 §65.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (storeEffC s c a p)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §65). -/
instance (s : SC) (c a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePreC s c a p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
      y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top) False ∧ (s.view c).Usable p ∧ isLeaf (s.view c).P p ∧
    HasRight (s.view c) .modify p ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length,
      OptP ((s.view c).A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P p ∧
      ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, OwnedIn (s.view c).P p q →
        l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P q) ∧
    EffAnchorOKC s a ((s.view c).pframe p) ∧ HasRight (storeEff (s.view c) a p) .modify p ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (storeEffC s c a p))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩⟩

/-- Decidability of `EndUseAnchorOK` (§69.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseAnchorOK s p x) := by
  unfold EndUseAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `endUse` (§69). -/
structure EndUsePre (k : K) (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §69.1: `place` is usable. -/
  usable : s.Usable p
  /-- §69.1: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p
  /-- §69.2: no active derived authority over an ending leaf is held outside the dying places,
  except the authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `place`: some
  authority grounding that right and its origin chain. -/
  access : ∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ EndUseAccessOK s p j
  /-- §69.2, last sentence: no authority that the effect makes inactive has an active descendant
  that the effect does not make inactive. -/
  keptDesc : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
    ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active j
  /-- §69.3: no place usable after the effect depends on an authority held by `place`, its root,
  or an authority whose holder dies. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s p).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q, EndUseAnchorOK s p x
  /-- §69.4: no ending leaf, owned storage included, is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `endUse` (§69). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (EndUsePre k s p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ EndUseAccessOK s p j) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
      ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active j) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s p).Usable q →
      ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q, EndUseAnchorOK s p x) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩

/-- `endUse` as a relation (§69). -/
def EndUseStep (k : K) (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (EndUsePre k s p) (endUseEff s p)

/-! ## O13 `free` (§70) -/

/-- The holder is a place (§70.1). -/
def Holder.isPlace : Holder → Bool
  | .place _ => true
  | .frame _ => false

/-- `OwnedRoot` (§70.1): a place with no structural parent, owned by a place. -/
def OwnedRoot (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.P[p]?) (fun pl => pl.parent = none ∧ pl.owner.isPlace = true) False

/-- Decidability of `OwnedRoot` (§70.1). -/

    s.Usable provider ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init) ∧
    (HasRight s .modify provider ∨
      ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)) ∧
    HasRight s .modify owner ∧ s.Usable owner)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- Places after `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): the elements of the shape appended, owned by
`owner`. -/
def allocP (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place :=
  shapeP s.P (.place owner) ls.toShape

/-- Effect of `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): a new storage root of fresh identities owned by
`owner`, its leaves `Uninit`, no anchor, alive, with a root `Modify` authority with no origin held
by `owner`; pinning obligations are unchanged. -/
def allocEff (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : S3 :=
  { s with
    P := allocP s owner ls
    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
    A := s.A ++ (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (allocP s owner ls) (s.P.length + i),
        shapeOwner ls.toShape (.place owner) i, true⟩
    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q }

/-- `alloc provider owner shape` as a relation (§71 outcomes, §58): `reject` when a static
precondition fails; `fail`, state unchanged, when `K.Satisfiable` is false; `ok` otherwise. -/
inductive AllocStep (k : K) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (s : S3) :
    Outcome3 S3 → Prop where
  | ok : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
      AllocStep k provider owner ls s (.ok (allocEff s owner ls))
  | fail : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → ¬ k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
      AllocStep k provider owner ls s .fail
  | reject : ¬ AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → AllocStep k provider owner ls s .reject

/-! ## O15 `pin`, O16 `unpin` (§74, §75) -/

/-- Preconditions of `pin` (§74). "Applicable pinning obligations" is not represented. -/
structure PinPre (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §74: `place` is usable. -/
  usable : s.Usable p
  /-- §74: exercisable `Modify` over the leaves of `place`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `pin` (§74). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (PinPre s p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `pin` (§74, `ok` effect): an active dynamic pinning obligation of fresh identity
`|pins|` is installed on the leaves of `place`. -/
def pinEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with pins := s.pins ++ [⟨p, footprint s.P p, true⟩] }

/-- `pin` as a relation (§74). -/
def PinStep (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (PinPre s p) (pinEff s p)

/-- Effect of `unpin` (§75, `ok` effect): the designated obligation `o` ends, and only that
one. -/
def unpinEff (s : S3) (o : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with pins := s.pins.modify o fun ob => { ob with active := false } }

/-- Preconditions of `unpin o` (§75), `o` the identity of a dynamic pinning obligation. -/
structure UnpinPre (k : K) (s : S3) (o : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §75: `unpin` designates an active dynamic pinning obligation. -/
  active : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => ob.active = true) False
  /-- §75: `place`, on which the obligation was installed by `pin`, is usable. -/
  usable : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => s.Usable ob.place) False
  /-- §75: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
  right : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => HasRight s .modify ob.place) False
  /-- §75: `K.ExternalDone`, applied to the obligation. -/
  externalDone : k.ExternalDone o

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `unpin` (§75). -/

theorem acquire_ctlUnique {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat}
    {st' : SC × SyncReg} (h : AcquireOk k L s reg c i st') (hw : WF3 s.flat)
    (hs : SyncCore L s reg) (hu : CtlUnique L s reg) : CtlUnique L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  obtain ⟨-, e, hi, -, hpre, rfl⟩ := h
  have hA : (deriveSyncEff s c e.guarded).A = s.A ++ [⟨.modify, some e.guarded,
      (s.view c).afp e.guarded, .frame (s.view c).top, true⟩] := rfl
  obtain ⟨hsk, hh⟩ := skel_append hA rfl (fun j y' hy' => ⟨y', hy', Same.refl _⟩) fun z hz => by
    rw [List.mem_singleton] at hz; subst hz
    exact .inr ⟨e.guarded, rfl, active_lt hpre.active, hpre.active, fun l hl => hl⟩
  exact ctlUnique_set hi rfl (ctlUnique_step hsk hs (fun x hx _ hc =>
    ctl_same_eq (s' := deriveSyncEff s c e.guarded) hw (pskel_refl _)
      (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (hs.1 x hx).bound hsk.len) hh hc) hu)

    {st' : SC × SyncReg} (h : UnlockOk L s reg c i st') (hw : WF3 s.flat)
    (hs : SyncCore L s reg) (hu : CtlUnique L s reg) : CtlUnique L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  obtain ⟨-, e, g₀, hi, -, -, hpre, -, rfl⟩ := h

def LibInv (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) : Prop :=
  SyncState L st.1 st.2.1 ∧ AdminSep st.1 st.2.1 st.2.2 ∧ ArenaInvC st.1 st.2.2

/-- With an empty arena registry, `LibInv` is `SyncState` (`AdminSep` and `ArenaInvC` range over
the entries of the arena registry). -/
theorem libInv_nil {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} :
    LibInv L (s, reg, []) ↔ SyncState L s reg := by
  refine ⟨fun h => h.1, fun h => ⟨h, ?_, ?_⟩⟩

/-- WC4 S18 (C21.7 with Spec 1 §63.3): under `SyncState`, a `transfer` whose destination contains
the mutex value of a live entry is rejected, its controller leaf being `Init`. Positive twins:
`Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces.invA`, `Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces.invB`. -/
theorem transfer_into_live_mutex_rejected {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg}
    {c src dst m : Nat} {s : SC} {e : SyncEntry} (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hs : SyncState L s reg)
    (he : e ∈ reg) (hl : e.Live s) (hm : mutexOf s e.guarded = some m)
    (hmd : partOf s.P m dst) : ¬ TransferPreC k s c src dst := by
  intro hpre
  have h3 := hs.1.control e he hl
  have h4 := hs.1.ctlInit e he hl
  cases hco : ControlOf L s e with
  | none => rw [hco] at h3; exact h3
  | some ctl =>
    rw [hco] at h3 h4; simp only [OptP] at h3 h4
    obtain ⟨y, q, m', hy, hh, hm', -, hkc⟩ := SyncPreserveAux.controlOf_spec hco
    have hy' : s.A[e.guarded]? = some y := hy
    have hmm : mutexOf s e.guarded = some m' := by simp [mutexOf, hy', hh, hm']
    rw [hm] at hmm; cases hmm
    have hcm : parentOf s.P ctl = some m := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hkc)).2
    have hcmp : partOf s.P ctl m := ⟨h3.1.lt, .inr (by
      rw [chain_cons hcm (WF3.parent_lt (s := s.flat) hw hcm).1]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..)⟩
    have hcd : ctl ∈ footprint s.P dst :=

    exact hpre.dstNotInit ctl hcd h4

  exact .of (skel_enter rfl hpre.params) (pskel_shapeP hpre.localsOK)
    (src_roots rfl (length_mapI _ _ _) fun z hz => by obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hz; rfl)

    show (exitEff (s.view c)).A.length = _; simp [exitEff, length_mapI]; rfl))
