import Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.Graph

/-!
# Invariant and coherence of the controller graph

Brief of milestone 4, slice 2, layer R, task 3 (`formal/reports/spec2-m4-mutexreal.md`):

* the invariant: along the trace, the recorded grant of `e` is `none` exactly when the last
  modification of the controller wrote `0` (`ctl_invariant`); it reads only the registry, so it
  covers the abandoned grant, recorded and inactive with the controller at `1`;
* coherence: the controller graph is well typed for every well-typed triple of orders and
  `EventConsistent` for every triple (`ctlGraph_coherent`).

The coherence proof is split: a statement on lists of controller events (`mkGraph_consistent`:
every RMW reads `0` from the event before it), then the invariant, which gives that condition on a
trace. Neither needs `Encap5R`: they use the `ok` steps of the trace and the absence of a taken
grant for `e` in its first state.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal

open Ern.Concurrency

/-! ## Lists of controller events -/

/-- The events have the kinds of the declared realization (brief, hypothesis 1): a successful RMW
reading `0` and writing `1`, or an atomic write of `0`. -/
def CtlShape (evs : List EventModel.Ev) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ evs, (∃ o, x.kind = .rmw o 0 1) ∨ ∃ o, x.kind = .wsh o 0

/-- Every RMW reads `0`: the event just before it, which it reads by hypothesis 2, wrote `0`. -/
def PredZero (evs : List EventModel.Ev) : Prop :=
  ∀ j x, evs[j]? = some x → kindIsRmw x.kind = true → (mkGraph evs).valW j = some 0

/-- The controller events of a trace have the kinds of the declared realization. -/
theorem ctlShape_ctlEvs (o : Ords) (e : Nat) (lbls : List Label) : CtlShape (ctlEvs o e lbls) := by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨⟨c, op⟩, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx
  cases op
  · exact Or.inl ⟨o.acq, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨o.rel, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨o.reset, rfl⟩

section Pure

variable {evs : List EventModel.Ev}

/-- Size of `mkGraph`. -/
theorem size_mkGraph : (mkGraph evs).size = evs.length + 1 := rfl

/-- `mo` of `mkGraph` is the order of the event indices. -/
theorem mo_mkGraph {a b : Nat} : EventModel.MO (mkGraph evs) a b ↔ a < b ∧ b < evs.length + 1 := by
  unfold EventModel.MO
  rw [show (mkGraph evs).mo = allPairs (evs.length + 1) from rfl, mem_allPairs, size_mkGraph]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h, -, -⟩; exact h
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩; exact ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, Nat.lt_trans h1 h2, h2⟩

/-- `rf` of `mkGraph`: each RMW reads the event just before it. -/
theorem rf_mkGraph {w r : Nat} : EventModel.RF (mkGraph evs) w r ↔
    r = w + 1 ∧ (evs[w]?.map fun x => kindIsRmw x.kind) = some true := by
  unfold EventModel.RF
  rw [show (mkGraph evs).rf = rfPairs evs from rfl, mem_rfPairs, size_mkGraph]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h, -, -⟩; exact h
  · rintro ⟨rfl, h⟩
    have hw : w < evs.length := by
      cases hx : evs[w]? with
      | none => rw [hx] at h; cases h
      | some _ => exact (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hx).1
    exact ⟨⟨rfl, h⟩, by omega, by omega⟩

/-- The kind of the initial write. -/
theorem kind?_mkGraph_zero : (mkGraph evs).kind? 0 = none := EventModel.kind?_zero _

/-- Every event of `mkGraph` of controller events is a modification (WC5.1 corrigé C31). -/
theorem isMod_mkGraph (hs : CtlShape evs) {i : Nat} (hi : i < evs.length + 1) :
    (mkGraph evs).isMod i = true := by
  cases i with
  | zero => simp [EventModel.Graph.isMod]
  | succ j =>
    have hj : j < evs.length := by omega
    have hk := kind?_mkGraph evs j
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj, Option.map_some] at hk
    unfold EventModel.Graph.isMod
    rw [hk]
    rcases hs _ (List.getElem_mem hj) with ⟨o, ho⟩ | ⟨o, ho⟩ <;> rw [ho] <;> simp

/-- An event of `mkGraph` of controller events reads `x` exactly when it is an RMW. -/
theorem isReadX_mkGraph (hs : CtlShape evs) {r : Nat} (h : (mkGraph evs).isReadX r = true) :
    ∃ j x, r = j + 1 ∧ evs[j]? = some x ∧ ∃ o, x.kind = .rmw o 0 1 := by
  cases r with
  | zero =>
    unfold EventModel.Graph.isReadX at h; rw [kind?_mkGraph_zero] at h; cases h
  | succ j =>
    unfold EventModel.Graph.isReadX at h
    rw [kind?_mkGraph] at h
    cases hx : evs[j]? with
    | none => rw [hx] at h; cases h
    | some x =>
      refine ⟨j, x, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
      rcases hs x (List.mem_of_getElem? hx) with hr | ⟨o, ho⟩
      · exact hr
      · rw [hx] at h; simp [ho] at h

/-- Edges of `po ∪ sw` of `mkGraph` increase the index. -/
theorem poSw_lt_mkGraph {a b : Nat} (h : EventModel.PoSw (mkGraph evs) a b) : a < b := by
  rcases h with ⟨-, h, -⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩
  · exact h
  · rw [(rf_mkGraph.1 h).1]; exact Nat.lt_succ_self a

/-- `hb` of `mkGraph` increases the index. -/
theorem hb_lt_mkGraph {a b : Nat} (h : EventModel.HB (mkGraph evs) a b) : a < b := by
  rcases h with h | ⟨rfl, h, -⟩
  · induction h with
    | single h => exact poSw_lt_mkGraph h
    | tail _ h ih => exact Nat.lt_trans ih (poSw_lt_mkGraph h)
  · exact h

/-- Edges of `rf ∪ mo ∪ rb` of `mkGraph` increase the index. -/
theorem ecoBase_lt_mkGraph {a b : Nat} (h : EventModel.EcoBase (mkGraph evs) a b) : a < b := by
  rcases h with h | h | ⟨⟨w, -, hwa, hwb⟩, hne⟩
  · rw [(rf_mkGraph.1 h).1]; exact Nat.lt_succ_self a
  · exact (mo_mkGraph.1 h).1
  · have h1 := (rf_mkGraph.1 hwa).1
    have h2 := (mo_mkGraph.1 hwb).1
    omega

/-- `eco` of `mkGraph` increases the index. -/
theorem eco_lt_mkGraph {a b : Nat} (h : EventModel.ECO (mkGraph evs) a b) : a < b := by
  induction h with
  | single h => exact ecoBase_lt_mkGraph h
  | tail _ h ih => exact Nat.lt_trans ih (ecoBase_lt_mkGraph h)

/-- Brief, task 3: a list of controller events of the declared realization whose RMWs each read
`0` gives a consistent graph (WC5.1 corrigé C31, C33): the five conjuncts of `EventConsistent`.
`po`, `sw`, `rf`, `mo` and `rb` all increase the index, which gives coherence. -/
theorem mkGraph_consistent (hs : CtlShape evs) (hp : PredZero evs) :
    EventModel.EventConsistent (mkGraph evs) := by
  have hcoh : EventModel.Coherent (mkGraph evs) := fun a _ =>
    ⟨fun h => Nat.lt_irrefl _ (hb_lt_mkGraph h),
     fun b _ hab hba => Nat.lt_irrefl _ (Nat.lt_trans (hb_lt_mkGraph hab) (eco_lt_mkGraph hba))⟩
  refine ⟨⟨fun w hw r _ hwr => ?_, fun r _ hr => ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, hcoh,
    EventModel.hbIrrefl_of_coherent hcoh⟩
  · obtain ⟨rfl, hk⟩ := rf_mkGraph.1 hwr
    cases hx : evs[w]? with
    | none => rw [hx] at hk; cases hk
    | some x =>
      rw [hx] at hk
      have hxr : kindIsRmw x.kind = true := by simpa using hk
      obtain ⟨o, ho⟩ : ∃ o, x.kind = .rmw o 0 1 := by
        rcases hs x (List.mem_of_getElem? hx) with h | ⟨o, ho⟩
        · exact h
        · rw [ho] at hxr; cases hxr
      refine ⟨isMod_mkGraph hs (by rw [size_mkGraph] at hw; exact List.mem_range.1 hw), ?_, ?_⟩
      · unfold EventModel.Graph.isReadX; rw [kind?_mkGraph, hx]; simp [ho]
      · rw [hp w x hx hxr]
        simp [EventModel.Graph.valR, kind?_mkGraph, hx, ho]
  · obtain ⟨j, x, rfl, hx, o, ho⟩ := isReadX_mkGraph hs hr
    have hrf : EventModel.RF (mkGraph evs) j (j + 1) :=
      rf_mkGraph.2 ⟨rfl, by rw [hx]; simp [ho, kindIsRmw]⟩
    refine ⟨j, List.mem_range.2 hrf.2.1, hrf, fun w' _ h' => ?_⟩
    have := (rf_mkGraph.1 h').1
    omega
  · intro a ha b hb hab
    exact ⟨isMod_mkGraph hs (List.mem_range.1 ha), isMod_mkGraph hs (List.mem_range.1 hb)⟩
  · intro a _ h
    exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ (mo_mkGraph.1 h).1
  · intro a _ b _ c _ hab hbc
    exact mo_mkGraph.2 ⟨Nat.lt_trans (mo_mkGraph.1 hab).1 (mo_mkGraph.1 hbc).1,
      (mo_mkGraph.1 hbc).2⟩
  · intro a ha b hb _ _ hne
    have ha' := List.mem_range.1 ha
    have hb' := List.mem_range.1 hb
    rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (mo_mkGraph.2 ⟨h, hb'⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (mo_mkGraph.2 ⟨h, ha'⟩)
  · intro m _ _ w _ hwm
    obtain ⟨rfl, -⟩ := rf_mkGraph.1 hwm
    refine ⟨mo_mkGraph.2 ⟨Nat.lt_succ_self w, hwm.2.2⟩, fun c _ ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ?_⟩
    have := (mo_mkGraph.1 h1).1
    have := (mo_mkGraph.1 h2).1
    omega

/-- `valW` of `mkGraph` below the length of a prefix. -/
theorem valW_mkGraph_append {ys : List EventModel.Ev} {j : Nat} (hj : j ≤ evs.length) :
    (mkGraph (evs ++ ys)).valW j = (mkGraph evs).valW j := by
  cases j with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ j =>
    simp only [EventModel.Graph.valW, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, kind?_mkGraph]
    rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by omega)]

end Pure

/-! ## Typing -/

/-- A triple of orders is well typed when each order is in its row of WC5.1 corrigé C40: the RMW
of `acquire` (every order), the writes of `unlock` and `resetLock` (`relaxed`, `release`,
`seq_cst`). -/
def Ords.WellTyped (o : Ords) : Prop :=
  (CtlOp.acq.kind o).OrdOk ∧ (CtlOp.unl.kind o).OrdOk ∧ (CtlOp.rst.kind o).OrdOk

/-- Brief, task 3: for a well-typed triple of orders, the controller graph is well typed (WC5.1
corrigé C40). -/
theorem ctlGraph_wellTyped {o : Ords} (ho : o.WellTyped) (e : Nat) (lbls : List Label) :
    EventModel.WellTyped (ctlGraph o e lbls) := by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨⟨c, op⟩, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx
  cases op
  · exact ho.1
  · exact ho.2.1
  · exact ho.2.2

/-! ## The invariant -/

/-- The value written by the last modification in `mo` of a graph. -/
def lastW (g : EventModel.Graph) : Option Nat := g.valW g.evs.length

/-- Change of entry `e` of the registry by a step `lbl`, from `r` to `r'`: `acquire(e)` finds the
grant `none` and records some grant; `unlock(e)` and `resetLock(e)` record `none`; any other step
keeps entry `e`, or creates it with grant `none` when it did not exist (`newMutex`). -/
def EntryStep (e : Nat) (lbl : Label) (r r' : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  match ctlOp e lbl with
  | some (_, .acq) => ∃ x, r[e]? = some x ∧ x.grant = none ∧ ∃ g, r'[e]? = some { x with grant := g }
      ∧ g ≠ none
  | some (_, _) => ∃ x, r[e]? = some x ∧ r'[e]? = some { x with grant := none }
  | none => r'[e]? = r[e]? ∨ (r[e]? = none ∧ ∃ x, r'[e]? = some x ∧ x.grant = none)

/-- Entry `e` of a registry after `set` at another index. -/
theorem getElem?_set_other {r : SyncReg} {i e : Nat} {y : SyncEntry} (h : i ≠ e) :
    (r.set i y)[e]? = r[e]? := List.getElem?_set_ne h

/-- The registry effect of an `ok` step on entry `e` (WC5.1 corrigé C13, C16–C18 effects; every
other labelled step keeps the registry). -/
theorem lstep_entry {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (e : Nat) : EntryStep e lbl st.2.1 st'.2.1 := by
  have keep : ∀ (l : Label), ctlOp e l = none → st'.2.1 = st.2.1 → EntryStep e l st.2.1 st'.2.1 :=
    fun l hl hr => by unfold EntryStep; rw [hl]; exact Or.inl (by rw [hr])
  cases h with
  | kernel => exact keep _ rfl rfl
  | spawn => exact keep _ rfl rfl
  | terminate => exact keep _ rfl rfl
  | join => exact keep _ rfl rfl
  | deriveSync => exact keep _ rfl rfl
  | spawnVal => exact keep _ rfl rfl
  | newArena => exact keep _ rfl rfl
  | issue => exact keep _ rfl rfl
  | reset => exact keep _ rfl rfl
  | @newMutex s reg ar c g st' hn =>
    obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ := hn
    unfold EntryStep
    simp only [ctlOp]
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge e reg.length with he | he
    · exact Or.inl (List.getElem?_append_left he)
    · rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le he with rfl | he
      · refine Or.inr ⟨List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (Nat.le_refl _), ⟨g, none⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
        simp
      · refine Or.inl ?_
        rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (by simp; omega), List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (by omega)]
  | @acquire s reg ar c i st' ha =>
    obtain ⟨-, x, hx, ⟨-, hg, -⟩, -, rfl⟩ := ha
    unfold EntryStep
    by_cases hi : i = e
    · subst hi
      simp only [ctlOp, ↓reduceIte]
      refine ⟨x, hx, hg, some s.A.length, ?_, by simp⟩
      rw [List.getElem?_set_self (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hx).1]
    · simp only [ctlOp, hi, ↓reduceIte]
      exact Or.inl (getElem?_set_other hi)
  | @unlock s reg ar c i st' hu =>
    obtain ⟨-, x, g, hx, -, -, -, -, rfl⟩ := hu
    unfold EntryStep
    by_cases hi : i = e
    · subst hi
      simp only [ctlOp, ↓reduceIte]
      exact ⟨x, hx, List.getElem?_set_self (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hx).1⟩
    · simp only [ctlOp, hi, ↓reduceIte]
      exact Or.inl (getElem?_set_other hi)
  | @resetLock s reg ar c i st' hr =>
    obtain ⟨-, x, hx, -, -, -, rfl⟩ := hr
    unfold EntryStep
    by_cases hi : i = e
    · subst hi
      simp only [ctlOp, ↓reduceIte]
      exact ⟨x, hx, List.getElem?_set_self (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hx).1⟩
    · simp only [ctlOp, hi, ↓reduceIte]
      exact Or.inl (getElem?_set_other hi)

/-- The controller events of a prefix extended by one step. -/
theorem ctlEvs_take_succ (o : Ords) (e : Nat) {lbls : List Label} {n : Nat}
    (hn : n < lbls.length) :
    ctlEvs o e (lbls.take (n + 1)) = ctlEvs o e (lbls.take n) ++
      ((ctlOp e lbls[n]).toList.map fun p => (⟨p.1, p.2.kind o⟩ : EventModel.Ev)) := by
  rw [ctlEvs, ctlOps_take_succ e hn, List.map_append]; rfl

/-- The last value after appending an event. -/
theorem lastW_snoc (evs : List EventModel.Ev) (x : EventModel.Ev) :
    lastW (mkGraph (evs ++ [x])) = (mkGraph [x]).valW 1 := by
  simp [lastW, mkGraph, EventModel.Graph.valW, EventModel.Graph.kind?, EventModel.Graph.ev?]

/-- `PredZero` of a list extended by one event. -/
theorem predZero_snoc {evs : List EventModel.Ev} {x : EventModel.Ev} (hp : PredZero evs)
    (hx : kindIsRmw x.kind = true → lastW (mkGraph evs) = some 0) : PredZero (evs ++ [x]) := by
  intro j y hy hr
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j evs.length with hj | hj
  · rw [valW_mkGraph_append (Nat.le_of_lt hj)]
    rw [List.getElem?_append_left hj] at hy
    exact hp j y hy hr
  · have hj' : j = evs.length := by
      have := (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hy).1
      simp at this; omega
    subst hj'
    rw [List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_refl _), Nat.sub_self] at hy
    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at hy
    subst hy
    rw [valW_mkGraph_append (Nat.le_refl _)]
    exact hx hr

/-- Brief, task 3, the invariant: along the `ok` steps of a trace whose first state has no taken
grant for entry `e`, at every state `n`, (1) when entry `e` exists, its recorded grant is `none`
exactly when the last modification of the controller (the `mo`-last event of the controller graph
of the steps before `n`) wrote `0`; (2) when it does not exist, no protocol step on `e` occurred;
(3) every RMW of the controller graph reads `0`. The statement reads only the registry, not the
activity of the grant: it covers the abandoned grant (WC5.1 corrigé C18), recorded and inactive,
with the controller at `1`. -/
theorem ctl_invariant {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (hs : ∀ i (h : i < lbls.length), LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1)))
    {e : Nat} (h0 : ∀ x, (σ 0).2.1[e]? = some x → x.grant = none) (o : Ords) :
    ∀ n, n ≤ lbls.length →
      (∀ x, (σ n).2.1[e]? = some x →
        (x.grant = none ↔ lastW (ctlGraph o e (lbls.take n)) = some 0)) ∧
      ((σ n).2.1[e]? = none → ctlOps e (lbls.take n) = []) ∧
      PredZero (ctlEvs o e (lbls.take n))
  | 0, _ => by
    refine ⟨fun x hx => ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun _ => h0 x hx⟩, fun _ => rfl, ?_⟩
    intro j y hy; simp [ctlEvs, ctlOps] at hy
  | n + 1, hn => by
    have hn' : n < lbls.length := hn
    obtain ⟨ihA, ihB, ihC⟩ := ctl_invariant hs h0 o n (Nat.le_of_lt hn')
    have hstep := lstep_entry (hs n hn') e
    have hevs := ctlEvs_take_succ o e hn'
    have hops := ctlOps_take_succ e hn'
    unfold ctlGraph
    rw [hevs, hops]
    unfold EntryStep at hstep
    cases hop : ctlOp e lbls[n] with
    | none =>
      rw [hop] at hstep
      simp only [Option.toList_none, List.map_nil, List.append_nil]
      refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun hx => ?_, ihC⟩
      · rcases hstep with hst | ⟨hnone, y, hy, hyg⟩
        · rw [hst] at hx; exact ihA x hx
        · rw [hy] at hx; cases hx
          have hnil : ctlEvs o e (lbls.take n) = [] := by simp [ctlEvs, ihB hnone]
          rw [hnil]
          exact ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun _ => hyg⟩
      · rcases hstep with hst | ⟨-, y, hy, -⟩
        · rw [hst] at hx; exact ihB hx
        · rw [hy] at hx; cases hx
    | some p =>
      obtain ⟨c, op⟩ := p
      rw [hop] at hstep
      simp only [Option.toList_some, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
      cases op with
      | acq =>
        obtain ⟨x, hx, hxg, g, hy, hg⟩ := hstep
        refine ⟨fun y hy' => ?_, fun hy' => by rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy', ?_⟩
        · rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'
          rw [lastW_snoc]
          simp [mkGraph, EventModel.Graph.valW, EventModel.Graph.kind?, EventModel.Graph.ev?,
            CtlOp.kind, hg]
        · exact predZero_snoc ihC fun _ => (ihA x hx).1 hxg
      | unl =>
        obtain ⟨x, -, hy⟩ := hstep
        refine ⟨fun y hy' => ?_, fun hy' => by rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy', ?_⟩
        · rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'
          rw [lastW_snoc]
          simp [mkGraph, EventModel.Graph.valW, EventModel.Graph.kind?, EventModel.Graph.ev?,
            CtlOp.kind]
        · exact predZero_snoc ihC fun h => by simp [CtlOp.kind, kindIsRmw] at h
      | rst =>
        obtain ⟨x, -, hy⟩ := hstep
        refine ⟨fun y hy' => ?_, fun hy' => by rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy', ?_⟩
        · rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'
          rw [lastW_snoc]
          simp [mkGraph, EventModel.Graph.valW, EventModel.Graph.kind?, EventModel.Graph.ev?,
            CtlOp.kind]
        · exact predZero_snoc ihC fun h => by simp [CtlOp.kind, kindIsRmw] at h

/-! ## Coherence -/

/-- Brief, task 3, coherence: along the `ok` steps of a trace whose first state has no taken grant
for entry `e`, the controller graph is well typed for every well-typed triple of orders and
`EventConsistent` (WC5.1 corrigé C31, C33, C40). Consistency holds for every triple; typing needs a
well-typed one. -/
theorem ctlGraph_coherent {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (hs : ∀ i (h : i < lbls.length), LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1)))
    {e : Nat} (h0 : ∀ x, (σ 0).2.1[e]? = some x → x.grant = none) {o : Ords}
    (ho : o.WellTyped) :
    EventModel.WellTyped (ctlGraph o e lbls) ∧ EventModel.EventConsistent (ctlGraph o e lbls) := by
  refine ⟨ctlGraph_wellTyped ho e lbls, ?_⟩
  have h := (ctl_invariant hs h0 o lbls.length (Nat.le_refl _)).2.2
  rw [List.take_length] at h
  exact mkGraph_consistent (ctlShape_ctlEvs o e lbls) h

/-- Brief, task 3, coherence on a `Run5R` from a state with an empty registry, the first state of
every run from the initial state of Spec 1 §47. -/
theorem ctlGraph_coherent_run {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (hr : Run5R k L σ lbls) (h0 : (σ 0).2.1 = []) (e : Nat) {o : Ords}
    (ho : o.WellTyped) :
    EventModel.WellTyped (ctlGraph o e lbls) ∧ EventModel.EventConsistent (ctlGraph o e lbls) :=
  ctlGraph_coherent (fun i h => (hr i h).2) (fun x hx => by rw [h0] at hx; cases hx) ho

/-- The reference realization is well typed (WC5.1 corrigé C40). -/
theorem refOrds_wellTyped : refOrds.WellTyped := by decide

end Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal

/-! ## `endUse` on the controller or on a strict part of `slot` (Spec 1 §69; WC4 C22.5, S17) -/

/-- `endUse(lock = 2)` by context 0 after `newMutex` (Spec 1 §69). -/
def eU : SC := e2.set (endUseEff (e2.view 0) 2)

/-- WC4 S17a, C22.5 (a): from `e2`, reached by the encapsulated trace `traceMutex`, `endUse(lock)`
is an `ok` step of Spec 1 §69 re-indexed and `Encap` excludes it. Without the exclusion, after the
step `KInvCA` holds, the entry is live, its controller `lock` (place 2) is `Uninit` (Spec 1 §69
effect: "The leaves of value `place` become `Uninit`"), and `SyncInv` fails (`ctlInit`, WC4
C21.7). -/
theorem endUse_ctl_excluded :
    EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (e0, [], [])
      [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 1), .newMutex 0 4] (e2, reg1, []) ∧
    opStepC K0 (.endUse 2) 0 e2 (.ok eU) ∧ ¬ Encap L0 (e2, reg1) (.kernel 0 (.endUse 2)) ∧
    KInvCA eU ∧ (⟨4, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live eU ∧ ControlOf L0 eU ⟨4, none⟩ = some 2 ∧
    eU.I 2 = .uninit ∧ ¬ SyncInv L0 eU reg1 := by
  have hst : opStepC K0 (.endUse 2) 0 e2 (.ok eU) := ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩
  refine ⟨traceMutex, hst,
    fun h => (h ⟨4, none⟩ (List.mem_singleton_self _) (by decide)).1 (by decide),
    lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (lbl := .kernel 0 (.endUse 2)) (st := (e2, reg1, []))
      (st' := (eU, reg1, [])) (.kernel hst) inv2.1, by decide, by decide, by decide, fun h => ?_⟩
  have := h.ctlInit ⟨4, none⟩ (List.mem_singleton_self _) (by decide)
  revert this; decide

/-- `endUse(M = 0)` by context 0 after `newMutex` (Spec 1 §69). -/
def eM : SC := e2.set (endUseEff (e2.view 0) 0)

/-- Positive twin of `endUse_ctl_excluded` (WC4 C22.5, S17b positive): from `e2`, `endUse(M)` is
an `ok` step of Spec 1 §69 re-indexed admitted by `Encap`; the entry is live before the step and
not after it (`guarded`, held by `slot`, a place of `M`, becomes inactive), and the encapsulated
trace ending with it reaches a state where `KInvCA` and `SyncState` (`SyncInv`, `GrantDiscipline`)
hold (`trace_inv`). -/
theorem endUse_mutex_kills_entry :
    EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (e0, [], [])
      [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 1), .newMutex 0 4,
       .kernel 0 (.endUse 0)] (eM, reg1, []) ∧
    (⟨4, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live e2 ∧ ¬ (⟨4, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live eM ∧
    KInvCA eM ∧ SyncState L0 eM reg1 := by
  have hst : opStepC K0 (.endUse 0) 0 e2 (.ok eM) := ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩
  have he : Encap L0 (e2, reg1) (.kernel 0 (.endUse 0)) :=
    (by decide : ∀ e ∈ reg1, e.Live e2 → ControlOf L0 e2 e ≠ some 0 ∧
      OptP (slotOf e2 e.guarded) (fun q => partOf e2.P 0 q → 0 = q) True)
  have ht : EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (e0, [], [])
      [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 1), .newMutex 0 4,
       .kernel 0 (.endUse 0)] (eM, reg1, []) :=
    .cons (fun e he => by cases he) (.kernel step_derive) <|
    .cons trivial (.kernel step_store) <| .cons trivial (.newMutex step_newMutex.1) <|
    .cons he (.kernel hst) .nil
  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := init_inv (k := K0) ddK0 est_ok L0
  exact ⟨ht, by decide, by decide, (trace_inv ddK0 ht hk hs).1, (trace_inv ddK0 ht hk hs).2.1⟩

/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): `0` the mutex value `M` with fields `1` (`slot`, a structure with the
leaves `2` and `3`) and `4` (`lock`), all leaves `Init`; `5` the root `T`, owned by `slot`. Root
authorities: `0` of `M`, `1` of `T` (held by `slot`, `guarded`). -/
def sst : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false), ((some 1, none, 0), true),
   ((some 1, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((none, some 1, 0), true)]

/-- The statics are well formed (Spec 1 §47). -/
theorem sst_ok : StaticsOK sst := by decide

/-- Initial single-context state of `sst`. -/
def z0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init sst)

/-- `newMutex(1)` is enabled in `z0` (WC4 C13). -/
theorem z_newMutex : NewMutexOk K0 L0 [] z0 [] 0 1 (z0, [⟨1, none⟩]) := ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩

  | t, [] => t
  | t, v :: vs => transfersEff c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs

/-- Phase 3 of WC4 C5 (yield): the parameters `ps` change holder to the frame `f` (WC4 C4 effect,
Spec 1 §72 effect); no right is created. -/
def yieldEff (t : SC) (ps : List Nat) (f : Nat) : SC :=
  { t with A := mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame f } else y) 0 t.A }

/-- Effect of the composite (WC4 C5.1–C5.3): create, the transfers of `vs`, then the yield of `ps`
to the new frame `nF`. -/
def spawnValEff (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (vs : List (Nat × Nat)) :
    SC :=
  yieldEff (transfersEff c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs) ps s.nF

/-! ## Preconditions (WC4 C4, C5) -/

/-- WC4 C5 item 2: `dst` is a fresh root local of the initial frame of the new context (its leaves
are `Uninit`, it holds no derived authority and its root authority is held by that frame by
construction of `spawnCreate`). -/
def FreshRootLocal (s : SC) (ls : LocalShape) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ i ∈ rootIdx ls.toShape, dst = s.P.length + i

/-- Decidability of `FreshRootLocal` (WC4 C5 item 2). -/
instance (s : SC) (ls : LocalShape) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (FreshRootLocal s ls dst) := by
  unfold FreshRootLocal; infer_instance

/-- The clauses of O4 (Spec 1 §63) for the by-value argument `(src, dst)`, executed by the creating
context `c`, at the start of its transfer phase in state `t` (WC4 C5.2, C5 items 1, 3, 4): those
of `TransferPreC` other than the exercisable `Modify` over the destination (replaced by C5 item 2,
WC4 C5 item 3) and the resulting-state clauses; §63.8 is evaluated on the final state `fin` (WC4
C5.4). -/

are `Uninit`, it holds no derived authority and its root authority is held by that frame by
construction of `spawnCreate`). -/
def FreshRootLocal (s : SC) (ls : LocalShape) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ i ∈ rootIdx ls.toShape, dst = s.P.length + i

/-- Decidability of `FreshRootLocal` (WC4 C5 item 2). -/
instance (s : SC) (ls : LocalShape) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (FreshRootLocal s ls dst) := by
  unfold FreshRootLocal; infer_instance

/-- The clauses of O4 (Spec 1 §63) for the by-value argument `(src, dst)`, executed by the creating
context `c`, at the start of its transfer phase in state `t` (WC4 C5.2, C5 items 1, 3, 4): those
of `TransferPreC` other than the exercisable `Modify` over the destination (replaced by C5 item 2,
WC4 C5 item 3) and the resulting-state clauses; §63.8 is evaluated on the final state `fin` (WC4
C5.4). -/

import Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.MX
/-!
# Corpus of milestone 3, block AR
`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §0 block AR and §1 S3: an arena whose arena value is administered through a
mutex grant (WC4 C19; Spec 1 §36, §46, §76–§78), shared between contexts 0 and 1. One theorem per
verdict, written from `corpus-spec2-m3.md`; preconditions checked by `decide`.
The arena operations are those of `LStep` (`NewArenaStepC`, `IssueStepC`, `ResetStepC`): the
derived operations of `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena` executed by the context, `store` reading
`ancestorC` (WC4 C2, C3). `S3_8_view_literal` records that `Arena.IssueD` run on the view of the
executing context, which reads the stack order of the view instead of `ancestorC`, rejects step 8.
-/
namespace Ern.Concurrency.Corpus
open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency
open Ern.Concurrency.Traces (L0)
/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): `0` the mutex value `M2` with fields `1` (`slot2`, `Uninit`) and `2`
(`lock2`, `Init`); `3` the arena value `AV`, a root leaf owned by `M2`, `Init`; `4` the storage
`ST`, a root owned by frame 0 with the leaves `5` (`R1`) and `6` (`R2`); `7` the leaf `d0`, a root
owned by frame 0. Root authorities: `0` of `M2`, `1` of `AV` (held by `M2`), `2` of `ST`, `3` of
`d0`. -/
def arst : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
   ((none, some 0, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false), ((some 4, none, 0), false),
   ((some 4, none, 0), false), ((none, none, 0), false)]
/-- The statics are well formed (Spec 1 §47). -/
theorem arst_ok : StaticsOK arst := by decide
/-- The contract of block AR: `lock2` (place 2) is the only `SharedMutable` leaf. -/
abbrev KA : K := KC [2]
/-- Initial state of block AR. -/
def a0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init arst)
/-- AR step 1: `internal := derive(root_ST, Modify, footprint(ST))`, authority 4. -/
def a1 : SC := a0.set (deriveEff (a0.view 0) 2 [5, 6] .modify)
/-- AR step 1: `store(internal, AV)`. -/
def a2 : SC := storeEffC a1 0 4 3
/-- AR step 1: the arena registry after `newArena(ST, internal)` (O17): the arena value is `AV`. -/
def arA : ArenaReg := [⟨4, 4, [5, 6], []⟩]
/-- AR step 2: `guarded2 := derive(root_AV, Modify, {AV})`, authority 5. -/
def a3 : SC := a2.set (deriveEff (a2.view 0) 1 [3] .modify)
/-- AR step 2: `store(guarded2, slot2)`. -/
def a4 : SC := storeEffC a3 0 5 1
/-- AR step 2: the synchronization registry after `newMutex(guarded2)`, entry `e2` (WC4 C13). -/
def regA : SyncReg := [⟨5, none⟩]
/-- AR step 3: `o1 := derive(root_M2, Observe, {slot2, lock2})`, authority 6. -/
def a5 : SC := a4.set (deriveEff (a4.view 0) 0 [1, 2] .observe)
/-- AR step 3: `spawn c1` yielding `o1`, with the local leaf `d1` (place 8, root authority 7):
context 1, initial frame 1. -/
def a6 : SC := spawnEff a5 0 [6] [(none, 0)]
/-- The construction of block AR (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §0): an `EncapsulatedTrace` from the
initial state (WC4 C22, C23); `ControlOf(e2) = lock2`, the arena value is `AV`, and
`{AV} ∩ {slot2, lock2} = ∅` (WC4 C13.4). -/
theorem ar_trace : EncapsulatedTrace KA L0 (a0, [], [])
    [.kernel 0 (.derive 2 [5, 6] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 3), .newArena 0 4 4,
     .kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 5 1), .newMutex 0 5,
     .kernel 0 (.derive 0 [1, 2] .observe), .spawn 0 [6] [(none, 0)]] (a6, regA, arA) ∧
    ControlOf L0 a4 ⟨5, none⟩ = some 2 ∧ Arena.arenaValue a2.flat ⟨4, 4, [5, 6], []⟩ = some 3 := by
  refine ⟨?_, by decide, by decide⟩
  have hn : NewMutexOk KA L0 arA a4 [] 0 5 (a4, regA) := ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩
  have ha : NewArenaStepC a2 [] [] 0 4 4 (.ok (a2, arA)) := ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩
  exact .cons (fun e he => by cases he) (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons trivial (.kernel ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) <|
    .cons trivial (.newArena ha) <|
    .cons (fun e he => by cases he) (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons trivial (.kernel ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) <|
    .cons trivial (.newMutex hn) <|
    .cons (by decide : ∀ e ∈ regA, e.Live a4 → 0 ≠ e.guarded)
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons trivial (.spawn ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) .nil
/-! ## S3 (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S3) -/
/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S3, step 1, `reject` (Spec 1 §77.1, `MetaRight`: context 1 has no
exercisable `Modify` over `AV`, only `Observe` over `M2`): `issue(arena, R1, d1)` by context 1
without grant, rejected by a static check. -/
theorem S3_1_reject : IssueStepC KA a6 arA 1 0 [5] 8 .reject ∧
    ¬ Arena.MetaRight (a6.view 1) ⟨4, 4, [5, 6], []⟩ :=
  ⟨.static (by decide) rfl (by decide), by decide⟩
/-- `c1 : acquire(e2)`: `g2`, authority 8, held by frame 1 (WC4 C16). -/
def a7 : SC := deriveSyncEff a6 1 5
/-- The registry with `g2` recorded. -/
def regA8 : SyncReg := [⟨5, some 8⟩]
/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S3, step 2, `ok` (WC4 C16): `acquire(e2)` by context 1. -/
theorem S3_2_ok : AcquireOk KA L0 a6 regA 1 0 (a7, regA8) :=
  ⟨by decide, ⟨5, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩
/-- `split(internal, [R1])` by context 1: the block, authority 9, held by frame 1 (O2). -/
def a8s : SC := a7.set (splitEff (a7.view 1) 4 [[5]])
/-- `store(block, d1)` by context 1 (O8). -/
def a8 : SC := storeEffC a8s 1 a7.A.length 8
/-- The arena registry after the issue of `R1` (Spec 1 §77 effect). -/
def arA1 : ArenaReg := arA.set 0 (Arena.issueMeta a7.flat ⟨4, 4, [5, 6], []⟩ [5])
/-- The block of `R1` is authority 9; `R2` is still available (Spec 1 §77 effect). -/
theorem arA1_eq : a7.A.length = 9 ∧ arA1 = [⟨4, 4, [6], [([5], 9)]⟩] := by decide
/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S3, step 3, `ok` (Spec 1 §43 clause 2: `g2` gives `Modify` over `{AV}`,
so `ExercisableAt(internal, Modify)`; §77.3, §77.6: `d1` is a local leaf of context 1 and the
effective anchor `root_ST` is in frame 0, an ancestor): `issue(arena, R1, d1)` by context 1. -/
theorem S3_3_ok : IssueStepC KA a7 arA 1 0 [5] 8 (.ok (a8, arA1)) :=
  .ok (E := ⟨4, 4, [5, 6], []⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide) ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩

    (hy : (endUseEff v p).A[j]? = some y') (ha : y'.active = true) :
    ∃ y, v.A[j]? = some y ∧ ¬ heldIn v.P p y.holder := by
  have e1 : (endUseEff v p).A[j]? = ((endUseS v p).A[j]?).map (fun y =>
      if HolderLive (endUseS v p) y.holder then y else { y with active := false }) := by
    simp only [endUseEff, cleanup, List.getElem?_map]
  have e2 : (endUseS v p).A[j]? = (v.A[j]?).map (fun y =>
      if heldIn v.P p y.holder then { y with active := false } else y) := by
    simp only [endUseS, List.getElem?_map]
  rw [e1, e2] at hy
  cases hv : v.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [hv] at hy; cases hy
  | some y =>
    rw [hv] at hy
    refine ⟨y, rfl, fun hh => ?_⟩
    simp only [Option.map_some, hh, ↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq] at hy
    subst hy
    by_cases hL : HolderLive (endUseS v p) y.holder
    · simp [hL] at ha
    · simp [hL] at ha

/-- `endUse` (Spec 1 §69) preserves `SyncState` under `Encap` (WC4 C22.5). -/
theorem endUse_syncState {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {c p : Nat} {s s' : SC}
    (h : opStepC k (.endUse p) c s (.ok s')) (he : Encap L (s, reg) (.kernel c (.endUse p)))
    (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hw' : WF3 s'.flat) (hs : SyncState L s reg) : SyncState L s' reg := by
  have hx : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ControlOf L s e ≠ some p ∧
      OptP (slotOf s e.guarded) (fun q => partOf s.P p q → p = q) True := he
  have hf := opStep_facts (reg := reg) h he (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw
  obtain ⟨hc, hu, hsi, hci⟩ := syncState_iff.1 hs
  obtain ⟨t, hR, rfl⟩ := viewStep_ok h
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hR
  have hI : ∀ l, (s.set (endUseEff (s.view c) p)).I l =
      if l ∈ footprint s.P p then .uninit else s.I l := fun _ => rfl
  -- the slot of a live entry after the step is not within `p`
  have hslot : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live (s.set (endUseEff (s.view c) p)) →
      ∃ y q, s.A[e.guarded]? = some y ∧ y.holder = .place q ∧ ¬ partOf s.P q p ∧
        slotOf s e.guarded = some q ∧
        slotOf (s.set (endUseEff (s.view c) p)) e.guarded = some q := by
    intro e he' hl
    have heo := hc.1 e he'
    have hl₀ := hf.skel.active heo.bound hl
    obtain ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩ := hl
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hnh⟩ := endUse_active (v := s.view c) hy' ya'
    have h1 := heo.guarded hl₀
    have hy₀ : s.A[e.guarded]? = some y := hy
    rw [hy₀] at h1; simp only [OptP] at h1
    cases hh : y.holder with
    | frame f => rw [hh] at h1; exact h1.2.elim
    | place q =>
      have hh' : y'.holder = .place q := by rw [hf.hold _ y y' q hy₀ hy' hh, hh]
      refine ⟨y, q, hy₀, hh, fun hq => hnh (by rw [hh]; exact hq), by simp [slotOf, hy₀, hh],
        by simp [slotOf, show (s.set (endUseEff (s.view c) p)).A[e.guarded]? = some y' from hy',
          hh']⟩
  refine syncState_iff.2 ⟨kernel_step_same hf.skel hf.hold hf.pskel hw hw' hc hf.src,
    facts_ctlUnique hf hw hc hu, fun e he' hl => ?_, fun e he' hl => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨y, q, hy, hh, hnq, hsl, hsl'⟩ := hslot e he' hl
    have hl₀ := hf.skel.active (hc.1 e he').bound hl
    have h2 := hsi e he' hl₀
    rw [hsl] at h2
    rw [hsl']
    intro l hl'
    rw [hI]
    have hnot : l ∉ footprint s.P p := fun hp => by
      have hx' := (hx e he' hl₀).2
      rw [hsl] at hx'
      rcases footprint_comparable (t := s.flat) hw hl' hp with h₁ | h₁

/-- Two places sharing a leaf are structurally comparable (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem footprint_comparable (hw : WF3 t) {a b l : Nat} (ha : l ∈ footprint t.P a)
    (hb : l ∈ footprint t.P b) : partOf t.P a b ∨ partOf t.P b a := by
  obtain ⟨hlP, -, hla⟩ := mem_footprint.1 ha
  obtain ⟨-, -, hlb⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hb
  exact partOf_total hw (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hla hlb

/-- A strict ancestor of a place with parent `m` is an ancestor of `m` (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem partOf_parent (hw : WF3 t) {x a m : Nat} (h : partOf t.P x a) (hne : x ≠ a)
    (hm : parentOf t.P x = some m) : partOf t.P m a := by
  obtain ⟨o, ho, -, hor⟩ := mem_chain (h.2.resolve_left hne)
  rw [hm] at ho; cases ho
  exact ⟨(WF3.parent_lt hw hm).2, hor.elim (fun e => .inl e.symm) .inr⟩

/-- A leaf has no strict part (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem partOf_leaf (hw : WF3 t) : ∀ (n y : Nat), y < n → ∀ {x : Nat}, isLeaf t.P x →
    partOf t.P y x → y = x
  | 0, _, h, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, y, hy, x, hx, h => by
    rcases h.2 with e | hc
    · exact e
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpy, hor⟩ := mem_chain hc
    rcases hor with rfl | hor
    · exact absurd hp (hx y h.1)
    · have := partOf_leaf hw n p (by omega) hx ⟨(WF3.parent_lt hw hp).2, .inr hor⟩
      subst this
      exact absurd hp (hx y h.1)

/-- A leaf in the footprint of a place is a part of it (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem leaf_mem_footprint {x q : Nat} (hx : isLeaf t.P x) (h : partOf t.P x q) :
    x ∈ footprint t.P q :=
  mem_footprint.2 ⟨h.1, hx, h⟩

/-- A leaf in the footprint of a place is the place or a strict part of it (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem partOf_of_mem_footprint {x q : Nat} (h : x ∈ footprint t.P q) : partOf t.P x q :=
  (mem_footprint.1 h).2.2

def S3.addAuth (s : S3) (y : Authority) : S3 := { s with A := s.A ++ [y] }

/-! ## Exercisable authorities (§43) -/

/-- `ExercisableAt(s, a, m)` (§43): `a` is active, its own mode permits `m`, and it is held by
the current frame, or by a place `p` such that an authority itself exercisable at `m` has an
effective mode permitting `m` on every leaf of `p`. Inductive along the holder chain (§43), so no
holder cycle justifies a right. -/

  | base {a : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → m.le y.mode →
      y.holder = .frame s.top → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
  | held {a p b : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
      m.le y.mode → y.holder = .place p → S3.ExercisableAt s b m →
      (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) → S3.ExercisableAt s a m

import Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.Coherence
import Ern.Concurrency.Reachable

/-!
# Classification of the steps that touch the controller

Brief of milestone 4, slice 2, layer R, task 4 (`formal/reports/spec2-m4-mutexreal.md`): for a
live entry `e`, each of the 28 kinds of labels (the 16 kernel operations and the 12 other labels
of `Label`) gets one status. The footprint of a step (`Touches`) is the notion of the brief:
the accesses of `read3`, `write3`, `writeShared` (`Label.Access`), and the source and destination
places of the steps that change an initialization state or a holder (`KernelOp.Writes` of Spec 1
§59 for `store` and `transfer`, extended to the source of `transfer`, to `endUse`, `alloc`,
`issue`, the by-value composite and the fresh locals); for the protocol steps, the controller of
their entry, by the declared realization (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` v10 §2 nonies).

This module proves the statuses `exclu` and `fin de vie` (`classified_sound`) and completeness
for those kinds and the protocol kinds (`completeness`). The witnesses of the statuses
`déplacement`, `fin de vie` and `contre-exemple` are in `Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.Witness`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal

open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency
open SyncPreserveAux SyncInitAux

/-! ## Footprint -/

/-- The footprint of step `lbl` from state `st` (brief, task 4): the leaves the step reads or
writes, or whose initialization state or holder relation it changes. `read3`, `write3`,
`writeShared`: their leaves (`Label.Access`). `store`: its target (Spec 1 §59, `KernelOp.Writes`;
§65 effect: the holder of the authority becomes the target). `transfer`: the leaves of the source
(they become `Moved`) and of the destination (written, §59). `endUse`: the leaves of the place
(they become `Uninit`, §69). `alloc`: the provider (§71.2), the owner (holder of the new root,
§71) and the fresh leaves. `enterFrame`, `spawn`: the fresh locals. By-value `spawn`: the fresh
locals and the sources of its transfers. `issue`: its destination (the `store` of the block,
§77). `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`, `resetLock`: the controller of their entry, by the declared
realization. The other steps change neither an initialization state nor a holder: empty. -/
def Touches (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) : Label → Nat → Prop
  | .kernel _ (.read _ ls), l | .kernel _ (.write _ ls), l | .kernel _ (.writeShared _ ls), l =>
    l ∈ ls
  | .kernel _ (.store _ p), l => l = p
  | .kernel _ (.transfer src dst), l => l ∈ footprint st.1.P src ∨ l ∈ footprint st.1.P dst
  | .kernel _ (.endUse p), l => l ∈ footprint st.1.P p
  | .kernel _ (.alloc pr ow _), l =>
    l ∈ footprint st.1.P pr ∨ l ∈ footprint st.1.P ow ∨ st.1.P.length ≤ l
  | .kernel _ (.enter _ _), l | .spawn _ _ _, l => st.1.P.length ≤ l
  | .spawnVal _ _ _ vs, l => st.1.P.length ≤ l ∨ ∃ v ∈ vs, l ∈ footprint st.1.P v.1
  | .issue _ _ _ dst, l => l = dst
  | .newMutex _ g, l => ControlOf L st.1 ⟨g, none⟩ = some l
  | .acquire _ i, l | .unlock _ i, l | .resetLock _ i, l =>
    (st.2.1[i]?).bind (ControlOf L st.1) = some l
  | _, _ => False

/-- Decidability of `Touches`. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbl : Label) (l : Nat) :
    Decidable (Touches L st lbl l) := by
  unfold Touches; split <;> infer_instance

/-! ## Kinds -/

/-- The kinds of status `exclu` (brief, task 4): `derive`, `split`, `depend`, `enterFrame`,
`exitFrame`, `read3`, `write3`, `writeShared`, `pin`, `unpin`, `free`, `spawn`, `terminate`,
`join`, `deriveSync`, `newArena`, `reset`. -/
def ExclKind : Label → Prop
  | .kernel _ (.derive _ _ _) | .kernel _ (.split _ _) | .kernel _ (.depend _ _)
  | .kernel _ (.enter _ _) | .kernel _ .exit | .kernel _ (.read _ _) | .kernel _ (.write _ _)
  | .kernel _ (.writeShared _ _) | .kernel _ (.pin _) | .kernel _ (.unpin _)
  | .kernel _ (.free _ _) | .spawn _ _ _ | .terminate _ | .join _ _ | .deriveSync _ _
  | .newArena _ _ _ | .reset _ _ => True
  | _ => False

/-- The kinds of status `fin de vie` (brief, task 4): `release`, `endUse`. -/
def FinKind : Label → Prop
  | .kernel _ (.release _) | .kernel _ (.endUse _) => True
  | _ => False

/-- The kinds of status `protocole` (brief, task 4). -/
def ProtoKind : Label → Prop
  | .newMutex _ _ | .acquire _ _ | .unlock _ _ | .resetLock _ _ => True
  | _ => False

/-! ## `exclu` and `fin de vie` -/

/-- An authority exercisable from a frame is active (Spec 1 §43). -/
theorem active_of_exercisable {t : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : t.ExercisableAt a m) :
    t.Active a := by
  cases h with
  | base hy ha => exact ⟨_, hy, ha⟩
  | held hy ha => exact ⟨_, hy, ha⟩

/-- A kernel step other than `transfer`, admitted by `Encap`, keeps the controller of an entry
(WC5.1 corrigé C12: positional `ControlOf`). -/
theorem kernel_ctl_same {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp}
    {s s' : SC} (hop : opStepC k op c s (.ok s')) (hEnc : Encap L (s, reg) (.kernel c op))
    (hnt : ∀ src dst, op ≠ .transfer src dst) (hw : WF3 s.flat) {x : SyncEntry} {ctl : Nat}
    (hb : x.guarded < s'.A.length) (hc : ControlOf L s x = some ctl) :
    ControlOf L s' x = some ctl :=
  have hf := opStep_facts (reg := reg) hop hEnc hnt hw
  ctl_same_eq hw hf.pskel hb hf.hold hc

/-- The controller of an entry is an existing place. -/
theorem ctl_lt {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {x : SyncEntry} {ctl : Nat}
    (hc : ControlOf L s x = some ctl) : ctl < s.P.length := by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hkc⟩ := controlOf_spec hc
  exact (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hkc)).1

/-- `endUse(p)` admitted by `Encap` after which the entry is still live does not touch its
controller (WC5.1 corrigé C22 item 5; Spec 1 §69): if the controller were a leaf of `p`, then `p`,
which is not the controller, would contain the mutex value and the place `slot` holding
`guarded`, and `guarded` would become inactive. -/
theorem endUse_ctl_not_touched {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {c p : Nat} {s s' : SC}
    (hop : opStepC k (.endUse p) c s (.ok s')) (hEnc : Encap L (s, reg) (.kernel c (.endUse p)))
    (hw : WF3 s.flat) {x : SyncEntry} (hx : x ∈ reg) (hl : x.Live s) (hl' : x.Live s')
    {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L s x = some ctl) : ctl ∉ footprint s.P p := by
  have hE : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ControlOf L s e ≠ some p ∧
      OptP (slotOf s e.guarded) (fun q => partOf s.P p q → p = q) True := hEnc
  obtain ⟨t, hR, rfl⟩ := viewStep_ok hop
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hR
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩ := hl'
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hnh⟩ := endUse_active (v := s.view c) hy' ya'
  obtain ⟨y₀, hp, m, hy₀, hh, hm, -, hkc⟩ := controlOf_spec hc
  have hy₁ : s.A[x.guarded]? = some y := hy
  rw [hy₀] at hy₁
  cases hy₁
  have hne : ctl ≠ p := fun h => (hE x hx hl).1 (h ▸ hc)
  have hcm : parentOf s.P ctl = some m := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hkc)).2
  have hmp := partOf_parent (t := s.flat) hw (partOf_of_mem_footprint (t := s.flat) hmem) hne hcm
  have hpP : hp < s.P.length := by
    simp only [parentOf] at hm
    cases hq : s.P[hp]? with
    | none => rw [hq] at hm; cases hm
    | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hq
  have hpm : partOf s.P hp m := ⟨hpP, .inr (by
    rw [chain_cons hm (WF3.parent_lt (s := s.flat) hw hm).1]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..)⟩
  exact hnh (by rw [hh]; exact partOf_trans (t := s.flat) hw hpm hmp)

/-- Brief, task 4, statuses `exclu` and `fin de vie`: an `ok` step of one of these kinds, admitted
by `Encap5R`, from a state satisfying `KInvCA` and the separation of the registries (both hold
along every encapsulated trace from the initial state, `trace_inv`), with a registered entry live
before and after the step, does not have the controller of the entry in its footprint and does
not change it. -/
theorem classified_sound {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label}
    {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} (hk : KInvCA st.1) (hsep : AdminSep st.1 st.2.1 st.2.2)
    (hkind : ExclKind lbl ∨ FinKind lbl) (he : Encap5R k L st lbl) (h : LStep k L lbl st st')
    {x : SyncEntry} (hx : x ∈ st.2.1) (hl : x.Live st.1) (hl' : x.Live st'.1) {ctl : Nat}
    (hc : ControlOf L st.1 x = some ctl) :
    ¬ Touches L st lbl ctl ∧ ControlOf L st'.1 x = some ctl := by
  have hw : WF3 st.1.flat := hk.1.1.2
  have hb : x.guarded < st'.1.A.length := active_lt hl'
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg ar c op hop =>
    have hEnc : Encap L (s, reg) (.kernel c op) := he.1.1
    have hctl : (∀ src dst, op ≠ .transfer src dst) → ControlOf L s' x = some ctl :=
      fun hnt => kernel_ctl_same hop hEnc hnt hw hb hc
    cases op with
    | transfer => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
    | store => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
    | alloc => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
    | read a ls =>
      have hx' := he.1.2.2 x hx hl
      rw [hc] at hx'
      exact ⟨hx', hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | write a ls =>
      have hx' := he.1.2.2 x hx hl
      rw [hc] at hx'
      exact ⟨hx', hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | writeShared a ls =>
      have hx' := he.1.2.2 x hx hl
      rw [hc] at hx'
      exact ⟨hx', hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | enter ps ls =>
      exact ⟨fun ht => Nat.not_lt.2 ht (ctl_lt hc), hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | endUse p =>
      exact ⟨endUse_ctl_not_touched hop hEnc hw hx hl hl' hc, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | derive => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | split => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | release => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | depend => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | exit => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | pin => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | unpin => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | free => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
  | @spawn s s' reg ar c ps ls hsp =>
    have hf := spawn_facts (reg := reg) hsp
    exact ⟨fun ht => Nat.not_lt.2 ht (ctl_lt hc), ctl_same_eq hw hf.pskel hb hf.hold hc⟩
  | @terminate s s' reg ar c ht =>
    have hf := term_facts (reg := reg) hw ht
    exact ⟨id, ctl_same_eq hw hf.pskel hb hf.hold hc⟩
  | @join s s' reg ar c d hj =>
    have hf := join_facts (reg := reg) hj
    exact ⟨id, ctl_same_eq hw hf.pskel hb hf.hold hc⟩
  | deriveSync hd => exact (deriveSync_excluded hd he.1.1).elim
  | newArena hn =>
    obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ := newArenaStepC_ok hn
    exact ⟨id, hc⟩
  | @reset s reg ar c i st' hr =>
    obtain ⟨E, s₁, hE, hd, hrl, -, -⟩ := resetStepC_ok (k := k) hr
    have hsep' : Encap L (s, reg) (.kernel c (.derive E.internal (footprint s.P E.storage) .modify)) :=
      fun e hm hl₀ heq => hsep e hm E (List.mem_of_getElem? hE) hl₀
        (by show s.flat.Active E.internal; rw [heq]; exact hl₀) heq.symm
    have hw₁ : WF3 s₁.flat := wf3_after_view hk.1.1.1
      (show ViewStep ((KernelOp.derive E.internal (footprint s.P E.storage) .modify).Step k) c s
        (.ok s₁) from hd)
      fun t' hR => by
        have hR' : DeriveStep E.internal (footprint s.P E.storage) .modify (s.view c) (.ok t') := hR
        refine ⟨derive_preserves_wf3 (SC.wf3_view hk.1.1.1 hw) hR', ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hR'; rfl
    have hf₂ := opStep_facts (reg := reg) hrl trivial (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw₁
    have hb₁ : x.guarded < s₁.A.length := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (active_lt hl) (opStep_facts
      (reg := reg) hd hsep' (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw).skel.len
    exact ⟨id, ctl_same_eq hw₁ hf₂.pskel hb hf₂.hold
      (kernel_ctl_same hd hsep' (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw hb₁ hc)⟩
  | newMutex => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
  | acquire => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
  | unlock => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
  | resetLock => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
  | spawnVal => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
  | issue => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind

/-! ## Completeness -/

/-- The event of the controller graph for the protocol step `i` on `e`. -/
theorem ctlGraph_ev (o : Ords) (e : Nat) {lbls : List Label} {i : Nat} (hi : i < lbls.length)
    {c : Nat} {op : CtlOp} (h : ctlOp e lbls[i] = some (c, op)) :
    (ctlGraph o e lbls).ev? (ctlIdx e lbls i) = some ⟨c, op.kind o⟩ := by
  simp only [EventModel.Graph.ev?, ctlIdx, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  exact ctlEvs_at o e hi h

/-- Brief, task 4, completeness, for the kinds `protocole`, `exclu` and `fin de vie`: at a step
`i` of a trace, taken under `Encap5R` from a state satisfying `KInvCA`, `SyncInv` and the
separation of the registries, while entry `e` is live before and after the step, a step that
touches the controller of `e` is a protocol step on `e`, hence an event of the controller graph,
the event `ctlIdx e lbls i`. The protocol steps of another entry touch another controller (WC5.1
corrigé C21 item 4, C13 item 8). Hypothesis 3 of the brief is not used: the kinds `déplacement`
are outside the statement. -/
theorem completeness {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} {i : Nat} (hi : i < lbls.length) (hst : LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1)))
    (he : Encap5R k L (σ i) lbls[i]) (hk : KInvCA (σ i).1)
    (hinv : SyncInv L (σ i).1 (σ i).2.1) (hsep : AdminSep (σ i).1 (σ i).2.1 (σ i).2.2)
    (hkind : ProtoKind lbls[i] ∨ ExclKind lbls[i] ∨ FinKind lbls[i]) {e : Nat} {x : SyncEntry}
    (hx : (σ i).2.1[e]? = some x) (hl : x.Live (σ i).1) (hl' : x.Live (σ (i + 1)).1)
    {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L (σ i).1 x = some ctl) (ht : Touches L (σ i) lbls[i] ctl)
    (o : Ords) :
    ∃ c op, ctlOp e lbls[i] = some (c, op) ∧
      (ctlGraph o e lbls).ev? (ctlIdx e lbls i) = some ⟨c, op.kind o⟩ := by
  suffices hp : ∃ c op, ctlOp e lbls[i] = some (c, op) by
    obtain ⟨c, op, h⟩ := hp
    exact ⟨c, op, h, ctlGraph_ev o e hi h⟩
  have hxm : x ∈ (σ i).2.1 := List.mem_of_getElem? hx
  rcases hkind with hp | hkind
  · -- a protocol step on another entry touches another controller
    have other : ∀ (j : Nat) (y : SyncEntry), (σ i).2.1[j]? = some y → y.Live (σ i).1 →
        ControlOf L (σ i).1 y = some ctl → j = e := fun j y hy hyl hyc =>
      hinv.ctlUnique j e y x ctl hy hx hyl hl hyc hc
    generalize hlbl : lbls[i] = lbl at hst he hp ht
    cases hst with
    | newMutex hn =>
      exfalso
      obtain ⟨-, hpre, -⟩ := hn
      have hcu := hpre.ctlUnique
      simp only [Touches] at ht
      rw [ht] at hcu
      exact hcu x hxm hl hc
    | @acquire s reg ar c j st' ha =>
      obtain ⟨-, y, hy, ⟨hyl, -⟩, -⟩ := ha
      simp only [Touches, hy, Option.bind_some] at ht
      obtain rfl := other j y hy hyl ht
      exact ⟨c, .acq, by simp [ctlOp]⟩
    | @unlock s reg ar c j st' hu =>
      obtain ⟨-, y, -, hy, hyl, -⟩ := hu
      simp only [Touches, hy, Option.bind_some] at ht
      obtain rfl := other j y hy hyl ht
      exact ⟨c, .unl, by simp [ctlOp]⟩
    | @resetLock s reg ar c j st' hr =>
      obtain ⟨-, y, hy, hex, -⟩ := hr
      simp only [Touches, hy, Option.bind_some] at ht
      obtain rfl := other j y hy (active_of_exercisable hex) ht
      exact ⟨c, .rst, by simp [ctlOp]⟩
    | _ => simp [ProtoKind] at hp
  · exact absurd ht (classified_sound hk hsep hkind he hst hxm hl hl' hc).1

/-! ## From the initial state -/

/-- The prefix of a `Run5R` is an encapsulated trace (WC5.1 corrigé C22, C23). -/
theorem run5R_prefix {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (hr : Run5R k L σ lbls) {i : Nat} (hi : i ≤ lbls.length) :
    EncapsulatedTrace k L (σ 0) (lbls.take i) (σ i) := by
  have hr' : Run5R k L σ (lbls.take i) := fun j hj => by
    have hj' : j < lbls.length := by simp at hj; omega
    have := hr j hj'
    simp only [List.getElem_take]
    exact this
  have h := run5R_trace hr'
  rw [List.length_take, Nat.min_eq_left hi] at h
  exact encapsulatedTrace5_imp (encapsulatedTrace5C_imp (encapsulatedTrace5R_imp h))

/-- Brief, task 4, completeness on a `Run5R` from the initial state of Spec 1 §47, under `DDSound`
(Spec 1 §80): the invariants of `completeness` hold at every step (`trace_inv`). -/
theorem completeness_run {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics}
    {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbls : List Label} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hstat : StaticsOK statics) (h0 : σ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []))
    (hr : Run5R k L σ lbls) {i : Nat} (hi : i < lbls.length)
    (hkind : ProtoKind lbls[i] ∨ ExclKind lbls[i] ∨ FinKind lbls[i]) {e : Nat} {x : SyncEntry}
    (hx : (σ i).2.1[e]? = some x) (hl : x.Live (σ i).1) (hl' : x.Live (σ (i + 1)).1)
    {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L (σ i).1 x = some ctl) (ht : Touches L (σ i) lbls[i] ctl)
    (o : Ords) :
    ∃ c op, ctlOp e lbls[i] = some (c, op) ∧
      (ctlGraph o e lbls).ev? (ctlIdx e lbls i) = some ⟨c, op.kind o⟩ := by
  have htr := run5R_prefix hr (Nat.le_of_lt hi)
  rw [h0] at htr
  obtain ⟨hk₀, hs₀⟩ := init_inv (k := k) hdd hstat L
  obtain ⟨hk, ⟨hs, -⟩, hsep, -⟩ := trace_inv hdd htr hk₀ hs₀
  exact completeness hi (hr i hi).2 (hr i hi).1 hk hs hsep hkind hx hl hl' hc ht o

end Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal

import Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.Coherence
import Ern.Concurrency.Reachable

/-!
# Classification of the steps that touch the controller

Brief of milestone 4, slice 2, layer R, task 4 (`formal/reports/spec2-m4-mutexreal.md`): for a
live entry `e`, each of the 28 kinds of labels (the 16 kernel operations and the 12 other labels
of `Label`) gets one status. The footprint of a step (`Touches`) is the notion of the brief:
the accesses of `read3`, `write3`, `writeShared` (`Label.Access`), and the source and destination
places of the steps that change an initialization state or a holder (`KernelOp.Writes` of Spec 1
§59 for `store` and `transfer`, extended to the source of `transfer`, to `endUse`, `alloc`,
`issue`, the by-value composite and the fresh locals); for the protocol steps, the controller of
their entry, by the declared realization (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` v10 §2 nonies).

This module proves the statuses `exclu` and `fin de vie` (`classified_sound`) and completeness
for those kinds and the protocol kinds (`completeness`). The witnesses of the statuses
`déplacement`, `fin de vie` and `contre-exemple` are in `Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.Witness`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal

open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency
open SyncPreserveAux SyncInitAux

/-! ## Footprint -/

/-- The footprint of step `lbl` from state `st` (brief, task 4): the leaves the step reads or
writes, or whose initialization state or holder relation it changes. `read3`, `write3`,
`writeShared`: their leaves (`Label.Access`). `store`: its target (Spec 1 §59, `KernelOp.Writes`;
§65 effect: the holder of the authority becomes the target). `transfer`: the leaves of the source
(they become `Moved`) and of the destination (written, §59). `endUse`: the leaves of the place
(they become `Uninit`, §69). `alloc`: the provider (§71.2), the owner (holder of the new root,
§71) and the fresh leaves. `enterFrame`, `spawn`: the fresh locals. By-value `spawn`: the fresh
locals and the sources of its transfers. `issue`: its destination (the `store` of the block,
§77). `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`, `resetLock`: the controller of their entry, by the declared
realization. The other steps change neither an initialization state nor a holder: empty. -/
def Touches (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) : Label → Nat → Prop
  | .kernel _ (.read _ ls), l | .kernel _ (.write _ ls), l | .kernel _ (.writeShared _ ls), l =>
    l ∈ ls
  | .kernel _ (.store _ p), l => l = p
  | .kernel _ (.transfer src dst), l => l ∈ footprint st.1.P src ∨ l ∈ footprint st.1.P dst
  | .kernel _ (.endUse p), l => l ∈ footprint st.1.P p
  | .kernel _ (.alloc pr ow _), l =>
    l ∈ footprint st.1.P pr ∨ l ∈ footprint st.1.P ow ∨ st.1.P.length ≤ l
  | .kernel _ (.enter _ _), l | .spawn _ _ _, l => st.1.P.length ≤ l
  | .spawnVal _ _ _ vs, l => st.1.P.length ≤ l ∨ ∃ v ∈ vs, l ∈ footprint st.1.P v.1
  | .issue _ _ _ dst, l => l = dst
  | .newMutex _ g, l => ControlOf L st.1 ⟨g, none⟩ = some l
  | .acquire _ i, l | .unlock _ i, l | .resetLock _ i, l =>
    (st.2.1[i]?).bind (ControlOf L st.1) = some l
  | _, _ => False

/-- Decidability of `Touches`. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbl : Label) (l : Nat) :
    Decidable (Touches L st lbl l) := by
  unfold Touches; split <;> infer_instance

/-! ## Kinds -/

/-- The kinds of status `exclu` (brief, task 4): `derive`, `split`, `depend`, `enterFrame`,
`exitFrame`, `read3`, `write3`, `writeShared`, `pin`, `unpin`, `free`, `spawn`, `terminate`,
`join`, `deriveSync`, `newArena`, `reset`. -/
def ExclKind : Label → Prop
  | .kernel _ (.derive _ _ _) | .kernel _ (.split _ _) | .kernel _ (.depend _ _)
  | .kernel _ (.enter _ _) | .kernel _ .exit | .kernel _ (.read _ _) | .kernel _ (.write _ _)
  | .kernel _ (.writeShared _ _) | .kernel _ (.pin _) | .kernel _ (.unpin _)
  | .kernel _ (.free _ _) | .spawn _ _ _ | .terminate _ | .join _ _ | .deriveSync _ _
  | .newArena _ _ _ | .reset _ _ => True
  | _ => False

/-- The kinds of status `fin de vie` (brief, task 4): `release`, `endUse`. -/
def FinKind : Label → Prop
  | .kernel _ (.release _) | .kernel _ (.endUse _) => True
  | _ => False

/-- The kinds of status `protocole` (brief, task 4). -/
def ProtoKind : Label → Prop
  | .newMutex _ _ | .acquire _ _ | .unlock _ _ | .resetLock _ _ => True
  | _ => False

/-! ## `exclu` and `fin de vie` -/

/-- An authority exercisable from a frame is active (Spec 1 §43). -/
theorem active_of_exercisable {t : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : t.ExercisableAt a m) :
    t.Active a := by
  cases h with
  | base hy ha => exact ⟨_, hy, ha⟩
  | held hy ha => exact ⟨_, hy, ha⟩

/-- A kernel step other than `transfer`, admitted by `Encap`, keeps the controller of an entry
(WC5.1 corrigé C12: positional `ControlOf`). -/
theorem kernel_ctl_same {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp}
    {s s' : SC} (hop : opStepC k op c s (.ok s')) (hEnc : Encap L (s, reg) (.kernel c op))
    (hnt : ∀ src dst, op ≠ .transfer src dst) (hw : WF3 s.flat) {x : SyncEntry} {ctl : Nat}
    (hb : x.guarded < s'.A.length) (hc : ControlOf L s x = some ctl) :
    ControlOf L s' x = some ctl :=
  have hf := opStep_facts (reg := reg) hop hEnc hnt hw
  ctl_same_eq hw hf.pskel hb hf.hold hc

/-- The controller of an entry is an existing place. -/
theorem ctl_lt {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {x : SyncEntry} {ctl : Nat}
    (hc : ControlOf L s x = some ctl) : ctl < s.P.length := by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hkc⟩ := controlOf_spec hc
  exact (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hkc)).1

/-- `endUse(p)` admitted by `Encap` after which the entry is still live does not touch its
controller (WC5.1 corrigé C22 item 5; Spec 1 §69): if the controller were a leaf of `p`, then `p`,
which is not the controller, would contain the mutex value and the place `slot` holding
`guarded`, and `guarded` would become inactive. -/
theorem endUse_ctl_not_touched {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {c p : Nat} {s s' : SC}
    (hop : opStepC k (.endUse p) c s (.ok s')) (hEnc : Encap L (s, reg) (.kernel c (.endUse p)))
    (hw : WF3 s.flat) {x : SyncEntry} (hx : x ∈ reg) (hl : x.Live s) (hl' : x.Live s')
    {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L s x = some ctl) : ctl ∉ footprint s.P p := by
  have hE : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ControlOf L s e ≠ some p ∧
      OptP (slotOf s e.guarded) (fun q => partOf s.P p q → p = q) True := hEnc
  obtain ⟨t, hR, rfl⟩ := viewStep_ok hop
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hR
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩ := hl'
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hnh⟩ := endUse_active (v := s.view c) hy' ya'
  obtain ⟨y₀, hp, m, hy₀, hh, hm, -, hkc⟩ := controlOf_spec hc
  have hy₁ : s.A[x.guarded]? = some y := hy
  rw [hy₀] at hy₁
  cases hy₁
  have hne : ctl ≠ p := fun h => (hE x hx hl).1 (h ▸ hc)
  have hcm : parentOf s.P ctl = some m := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hkc)).2
  have hmp := partOf_parent (t := s.flat) hw (partOf_of_mem_footprint (t := s.flat) hmem) hne hcm
  have hpP : hp < s.P.length := by
    simp only [parentOf] at hm
    cases hq : s.P[hp]? with
    | none => rw [hq] at hm; cases hm
    | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hq
  have hpm : partOf s.P hp m := ⟨hpP, .inr (by
    rw [chain_cons hm (WF3.parent_lt (s := s.flat) hw hm).1]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..)⟩
  exact hnh (by rw [hh]; exact partOf_trans (t := s.flat) hw hpm hmp)

/-- Brief, task 4, statuses `exclu` and `fin de vie`: an `ok` step of one of these kinds, admitted
by `Encap5R`, from a state satisfying `KInvCA` and the separation of the registries (both hold
along every encapsulated trace from the initial state, `trace_inv`), with a registered entry live
before and after the step, does not have the controller of the entry in its footprint and does
not change it. -/
theorem classified_sound {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label}
    {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} (hk : KInvCA st.1) (hsep : AdminSep st.1 st.2.1 st.2.2)
    (hkind : ExclKind lbl ∨ FinKind lbl) (he : Encap5R k L st lbl) (h : LStep k L lbl st st')
    {x : SyncEntry} (hx : x ∈ st.2.1) (hl : x.Live st.1) (hl' : x.Live st'.1) {ctl : Nat}
    (hc : ControlOf L st.1 x = some ctl) :
    ¬ Touches L st lbl ctl ∧ ControlOf L st'.1 x = some ctl := by
  have hw : WF3 st.1.flat := hk.1.1.2
  have hb : x.guarded < st'.1.A.length := active_lt hl'
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg ar c op hop =>
    have hEnc : Encap L (s, reg) (.kernel c op) := he.1.1
    have hctl : (∀ src dst, op ≠ .transfer src dst) → ControlOf L s' x = some ctl :=
      fun hnt => kernel_ctl_same hop hEnc hnt hw hb hc
    cases op with
    | transfer => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
    | store => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
    | alloc => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
    | read a ls =>
      have hx' := he.1.2.2 x hx hl
      rw [hc] at hx'
      exact ⟨hx', hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | write a ls =>
      have hx' := he.1.2.2 x hx hl
      rw [hc] at hx'
      exact ⟨hx', hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | writeShared a ls =>
      have hx' := he.1.2.2 x hx hl
      rw [hc] at hx'
      exact ⟨hx', hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | enter ps ls =>
      exact ⟨fun ht => Nat.not_lt.2 ht (ctl_lt hc), hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | endUse p =>
      exact ⟨endUse_ctl_not_touched hop hEnc hw hx hl hl' hc, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | derive => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | split => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | release => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | depend => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | exit => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | pin => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | unpin => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | free => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
  | @spawn s s' reg ar c ps ls hsp =>
    have hf := spawn_facts (reg := reg) hsp
    exact ⟨fun ht => Nat.not_lt.2 ht (ctl_lt hc), ctl_same_eq hw hf.pskel hb hf.hold hc⟩
  | @terminate s s' reg ar c ht =>
    have hf := term_facts (reg := reg) hw ht
    exact ⟨id, ctl_same_eq hw hf.pskel hb hf.hold hc⟩
  | @join s s' reg ar c d hj =>
    have hf := join_facts (reg := reg) hj
    exact ⟨id, ctl_same_eq hw hf.pskel hb hf.hold hc⟩
  | deriveSync hd => exact (deriveSync_excluded hd he.1.1).elim
  | newArena hn =>
    obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ := newArenaStepC_ok hn
    exact ⟨id, hc⟩
  | @reset s reg ar c i st' hr =>
    obtain ⟨E, s₁, hE, hd, hrl, -, -⟩ := resetStepC_ok (k := k) hr
    have hsep' : Encap L (s, reg) (.kernel c (.derive E.internal (footprint s.P E.storage) .modify)) :=
      fun e hm hl₀ heq => hsep e hm E (List.mem_of_getElem? hE) hl₀
        (by show s.flat.Active E.internal; rw [heq]; exact hl₀) heq.symm
    have hw₁ : WF3 s₁.flat := wf3_after_view hk.1.1.1
      (show ViewStep ((KernelOp.derive E.internal (footprint s.P E.storage) .modify).Step k) c s
        (.ok s₁) from hd)
      fun t' hR => by
        have hR' : DeriveStep E.internal (footprint s.P E.storage) .modify (s.view c) (.ok t') := hR
        refine ⟨derive_preserves_wf3 (SC.wf3_view hk.1.1.1 hw) hR', ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hR'; rfl
    have hf₂ := opStep_facts (reg := reg) hrl trivial (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw₁
    have hb₁ : x.guarded < s₁.A.length := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (active_lt hl) (opStep_facts
      (reg := reg) hd hsep' (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw).skel.len
    exact ⟨id, ctl_same_eq hw₁ hf₂.pskel hb hf₂.hold
      (kernel_ctl_same hd hsep' (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw hb₁ hc)⟩
  | newMutex => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
  | acquire => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
  | unlock => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
  | resetLock => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
  | spawnVal => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
  | issue => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind

/-! ## Completeness -/

/-- The event of the controller graph for the protocol step `i` on `e`. -/
theorem ctlGraph_ev (o : Ords) (e : Nat) {lbls : List Label} {i : Nat} (hi : i < lbls.length)
    {c : Nat} {op : CtlOp} (h : ctlOp e lbls[i] = some (c, op)) :
    (ctlGraph o e lbls).ev? (ctlIdx e lbls i) = some ⟨c, op.kind o⟩ := by
  simp only [EventModel.Graph.ev?, ctlIdx, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  exact ctlEvs_at o e hi h

/-- Brief, task 4, completeness, for the kinds `protocole`, `exclu` and `fin de vie`: at a step
`i` of a trace, taken under `Encap5R` from a state satisfying `KInvCA`, `SyncInv` and the
separation of the registries, while entry `e` is live before and after the step, a step that
touches the controller of `e` is a protocol step on `e`, hence an event of the controller graph,
the event `ctlIdx e lbls i`. The protocol steps of another entry touch another controller (WC5.1
corrigé C21 item 4, C13 item 8). Hypothesis 3 of the brief is not used: the kinds `déplacement`
are outside the statement. -/
theorem completeness {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} {i : Nat} (hi : i < lbls.length) (hst : LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1)))
    (he : Encap5R k L (σ i) lbls[i]) (hk : KInvCA (σ i).1)
    (hinv : SyncInv L (σ i).1 (σ i).2.1) (hsep : AdminSep (σ i).1 (σ i).2.1 (σ i).2.2)
    (hkind : ProtoKind lbls[i] ∨ ExclKind lbls[i] ∨ FinKind lbls[i]) {e : Nat} {x : SyncEntry}
    (hx : (σ i).2.1[e]? = some x) (hl : x.Live (σ i).1) (hl' : x.Live (σ (i + 1)).1)
    {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L (σ i).1 x = some ctl) (ht : Touches L (σ i) lbls[i] ctl)
    (o : Ords) :
    ∃ c op, ctlOp e lbls[i] = some (c, op) ∧
      (ctlGraph o e lbls).ev? (ctlIdx e lbls i) = some ⟨c, op.kind o⟩ := by
  suffices hp : ∃ c op, ctlOp e lbls[i] = some (c, op) by
    obtain ⟨c, op, h⟩ := hp
    exact ⟨c, op, h, ctlGraph_ev o e hi h⟩
  have hxm : x ∈ (σ i).2.1 := List.mem_of_getElem? hx
  rcases hkind with hp | hkind
  · -- a protocol step on another entry touches another controller
    have other : ∀ (j : Nat) (y : SyncEntry), (σ i).2.1[j]? = some y → y.Live (σ i).1 →
        ControlOf L (σ i).1 y = some ctl → j = e := fun j y hy hyl hyc =>
      hinv.ctlUnique j e y x ctl hy hx hyl hl hyc hc
    generalize hlbl : lbls[i] = lbl at hst he hp ht
    cases hst with
    | newMutex hn =>
      exfalso
      obtain ⟨-, hpre, -⟩ := hn
      have hcu := hpre.ctlUnique
      simp only [Touches] at ht
      rw [ht] at hcu
      exact hcu x hxm hl hc
    | @acquire s reg ar c j st' ha =>
      obtain ⟨-, y, hy, ⟨hyl, -⟩, -⟩ := ha
      simp only [Touches, hy, Option.bind_some] at ht
      obtain rfl := other j y hy hyl ht
      exact ⟨c, .acq, by simp [ctlOp]⟩
    | @unlock s reg ar c j st' hu =>
      obtain ⟨-, y, -, hy, hyl, -⟩ := hu
      simp only [Touches, hy, Option.bind_some] at ht
      obtain rfl := other j y hy hyl ht
      exact ⟨c, .unl, by simp [ctlOp]⟩
    | @resetLock s reg ar c j st' hr =>
      obtain ⟨-, y, hy, hex, -⟩ := hr
      simp only [Touches, hy, Option.bind_some] at ht
      obtain rfl := other j y hy (active_of_exercisable hex) ht
      exact ⟨c, .rst, by simp [ctlOp]⟩
    | _ => simp [ProtoKind] at hp
  · exact absurd ht (classified_sound hk hsep hkind he hst hxm hl hl' hc).1

/-! ## From the initial state -/

/-- The prefix of a `Run5R` is an encapsulated trace (WC5.1 corrigé C22, C23). -/
theorem run5R_prefix {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (hr : Run5R k L σ lbls) {i : Nat} (hi : i ≤ lbls.length) :
    EncapsulatedTrace k L (σ 0) (lbls.take i) (σ i) := by
  have hr' : Run5R k L σ (lbls.take i) := fun j hj => by
    have hj' : j < lbls.length := by simp at hj; omega
    have := hr j hj'
    simp only [List.getElem_take]
    exact this
  have h := run5R_trace hr'
  rw [List.length_take, Nat.min_eq_left hi] at h
  exact encapsulatedTrace5_imp (encapsulatedTrace5C_imp (encapsulatedTrace5R_imp h))

/-- Brief, task 4, completeness on a `Run5R` from the initial state of Spec 1 §47, under `DDSound`
(Spec 1 §80): the invariants of `completeness` hold at every step (`trace_inv`). -/
theorem completeness_run {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics}
    {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbls : List Label} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hstat : StaticsOK statics) (h0 : σ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []))
    (hr : Run5R k L σ lbls) {i : Nat} (hi : i < lbls.length)
    (hkind : ProtoKind lbls[i] ∨ ExclKind lbls[i] ∨ FinKind lbls[i]) {e : Nat} {x : SyncEntry}
    (hx : (σ i).2.1[e]? = some x) (hl : x.Live (σ i).1) (hl' : x.Live (σ (i + 1)).1)
    {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L (σ i).1 x = some ctl) (ht : Touches L (σ i) lbls[i] ctl)
    (o : Ords) :
    ∃ c op, ctlOp e lbls[i] = some (c, op) ∧
      (ctlGraph o e lbls).ev? (ctlIdx e lbls i) = some ⟨c, op.kind o⟩ := by
  have htr := run5R_prefix hr (Nat.le_of_lt hi)
  rw [h0] at htr
  obtain ⟨hk₀, hs₀⟩ := init_inv (k := k) hdd hstat L
  obtain ⟨hk, ⟨hs, -⟩, hsep, -⟩ := trace_inv hdd htr hk₀ hs₀
  exact completeness hi (hr i hi).2 (hr i hi).1 hk hs hsep hkind hx hl hl' hc ht o

end Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal
