import Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.Coherence
import Ern.Concurrency.Reachable

/-!
# Classification of the steps that touch the controller

Brief of milestone 4, slice 2, layer R, task 4 (`formal/reports/spec2-m4-mutexreal.md`): for a
live entry `e`, each of the 28 kinds of labels (the 16 kernel operations and the 12 other labels
of `Label`) gets one status. The footprint of a step (`Touches`) is the notion of the brief:
the accesses of `read3`, `write3`, `writeShared` (`Label.Access`), and the source and destination
places of the steps that change an initialization state or a holder (`KernelOp.Writes` of Spec 1
§59 for `store` and `transfer`, extended to the source of `transfer`, to `endUse`, `alloc`,
`issue`, the by-value composite and the fresh locals); for the protocol steps, the controller of
their entry, by the declared realization (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` v10 §2 nonies).

This module proves the statuses `exclu` and `fin de vie` (`classified_sound`) and completeness
for those kinds and the protocol kinds (`completeness`). The witnesses of the statuses
`déplacement`, `fin de vie` and `contre-exemple` are in `Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.Witness`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal

open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency
open SyncPreserveAux SyncInitAux

/-! ## Footprint -/

/-- The footprint of step `lbl` from state `st` (brief, task 4): the leaves the step reads or
writes, or whose initialization state or holder relation it changes. `read3`, `write3`,
`writeShared`: their leaves (`Label.Access`). `store`: its target (Spec 1 §59, `KernelOp.Writes`;
§65 effect: the holder of the authority becomes the target). `transfer`: the leaves of the source
(they become `Moved`) and of the destination (written, §59). `endUse`: the leaves of the place
(they become `Uninit`, §69). `alloc`: the provider (§71.2), the owner (holder of the new root,
§71) and the fresh leaves. `enterFrame`, `spawn`: the fresh locals. By-value `spawn`: the fresh
locals and the sources of its transfers. `issue`: its destination (the `store` of the block,
§77). `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`, `resetLock`: the controller of their entry, by the declared
realization. The other steps change neither an initialization state nor a holder: empty. -/
def Touches (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) : Label → Nat → Prop
  | .kernel _ (.read _ ls), l | .kernel _ (.write _ ls), l | .kernel _ (.writeShared _ ls), l =>
    l ∈ ls
  | .kernel _ (.store _ p), l => l = p
  | .kernel _ (.transfer src dst), l => l ∈ footprint st.1.P src ∨ l ∈ footprint st.1.P dst
  | .kernel _ (.endUse p), l => l ∈ footprint st.1.P p
  | .kernel _ (.alloc pr ow _), l =>
    l ∈ footprint st.1.P pr ∨ l ∈ footprint st.1.P ow ∨ st.1.P.length ≤ l
  | .kernel _ (.enter _ _), l | .spawn _ _ _, l => st.1.P.length ≤ l
  | .spawnVal _ _ _ vs, l => st.1.P.length ≤ l ∨ ∃ v ∈ vs, l ∈ footprint st.1.P v.1
  | .issue _ _ _ dst, l => l = dst
  | .newMutex _ g, l => ControlOf L st.1 ⟨g, none⟩ = some l
  | .acquire _ i, l | .unlock _ i, l | .resetLock _ i, l =>
    (st.2.1[i]?).bind (ControlOf L st.1) = some l
  | _, _ => False

/-- Decidability of `Touches`. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbl : Label) (l : Nat) :
    Decidable (Touches L st lbl l) := by
  unfold Touches; split <;> infer_instance

/-! ## Kinds -/

/-- The kinds of status `exclu` (brief, task 4): `derive`, `split`, `depend`, `enterFrame`,
`exitFrame`, `read3`, `write3`, `writeShared`, `pin`, `unpin`, `free`, `spawn`, `terminate`,
`join`, `deriveSync`, `newArena`, `reset`. -/
def ExclKind : Label → Prop
  | .kernel _ (.derive _ _ _) | .kernel _ (.split _ _) | .kernel _ (.depend _ _)
  | .kernel _ (.enter _ _) | .kernel _ .exit | .kernel _ (.read _ _) | .kernel _ (.write _ _)
  | .kernel _ (.writeShared _ _) | .kernel _ (.pin _) | .kernel _ (.unpin _)
  | .kernel _ (.free _ _) | .spawn _ _ _ | .terminate _ | .join _ _ | .deriveSync _ _
  | .newArena _ _ _ | .reset _ _ => True
  | _ => False

/-- The kinds of status `fin de vie` (brief, task 4): `release`, `endUse`. -/
def FinKind : Label → Prop
  | .kernel _ (.release _) | .kernel _ (.endUse _) => True
  | _ => False

/-- The kinds of status `protocole` (brief, task 4). -/
def ProtoKind : Label → Prop
  | .newMutex _ _ | .acquire _ _ | .unlock _ _ | .resetLock _ _ => True
  | _ => False

/-! ## `exclu` and `fin de vie` -/

/-- An authority exercisable from a frame is active (Spec 1 §43). -/
theorem active_of_exercisable {t : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : t.ExercisableAt a m) :
    t.Active a := by
  cases h with
  | base hy ha => exact ⟨_, hy, ha⟩
  | held hy ha => exact ⟨_, hy, ha⟩

/-- A kernel step other than `transfer`, admitted by `Encap`, keeps the controller of an entry
(WC5.1 corrigé C12: positional `ControlOf`). -/
theorem kernel_ctl_same {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp}
    {s s' : SC} (hop : opStepC k op c s (.ok s')) (hEnc : Encap L (s, reg) (.kernel c op))
    (hnt : ∀ src dst, op ≠ .transfer src dst) (hw : WF3 s.flat) {x : SyncEntry} {ctl : Nat}
    (hb : x.guarded < s'.A.length) (hc : ControlOf L s x = some ctl) :
    ControlOf L s' x = some ctl :=
  have hf := opStep_facts (reg := reg) hop hEnc hnt hw
  ctl_same_eq hw hf.pskel hb hf.hold hc

/-- The controller of an entry is an existing place. -/
theorem ctl_lt {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {x : SyncEntry} {ctl : Nat}
    (hc : ControlOf L s x = some ctl) : ctl < s.P.length := by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hkc⟩ := controlOf_spec hc
  exact (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hkc)).1

/-- `endUse(p)` admitted by `Encap` after which the entry is still live does not touch its
controller (WC5.1 corrigé C22 item 5; Spec 1 §69): if the controller were a leaf of `p`, then `p`,
which is not the controller, would contain the mutex value and the place `slot` holding
`guarded`, and `guarded` would become inactive. -/
theorem endUse_ctl_not_touched {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {c p : Nat} {s s' : SC}
    (hop : opStepC k (.endUse p) c s (.ok s')) (hEnc : Encap L (s, reg) (.kernel c (.endUse p)))
    (hw : WF3 s.flat) {x : SyncEntry} (hx : x ∈ reg) (hl : x.Live s) (hl' : x.Live s')
    {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L s x = some ctl) : ctl ∉ footprint s.P p := by
  have hE : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ControlOf L s e ≠ some p ∧
      OptP (slotOf s e.guarded) (fun q => partOf s.P p q → p = q) True := hEnc
  obtain ⟨t, hR, rfl⟩ := viewStep_ok hop
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hR
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩ := hl'
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hnh⟩ := endUse_active (v := s.view c) hy' ya'
  obtain ⟨y₀, hp, m, hy₀, hh, hm, -, hkc⟩ := controlOf_spec hc
  have hy₁ : s.A[x.guarded]? = some y := hy
  rw [hy₀] at hy₁
  cases hy₁
  have hne : ctl ≠ p := fun h => (hE x hx hl).1 (h ▸ hc)
  have hcm : parentOf s.P ctl = some m := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hkc)).2
  have hmp := partOf_parent (t := s.flat) hw (partOf_of_mem_footprint (t := s.flat) hmem) hne hcm
  have hpP : hp < s.P.length := by
    simp only [parentOf] at hm
    cases hq : s.P[hp]? with
    | none => rw [hq] at hm; cases hm
    | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hq
  have hpm : partOf s.P hp m := ⟨hpP, .inr (by
    rw [chain_cons hm (WF3.parent_lt (s := s.flat) hw hm).1]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..)⟩
  exact hnh (by rw [hh]; exact partOf_trans (t := s.flat) hw hpm hmp)

/-- Brief, task 4, statuses `exclu` and `fin de vie`: an `ok` step of one of these kinds, admitted
by `Encap5R`, from a state satisfying `KInvCA` and the separation of the registries (both hold
along every encapsulated trace from the initial state, `trace_inv`), with a registered entry live
before and after the step, does not have the controller of the entry in its footprint and does
not change it. -/
theorem classified_sound {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label}
    {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} (hk : KInvCA st.1) (hsep : AdminSep st.1 st.2.1 st.2.2)
    (hkind : ExclKind lbl ∨ FinKind lbl) (he : Encap5R k L st lbl) (h : LStep k L lbl st st')
    {x : SyncEntry} (hx : x ∈ st.2.1) (hl : x.Live st.1) (hl' : x.Live st'.1) {ctl : Nat}
    (hc : ControlOf L st.1 x = some ctl) :
    ¬ Touches L st lbl ctl ∧ ControlOf L st'.1 x = some ctl := by
  have hw : WF3 st.1.flat := hk.1.1.2
  have hb : x.guarded < st'.1.A.length := active_lt hl'
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg ar c op hop =>
    have hEnc : Encap L (s, reg) (.kernel c op) := he.1.1
    have hctl : (∀ src dst, op ≠ .transfer src dst) → ControlOf L s' x = some ctl :=
      fun hnt => kernel_ctl_same hop hEnc hnt hw hb hc
    cases op with
    | transfer => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
    | store => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
    | alloc => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
    | read a ls =>
      have hx' := he.1.2.2 x hx hl
      rw [hc] at hx'
      exact ⟨hx', hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | write a ls =>
      have hx' := he.1.2.2 x hx hl
      rw [hc] at hx'
      exact ⟨hx', hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | writeShared a ls =>
      have hx' := he.1.2.2 x hx hl
      rw [hc] at hx'
      exact ⟨hx', hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | enter ps ls =>
      exact ⟨fun ht => Nat.not_lt.2 ht (ctl_lt hc), hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | endUse p =>
      exact ⟨endUse_ctl_not_touched hop hEnc hw hx hl hl' hc, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | derive => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | split => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | release => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | depend => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | exit => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | pin => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | unpin => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
    | free => exact ⟨id, hctl fun _ _ h => by cases h⟩
  | @spawn s s' reg ar c ps ls hsp =>
    have hf := spawn_facts (reg := reg) hsp
    exact ⟨fun ht => Nat.not_lt.2 ht (ctl_lt hc), ctl_same_eq hw hf.pskel hb hf.hold hc⟩
  | @terminate s s' reg ar c ht =>
    have hf := term_facts (reg := reg) hw ht
    exact ⟨id, ctl_same_eq hw hf.pskel hb hf.hold hc⟩
  | @join s s' reg ar c d hj =>
    have hf := join_facts (reg := reg) hj
    exact ⟨id, ctl_same_eq hw hf.pskel hb hf.hold hc⟩
  | deriveSync hd => exact (deriveSync_excluded hd he.1.1).elim
  | newArena hn =>
    obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ := newArenaStepC_ok hn
    exact ⟨id, hc⟩
  | @reset s reg ar c i st' hr =>
    obtain ⟨E, s₁, hE, hd, hrl, -, -⟩ := resetStepC_ok (k := k) hr
    have hsep' : Encap L (s, reg) (.kernel c (.derive E.internal (footprint s.P E.storage) .modify)) :=
      fun e hm hl₀ heq => hsep e hm E (List.mem_of_getElem? hE) hl₀
        (by show s.flat.Active E.internal; rw [heq]; exact hl₀) heq.symm
    have hw₁ : WF3 s₁.flat := wf3_after_view hk.1.1.1
      (show ViewStep ((KernelOp.derive E.internal (footprint s.P E.storage) .modify).Step k) c s
        (.ok s₁) from hd)
      fun t' hR => by
        have hR' : DeriveStep E.internal (footprint s.P E.storage) .modify (s.view c) (.ok t') := hR
        refine ⟨derive_preserves_wf3 (SC.wf3_view hk.1.1.1 hw) hR', ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hR'; rfl
    have hf₂ := opStep_facts (reg := reg) hrl trivial (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw₁
    have hb₁ : x.guarded < s₁.A.length := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (active_lt hl) (opStep_facts
      (reg := reg) hd hsep' (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw).skel.len
    exact ⟨id, ctl_same_eq hw₁ hf₂.pskel hb hf₂.hold
      (kernel_ctl_same hd hsep' (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw hb₁ hc)⟩
  | newMutex => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
  | acquire => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
  | unlock => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
  | resetLock => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
  | spawnVal => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind
  | issue => simp [ExclKind, FinKind] at hkind

/-! ## Completeness -/

/-- The event of the controller graph for the protocol step `i` on `e`. -/
theorem ctlGraph_ev (o : Ords) (e : Nat) {lbls : List Label} {i : Nat} (hi : i < lbls.length)
    {c : Nat} {op : CtlOp} (h : ctlOp e lbls[i] = some (c, op)) :
    (ctlGraph o e lbls).ev? (ctlIdx e lbls i) = some ⟨c, op.kind o⟩ := by
  simp only [EventModel.Graph.ev?, ctlIdx, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  exact ctlEvs_at o e hi h

/-- Brief, task 4, completeness, for the kinds `protocole`, `exclu` and `fin de vie`: at a step
`i` of a trace, taken under `Encap5R` from a state satisfying `KInvCA`, `SyncInv` and the
separation of the registries, while entry `e` is live before and after the step, a step that
touches the controller of `e` is a protocol step on `e`, hence an event of the controller graph,
the event `ctlIdx e lbls i`. The protocol steps of another entry touch another controller (WC5.1
corrigé C21 item 4, C13 item 8). Hypothesis 3 of the brief is not used: the kinds `déplacement`
are outside the statement. -/
theorem completeness {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} {i : Nat} (hi : i < lbls.length) (hst : LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1)))
    (he : Encap5R k L (σ i) lbls[i]) (hk : KInvCA (σ i).1)
    (hinv : SyncInv L (σ i).1 (σ i).2.1) (hsep : AdminSep (σ i).1 (σ i).2.1 (σ i).2.2)
    (hkind : ProtoKind lbls[i] ∨ ExclKind lbls[i] ∨ FinKind lbls[i]) {e : Nat} {x : SyncEntry}
    (hx : (σ i).2.1[e]? = some x) (hl : x.Live (σ i).1) (hl' : x.Live (σ (i + 1)).1)
    {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L (σ i).1 x = some ctl) (ht : Touches L (σ i) lbls[i] ctl)
    (o : Ords) :
    ∃ c op, ctlOp e lbls[i] = some (c, op) ∧
      (ctlGraph o e lbls).ev? (ctlIdx e lbls i) = some ⟨c, op.kind o⟩ := by
  suffices hp : ∃ c op, ctlOp e lbls[i] = some (c, op) by
    obtain ⟨c, op, h⟩ := hp
    exact ⟨c, op, h, ctlGraph_ev o e hi h⟩
  have hxm : x ∈ (σ i).2.1 := List.mem_of_getElem? hx
  rcases hkind with hp | hkind
  · -- a protocol step on another entry touches another controller
    have other : ∀ (j : Nat) (y : SyncEntry), (σ i).2.1[j]? = some y → y.Live (σ i).1 →
        ControlOf L (σ i).1 y = some ctl → j = e := fun j y hy hyl hyc =>
      hinv.ctlUnique j e y x ctl hy hx hyl hl hyc hc
    generalize hlbl : lbls[i] = lbl at hst he hp ht
    cases hst with
    | newMutex hn =>
      exfalso
      obtain ⟨-, hpre, -⟩ := hn
      have hcu := hpre.ctlUnique
      simp only [Touches] at ht
      rw [ht] at hcu

/-- The prefix of a `Run5R` is an encapsulated trace (WC5.1 corrigé C22, C23). -/
theorem run5R_prefix {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (hr : Run5R k L σ lbls) {i : Nat} (hi : i ≤ lbls.length) :
    EncapsulatedTrace k L (σ 0) (lbls.take i) (σ i) := by

    have hj' : j < lbls.length := by simp at hj; omega

theorem completeness_run {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics}
    {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbls : List Label} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hstat : StaticsOK statics) (h0 : σ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []))
    (hr : Run5R k L σ lbls) {i : Nat} (hi : i < lbls.length)
    (hkind : ProtoKind lbls[i] ∨ ExclKind lbls[i] ∨ FinKind lbls[i]) {e : Nat} {x : SyncEntry}
    (hx : (σ i).2.1[e]? = some x) (hl : x.Live (σ i).1) (hl' : x.Live (σ (i + 1)).1)
    {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L (σ i).1 x = some ctl) (ht : Touches L (σ i) lbls[i] ctl)
    (o : Ords) :
    ∃ c op, ctlOp e lbls[i] = some (c, op) ∧
      (ctlGraph o e lbls).ev? (ctlIdx e lbls i) = some ⟨c, op.kind o⟩ := by
  have htr := run5R_prefix hr (Nat.le_of_lt hi)
  rw [h0] at htr
  obtain ⟨hk₀, hs₀⟩ := init_inv (k := k) hdd hstat L
  obtain ⟨hk, ⟨hs, -⟩, hsep, -⟩ := trace_inv hdd htr hk₀ hs₀
  exact completeness hi (hr i hi).2 (hr i hi).1 hk hs hsep hkind hx hl hl' hc ht o

import Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.Classify
import Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.MutexEdge
import Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.AR

/-!
# Witnesses of the classification

Brief of milestone 4, slice 2, layer R, task 4 (`formal/reports/spec2-m4-mutexreal.md`): the traces
behind the statuses `contre-exemple` (`store`, `alloc`, `issue`), `déplacement` (`transfer`,
by-value `spawn`) and `fin de vie` (`endUse`, `release`), each a `Run5R` from the initial state of
Spec 1 §47, checked by `decide`. Block MX and block AR of `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §0; contracts `KM`
and `KA`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.ClassifyWitness

open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal
open Ern.Concurrency.Corpus
open Ern.Concurrency.Traces (L0)

/-- The labels of block MX up to `MX₃` (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §0). -/
def mx3Lbls : List Label :=
  [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 3 1), .newMutex 0 3]

/-- The setup of `MX₃` from the initial state, each step admitted by `Encap5R`, followed by any run
from `MX₃`. -/
theorem mx3_steps {sts : List (SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg)} {lbls : List Label}
    (h : Steps5R KM L0 ((x2, regX, []) :: sts) lbls) :
    Steps5R KM L0 ((x0, [], []) :: (x1, [], []) :: (x2, [], []) :: (x2, regX, []) :: sts)
      (mx3Lbls ++ lbls) :=
  .cons ⟨⟨(fun e he => by cases he), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel mx_steps.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel mx_steps.2.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.newMutex mx_steps.2.2.1) h

/-! ## `store`: counter-example -/

/-- `c0 : z := derive(root_M′, Observe, {slot′})`, authority 4 (O1). -/
def cs1 : SC := x2.set (deriveEff (x2.view 0) 2 [5] .observe)
/-- `c0 : store(z, lock)` (O8). -/
def cs2 : SC := storeEffC cs1 0 4 2

/-- The labels of the `store` counter-example. -/
def csLbls : List Label :=
  mx3Lbls ++ [.kernel 0 (.derive 2 [5] .observe), .kernel 0 (.store 4 2)]

/-- The named states of the `store` counter-example. -/
def csσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  [(x0, [], []), (x1, [], []), (x2, [], []), (x2, regX, []), (cs1, regX, []),
    (cs2, regX, [])].getD i (cs2, regX, [])

/-- Brief, task 4, `store`, status `contre-exemple`: from `MX₃`, `c0 : z := derive(root_M′, Observe,
{slot′})` then `c0 : store(z, lock)` form a `Run5R` from the initial state. Entry `e` is live
before and after the `store`, its controller is `lock` (place 2) in both states; the `store`
writes `lock` (Spec 1 §59, `KernelOp.Writes`) and makes it the holder of `z`; it is not a protocol
step on `e`, so it is no event of the controller graph. No conjunct of `Encap5R` reads the target
of a `store` other than its right premises (`PlaceExcl`), which `root_M` satisfies. -/
theorem store_cex : csσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst), [], []) ∧ Run5R KM L0 csσ csLbls ∧
    csLbls[4]? = some (.kernel 0 (.store 4 2)) ∧
    (⟨3, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live cs1 ∧ (⟨3, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live cs2 ∧
    ControlOf L0 cs1 ⟨3, none⟩ = some 2 ∧ ControlOf L0 cs2 ⟨3, none⟩ = some 2 ∧
    Touches L0 (cs1, regX, []) (.kernel 0 (.store 4 2)) 2 ∧
    KernelOp.Writes cs1.flat 2 (.store 4 2) ∧ (cs2.A[4]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 2) ∧
    ctlOp 0 (.kernel 0 (.store 4 2)) = none := by
  have h : Steps5R KM L0 [(x2, regX, []), (cs1, regX, []), (cs2, regX, [])]
      [.kernel 0 (.derive 2 [5] .observe), .kernel 0 (.store 4 2)] :=
    .cons ⟨⟨(by decide : ∀ e ∈ regX, e.Live x2 → 2 ≠ e.guarded), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, (mx3_steps h).run _, rfl, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, rfl, rfl,
    by decide, rfl⟩

/-! ## `alloc`: counter-example -/

/-- `c0 : alloc(provider = slot, owner = lock, one leaf)` (O14): the new root authority, 4, is held
by `lock`. -/
def ca1 : SC := x2.set (allocEff (x2.view 0) 2 [(none, 0)])

/-- The labels of the `alloc` counter-example. -/
def caLbls : List Label := mx3Lbls ++ [.kernel 0 (.alloc 1 2 [(none, 0)])]

/-- The named states of the `alloc` counter-example. -/
def caσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  [(x0, [], []), (x1, [], []), (x2, [], []), (x2, regX, []), (ca1, regX, [])].getD i
    (ca1, regX, [])

/-- Brief, task 4, `alloc`, status `contre-exemple`: from `MX₃`, `c0 : alloc(provider = slot,
owner = lock)` is an `ok` step admitted by `Encap5R` (its right premises, `PlaceExcl`, hold through
`root_M`); the trace is a `Run5R` from the initial state. Entry `e` stays live with controller
`lock`, which becomes the holder of the new root authority (Spec 1 §71 effect); the step is not a
protocol step on `e`. -/
theorem alloc_cex : caσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst), [], []) ∧ Run5R KM L0 caσ caLbls ∧
    caLbls[3]? = some (.kernel 0 (.alloc 1 2 [(none, 0)])) ∧
    (⟨3, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live x2 ∧ (⟨3, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live ca1 ∧
    ControlOf L0 x2 ⟨3, none⟩ = some 2 ∧ ControlOf L0 ca1 ⟨3, none⟩ = some 2 ∧
    Touches L0 (x2, regX, []) (.kernel 0 (.alloc 1 2 [(none, 0)])) 2 ∧
    (ca1.A[4]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 2) ∧
    ctlOp 0 (.kernel 0 (.alloc 1 2 [(none, 0)])) = none := by
  have h : Steps5R KM L0 [(x2, regX, []), (ca1, regX, [])] [.kernel 0 (.alloc 1 2 [(none, 0)])] :=
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide) trivial, rfl⟩) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, (mx3_steps h).run _, rfl, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, rfl⟩

/-! ## `issue`: counter-example -/

/-- `c0 : acquire(e2)`: grant, authority 6, held by frame 0 (WC5.1 corrigé C16). -/
def ci1 : SC := deriveSyncEff a4 0 5
/-- The registry with the grant recorded. -/
def regI : SyncReg := [⟨5, some 6⟩]
/-- `split(internal, [R1])` by context 0: the block, authority 7 (O2). -/
def ci2s : SC := ci1.set (splitEff (ci1.view 0) 4 [[5]])
/-- `store(block, lock2)` by context 0 (O8). -/
def ci2 : SC := storeEffC ci2s 0 ci1.A.length 2
/-- The arena registry after the issue of `R1` (Spec 1 §77 effect). -/
def arI : ArenaReg := arA.set 0 (Arena.issueMeta ci1.flat ⟨4, 4, [5, 6], []⟩ [5])

/-- The labels of the `issue` counter-example: block AR up to `newMutex(guarded2)`, then
`c0 : acquire(e2)` and `c0 : issue(arena, R1, lock2)`. -/
def ciLbls : List Label :=
  [.kernel 0 (.derive 2 [5, 6] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 3), .newArena 0 4 4,
   .kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 5 1), .newMutex 0 5, .acquire 0 0,
   .issue 0 0 [5] 2]

/-- The named states of the `issue` counter-example. -/
def ciσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  [(a0, [], []), (a1, [], []), (a2, [], []), (a2, [], arA), (a3, [], arA), (a4, [], arA),
    (a4, regA, arA), (ci1, regI, arA), (ci2, regI, arI)].getD i (ci2, regI, arI)

/-- Brief, task 4, `issue`, status `contre-exemple`: in block AR before the sharing of `M2`,
`c0 : acquire(e2)` then `c0 : issue(arena, R1, lock2)` are `ok` steps admitted by `Encap5R` (the
`MetaRight` premise of `PlaceExcl` holds through the grant); the trace is a `Run5R` from the initial
state. Entry `e2` stays live with controller `lock2` (place 2), into which the block is stored
(Spec 1 §77, §65); the `issue` is not a protocol step on `e2`. -/
theorem issue_cex : ciσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init arst), [], []) ∧ Run5R KA L0 ciσ ciLbls ∧
    ciLbls[7]? = some (.issue 0 0 [5] 2) ∧
    (⟨5, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live ci1 ∧ (⟨5, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live ci2 ∧
    ControlOf L0 ci1 ⟨5, none⟩ = some 2 ∧ ControlOf L0 ci2 ⟨5, none⟩ = some 2 ∧
    Touches L0 (ci1, regI, arA) (.issue 0 0 [5] 2) 2 ∧
    (ci2.A[7]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 2) ∧ ctlOp 0 (.issue 0 0 [5] 2) = none := by
  have h : Steps5R KA L0 [(a0, [], []), (a1, [], []), (a2, [], []), (a2, [], arA), (a3, [], arA),
      (a4, [], arA), (a4, regA, arA), (ci1, regI, arA), (ci2, regI, arI)] ciLbls :=
    .cons ⟨⟨(fun e he => by cases he), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.newArena ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨(fun e he => by cases he), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.newMutex ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩
      (.acquire ⟨by decide, ⟨5, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩
      (.issue (.ok (E := ⟨4, 4, [5, 6], []⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide)
        ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩ ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩)) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, h.run _, rfl, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, rfl, by decide, rfl⟩

/-! ## `déplacement` -/

open Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.MutexEdge in
/-- Brief, task 4, `transfer`, status `déplacement` (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` S7, v9 §2 octies W-TR):
in the `Run5R` W-TR, step 9, `c0 : transfer(M, M′)`, keeps entry `e` live and moves its
controller from `lock` (place 2) to `lock′` (place 6). -/
theorem transfer_moves : Run5R KM L0 trσ trLbls ∧ trLbls[9]? = some (.kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4)) ∧
    (⟨3, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live (trσ 9).1 ∧ (⟨3, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live (trσ 10).1 ∧
    ControlOf L0 (trσ 9).1 ⟨3, none⟩ = some 2 ∧ ControlOf L0 (trσ 10).1 ⟨3, none⟩ = some 6 :=
  ⟨W_TR_run.2, rfl, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

/-!
# Witnesses of the classification

Brief of milestone 4, slice 2, layer R, task 4 (`formal/reports/spec2-m4-mutexreal.md`): the traces
behind the statuses `contre-exemple` (`store`, `alloc`, `issue`), `déplacement` (`transfer`,
by-value `spawn`) and `fin de vie` (`endUse`, `release`), each a `Run5R` from the initial state of
Spec 1 §47, checked by `decide`. Block MX and block AR of `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §0; contracts `KM`
and `KA`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.ClassifyWitness

open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal
open Ern.Concurrency.Corpus
open Ern.Concurrency.Traces (L0)

/-- The labels of block MX up to `MX₃` (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §0). -/
def mx3Lbls : List Label :=
  [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 3 1), .newMutex 0 3]

/-- The setup of `MX₃` from the initial state, each step admitted by `Encap5R`, followed by any run
from `MX₃`. -/
theorem mx3_steps {sts : List (SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg)} {lbls : List Label}
    (h : Steps5R KM L0 ((x2, regX, []) :: sts) lbls) :
    Steps5R KM L0 ((x0, [], []) :: (x1, [], []) :: (x2, [], []) :: (x2, regX, []) :: sts)
      (mx3Lbls ++ lbls) :=
  .cons ⟨⟨(fun e he => by cases he), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel mx_steps.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel mx_steps.2.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.newMutex mx_steps.2.2.1) h

/-! ## `store`: counter-example -/

/-- `c0 : z := derive(root_M′, Observe, {slot′})`, authority 4 (O1). -/
def cs1 : SC := x2.set (deriveEff (x2.view 0) 2 [5] .observe)
/-- `c0 : store(z, lock)` (O8). -/
def cs2 : SC := storeEffC cs1 0 4 2

/-- The labels of the `store` counter-example. -/
def csLbls : List Label :=
  mx3Lbls ++ [.kernel 0 (.derive 2 [5] .observe), .kernel 0 (.store 4 2)]

/-- The named states of the `store` counter-example. -/
def csσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  [(x0, [], []), (x1, [], []), (x2, [], []), (x2, regX, []), (cs1, regX, []),
    (cs2, regX, [])].getD i (cs2, regX, [])

/-- Brief, task 4, `store`, status `contre-exemple`: from `MX₃`, `c0 : z := derive(root_M′, Observe,
{slot′})` then `c0 : store(z, lock)` form a `Run5R` from the initial state. Entry `e` is live
before and after the `store`, its controller is `lock` (place 2) in both states; the `store`
writes `lock` (Spec 1 §59, `KernelOp.Writes`) and makes it the holder of `z`; it is not a protocol
step on `e`, so it is no event of the controller graph. No conjunct of `Encap5R` reads the target
of a `store` other than its right premises (`PlaceExcl`), which `root_M` satisfies. -/
theorem store_cex : csσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst), [], []) ∧ Run5R KM L0 csσ csLbls ∧
    csLbls[4]? = some (.kernel 0 (.store 4 2)) ∧
    (⟨3, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live cs1 ∧ (⟨3, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live cs2 ∧
    ControlOf L0 cs1 ⟨3, none⟩ = some 2 ∧ ControlOf L0 cs2 ⟨3, none⟩ = some 2 ∧
    Touches L0 (cs1, regX, []) (.kernel 0 (.store 4 2)) 2 ∧
    KernelOp.Writes cs1.flat 2 (.store 4 2) ∧ (cs2.A[4]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 2) ∧
    ctlOp 0 (.kernel 0 (.store 4 2)) = none := by
  have h : Steps5R KM L0 [(x2, regX, []), (cs1, regX, []), (cs2, regX, [])]
      [.kernel 0 (.derive 2 [5] .observe), .kernel 0 (.store 4 2)] :=
    .cons ⟨⟨(by decide : ∀ e ∈ regX, e.Live x2 → 2 ≠ e.guarded), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, (mx3_steps h).run _, rfl, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, rfl, rfl,
    by decide, rfl⟩

/-! ## `alloc`: counter-example -/

/-- `c0 : alloc(provider = slot, owner = lock, one leaf)` (O14): the new root authority, 4, is held
by `lock`. -/
def ca1 : SC := x2.set (allocEff (x2.view 0) 2 [(none, 0)])

/-- The labels of the `alloc` counter-example. -/
def caLbls : List Label := mx3Lbls ++ [.kernel 0 (.alloc 1 2 [(none, 0)])]

/-- The named states of the `alloc` counter-example. -/
def caσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  [(x0, [], []), (x1, [], []), (x2, [], []), (x2, regX, []), (ca1, regX, [])].getD i
    (ca1, regX, [])

/-- Brief, task 4, `alloc`, status `contre-exemple`: from `MX₃`, `c0 : alloc(provider = slot,
owner = lock)` is an `ok` step admitted by `Encap5R` (its right premises, `PlaceExcl`, hold through
`root_M`); the trace is a `Run5R` from the initial state. Entry `e` stays live with controller
`lock`, which becomes the holder of the new root authority (Spec 1 §71 effect); the step is not a
protocol step on `e`. -/
theorem alloc_cex : caσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst), [], []) ∧ Run5R KM L0 caσ caLbls ∧
    caLbls[3]? = some (.kernel 0 (.alloc 1 2 [(none, 0)])) ∧
    (⟨3, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live x2 ∧ (⟨3, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live ca1 ∧
    ControlOf L0 x2 ⟨3, none⟩ = some 2 ∧ ControlOf L0 ca1 ⟨3, none⟩ = some 2 ∧
    Touches L0 (x2, regX, []) (.kernel 0 (.alloc 1 2 [(none, 0)])) 2 ∧
    (ca1.A[4]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 2) ∧
    ctlOp 0 (.kernel 0 (.alloc 1 2 [(none, 0)])) = none := by
  have h : Steps5R KM L0 [(x2, regX, []), (ca1, regX, [])] [.kernel 0 (.alloc 1 2 [(none, 0)])] :=
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide) trivial, rfl⟩) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, (mx3_steps h).run _, rfl, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, rfl⟩

/-! ## `issue`: counter-example -/

/-- `c0 : acquire(e2)`: grant, authority 6, held by frame 0 (WC5.1 corrigé C16). -/
def ci1 : SC := deriveSyncEff a4 0 5
/-- The registry with the grant recorded. -/
def regI : SyncReg := [⟨5, some 6⟩]
/-- `split(internal, [R1])` by context 0: the block, authority 7 (O2). -/
def ci2s : SC := ci1.set (splitEff (ci1.view 0) 4 [[5]])
/-- `store(block, lock2)` by context 0 (O8). -/
def ci2 : SC := storeEffC ci2s 0 ci1.A.length 2
/-- The arena registry after the issue of `R1` (Spec 1 §77 effect). -/
def arI : ArenaReg := arA.set 0 (Arena.issueMeta ci1.flat ⟨4, 4, [5, 6], []⟩ [5])

/-- The labels of the `issue` counter-example: block AR up to `newMutex(guarded2)`, then
`c0 : acquire(e2)` and `c0 : issue(arena, R1, lock2)`. -/
def ciLbls : List Label :=
  [.kernel 0 (.derive 2 [5, 6] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 3), .newArena 0 4 4,
   .kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 5 1), .newMutex 0 5, .acquire 0 0,
   .issue 0 0 [5] 2]

/-- The named states of the `issue` counter-example. -/
def ciσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  [(a0, [], []), (a1, [], []), (a2, [], []), (a2, [], arA), (a3, [], arA), (a4, [], arA),
    (a4, regA, arA), (ci1, regI, arA), (ci2, regI, arI)].getD i (ci2, regI, arI)

/-- Brief, task 4, `issue`, status `contre-exemple`: in block AR before the sharing of `M2`,
`c0 : acquire(e2)` then `c0 : issue(arena, R1, lock2)` are `ok` steps admitted by `Encap5R` (the
`MetaRight` premise of `PlaceExcl` holds through the grant); the trace is a `Run5R` from the initial
state. Entry `e2` stays live with controller `lock2` (place 2), into which the block is stored
(Spec 1 §77, §65); the `issue` is not a protocol step on `e2`. -/
theorem issue_cex : ciσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init arst), [], []) ∧ Run5R KA L0 ciσ ciLbls ∧
    ciLbls[7]? = some (.issue 0 0 [5] 2) ∧
    (⟨5, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live ci1 ∧ (⟨5, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live ci2 ∧
    ControlOf L0 ci1 ⟨5, none⟩ = some 2 ∧ ControlOf L0 ci2 ⟨5, none⟩ = some 2 ∧
    Touches L0 (ci1, regI, arA) (.issue 0 0 [5] 2) 2 ∧
    (ci2.A[7]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 2) ∧ ctlOp 0 (.issue 0 0 [5] 2) = none := by
  have h : Steps5R KA L0 [(a0, [], []), (a1, [], []), (a2, [], []), (a2, [], arA), (a3, [], arA),
      (a4, [], arA), (a4, regA, arA), (ci1, regI, arA), (ci2, regI, arI)] ciLbls :=
    .cons ⟨⟨(fun e he => by cases he), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.newArena ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨(fun e he => by cases he), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.newMutex ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩
      (.acquire ⟨by decide, ⟨5, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩
      (.issue (.ok (E := ⟨4, 4, [5, 6], []⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide)
        ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩ ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩)) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, h.run _, rfl, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, rfl, by decide, rfl⟩

/-! ## `déplacement` -/

open Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.MutexEdge in
/-- Brief, task 4, `transfer`, status `déplacement` (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` S7, v9 §2 octies W-TR):
in the `Run5R` W-TR, step 9, `c0 : transfer(M, M′)`, keeps entry `e` live and moves its
controller from `lock` (place 2) to `lock′` (place 6). -/
theorem transfer_moves : Run5R KM L0 trσ trLbls ∧ trLbls[9]? = some (.kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4)) ∧
    (⟨3, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live (trσ 9).1 ∧ (⟨3, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live (trσ 10).1 ∧
    ControlOf L0 (trσ 9).1 ⟨3, none⟩ = some 2 ∧ ControlOf L0 (trσ 10).1 ⟨3, none⟩ = some 6 :=
  ⟨W_TR_run.2, rfl, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

/-- The locals of the child: a copy of the shape of the mutex value, root `7`, fields `8`, `9`. -/
def mLocals : LocalShape := [(none, 0), (some 7, 0), (some 7, 0)]
/-- `c0 : spawn` by value moving `M` into the root local `7` of the child (WC5.1 corrigé C5). -/
def cv1 : SC := spawnValEff x2 0 [] mLocals [(0, 7)]

/-- The labels of the by-value `spawn` that moves the mutex. -/
def cvLbls : List Label := mx3Lbls ++ [.spawnVal 0 [] mLocals [(0, 7)]]

/-- The named states of the by-value `spawn` that moves the mutex. -/
def cvσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  [(x0, [], []), (x1, [], []), (x2, [], []), (x2, regX, []), (cv1, regX, [])].getD i
    (cv1, regX, [])

/-- Brief, task 4, by-value `spawn`, status `déplacement`: from `MX₃`, a by-value `spawn` whose
transfer moves the whole mutex value `M` into a local of the child (WC5.1 corrigé C12, C22 item 3:
the source is neither `slot`, a strict part of `slot`, nor the controller) is an `ok` step admitted
by `Encap5R`; the trace is a `Run5R` from the initial state. Entry `e` stays live and its controller
moves from `lock` (place 2) to the child's place 9; the step touches `lock`. -/
theorem spawnVal_moves : cvσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst), [], []) ∧ Run5R KM L0 cvσ cvLbls ∧
    (⟨3, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live x2 ∧ (⟨3, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live cv1 ∧
    ControlOf L0 x2 ⟨3, none⟩ = some 2 ∧ ControlOf L0 cv1 ⟨3, none⟩ = some 9 ∧
    Touches L0 (x2, regX, []) (.spawnVal 0 [] mLocals [(0, 7)]) 2 := by
  have h : Steps5R KM L0 [(x2, regX, []), (cv1, regX, [])] [.spawnVal 0 [] mLocals [(0, 7)]] :=
    .cons ⟨⟨⟨by decide, trivial⟩, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩
      (.spawnVal ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, (mx3_steps h).run _, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

/-! ## `fin de vie` -/

/-- `c0 : endUse(M)` (O12). -/
def ce1 : SC := x2.set (endUseEff (x2.view 0) 0)

/-- The labels of the `endUse(M)` trace. -/
def ceLbls : List Label := mx3Lbls ++ [.kernel 0 (.endUse 0)]

/-- The named states of the `endUse(M)` trace. -/
def ceσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  [(x0, [], []), (x1, [], []), (x2, [], []), (x2, regX, []), (ce1, regX, [])].getD i
    (ce1, regX, [])

/-- Brief, task 4, `endUse`, status `fin de vie` (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` S17a twin; WC5.1 corrigé
C22 item 5): from `MX₃`, `c0 : endUse(M)` is an `ok` step admitted by `Encap5R`; it touches `lock`
and entry `e` is dead after it. -/
theorem endUse_ends : ceσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst), [], []) ∧ Run5R KM L0 ceσ ceLbls ∧
    (⟨3, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live x2 ∧ ¬ (⟨3, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live ce1 ∧
    Touches L0 (x2, regX, []) (.kernel 0 (.endUse 0)) 2 := by
  have h : Steps5R KM L0 [(x2, regX, []), (ce1, regX, [])] [.kernel 0 (.endUse 0)] :=
    .cons ⟨⟨(by decide : ∀ e ∈ regX, e.Live x2 → ControlOf L0 x2 e ≠ some 0 ∧
        OptP (slotOf x2 e.guarded) (fun q => partOf x2.P 0 q → 0 = q) True), trivial, trivial⟩,
        by decide⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, (mx3_steps h).run _, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

/-- `c0 : release(guarded)` (O3). -/
def cr1 : SC := x2.set (releaseEff (x2.view 0) 3)

/-- The labels of the `release(guarded)` trace. -/
def crLbls : List Label := mx3Lbls ++ [.kernel 0 (.release 3)]

/-- The named states of the `release(guarded)` trace. -/
def crσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  [(x0, [], []), (x1, [], []), (x2, [], []), (x2, regX, []), (cr1, regX, [])].getD i
    (cr1, regX, [])

/-- Brief, task 4, `release`, status `fin de vie`: from `MX₃`, `c0 : release(guarded)` is an `ok`
step admitted by `Encap5R` (Spec 1 §62: `guarded` is derived, held by `slot`, on which `root_M`
gives exercisable `Modify`; WC5.1 corrigé C22 excludes `derive` and `split` from `guarded`, not its
`release`); entry `e` is dead after it. The step touches no leaf. -/
theorem release_ends : crσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst), [], []) ∧ Run5R KM L0 crσ crLbls ∧
    (⟨3, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live x2 ∧ ¬ (⟨3, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live cr1 := by
  have h : Steps5R KM L0 [(x2, regX, []), (cr1, regX, [])] [.kernel 0 (.release 3)] :=
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, (mx3_steps h).run _, by decide, by decide⟩

end Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.ClassifyWitness

import Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.Coherence
import Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.Classify
import Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.MutexEdge

/-!
# The strict mutex edge and the controller graph

Brief of milestone 4, slice 2, layer R, task 5 (`formal/reports/spec2-m4-mutexreal.md`): the strict
mutex edge of slice 1 (`SWS`, `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies) against the controller graph of
`Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.Graph`, under the declared realization.

* bridge (`bridge`): a strict edge from `unlock(e)` to `acquire(e)` is an `rf` edge between their
  events; it uses the invariant (no `unlock(e)` between them) and not hypothesis 3;
* synchronization (`bridge_sw`): that `rf` edge is an `sw` edge exactly when the order of the
  `unlock` is release-capable and that of the `acquire` acquire-capable (WC5.1 corrigé C32 item 1,
  C40); in particular for the reference realization (`bridge_sw_ref`);
* converse (`bridge_converse`): under hypothesis 3, an `rf` edge from the write of an `unlock(e)` to
  the RMW of an `acquire(e)` is a strict edge; without it W-TR refutes it
  (`converse_needs_fixed`).

These are conditional statements under the declared realization: they do not prove that a
physical realization satisfies it, and they do not discharge `OB-C05`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency

/-! ## Counting protocol steps -/

/-- The protocol steps of a prefix are those of a shorter prefix. -/
theorem ctlOps_take_take (e : Nat) (lbls : List Label) {m n : Nat} (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    ctlOps e (lbls.take n) = ctlOps e (lbls.take m) ++ ctlOps e ((lbls.take n).drop m) := by
  rw [← ctlOps_append]
  conv => lhs; rw [← List.take_append_drop m (lbls.take n)]
  rw [List.take_take, Nat.min_eq_left hmn]

/-- The number of protocol steps grows with the prefix. -/
theorem ctlOps_length_mono (e : Nat) (lbls : List Label) {m n : Nat} (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    (ctlOps e (lbls.take m)).length ≤ (ctlOps e (lbls.take n)).length := by
  rw [ctlOps_take_take e lbls hmn, List.length_append]
  exact Nat.le_add_right _ _

/-- Without a protocol step in `[m, n)`, the prefixes `m` and `n` have the same protocol steps. -/
theorem ctlOps_take_eq_of_none (e : Nat) {lbls : List Label} {m : Nat} :
    ∀ d, m + d ≤ lbls.length →
      (∀ q (hq : q < lbls.length), m ≤ q → q < m + d → ctlOp e lbls[q] = none) →
      ctlOps e (lbls.take (m + d)) = ctlOps e (lbls.take m)
  | 0, _, _ => rfl
  | d + 1, hd, h => by
    have hq : m + d < lbls.length := by omega
    rw [← Nat.add_assoc, ctlOps_take_succ e hq, h (m + d) hq (Nat.le_add_right m d)
      (Nat.lt_succ_self _), Option.toList_none, List.append_nil]
    exact ctlOps_take_eq_of_none e d (by omega) fun q hq' h1 h2 => h q hq' h1 (by omega)

/-- With as many protocol steps in the prefixes `m` and `n`, there is none in `[m, n)`. -/
theorem ctlOps_none_of_length (e : Nat) {lbls : List Label} {m n : Nat}
    (hlen : (ctlOps e (lbls.take n)).length = (ctlOps e (lbls.take m)).length) :
    ∀ q (hq : q < lbls.length), m ≤ q → q < n → ctlOp e lbls[q] = none := by
  intro q hq h1 h2
  cases hc : ctlOp e lbls[q] with
  | none => rfl
  | some p =>
    exfalso
    have hs := ctlOps_take_succ e hq
    rw [hc] at hs
    have h3 : (ctlOps e (lbls.take (q + 1))).length = (ctlOps e (lbls.take q)).length + 1 := by
      rw [hs]; simp
    have h4 := ctlOps_length_mono e lbls h1
    have h5 := ctlOps_length_mono e lbls (show q + 1 ≤ n by omega)
    omega

/-- The label of a protocol step on `e`. -/
theorem ctlOp_label {e : Nat} {lbl : Label} {c : Nat} {op : CtlOp}
    (h : ctlOp e lbl = some (c, op)) :
    lbl = match op with
      | .acq => .acquire c e
      | .unl => .unlock c e
      | .rst => .resetLock c e := by
  cases lbl <;> simp only [ctlOp, reduceCtorEq] at h
  all_goals (split at h <;> simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, reduceCtorEq] at h)
  all_goals (obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h; subst_vars; rfl)

/-- An `unlock` finds a recorded grant (WC5.1 corrigé C17 item 1). -/
theorem unlock_grant {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {c i : Nat} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    (h : LStep k L (.unlock c i) st st') : ∃ x g, st.2.1[i]? = some x ∧ x.grant = some g := by
  cases h with
  | unlock hu => obtain ⟨-, x, g, hx, -, hg, -⟩ := hu; exact ⟨x, g, hx, hg⟩

/-- The kind of the event of a protocol step on `e`. -/
theorem kind?_ctlIdx (o : Ords) (e : Nat) {lbls : List Label} {i : Nat} (hi : i < lbls.length)
    {c : Nat} {op : CtlOp} (h : ctlOp e lbls[i] = some (c, op)) :
    (ctlGraph o e lbls).kind? (ctlIdx e lbls i) = some (op.kind o) := by
  simp [EventModel.Graph.kind?, ctlGraph_ev o e hi h]

/-! ## Bridge -/

/-- Brief, task 5, bridge: along the `ok` steps of a trace whose first state has no taken grant
for entry `e`, if the strict mutex edge (`SWS`, `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies) relates
`unlock(e)` at step `u` to the step `a`, then in the controller graph `rf` relates the write of `u`
to the RMW of `a` (WC5.1 corrigé C32 item 1, C48). Between `u` and `a` there is no `acquire(e)`
(`SWS`), no `resetLock(e)` (`MutexGap`), and no `unlock(e)`: the invariant (`ctl_invariant`) makes
the grant `none` after `u`, and `unlock` needs a recorded grant. The `ctlAt` clauses of `MutexGap`,
hence hypothesis 3, are not used. -/
theorem bridge {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbls : List Label}
    (hs : ∀ i (h : i < lbls.length), LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1))) {e : Nat}
    (h0 : ∀ x, (σ 0).2.1[e]? = some x → x.grant = none) {u a c : Nat}
    (hu : lbls[u]? = some (.unlock c e)) (hsw : SWS σ L lbls (.step u) (.step a)) (o : Ords) :
    EventModel.RF (ctlGraph o e lbls) (ctlIdx e lbls u) (ctlIdx e lbls a) := by
  obtain ⟨hua, ha, hsw'⟩ := hsw
  simp only [hu, Option.bind_some, Label.termOf, Label.unlockOf, OptP, false_or] at hsw'
  obtain ⟨hacq, hfirst, hgap, -, -⟩ := hsw'
  have hul : u < lbls.length := Nat.lt_trans hua ha
  have hu' : lbls[u] = .unlock c e := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hul] at hu; exact Option.some.inj hu
  have hopu : ctlOp e lbls[u] = some (c, .unl) := by rw [hu']; simp [ctlOp]
  have hsu := ctlOps_take_succ e hul
  rw [hopu] at hsu
  -- no protocol step on `e` strictly between `u` and `a`
  have hnone : ∀ p, p ≤ a → ∀ q (hq : q < lbls.length), u + 1 ≤ q → q < p →
      ctlOp e lbls[q] = none := by
    intro p
    induction p with
    | zero => intro _ q _ _ h; exact absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
    | succ p ih =>
      intro hp q hq h1 h2
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge q p with hqp | hqp
      · exact ih (by omega) q hq h1 hqp
      · obtain rfl : q = p := by omega
        have hpl : q < lbls.length := hq
        have heq : ctlOps e (lbls.take q) = ctlOps e (lbls.take (u + 1)) := by
          have := ctlOps_take_eq_of_none e (m := u + 1) (q - (u + 1)) (by omega)
            fun r hr hr1 hr2 => ih (by omega) r hr hr1 (by omega)
          rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' h1] at this
        obtain ⟨hA, hB, -⟩ := ctl_invariant hs h0 o q (Nat.le_of_lt hpl)
        have hex : ∃ x, (σ q).2.1[e]? = some x := by
          cases hx : (σ q).2.1[e]? with
          | some x => exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
          | none =>
            have := hB hx
            rw [heq, hsu] at this
            simp at this
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hex
        have hlast : lastW (ctlGraph o e (lbls.take q)) = some 0 := by
          unfold ctlGraph ctlEvs
          rw [heq, hsu, List.map_append]
          simp [lastW, mkGraph, EventModel.Graph.valW, EventModel.Graph.kind?,
            EventModel.Graph.ev?, CtlOp.kind]
        have hgx : x.grant = none := (hA x hx).2 hlast
        cases hc : ctlOp e lbls[q] with
        | none => rfl
        | some pc =>
          obtain ⟨c', op⟩ := pc
          have hl := ctlOp_label hc
          exfalso
          cases op with
          | acq =>
            have := hfirst q (List.mem_range.2 h2') (by omega)
            simp [hl, Label.acquireOf] at this
          | unl =>
            have hst := hs q hpl
            simp only at hl
            rw [hl] at hst
            obtain ⟨y, g, hy, hyg⟩ := unlock_grant hst
            rw [hx] at hy; cases hy
            rw [hgx] at hyg; cases hyg
          | rst =>
            have := hgap q (List.mem_range.2 h2') (by omega)
            simp [hl, Label.resetLockOf] at this
  sorry

end Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal

namespace Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency

/-! ## Counting protocol steps -/

/-- The protocol steps of a prefix are those of a shorter prefix. -/
theorem ctlOps_take_take (e : Nat) (lbls : List Label) {m n : Nat} (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    ctlOps e (lbls.take n) = ctlOps e (lbls.take m) ++ ctlOps e ((lbls.take n).drop m) := by
  rw [← ctlOps_append]
  conv => lhs; rw [← List.take_append_drop m (lbls.take n)]
  rw [List.take_take, Nat.min_eq_left hmn]

/-- The number of protocol steps grows with the prefix. -/
theorem ctlOps_length_mono (e : Nat) (lbls : List Label) {m n : Nat} (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    (ctlOps e (lbls.take m)).length ≤ (ctlOps e (lbls.take n)).length := by
  rw [ctlOps_take_take e lbls hmn, List.length_append]
  exact Nat.le_add_right _ _

/-- Without a protocol step in `[m, n)`, the prefixes `m` and `n` have the same protocol steps. -/
theorem ctlOps_take_eq_of_none (e : Nat) {lbls : List Label} {m : Nat} :
    ∀ d, m + d ≤ lbls.length →
      (∀ q (hq : q < lbls.length), m ≤ q → q < m + d → ctlOp e lbls[q] = none) →
      ctlOps e (lbls.take (m + d)) = ctlOps e (lbls.take m)
  | 0, _, _ => rfl
  | d + 1, hd, h => by
    have hq : m + d < lbls.length := by omega
    rw [← Nat.add_assoc, ctlOps_take_succ e hq, h (m + d) hq (Nat.le_add_right m d)
      (Nat.lt_succ_self _), Option.toList_none, List.append_nil]
    exact ctlOps_take_eq_of_none e d (by omega) fun q hq' h1 h2 => h q hq' h1 (by omega)

/-- With as many protocol steps in the prefixes `m` and `n`, there is none in `[m, n)`. -/
theorem ctlOps_none_of_length (e : Nat) {lbls : List Label} {m n : Nat}
    (hlen : (ctlOps e (lbls.take n)).length = (ctlOps e (lbls.take m)).length) :
    ∀ q (hq : q < lbls.length), m ≤ q → q < n → ctlOp e lbls[q] = none := by
  intro q hq h1 h2
  cases hc : ctlOp e lbls[q] with
  | none => rfl
  | some p =>
    exfalso
    have hs := ctlOps_take_succ e hq
    rw [hc] at hs
    have h3 : (ctlOps e (lbls.take (q + 1))).length = (ctlOps e (lbls.take q)).length + 1 := by
      rw [hs]; simp
    have h4 := ctlOps_length_mono e lbls h1
    have h5 := ctlOps_length_mono e lbls (show q + 1 ≤ n by omega)

  all_goals (obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h; subst_vars; rfl)

theorem unlock_grant {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {c i : Nat} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    (h : LStep k L (.unlock c i) st st') : ∃ x g, st.2.1[i]? = some x ∧ x.grant = some g := by
  cases h with
  | unlock hu => obtain ⟨-, x, g, hx, -, hg, -⟩ := hu; exact ⟨x, g, hx, hg⟩

/-- The kind of the event of a protocol step on `e`. -/
theorem kind?_ctlIdx (o : Ords) (e : Nat) {lbls : List Label} {i : Nat} (hi : i < lbls.length)
    {c : Nat} {op : CtlOp} (h : ctlOp e lbls[i] = some (c, op)) :
    (ctlGraph o e lbls).kind? (ctlIdx e lbls i) = some (op.kind o) := by
  simp [EventModel.Graph.kind?, ctlGraph_ev o e hi h]

/-- Brief, task 5, bridge: along the `ok` steps of a trace whose first state has no taken grant
for entry `e`, if the strict mutex edge (`SWS`, `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v9 §2 octies) relates

hence hypothesis 3, are not used. -/

    (hs : ∀ i (h : i < lbls.length), LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1))) {e : Nat}
    (h0 : ∀ x, (σ 0).2.1[e]? = some x → x.grant = none) {u a c : Nat}
    (hu : lbls[u]? = some (.unlock c e)) (hsw : SWS σ L lbls (.step u) (.step a)) (o : Ords) :
    EventModel.RF (ctlGraph o e lbls) (ctlIdx e lbls u) (ctlIdx e lbls a) := by
  obtain ⟨hua, ha, hsw'⟩ := hsw
  simp only [hu, Option.bind_some, Label.termOf, Label.unlockOf, OptP, false_or] at hsw'
  obtain ⟨hacq, hfirst, hgap, -, -⟩ := hsw'

  have hu' : lbls[u] = .unlock c e := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hul] at hu; exact Option.some.inj hu
  have hopu : ctlOp e lbls[u] = some (c, .unl) := by rw [hu']; simp [ctlOp]
  have hsu := ctlOps_take_succ e hul
  rw [hopu] at hsu

    | succ p ih =>
      intro hp q hq h1 h2
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge q p with hqp | hqp
      · exact ih (by omega) q hq h1 hqp
      · obtain rfl : q = p := by omega
        have hpl : q < lbls.length := hq
        have heq : ctlOps e (lbls.take q) = ctlOps e (lbls.take (u + 1)) := by
          have := ctlOps_take_eq_of_none e (m := u + 1) (q - (u + 1)) (by omega)

          rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' h1] at this
        obtain ⟨hA, hB, -⟩ := ctl_invariant hs h0 o q (Nat.le_of_lt hpl)

          | some x => exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
          | none =>
            have := hB hx

            EventModel.Graph.ev?, CtlOp.kind]

          | acq =>

            simp only at hl

            obtain ⟨y, g, hy, hyg⟩ := unlock_grant hst
            rw [hx] at hy; cases hy
            rw [hgx] at hyg; cases hyg
          | rst =>
            have := hgap q (List.mem_range.2 h2') (by omega)

tail='''  obtain ⟨ca, hla⟩ : ∃ ca, lbls[a] = .acquire ca e := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem ha] at hacq
    cases hl : lbls[a] <;> simp [hl, Label.acquireOf] at hacq ⊢

  have heqa : ctlOps e (lbls.take a) = ctlOps e (lbls.take (u + 1)) := by
    have := ctlOps_take_eq_of_none e (m := u + 1) (a - (u + 1)) (by omega)
      fun r hr hr1 hr2 => hnone a (Nat.le_refl _) r hr hr1 (by omega)
    rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' (show u + 1 ≤ a by omega)] at this
  have hlen : (ctlOps e (lbls.take a)).length = (ctlOps e (lbls.take u)).length + 1 := by
    rw [heqa, hsu]; simp
  have hidx : ctlIdx e lbls a = ctlIdx e lbls u + 1 := by

/-! ## Synchronization -/

/-- Brief, task 5, synchronization: under the hypotheses of `bridge`, `sw` relates the write of the
`unlock(e)` at `u` and the RMW of the `acquire(e)` at `a` exactly when the order of the `unlock` is
release-capable and the order of the `acquire` acquire-capable (WC5.1 corrigé C32 item 1, C40). -/
theorem bridge_sw {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (hs : ∀ i (h : i < lbls.length), LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1)))
    {e : Nat} (h0 : ∀ x, (σ 0).2.1[e]? = some x → x.grant = none) {u a c : Nat}
    (hu : lbls[u]? = some (.unlock c e)) (hsw : SWS σ L lbls (.step u) (.step a)) (o : Ords) :
    EventModel.SW (ctlGraph o e lbls) (ctlIdx e lbls u) (ctlIdx e lbls a) ↔
      (o.rel = .rel ∨ o.rel = .sc) ∧ (o.acq = .acq ∨ o.acq = .acqRel ∨ o.acq = .sc) := by
  have hrf := bridge hs h0 hu hsw o
  obtain ⟨hua, ha, hsw'⟩ := hsw
  simp only [hu, Option.bind_some, Label.termOf, Label.unlockOf, OptP, false_or] at hsw'
  have hacq := hsw'.1
  have hul : u < lbls.length := Nat.lt_trans hua ha
  have hopu : ctlOp e lbls[u] = some (c, .unl) := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hul] at hu; rw [Option.some.inj hu]; simp [ctlOp]
  obtain ⟨ca, hla⟩ : ∃ ca, lbls[a] = .acquire ca e := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem ha] at hacq
    cases hl : lbls[a] <;> simp [hl, Label.acquireOf] at hacq ⊢
    exact hacq
  have hopa : ctlOp e lbls[a] = some (ca, .acq) := by rw [hla]; simp [ctlOp]
  have hku := kind?_ctlIdx o e hul hopu
  have hka := kind?_ctlIdx o e ha hopa
  unfold EventModel.SW EventModel.Graph.relCap EventModel.Graph.acqCap
  rw [hku, hka]
  simp only [CtlOp.kind, hrf, true_and]
  cases o.rel <;> cases o.acq <;> simp

/-- Brief, task 5: for the reference realization (`acquire`, `release`, `relaxed`), the strict
mutex edge is an `sw` edge of the controller graph. -/
theorem bridge_sw_ref {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (hs : ∀ i (h : i < lbls.length), LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1)))
    {e : Nat} (h0 : ∀ x, (σ 0).2.1[e]? = some x → x.grant = none) {u a c : Nat}
    (hu : lbls[u]? = some (.unlock c e)) (hsw : SWS σ L lbls (.step u) (.step a)) :
    EventModel.SW (ctlGraph refOrds e lbls) (ctlIdx e lbls u) (ctlIdx e lbls a) :=
  (bridge_sw hs h0 hu hsw refOrds).2 ⟨Or.inl rfl, Or.inl rfl⟩

/-! ## Converse -/

/-- Hypothesis 3 of the brief, controller fixed: the controller of entry `e` designates one leaf in
every state of the trace in which the entry exists (WC5.1 corrigé C12, C21 item 3). -/
def CtlFixed (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (L : MutexLayout) (lbls : List Label)
    (e : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ ctl, ∀ k, k ≤ lbls.length → ((σ k).2.1[e]?).isSome → ctlAt σ L e k = some ctl

/-- Brief, task 5, converse: along the `ok` steps of a trace whose first state has no taken grant
for entry `e`, under hypothesis 3 (`CtlFixed`), if in the controller graph `rf` relates the write
of an `unlock(e)` at step `u` to the RMW of an `acquire(e)` at step `a`, then the strict mutex edge
relates `u` to `a`. The `rf` edge makes the two events adjacent, so no protocol step on `e` lies
between the steps; hypothesis 3 gives the `ctlAt` clauses of `MutexGap`. -/
theorem bridge_converse {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (hs : ∀ i (h : i < lbls.length), LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1)))

    {u a cu ca : Nat} (hu : lbls[u]? = some (.unlock cu e)) (ha : lbls[a]? = some (.acquire ca e))
    (o : Ords) (hrf : EventModel.RF (ctlGraph o e lbls) (ctlIdx e lbls u) (ctlIdx e lbls a)) :
    SWS σ L lbls (.step u) (.step a) := by
  have hidx : ctlIdx e lbls a = ctlIdx e lbls u + 1 := (rf_mkGraph.1 hrf).1
  have hul : u < lbls.length := by
    cases h : lbls[u]? with
    | none => rw [h] at hu; cases hu
    | some _ => exact (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 h).1
  have hal : a < lbls.length := by
    cases h : lbls[a]? with
    | none => rw [h] at ha; cases ha
    | some _ => exact (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 h).1
  have hopu : ctlOp e lbls[u] = some (cu, .unl) := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hul] at hu; rw [Option.some.inj hu]; simp [ctlOp]
  have hopa : ctlOp e lbls[a] = some (ca, .acq) := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hal] at ha; rw [Option.some.inj ha]; simp [ctlOp]
  have hsu := ctlOps_take_succ e hul
  rw [hopu] at hsu
  have hsa := ctlOps_take_succ e hal
  rw [hopa] at hsa
  have hsu' : (ctlOps e (lbls.take (u + 1))).length = (ctlOps e (lbls.take u)).length + 1 := by
    rw [hsu]; simp
  have hsa' : (ctlOps e (lbls.take (a + 1))).length = (ctlOps e (lbls.take a)).length + 1 := by
    rw [hsa]; simp
  have hidx' : (ctlOps e (lbls.take a)).length = (ctlOps e (lbls.take u)).length + 1 := by
    simp only [ctlIdx] at hidx; omega
  have hua : u < a := by

    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hau with rfl | hau
    · rw [hu] at ha; cases ha
    · have := ctlOps_length_mono e lbls (show a + 1 ≤ u from hau)

    refine hctl q (by omega) ?_
    obtain ⟨-, hB, -⟩ := ctl_invariant hs h0 o q (by omega)

    | some _ => rfl
    | none =>

      have h5 := ctlOps_length_mono e lbls h1

  refine ⟨hua, hal, Or.inr ?_⟩
  simp only [hu, ha, Option.bind_some, Label.unlockOf, Label.acquireOf, OptP, true_and]
  refine ⟨fun p hp hup => ?_, ⟨fun p hp hup => ?_, ?_, fun q hq h1 => ?_⟩⟩
  · have hpl : p < lbls.length := Nat.lt_trans (List.mem_range.1 hp) hal
    have := hnone p hpl hup (List.mem_range.1 hp)
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hpl]
    cases hl : lbls[p] <;> simp_all [ctlOp, Label.acquireOf]
  · have hpl : p < lbls.length := Nat.lt_trans (List.mem_range.1 hp) hal
    have := hnone p hpl hup (List.mem_range.1 hp)
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hpl]
    cases hl : lbls[p] <;> simp_all [ctlOp, Label.resetLockOf]
  · rw [hex (u + 1) (Nat.le_refl _) (by omega)]; simp
  · rw [hex q h1 (by have := List.mem_range.1 hq; omega), hex (u + 1) (Nat.le_refl _) (by omega)]

/-! ## Synchronization -/

/-- Brief, task 5, synchronization: under the hypotheses of `bridge`, `sw` relates the write of the
`unlock(e)` at `u` and the RMW of the `acquire(e)` at `a` exactly when the order of the `unlock` is
release-capable and the order of the `acquire` acquire-capable (WC5.1 corrigé C32 item 1, C40). -/
theorem bridge_sw {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (hs : ∀ i (h : i < lbls.length), LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1)))
    {e : Nat} (h0 : ∀ x, (σ 0).2.1[e]? = some x → x.grant = none) {u a c : Nat}
    (hu : lbls[u]? = some (.unlock c e)) (hsw : SWS σ L lbls (.step u) (.step a)) (o : Ords) :
    EventModel.SW (ctlGraph o e lbls) (ctlIdx e lbls u) (ctlIdx e lbls a) ↔
      (o.rel = .rel ∨ o.rel = .sc) ∧ (o.acq = .acq ∨ o.acq = .acqRel ∨ o.acq = .sc) := by
  have hrf := bridge hs h0 hu hsw o
  obtain ⟨hua, ha, hsw'⟩ := hsw
  simp only [hu, Option.bind_some, Label.termOf, Label.unlockOf, OptP, false_or] at hsw'
  have hacq := hsw'.1
  have hul : u < lbls.length := Nat.lt_trans hua ha
  have hopu : ctlOp e lbls[u] = some (c, .unl) := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hul] at hu; rw [Option.some.inj hu]; simp [ctlOp]
  obtain ⟨ca, hla⟩ : ∃ ca, lbls[a] = .acquire ca e := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem ha] at hacq
    cases hl : lbls[a] <;> simp [hl, Label.acquireOf] at hacq ⊢
    exact hacq
  have hopa : ctlOp e lbls[a] = some (ca, .acq) := by rw [hla]; simp [ctlOp]
  have hku := kind?_ctlIdx o e hul hopu
  have hka := kind?_ctlIdx o e ha hopa
  unfold EventModel.SW EventModel.Graph.relCap EventModel.Graph.acqCap
  rw [hku, hka]
  simp only [CtlOp.kind, hrf, true_and]
  cases o.rel <;> cases o.acq <;> simp

/-- Brief, task 5: for the reference realization (`acquire`, `release`, `relaxed`), the strict
mutex edge is an `sw` edge of the controller graph. -/
theorem bridge_sw_ref {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (hs : ∀ i (h : i < lbls.length), LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1)))
    {e : Nat} (h0 : ∀ x, (σ 0).2.1[e]? = some x → x.grant = none) {u a c : Nat}
    (hu : lbls[u]? = some (.unlock c e)) (hsw : SWS σ L lbls (.step u) (.step a)) :
    EventModel.SW (ctlGraph refOrds e lbls) (ctlIdx e lbls u) (ctlIdx e lbls a) :=
  (bridge_sw hs h0 hu hsw refOrds).2 ⟨Or.inl rfl, Or.inl rfl⟩

/-! ## Converse -/

/-- Hypothesis 3 of the brief, controller fixed: the controller of entry `e` designates one leaf in
every state of the trace in which the entry exists (WC5.1 corrigé C12, C21 item 3). -/
def CtlFixed (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (L : MutexLayout) (lbls : List Label)
    (e : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ ctl, ∀ k, k ≤ lbls.length → ((σ k).2.1[e]?).isSome → ctlAt σ L e k = some ctl

/-- Brief, task 5, converse: along the `ok` steps of a trace whose first state has no taken grant
for entry `e`, under hypothesis 3 (`CtlFixed`), if in the controller graph `rf` relates the write
of an `unlock(e)` at step `u` to the RMW of an `acquire(e)` at step `a`, then the strict mutex edge
relates `u` to `a`. The `rf` edge makes the two events adjacent, so no protocol step on `e` lies
between the steps; hypothesis 3 gives the `ctlAt` clauses of `MutexGap`. -/
theorem bridge_converse {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (hs : ∀ i (h : i < lbls.length), LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1)))
    {e : Nat} (h0 : ∀ x, (σ 0).2.1[e]? = some x → x.grant = none) (h3 : CtlFixed σ L lbls e)
    {u a cu ca : Nat} (hu : lbls[u]? = some (.unlock cu e)) (ha : lbls[a]? = some (.acquire ca e))
    (o : Ords) (hrf : EventModel.RF (ctlGraph o e lbls) (ctlIdx e lbls u) (ctlIdx e lbls a)) :
    SWS σ L lbls (.step u) (.step a) := by
  have hidx : ctlIdx e lbls a = ctlIdx e lbls u + 1 := (rf_mkGraph.1 hrf).1
  have hul : u < lbls.length := by
    cases h : lbls[u]? with
    | none => rw [h] at hu; cases hu
    | some _ => exact (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 h).1
  have hal : a < lbls.length := by
    cases h : lbls[a]? with
    | none => rw [h] at ha; cases ha
    | some _ => exact (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 h).1
  have hopu : ctlOp e lbls[u] = some (cu, .unl) := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hul] at hu; rw [Option.some.inj hu]; simp [ctlOp]
  have hopa : ctlOp e lbls[a] = some (ca, .acq) := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hal] at ha; rw [Option.some.inj ha]; simp [ctlOp]
  have hsu := ctlOps_take_succ e hul
  rw [hopu] at hsu
  have hsa := ctlOps_take_succ e hal
  rw [hopa] at hsa
  have hsu' : (ctlOps e (lbls.take (u + 1))).length = (ctlOps e (lbls.take u)).length + 1 := by
    rw [hsu]; simp
  have hsa' : (ctlOps e (lbls.take (a + 1))).length = (ctlOps e (lbls.take a)).length + 1 := by
    rw [hsa]; simp
  have hidx' : (ctlOps e (lbls.take a)).length = (ctlOps e (lbls.take u)).length + 1 := by
    simp only [ctlIdx] at hidx; omega
  have hua : u < a := by
    refine Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hau => ?_
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hau with rfl | hau
    · rw [hu] at ha; cases ha
    · have := ctlOps_length_mono e lbls (show a + 1 ≤ u from hau)

  have hex : ∀ q, u + 1 ≤ q → q ≤ a → ctlAt σ L e q = some ctl := by
    intro q h1 h2
    refine hctl q (by omega) ?_
    obtain ⟨-, hB, -⟩ := ctl_invariant hs h0 o q (by omega)
    cases hx : (σ q).2.1[e]? with

    | none =>

  refine ⟨fun p hp hup => ?_, ⟨fun p hp hup => ?_, ?_, fun q hq h1 => ?_⟩⟩

    have := hnone p hpl hup (List.mem_range.1 hp)
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hpl]
    cases hl : lbls[p] <;> simp_all [ctlOp, Label.acquireOf]

    have := hnone p hpl hup (List.mem_range.1 hp)

  · rw [hex q h1 (by have := List.mem_range.1 hq; omega), hex (u + 1) (Nat.le_refl _) (by omega)]

/-! ## Synchronization -/

/-- Brief, task 5, synchronization: under the hypotheses of `bridge`, `sw` relates the write of the
`unlock(e)` at `u` and the RMW of the `acquire(e)` at `a` exactly when the order of the `unlock` is
release-capable and the order of the `acquire` acquire-capable (WC5.1 corrigé C32 item 1, C40). -/
theorem bridge_sw {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (hs : ∀ i (h : i < lbls.length), LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1)))
    {e : Nat} (h0 : ∀ x, (σ 0).2.1[e]? = some x → x.grant = none) {u a c : Nat}
    (hu : lbls[u]? = some (.unlock c e)) (hsw : SWS σ L lbls (.step u) (.step a)) (o : Ords) :
    EventModel.SW (ctlGraph o e lbls) (ctlIdx e lbls u) (ctlIdx e lbls a) ↔
      (o.rel = .rel ∨ o.rel = .sc) ∧ (o.acq = .acq ∨ o.acq = .acqRel ∨ o.acq = .sc) := by
  have hrf := bridge hs h0 hu hsw o
  obtain ⟨hua, ha, hsw'⟩ := hsw
  simp only [hu, Option.bind_some, Label.termOf, Label.unlockOf, OptP, false_or] at hsw'
  have hacq := hsw'.1
  have hul : u < lbls.length := Nat.lt_trans hua ha
  have hopu : ctlOp e lbls[u] = some (c, .unl) := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hul] at hu; rw [Option.some.inj hu]; simp [ctlOp]
  obtain ⟨ca, hla⟩ : ∃ ca, lbls[a] = .acquire ca e := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem ha] at hacq
    cases hl : lbls[a] <;> simp [hl, Label.acquireOf] at hacq ⊢
    exact hacq
  have hopa : ctlOp e lbls[a] = some (ca, .acq) := by rw [hla]; simp [ctlOp]
  have hku := kind?_ctlIdx o e hul hopu
  have hka := kind?_ctlIdx o e ha hopa
  unfold EventModel.SW EventModel.Graph.relCap EventModel.Graph.acqCap
  rw [hku, hka]
  simp only [CtlOp.kind, hrf, true_and]
  cases o.rel <;> cases o.acq <;> simp

/-- Brief, task 5: for the reference realization (`acquire`, `release`, `relaxed`), the strict
mutex edge is an `sw` edge of the controller graph. -/
theorem bridge_sw_ref {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (hs : ∀ i (h : i < lbls.length), LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1)))
    {e : Nat} (h0 : ∀ x, (σ 0).2.1[e]? = some x → x.grant = none) {u a c : Nat}
    (hu : lbls[u]? = some (.unlock c e)) (hsw : SWS σ L lbls (.step u) (.step a)) :
    EventModel.SW (ctlGraph refOrds e lbls) (ctlIdx e lbls u) (ctlIdx e lbls a) :=
  (bridge_sw hs h0 hu hsw refOrds).2 ⟨Or.inl rfl, Or.inl rfl⟩

/-! ## Converse -/

/-- Hypothesis 3 of the brief, controller fixed: the controller of entry `e` designates one leaf in
every state of the trace in which the entry exists (WC5.1 corrigé C12, C21 item 3). -/
def CtlFixed (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (L : MutexLayout) (lbls : List Label)
    (e : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ ctl, ∀ k, k ≤ lbls.length → ((σ k).2.1[e]?).isSome → ctlAt σ L e k = some ctl

/-- Brief, task 5, converse: along the `ok` steps of a trace whose first state has no taken grant
for entry `e`, under hypothesis 3 (`CtlFixed`), if in the controller graph `rf` relates the write
of an `unlock(e)` at step `u` to the RMW of an `acquire(e)` at step `a`, then the strict mutex edge
relates `u` to `a`. The `rf` edge makes the two events adjacent, so no protocol step on `e` lies
between the steps; hypothesis 3 gives the `ctlAt` clauses of `MutexGap`. -/
theorem bridge_converse {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (hs : ∀ i (h : i < lbls.length), LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1)))
    {e : Nat} (h0 : ∀ x, (σ 0).2.1[e]? = some x → x.grant = none) (h3 : CtlFixed σ L lbls e)
    {u a cu ca : Nat} (hu : lbls[u]? = some (.unlock cu e)) (ha : lbls[a]? = some (.acquire ca e))
    (o : Ords) (hrf : EventModel.RF (ctlGraph o e lbls) (ctlIdx e lbls u) (ctlIdx e lbls a)) :
    SWS σ L lbls (.step u) (.step a) := by
  have hidx : ctlIdx e lbls a = ctlIdx e lbls u + 1 := (rf_mkGraph.1 hrf).1
  have hul : u < lbls.length := by
    cases h : lbls[u]? with
    | none => rw [h] at hu; cases hu
    | some _ => exact (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 h).1
  have hal : a < lbls.length := by
    cases h : lbls[a]? with
    | none => rw [h] at ha; cases ha
    | some _ => exact (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 h).1
  have hopu : ctlOp e lbls[u] = some (cu, .unl) := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hul] at hu; rw [Option.some.inj hu]; simp [ctlOp]
  have hopa : ctlOp e lbls[a] = some (ca, .acq) := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hal] at ha; rw [Option.some.inj ha]; simp [ctlOp]
  have hsu := ctlOps_take_succ e hul
  rw [hopu] at hsu
  have hsa := ctlOps_take_succ e hal
  rw [hopa] at hsa
  have hsu' : (ctlOps e (lbls.take (u + 1))).length = (ctlOps e (lbls.take u)).length + 1 := by
    rw [hsu]; simp
  have hsa' : (ctlOps e (lbls.take (a + 1))).length = (ctlOps e (lbls.take a)).length + 1 := by
    rw [hsa]; simp
  have hidx' : (ctlOps e (lbls.take a)).length = (ctlOps e (lbls.take u)).length + 1 := by
    simp only [ctlIdx] at hidx; omega
  have hua : u < a := by
    refine Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hau => ?_
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hau with rfl | hau
    · rw [hu] at ha; cases ha
    · have := ctlOps_length_mono e lbls (show a + 1 ≤ u from hau)
      omega
  have hnone := ctlOps_none_of_length e (m := u + 1) (n := a) (by omega)
  -- the entry exists from `u + 1` on
  obtain ⟨ctl, hctl⟩ := h3
  have hex : ∀ q, u + 1 ≤ q → q ≤ a → ctlAt σ L e q = some ctl := by
    intro q h1 h2
    refine hctl q (by omega) ?_
    obtain ⟨-, hB, -⟩ := ctl_invariant hs h0 o q (by omega)
    cases hx : (σ q).2.1[e]? with
    | some _ => rfl
    | none =>
      have h4 := hB hx
      have h5 := ctlOps_length_mono e lbls h1
      rw [h4] at h5; simp at h5; omega
  refine ⟨hua, hal, Or.inr ?_⟩
  simp only [hu, ha, Option.bind_some, Label.unlockOf, Label.acquireOf, OptP, true_and]
  refine ⟨fun p hp hup => ?_, ⟨fun p hp hup => ?_, ?_, fun q hq h1 => ?_⟩⟩
  · have hpl : p < lbls.length := Nat.lt_trans (List.mem_range.1 hp) hal
    have := hnone p hpl hup (List.mem_range.1 hp)
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hpl]
    cases hl : lbls[p] <;> simp_all [ctlOp, Label.acquireOf]
  · have hpl : p < lbls.length := Nat.lt_trans (List.mem_range.1 hp) hal
    have := hnone p hpl hup (List.mem_range.1 hp)
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hpl]
    cases hl : lbls[p] <;> simp_all [ctlOp, Label.resetLockOf]
  · rw [hex (u + 1) (Nat.le_refl _) (by omega)]; simp
  · rw [hex q h1 (by have := List.mem_range.1 hq; omega), hex (u + 1) (Nat.le_refl _) (by omega)]

being no protocol step, while the strict mutex edge does not relate them; the controller moves from

theorem converse_needs_fixed : Run5R KM Ern.Concurrency.Traces.L0 trσ trLbls ∧
    trLbls[7]? = some (.unlock 1 0) ∧ trLbls[10]? = some (.acquire 0 0) ∧

    ¬ SWS trσ Ern.Concurrency.Traces.L0 trLbls (.step 7) (.step 10) ∧
    ctlAt trσ Ern.Concurrency.Traces.L0 0 9 = some 2 ∧
    ctlAt trσ Ern.Concurrency.Traces.L0 0 10 = some 6 :=
  ⟨W_TR_run.2, rfl, rfl, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

consistency of the controller graph, its `sw` edges, the two variants of `lc_trace`, and the order,
in the strict graph of slice 1, between `newMutex(e)` and the protocol steps of `c1`. The facts are
written from the corpus and decided by `decide`. A last witness, S11, shows the invariant on an
abandoned grant.

set_option autoImplicit false

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal
open Ern.Concurrency.Corpus
open Ern.Concurrency.Traces (L0)
open Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.GuardedChainC (lcLbls)
open Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.MutexEdge

/-- The `sw` edges of a graph are exactly the edge `(a, b)`. -/
def SwExactly (g : EventModel.Graph) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ List.range g.size, ∀ y ∈ List.range g.size, EventModel.SW g x y ↔ x = a ∧ y = b

/-- Decidability of `SwExactly`. -/
instance (g : EventModel.Graph) (a b : Nat) : Decidable (SwExactly g a b) := by
  unfold SwExactly; infer_instance

/-- Every protocol step on entry `0` made by context `1` comes after step `nm` in the strict graph
of slice 1 (`HBS`). -/
def AfterNewMutex (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbls : List Label) (nm : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ p ∈ List.range lbls.length, ((lbls[p]?).bind (ctlOp 0)).map (·.1) = some 1 →
    HBS σ L0 lbls (.step nm) (.step p)

/-- Decidability of `AfterNewMutex`. -/
instance (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbls : List Label) (nm : Nat) :
    Decidable (AfterNewMutex σ lbls nm) := by
  unfold AfterNewMutex; infer_instance

/-- `A1`, the RMW of an `acquire` by `c1`, under the reference realization. -/

    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel S11_1_ok.2.2.2.1) .nil
  have hr := h.run (y3, regG6, [])

/-!
# Witnesses of the controller graph

Brief of milestone 4, slice 2, layer R, task 6 (`formal/reports/spec2-m4-mutexreal.md`;
`corpus-spec2-m3.md` v10 §2 nonies, "Faits attendus sur les graphes du contrôleur"): on `lc_trace`,
W-RL₀, W-RL and W-RL-J, the events of the controller of entry `e` (index `0`) and `rf`, the
consistency of the controller graph, its `sw` edges, the two variants of `lc_trace`, and the order,
in the strict graph of slice 1, between `newMutex(e)` and the protocol steps of `c1`. The facts are
written from the corpus and decided by `decide`. A last witness, S11, shows the invariant on an
abandoned grant.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.Witness

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal
open Ern.Concurrency.Corpus
open Ern.Concurrency.Traces (L0)
open Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.GuardedChainC (lcLbls)
open Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.MutexEdge

/-- The `sw` edges of a graph are exactly the edge `(a, b)`. -/
def SwExactly (g : EventModel.Graph) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ List.range g.size, ∀ y ∈ List.range g.size, EventModel.SW g x y ↔ x = a ∧ y = b

/-- Decidability of `SwExactly`. -/
instance (g : EventModel.Graph) (a b : Nat) : Decidable (SwExactly g a b) := by
  unfold SwExactly; infer_instance

/-- Every protocol step on entry `0` made by context `1` comes after step `nm` in the strict graph
of slice 1 (`HBS`). -/
def AfterNewMutex (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbls : List Label) (nm : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ p ∈ List.range lbls.length, ((lbls[p]?).bind (ctlOp 0)).map (·.1) = some 1 →
    HBS σ L0 lbls (.step nm) (.step p)

/-- Decidability of `AfterNewMutex`. -/
instance (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbls : List Label) (nm : Nat) :
    Decidable (AfterNewMutex σ lbls nm) := by
  unfold AfterNewMutex; infer_instance

/-- `A1`, the RMW of an `acquire` by `c1`, under the reference realization. -/
abbrev A1 : EventModel.Ev := ⟨1, .rmw .acq 0 1⟩
/-- `U1`, the write of an `unlock` by `c1`. -/
abbrev U1 : EventModel.Ev := ⟨1, .wsh .rel 0⟩
/-- `R0`, the write of a `resetLock` by `c0`. -/
abbrev R0 : EventModel.Ev := ⟨0, .wsh .rlx 0⟩
/-- `A0`, the RMW of an `acquire` by `c0`. -/
abbrev A0 : EventModel.Ev := ⟨0, .rmw .acq 0 1⟩

    (ctlGraph refOrds 0 lcLbls).evs = [A1, U1, A0] ∧ (ctlGraph refOrds 0 lcLbls).rf = [(0, 1), (2, 3)] ∧
    [ctlIdx 0 lcLbls 7, ctlIdx 0 lcLbls 9, ctlIdx 0 lcLbls 10] = [1, 2, 3] ∧
    EventModel.WellTyped (ctlGraph refOrds 0 lcLbls) ∧
    EventModel.EventConsistent (ctlGraph refOrds 0 lcLbls) ∧
    SwExactly (ctlGraph refOrds 0 lcLbls) 2 3 ∧ AfterNewMutex lcσ lcLbls 4 :=
  ⟨lc_run.2, ⟨⟨0, 4, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,

    EventModel.EventConsistent (ctlGraph ⟨.acq, .rlx, .rlx⟩ 0 lcLbls) ∧
    EventModel.NoSW (ctlGraph ⟨.acq, .rlx, .rlx⟩ 0 lcLbls) ∧
    EventModel.RF (ctlGraph ⟨.rlx, .rel, .rlx⟩ 0 lcLbls) 2 3 ∧
    EventModel.EventConsistent (ctlGraph ⟨.rlx, .rel, .rlx⟩ 0 lcLbls) ∧
    EventModel.NoSW (ctlGraph ⟨.rlx, .rel, .rlx⟩ 0 lcLbls) := by
