import Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.Classify

/-!
# The proposed amendments to C22 item 4 and C18

Brief of milestone 4, slice 2, layer R, corrective pass, task 1
(`formal/reports/spec2-m4-mutexreal.md`, § Passe corrective). Two **proposed, not validated**
amendments to WC5.1 corrigé (`ERN_WC5_2_amendements_proposes.md`), encoded beside the existing
definitions, which are unchanged:

* amendment 1, the new C22 item 4: for every entry live before the step, a step whose enlarged
  footprint (`TouchesX`) contains the controller is refused unless it is a protocol step of that
  entry, a `transfer` or by-value `spawn` admitted by C22 item 3, or a step after which the entry
  is dead (`CtlRestr`). The corrected encapsulation (`Encap6`) is `Encap5R` and `CtlRestr`; it
  reads the state after the step, since the last exception does. Executions: `Run6`;
* amendment 2, the new C18 item 4: `resetLock` also needs the controller-access right, in the form
  the model uses for C14 item 3 and C17 item 4 (`CtrlRight`). The step relation is unchanged: the
  amended step is a predicate beside it (`ResetLockAmOk`), and an amended execution is a `Run6`
  whose `resetLock` steps satisfy it (`RunAm`).
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency

/-! ## Amendment 1 -/

/-- The enlarged footprint (brief, corrective pass, "Empreinte élargie"): `Touches`, plus the place
`result` of a `depend`, whose anchors `D(result)` the step changes (Spec 1 §64 effect), the
"dependency state" of the proposed C22 item 4. The place itself, not its leaves: `depend` changes
`D` of `result` only (`dependEff`). -/
def TouchesX (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbl : Label) (l : Nat) : Prop :=
  Touches L st lbl l ∨
    match lbl with
    | .kernel _ (.depend q _) => l = q
    | _ => False

/-- Decidability of `TouchesX`. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbl : Label) (l : Nat) :
    Decidable (TouchesX L st lbl l) := by
  unfold TouchesX; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Decidability of `EncapVals` (WC5.1 corrigé C22 item 3 for the by-value composite). -/
instance instDecidableEncapVals (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) :
    (t : SC) → (vs : List (Nat × Nat)) → Decidable (EncapVals L reg c t vs)
  | _, [] => isTrue trivial
  | t, v :: vs =>
    haveI := instDecidableEncapVals L reg c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs
    inferInstanceAs (Decidable (TransferExcl L (t, reg) v.1 ∧ _))

/-- A `transfer` or a by-value `spawn` admitted by WC5.1 corrigé C22 item 3 (`TransferExcl`,
`EncapVals`): the exception of the proposed C22 item 4 for the legal moves of the mutex value. -/
def C223Move (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) : Label → Prop
  | .kernel _ (.transfer src _) => TransferExcl L st src
  | .spawnVal c _ ls vs => EncapVals L st.2 c (spawnCreate st.1 c ls) vs
  | _ => False

/-- Decidability of `C223Move`. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) (lbl : Label) : Decidable (C223Move L st lbl) := by
  unfold C223Move; split <;> infer_instance

/-- The restriction of the controller (proposed C22 item 4; brief, corrective pass): for every
entry `i` live before the step from `st` to `st'`, if the enlarged footprint of the step contains
`ControlOf(i)`, then the step is a protocol step of entry `i`, or a move admitted by C22 item 3, or
entry `i` is dead after it. -/
def CtlRestr (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbl : Label)
    (st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ i ∈ List.range st.2.1.length, OptP (st.2.1[i]?) (fun x => x.Live st.1 →
    OptP (ControlOf L st.1 x) (fun ctl => TouchesX L st lbl ctl →
      ctlOp i lbl ≠ none ∨ C223Move L (st.1, st.2.1) lbl ∨ ¬ x.Live st'.1) True) True

/-- Decidability of `CtlRestr`. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbl : Label)
    (st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) : Decidable (CtlRestr L st lbl st') := by
  unfold CtlRestr; infer_instance

/-- `CtlRestr` read on one entry. -/
theorem CtlRestr.apply {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbl : Label}
    (h : CtlRestr L st lbl st') {i : Nat} {x : SyncEntry} (hx : st.2.1[i]? = some x)
    (hl : x.Live st.1) {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L st.1 x = some ctl)
    (ht : TouchesX L st lbl ctl) :
    ctlOp i lbl ≠ none ∨ C223Move L (st.1, st.2.1) lbl ∨ ¬ x.Live st'.1 := by
  have hi := h i (List.mem_range.2 (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hx).1)
  rw [hx] at hi
  have hi' := hi hl
  rw [hc] at hi'
  exact hi' ht

/-- The corrected encapsulation of a step from `st` to `st'` (brief, corrective pass): `Encap5R`
and the restriction of the controller. -/
def Encap6 (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbl : Label)
    (st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) : Prop :=
  Encap5R k L st lbl ∧ CtlRestr L st lbl st'

/-- `Run6` (brief, corrective pass): a run with named states every step of which satisfies
`Encap6` and is an `ok` step. -/
def Run6 (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbls : List Label) :
    Prop :=
  ∀ i (h : i < lbls.length), Encap6 k L (σ i) lbls[i] (σ (i + 1)) ∧
    LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1))

    (st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ i ∈ List.range st.2.1.length, OptP (st.2.1[i]?) (fun x => x.Live st.1 →

    ResetLockOk L st.1 st.2.1 c i (st'.1, st'.2.1) := by
  cases h with
  | resetLock hr => exact hr

/-- In an amended execution, every `resetLock` step is an amended `resetLock` that is `ok`. -/
theorem RunAm.resetLock {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (h : RunAm k L σ lbls) {i : Nat} (hi : i < lbls.length) {c j : Nat}
    (hl : lbls[i] = .resetLock c j) :
    ResetLockAmOk L (σ i).1 (σ i).2.1 c j ((σ (i + 1)).1, (σ (i + 1)).2.1) := by
  have hs := (h.1 i hi).2
  have ha := h.2 i hi
  rw [hl] at hs ha
  exact ⟨lstep_resetLock hs, ha⟩

end Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal

import Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.Classify

/-!
# The proposed amendments to C22 item 4 and C18

Brief of milestone 4, slice 2, layer R, corrective pass, task 1
(`formal/reports/spec2-m4-mutexreal.md`, § Passe corrective). Two **proposed, not validated**
amendments to WC5.1 corrigé (`ERN_WC5_2_amendements_proposes.md`), encoded beside the existing
definitions, which are unchanged:

* amendment 1, the new C22 item 4: for every entry live before the step, a step whose enlarged
  footprint (`TouchesX`) contains the controller is refused unless it is a protocol step of that
  entry, a `transfer` or by-value `spawn` admitted by C22 item 3, or a step after which the entry
  is dead (`CtlRestr`). The corrected encapsulation (`Encap6`) is `Encap5R` and `CtlRestr`; it
  reads the state after the step, since the last exception does. Executions: `Run6`;
* amendment 2, the new C18 item 4: `resetLock` also needs the controller-access right, in the form
  the model uses for C14 item 3 and C17 item 4 (`CtrlRight`). The step relation is unchanged: the
  amended step is a predicate beside it (`ResetLockAmOk`), and an amended execution is a `Run6`
  whose `resetLock` steps satisfy it (`RunAm`).
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency

/-! ## Amendment 1 -/

/-- The enlarged footprint (brief, corrective pass, "Empreinte élargie"): `Touches`, plus the place
`result` of a `depend`, whose anchors `D(result)` the step changes (Spec 1 §64 effect), the
"dependency state" of the proposed C22 item 4. The place itself, not its leaves: `depend` changes
`D` of `result` only (`dependEff`). -/
def TouchesX (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbl : Label) (l : Nat) : Prop :=
  Touches L st lbl l ∨
    match lbl with
    | .kernel _ (.depend q _) => l = q
    | _ => False

/-- Decidability of `TouchesX`. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbl : Label) (l : Nat) :
    Decidable (TouchesX L st lbl l) := by
  unfold TouchesX; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Decidability of `EncapVals` (WC5.1 corrigé C22 item 3 for the by-value composite). -/
instance instDecidableEncapVals (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) :
    (t : SC) → (vs : List (Nat × Nat)) → Decidable (EncapVals L reg c t vs)
  | _, [] => isTrue trivial
  | t, v :: vs =>
    haveI := instDecidableEncapVals L reg c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs
    inferInstanceAs (Decidable (TransferExcl L (t, reg) v.1 ∧ _))

/-- A `transfer` or a by-value `spawn` admitted by WC5.1 corrigé C22 item 3 (`TransferExcl`,
`EncapVals`): the exception of the proposed C22 item 4 for the legal moves of the mutex value. -/
def C223Move (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) : Label → Prop
  | .kernel _ (.transfer src _) => TransferExcl L st src
  | .spawnVal c _ ls vs => EncapVals L st.2 c (spawnCreate st.1 c ls) vs
  | _ => False

/-- Decidability of `C223Move`. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) (lbl : Label) : Decidable (C223Move L st lbl) := by
  unfold C223Move; split <;> infer_instance

/-- The restriction of the controller (proposed C22 item 4; brief, corrective pass): for every
entry `i` live before the step from `st` to `st'`, if the enlarged footprint of the step contains
`ControlOf(i)`, then the step is a protocol step of entry `i`, or a move admitted by C22 item 3, or
entry `i` is dead after it. -/
def CtlRestr (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbl : Label)
    (st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ i ∈ List.range st.2.1.length, OptP (st.2.1[i]?) (fun x => x.Live st.1 →
    OptP (ControlOf L st.1 x) (fun ctl => TouchesX L st lbl ctl →
      ctlOp i lbl ≠ none ∨ C223Move L (st.1, st.2.1) lbl ∨ ¬ x.Live st'.1) True) True

/-- Decidability of `CtlRestr`. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbl : Label)
    (st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) : Decidable (CtlRestr L st lbl st') := by
  unfold CtlRestr; infer_instance

/-- `CtlRestr` read on one entry. -/
theorem CtlRestr.apply {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbl : Label}
    (h : CtlRestr L st lbl st') {i : Nat} {x : SyncEntry} (hx : st.2.1[i]? = some x)
    (hl : x.Live st.1) {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L st.1 x = some ctl)
    (ht : TouchesX L st lbl ctl) :
    ctlOp i lbl ≠ none ∨ C223Move L (st.1, st.2.1) lbl ∨ ¬ x.Live st'.1 := by
  have hi := h i (List.mem_range.2 (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hx).1)
  rw [hx] at hi
  have hi' := hi hl
  rw [hc] at hi'
  exact hi' ht

/-- The corrected encapsulation of a step from `st` to `st'` (brief, corrective pass): `Encap5R`
and the restriction of the controller. -/
def Encap6 (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbl : Label)
    (st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) : Prop :=
  Encap5R k L st lbl ∧ CtlRestr L st lbl st'

/-- `Run6` (brief, corrective pass): a run with named states every step of which satisfies
`Encap6` and is an `ok` step. -/
def Run6 (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbls : List Label) :
    Prop :=
  ∀ i (h : i < lbls.length), Encap6 k L (σ i) lbls[i] (σ (i + 1)) ∧
    LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1))

/-- Brief, corrective pass, task 1: every `Run6` is a `Run5R`. -/
theorem run6_run5R {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (h : Run6 k L σ lbls) : Run5R k L σ lbls :=
  fun i hi => ⟨(h i hi).1.1, (h i hi).2⟩

/-- A `Run5R` whose steps all satisfy the restriction of the controller is a `Run6`. -/
theorem run6_of_run5R {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (h : Run5R k L σ lbls)
    (hc : ∀ i (hi : i < lbls.length), CtlRestr L (σ i) lbls[i] (σ (i + 1))) : Run6 k L σ lbls :=
  fun i hi => ⟨⟨(h i hi).1, hc i hi⟩, (h i hi).2⟩

/-- A `Run6` satisfies the restriction of the controller at each step. -/
theorem Run6.restr {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (h : Run6 k L σ lbls) {i : Nat} (hi : i < lbls.length) :
    CtlRestr L (σ i) lbls[i] (σ (i + 1)) :=
  (h i hi).1.2

/-! ## Amendment 2 -/

/-- The amended `resetLock` of entry `i` executed by `c` (proposed C18 item 4; brief, corrective
pass): the preconditions of `ResetLockOk` (WC5.1 corrigé C18.1–C18.3) and the controller-access
right of the acting frame on that entry, `CtrlRight`, the form of C14 item 3 and C17 item 4. -/
def ResetLockAmOk (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat) (st' : SC × SyncReg) :
    Prop :=
  ResetLockOk L s reg c i st' ∧ OptP (reg[i]?) (fun e => CtrlRight L s e (s.view c).top) False

/-- Brief, corrective pass, task 1: an amended `resetLock` that is `ok` is a `resetLock` that is
`ok`. -/
theorem ResetLockAmOk.ok {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat}
    {st' : SC × SyncReg} (h : ResetLockAmOk L s reg c i st') : ResetLockOk L s reg c i st' :=
  h.1

/-- The clause added by the proposed C18 item 4 to a step: for `resetLock(i)` by `c`, the
controller-access right of the current frame of `c` on entry `i`; no condition on other steps. -/
def AmCond (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) : Label → Prop
  | .resetLock c i => OptP (st.2.1[i]?) (fun e => CtrlRight L st.1 e (st.1.view c).top) False
  | _ => True

/-- Decidability of `AmCond`. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbl : Label) :
    Decidable (AmCond L st lbl) := by
  unfold AmCond; split <;> infer_instance

/-- An amended execution (brief, corrective pass): a `Run6` each `resetLock` step of which
satisfies the clause of the proposed C18 item 4. -/
def RunAm (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) (lbls : List Label) :
    Prop :=
  Run6 k L σ lbls ∧ ∀ i (h : i < lbls.length), AmCond L (σ i) lbls[i]

/-- An `ok` `resetLock` step is a `ResetLockOk` of the registry. -/
theorem lstep_resetLock {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {c i : Nat} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    (h : LStep k L (.resetLock c i) st st') :
    ResetLockOk L st.1 st.2.1 c i (st'.1, st'.2.1) := by
  cases h with
  | resetLock hr => exact hr

/-- In an amended execution, every `resetLock` step is an amended `resetLock` that is `ok`. -/
theorem RunAm.resetLock {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (h : RunAm k L σ lbls) {i : Nat} (hi : i < lbls.length) {c j : Nat}
    (hl : lbls[i] = .resetLock c j) :
    ResetLockAmOk L (σ i).1 (σ i).2.1 c j ((σ (i + 1)).1, (σ (i + 1)).2.1) := by
  have hs := (h.1 i hi).2
  have ha := h.2 i hi
  rw [hl] at hs ha
  exact ⟨lstep_resetLock hs, ha⟩

end Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal

import Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.Amend
import Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.ClassifyWitness

/-!
# Exclusions and twins under the proposed C22 item 4

Brief of milestone 4, slice 2, layer R, corrective pass, task 2 (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` v11 §2
decies, "Contre-exemples de la classification et jumeaux"): the last steps of `store_cex`,
`alloc_cex` and `issue_cex` are refused by the restriction of the controller (`CtlRestr`) on their
existing states; each positive twin, and the `depend` witness with its twin, are checked by
`decide`. Verdicts and facts are written from the corpus.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.AmendWitness

open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal
open Ern.Concurrency.Corpus Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.ClassifyWitness
open Ern.Concurrency.Traces (L0)

/-! ## The three counter-examples are refused -/

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v11 §2 decies, `store`: the last step of `store_cex`, `c0 : store(z, lock)`,
admitted by `Encap5R`, is refused by the restriction of the controller (proposed C22 item 4: a
`store` whose target is the controller); the trace is no `Run6`. -/
theorem store_refused : ¬ CtlRestr L0 (csσ 4) (.kernel 0 (.store 4 2)) (csσ 5) ∧
    ¬ Run6 KM L0 csσ csLbls := by
  have h : ¬ CtlRestr L0 (csσ 4) (.kernel 0 (.store 4 2)) (csσ 5) := by decide
  exact ⟨h, fun hr => h (hr.restr (i := 4) (by decide))⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v11 §2 decies, `alloc`: the last step of `alloc_cex`, `c0 : alloc(provider =
slot, owner = lock)`, is refused by the restriction of the controller (an `alloc` whose owner is
the controller); the trace is no `Run6`. -/
theorem alloc_refused : ¬ CtlRestr L0 (caσ 3) (.kernel 0 (.alloc 1 2 [(none, 0)])) (caσ 4) ∧
    ¬ Run6 KM L0 caσ caLbls := by
  have h : ¬ CtlRestr L0 (caσ 3) (.kernel 0 (.alloc 1 2 [(none, 0)])) (caσ 4) := by decide
  exact ⟨h, fun hr => h (hr.restr (i := 3) (by decide))⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v11 §2 decies, `issue`: the last step of `issue_cex`, `c0 : issue(arena, R1,
lock2)`, is refused by the restriction of the controller (an `issue` whose destination is the
controller); the trace is no `Run6`. -/
theorem issue_refused : ¬ CtlRestr L0 (ciσ 7) (.issue 0 0 [5] 2) (ciσ 8) ∧
    ¬ Run6 KA L0 ciσ ciLbls := by
  have h : ¬ CtlRestr L0 (ciσ 7) (.issue 0 0 [5] 2) (ciσ 8) := by decide
  exact ⟨h, fun hr => h (hr.restr (i := 7) (by decide))⟩

/-! ## Twins -/

/-- `c0 : store(z, lock′)` (O8). -/
def ts2 : SC := storeEffC cs1 0 4 6

/-- The labels of the twin of the `store` counter-example. -/
def tsLbls : List Label :=
  mx3Lbls ++ [.kernel 0 (.derive 2 [5] .observe), .kernel 0 (.store 4 6)]

/-- The named states of the twin of the `store` counter-example. -/
def tsσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  [(x0, [], []), (x1, [], []), (x2, [], []), (x2, regX, []), (cs1, regX, []),
    (ts2, regX, [])].getD i (ts2, regX, [])

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v11 §2 decies, twin of `store`: `c0 : store(z, lock′)` is `ok` (Spec 1
§65.1–§65.5; `M′` has no entry) and the trace is a `Run6` from the initial state. -/
theorem store_twin : tsσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst), [], []) ∧ Run6 KM L0 tsσ tsLbls := by
  have h : Steps5R KM L0 [(x2, regX, []), (cs1, regX, []), (ts2, regX, [])]
      [.kernel 0 (.derive 2 [5] .observe), .kernel 0 (.store 4 6)] :=
    .cons ⟨⟨(by decide : ∀ e ∈ regX, e.Live x2 → 2 ≠ e.guarded), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, run6_of_run5R ((mx3_steps h).run _) (by decide)⟩

/-- `c0 : alloc(provider = slot, owner = lock′)` (O14). -/
def ta1 : SC := x2.set (allocEff (x2.view 0) 6 [(none, 0)])

/-- The labels of the twin of the `alloc` counter-example. -/
def taLbls : List Label := mx3Lbls ++ [.kernel 0 (.alloc 1 6 [(none, 0)])]

/-- The named states of the twin of the `alloc` counter-example. -/
def taσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  [(x0, [], []), (x1, [], []), (x2, [], []), (x2, regX, []), (ta1, regX, [])].getD i
    (ta1, regX, [])

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v11 §2 decies, twin of `alloc`: `c0 : alloc(provider = slot, owner = lock′)`
is `ok` (Spec 1 §71.3: `Modify` exercisable on `lock′` through `root_M′`) and the trace is a `Run6`
from the initial state. -/
theorem alloc_twin : taσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst), [], []) ∧ Run6 KM L0 taσ taLbls := by
  have h : Steps5R KM L0 [(x2, regX, []), (ta1, regX, [])] [.kernel 0 (.alloc 1 6 [(none, 0)])] :=
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide) trivial, rfl⟩) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, run6_of_run5R ((mx3_steps h).run _) (by decide)⟩

/-- `store(block, d0)` by context 0, the store phase of `issue(arena, R1, d0)` (O8). -/
def ti2 : SC := storeEffC ci2s 0 ci1.A.length 7

/-- The labels of the twin of the `issue` counter-example. -/
def tiLbls : List Label :=
  [.kernel 0 (.derive 2 [5, 6] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 3), .newArena 0 4 4,
   .kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 5 1), .newMutex 0 5, .acquire 0 0,
   .issue 0 0 [5] 7]

/-- The named states of the twin of the `issue` counter-example. -/
def tiσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  [(a0, [], []), (a1, [], []), (a2, [], []), (a2, [], arA), (a3, [], arA), (a4, [], arA),
    (a4, regA, arA), (ci1, regI, arA), (ti2, regI, arI)].getD i (ti2, regI, arI)

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v11 §2 decies, twin of `issue`: `c0 : issue(arena, R1, d0)`, `d0` a local
leaf of `f0` (as S3, step 3), is `ok` and the trace is a `Run6` from the initial state. -/
theorem issue_twin : tiσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init arst), [], []) ∧ Run6 KA L0 tiσ tiLbls := by
  have h : Steps5R KA L0 [(a0, [], []), (a1, [], []), (a2, [], []), (a2, [], arA), (a3, [], arA),
      (a4, [], arA), (a4, regA, arA), (ci1, regI, arA), (ti2, regI, arI)] tiLbls :=
    .cons ⟨⟨(fun e he => by cases he), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.newArena ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨(fun e he => by cases he), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.newMutex ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩
      (.acquire ⟨by decide, ⟨5, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩
      (.issue (.ok (E := ⟨4, 4, [5, 6], []⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide)
        ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩ ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩)) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, run6_of_run5R (h.run _) (by decide)⟩

/-! ## `depend` -/

/-- `c0 : depend(lock, a)` (O5), `a` the authority 4 of `cs1`. -/
def td2 : SC := dependEffC cs1 0 2 4
/-- `c0 : depend(lock′, a)` (O5). -/
def tdt2 : SC := dependEffC cs1 0 6 4

/-- The labels of the `depend` witness. -/
def tdLbls : List Label :=
  mx3Lbls ++ [.kernel 0 (.derive 2 [5] .observe), .kernel 0 (.depend 2 4)]

/-- The named states of the `depend` witness. -/
def tdσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  [(x0, [], []), (x1, [], []), (x2, [], []), (x2, regX, []), (cs1, regX, []),
    (td2, regX, [])].getD i (td2, regX, [])

/-- The labels of the twin of the `depend` witness. -/
def tdtLbls : List Label :=
  mx3Lbls ++ [.kernel 0 (.derive 2 [5] .observe), .kernel 0 (.depend 6 4)]

/-- The named states of the twin of the `depend` witness. -/
def tdtσ (i : Nat) : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg :=
  [(x0, [], []), (x1, [], []), (x2, [], []), (x2, regX, []), (cs1, regX, []),
    (tdt2, regX, [])].getD i (tdt2, regX, [])

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v11 §2 decies, `depend`: from `MX₃`, `c0 : a := derive(root_M′, Observe,
{slot′})` then `c0 : depend(lock, a)` form a `Run5R` from the initial state; the `depend` is an `ok`
kernel step (Spec 1 §64.1, §64.3), admitted by `Encap5R`, and refused by the restriction of the
controller (proposed C22 item 4: a change of the dependency state of the controller); entry `e`
stays live. -/
theorem depend_refused : tdσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst), [], []) ∧ Run5R KM L0 tdσ tdLbls ∧
    opStepC KM (.depend 2 4) 0 cs1 (.ok td2) ∧ (⟨3, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live td2 ∧
    ¬ CtlRestr L0 (tdσ 4) (.kernel 0 (.depend 2 4)) (tdσ 5) := by
  have hd : opStepC KM (.depend 2 4) 0 cs1 (.ok td2) := ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩
  have h : Steps5R KM L0 [(x2, regX, []), (cs1, regX, []), (td2, regX, [])]
      [.kernel 0 (.derive 2 [5] .observe), .kernel 0 (.depend 2 4)] :=
    .cons ⟨⟨(by decide : ∀ e ∈ regX, e.Live x2 → 2 ≠ e.guarded), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel hd) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, (mx3_steps h).run _, hd, by decide, by decide⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v11 §2 decies, twin of `depend`: `c0 : depend(lock′, a)` is `ok` and the
trace is a `Run6` from the initial state. -/
theorem depend_twin : tdtσ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init mxst), [], []) ∧ Run6 KM L0 tdtσ tdtLbls := by
  have h : Steps5R KM L0 [(x2, regX, []), (cs1, regX, []), (tdt2, regX, [])]
      [.kernel 0 (.derive 2 [5] .observe), .kernel 0 (.depend 6 4)] :=
    .cons ⟨⟨(by decide : ∀ e ∈ regX, e.Live x2 → 2 ≠ e.guarded), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) .nil
  exact ⟨rfl, run6_of_run5R ((mx3_steps h).run _) (by decide)⟩

end Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.AmendWitness

import Ern.Concurrency.Encap5R
import Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.GuardedStore
import Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.GuardedChainC
import Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.Encap5Witness
import Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.AR
import Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.S10

/-!
# Witnesses of the extended exclusion `PlaceExcl`

Brief of milestone 4, task 3: test of `PlaceExcl` (`Ern.Concurrency.Encap5R`) on W-GS
(`corpus-spec2-m3.md` v6 §2 sexies), on the locked trace of `Corpus/GuardedChainC.lean`, and on the
legitimate uses of `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v6 §1 (S2, S3 up to `issue`, S4, S10), replayed from the
initial state of Spec 1 §47, by `decide`.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.PlaceExclWitness

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency Ern.Concurrency.Corpus
open Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.GuardedStore
open Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.GuardedChain (gc0 gc6 greg)
open Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.GuardedChainC (lc7 lc8 lc9 lc10 lc11 lcLbls)
open Ern.Concurrency.Traces (L0 q0 q6 s4_steps)
open Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples (K0)

/-! ## W-GS -/

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v6 §2 sexies W-GS, step 1, under the extended rule: `store(z2, T)` by
context 0 without the grant is an `ok` step of the kernel (O8) admitted by `Encap5C`, and excluded
by `PlaceExcl`: the right over `T` holds neither before the store (Spec 1 §65.2) nor in the
resulting state (§65.5) without `guarded`, the only authority with effective `Modify` on `T`. -/
theorem W_GS_1_placeExcl : opStepC KM (.store 4 3) 0 gs5 (.ok gs6) ∧
    Encap5C L0 (gs5, sreg) (.kernel 0 (.store 4 3)) ∧
    ¬ PlaceExcl KM L0 (gs5, sreg, []) (.kernel 0 (.store 4 3)) ∧
    ¬ HasRight5 (gs5, sreg) 0 .modify 3 ∧ ¬ HasRight5 (gs6, sreg) 0 .modify 3 :=
  ⟨W_GS_1_ok, ⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

/-- Twin, `c0 : unlock(e)`: `g₀` released (O3, WC5 C17). -/
def gt8 : SC := gt7.set (releaseEff (gt7.view 0) 6)

/-- The W-GS setup from the initial state, each step admitted by `Encap5R` (Spec 1 §60, §65;
WC5 C4, C13). -/
theorem gs_setup5R : EncapsulatedTrace5R KM L0 (gs0, [], []) setupLbls (gs5, sreg, []) :=
  .cons ⟨⟨(fun e he => by cases he), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
    (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.newMutex ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨(by decide : ∀ e ∈ sreg, e.Live gs2 → 2 ≠ e.guarded), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
    (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨(by decide : ∀ e ∈ sreg, e.Live gs3 → 0 ≠ e.guarded), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
    (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.spawn ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) .nil

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v6 §2 sexies W-GS, twin under the extended rule, extended by an `unlock`:
from the initial state, the setup, then `acquire(e)`, `store(z2, T)` under `g₀` (the right over
`T` rests on the grant, held by frame 0) and `unlock(e)` by context 0 form an
`EncapsulatedTrace5R`. -/
theorem W_GS_twin_trace5R : EncapsulatedTrace5R KM L0 (gs0, [], [])
    (setupLbls ++ [.acquire 0 0] ++ [.kernel 0 (.store 4 3)] ++ [.unlock 0 0]) (gt8, sreg, []) := by
  have h := gs_setup5R.snoc (lbl := .acquire 0 0) (st'' := (gt6, sregG, []))
    ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.acquire W_GS_twin_ok.1)
  have h := h.snoc (lbl := .kernel 0 (.store 4 3)) (st'' := (gt7, sregG, []))
    ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel W_GS_twin_ok.2)
  exact h.snoc (lbl := .unlock 0 0) (st'' := (gt8, sreg, [])) ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
    (.unlock ⟨by decide, ⟨3, some 6⟩, 6, rfl, by decide, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩)

/-! ## The locked trace -/

/-- The locked trace of `Corpus/GuardedChainC.lean` (`lc_trace`) is an `EncapsulatedTrace5R`. -/
theorem lc_trace5R :
    EncapsulatedTrace5R KM L0 (gc0, [], []) lcLbls (lc11, [⟨4, some 7⟩], []) := by
  have h : EncapsulatedTrace5R KM L0 (gc0, [], []) (lcLbls.take 7) (gc6, greg, []) :=
    .cons ⟨⟨(fun e he => by cases he), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨(fun e he => by cases he), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.newMutex ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨(by decide : ∀ e ∈ greg, e.Live Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.GuardedChain.gc4 →
        0 ≠ e.guarded), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.spawn ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) .nil
  have h := h.snoc (lbl := .acquire 1 0) (st'' := (lc7, [⟨4, some 6⟩], []))
    ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩
    (.acquire ⟨by decide, ⟨4, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩)
  have h := h.snoc (lbl := .kernel 1 (.read 3 [4])) (st'' := (lc8, [⟨4, some 6⟩], []))
    ⟨⟨trivial, by decide, by decide⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩)
  have h := h.snoc (lbl := .unlock 1 0) (st'' := (lc9, greg, []))
    ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
    (.unlock ⟨by decide, ⟨4, some 6⟩, 6, rfl, by decide, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩)
  have h := h.snoc (lbl := .acquire 0 0) (st'' := (lc10, [⟨4, some 7⟩], []))
    ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩
    (.acquire ⟨by decide, ⟨4, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩)
  exact h.snoc (lbl := .kernel 0 (.write 3 [4])) (st'' := (lc11, [⟨4, some 7⟩], []))
    ⟨⟨trivial, by decide, by decide⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩)

/-! ## Legitimate uses -/

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v6 §1 S2, which is the cycle of `cycle_trace5`: block MX from the initial
state, then `acquire(e)`, `write3(T)` via `g` and `unlock(e)` by context 1, form an
`EncapsulatedTrace5R`. -/
theorem s2_trace5R : EncapsulatedTrace5R KM L0 (x0, [], [])
    [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 3 1), .newMutex 0 3,
     .kernel 0 (.derive 0 [1, 2] .observe), .spawn 0 [4] [], .acquire 1 0,
     .kernel 1 (.write 5 [3]), .unlock 1 0] (x7, regX, []) :=
  .cons ⟨⟨(fun e he => by cases he), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel mx_steps.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel mx_steps.2.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.newMutex mx_steps.2.2.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨(by decide : ∀ e ∈ regX, e.Live x2 → 0 ≠ e.guarded), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
    (.kernel mx_steps.2.2.2.2.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.spawn mx_steps.2.2.2.2.2) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.acquire S2_1_ok) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, by decide, by decide⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel S2_2_ok) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.unlock S2_3_ok) .nil

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v6 §1 S4: from the initial state of `q0`, the writes, the `alloc`, the
by-value composite moving `v` into `d` and the exit of the creating frame form an
`EncapsulatedTrace5R` (no mutex is registered). -/
theorem s4_trace5R : EncapsulatedTrace5R K0 L0 (q0, [], [])
    [.kernel 0 (.enter [] [(none, 0), (none, 0)]), .kernel 0 (.write 1 [1]),
     .kernel 0 (.write 2 [2]), .kernel 0 (.alloc 2 1 [(none, 0)]),
     .spawnVal 0 [] [(none, 0)] [(1, 4)], .kernel 0 .exit] (q6, [], []) :=
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel s4_steps.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, by decide, by decide⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel s4_steps.2.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, by decide, by decide⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel s4_steps.2.2.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel s4_steps.2.2.2.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨⟨fun _ h => (by cases h), trivial⟩, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩
    (.spawnVal s4_steps.2.2.2.2.1) <|
  .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.kernel s4_steps.2.2.2.2.2) .nil

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v6 §1 S3 up to step 3 (the labels of `s3_realized`): block AR from the
initial state, then `acquire(e2)` and `issue(arena, R1, d1)` by context 1, form an
`EncapsulatedTrace5R`; the `MetaRight` over `AV` (Spec 1 §77.1) rests on `g2`. -/
theorem s3_trace5R : EncapsulatedTrace5R KA L0 (a0, [], [])
    [.kernel 0 (.derive 2 [5, 6] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 3), .newArena 0 4 4,
     .kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 5 1), .newMutex 0 5,
     .kernel 0 (.derive 0 [1, 2] .observe), .spawn 0 [6] [(none, 0)], .acquire 1 0,
     .issue 1 0 [5] 8] (a8, regA8, arA1) := by
  have hn : NewMutexOk KA L0 arA a4 [] 0 5 (a4, regA) := ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩
  have ha : NewArenaStepC a2 [] [] 0 4 4 (.ok (a2, arA)) := ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩
  exact .cons ⟨⟨(fun e he => by cases he), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.newArena ha) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨(fun e he => by cases he), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, by decide⟩ (.kernel ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ (.newMutex hn) <|
    .cons ⟨⟨(by decide : ∀ e ∈ regA, e.Live a4 → 0 ≠ e.guarded), by decide, trivial⟩, trivial⟩
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|

import Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.Amend
import Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.Bridge
import Ern.MemoryModel.Arena

/-!
# The classification replayed under the proposed C22 item 4

Brief of milestone 4, slice 2, layer R, corrective pass, task 4
(`formal/reports/spec2-m4-mutexreal.md`, § Passe corrective):

* `classified6_sound`: under `Encap6`, the kinds `exclu` and `fin de vie` of the previous pass and
  the three former counter-examples (`store`, `alloc`, `issue`) do not have the controller of an
  entry live before and after the step in their enlarged footprint, and keep it. The first half is
  the restriction itself (proposed C22 item 4); the second is proved;
* `spawnVal_fixed_sound`: the statement left open by the previous pass, by-value `spawn` under
  hypothesis 3;
* `completeness6`, `completeness6_run`: completeness without restriction of kind, under
  hypothesis 3.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency
open SyncPreserveAux SyncInitAux

/-! ## Exclusion by the restriction -/

/-- The kinds of the three counter-examples of the previous pass: `store`, `alloc`, `issue`. -/
def CexKind : Label → Prop
  | .kernel _ (.store _ _) | .kernel _ (.alloc _ _ _) | .issue _ _ _ _ => True
  | _ => False

/-- A step of a kind `exclu`, `fin de vie` or of a former counter-example is no protocol step and
no move admitted by C22 item 3. -/
theorem kind_not_proto {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label}
    (hkind : ExclKind lbl ∨ FinKind lbl ∨ CexKind lbl) :
    (∀ i, ctlOp i lbl = none) ∧ ∀ st, ¬ C223Move L st lbl := by
  cases lbl with
  | kernel c op =>
    cases op <;> simp_all [ExclKind, FinKind, CexKind, ctlOp, C223Move]
  | _ => simp_all [ExclKind, FinKind, CexKind, ctlOp, C223Move]

/-- Under the restriction of the controller, a step that is no protocol step of entry `i` and no
move admitted by C22 item 3, after which entry `i` is still live, does not have its controller in
its enlarged footprint (proposed C22 item 4). -/
theorem restr_not_touch {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbl : Label}
    (h : CtlRestr L st lbl st') {i : Nat} {x : SyncEntry} (hx : st.2.1[i]? = some x)
    (hl : x.Live st.1) (hl' : x.Live st'.1) {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L st.1 x = some ctl)
    (hp : ctlOp i lbl = none) (hm : ¬ C223Move L (st.1, st.2.1) lbl) :
    ¬ TouchesX L st lbl ctl := fun ht => by
  rcases h.apply hx hl hc ht with h1 | h1 | h1
  · exact h1 hp
  · exact hm h1
  · exact h1 hl'

/-- A former counter-example kind (`store`, `alloc`, `issue`) keeps the controller of an entry live
after the step (WC5.1 corrigé C12, positional `ControlOf`): the kernel steps other than
`transfer` keep the holders of places and the parents (`opStep_facts`); `issue` is a `split` then a
`store` (Spec 1 §77, Part XIV), the `split` of `internal` admitted by `Encap` through the separation
of the registries. -/
theorem cex_ctl_same {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    (hk : KInvCA st.1) (hsep : AdminSep st.1 st.2.1 st.2.2) (hkind : CexKind lbl)
    (he : Encap5R k L st lbl) (h : LStep k L lbl st st') {x : SyncEntry} (hl' : x.Live st'.1)
    {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L st.1 x = some ctl) : ControlOf L st'.1 x = some ctl := by
  have hw : WF3 st.1.flat := hk.1.1.2
  have hb : x.guarded < st'.1.A.length := active_lt hl'
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg ar c op hop =>
    cases op <;> simp only [CexKind] at hkind
    · exact kernel_ctl_same hop he.1.1 (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw hb hc
    · exact kernel_ctl_same hop he.1.1 (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw hb hc
  | @issue s reg ar c i region dst st' hi =>
    obtain ⟨E, s₁, hE, -, -, hsp, hsto, -⟩ := issueStepC_ok hi
    have hsep' : Encap L (s, reg) (.kernel c (.split E.internal [region])) :=
      fun e hm hl₀ heq => hsep e hm E (List.mem_of_getElem? hE) hl₀
        (by show s.flat.Active E.internal; rw [heq]; exact hl₀) heq.symm
    have hw₁ : WF3 s₁.flat := wf3_after_view hk.1.1.1
      (show ViewStep ((KernelOp.split E.internal [region]).Step k) c s (.ok s₁) from hsp)
      fun t' hR => by
        have hR' : SplitStep k E.internal [region] (s.view c) (.ok t') := hR
        refine ⟨split_preserves_wf3 (SC.wf3_view hk.1.1.1 hw) hR', ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hR'; rfl
    have hb₁ : x.guarded < s₁.A.length := by
      have := (opStep_facts (L := L) (reg := reg) hsp hsep' (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw).skel.len
      have h₂ := (opStep_facts (L := L) (reg := reg) hsto trivial (fun _ _ h => by cases h)
        hw₁).skel.len
      have : x.guarded < st'.1.A.length := hb
      omega
    exact kernel_ctl_same hsto (reg := reg) trivial (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw₁ hb
      (kernel_ctl_same hsp hsep' (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw hb₁ hc)
  | _ => simp only [CexKind] at hkind

/-- Brief, corrective pass, task 4: under `Encap6`, from a state satisfying `KInvCA`, `SyncState`
and the separation of the registries, to a state satisfying `WF3`, an `ok` step of a kind `exclu`
or `fin de vie` of the previous pass, or of a former counter-example kind, with entry `i` live
before and after it, does not have the controller of entry `i` in its enlarged footprint and does
not change it. The first conclusion is the restriction of the controller (proposed C22 item 4);
the second is `classified_sound` and `cex_ctl_same`. -/
theorem classified6_sound {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label}
    {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} (hk : KInvCA st.1) (hw' : WF3 st'.1.flat)
    (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2.1) (hsep : AdminSep st.1 st.2.1 st.2.2)
    (hkind : ExclKind lbl ∨ FinKind lbl ∨ CexKind lbl) (he : Encap6 k L st lbl st')
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') {i : Nat} {x : SyncEntry} (hx : st.2.1[i]? = some x)
    (hl : x.Live st.1) (hl' : x.Live st'.1) {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L st.1 x = some ctl) :
    ¬ TouchesX L st lbl ctl ∧ ControlOf L st'.1 x = some ctl := by
  obtain ⟨hp, hm⟩ := kind_not_proto (L := L) hkind
  refine ⟨restr_not_touch he.2 hx hl hl' hc (hp i) (hm _), ?_⟩
  rcases hkind with hkind | hkind | hkind
  · exact (classified_sound hk hw' hs hsep (.inl hkind) he.1 h (List.mem_of_getElem? hx) hl hl'
      hc).2
  · exact (classified_sound hk hw' hs hsep (.inr hkind) he.1 h (List.mem_of_getElem? hx) hl hl'
      hc).2
  · exact cex_ctl_same hk hsep hkind he.1 h hl' hc

/-! ## By-value `spawn` under hypothesis 3 -/

/-- The footprints of a place are kept by a `transfer` (Spec 1 §63: parents are unchanged). -/
theorem footprint_transferEffC (t : SC) (c src dst q : Nat) :
    footprint (transferEffC t c src dst).P q = footprint t.P q :=
  footprint_congr (by simp [transferEffC, SC.set, transferEff])
    (transfer_parentOf (t.view c) src dst) q

/-- Along the transfer phases of the by-value composite, a leaf that lies in no destination and
was `Moved`, or lies in some source, is `Moved` at the end (Spec 1 §63 effect: the source leaves
become `Moved`, only the destination leaves become `Init`). -/
theorem transfers_moved (c l : Nat) : ∀ (t : SC) (vs : List (Nat × Nat)),
    (∀ v ∈ vs, l ∉ footprint t.P v.2) → (t.I l = .moved ∨ ∃ v ∈ vs, l ∈ footprint t.P v.1) →
    (transfersEff c t vs).I l = .moved
  | t, [], _, h => by
    rcases h with h | ⟨v, hv, -⟩
    · exact h
    · cases hv
  | t, v :: vs, hd, h => by
    have hI : (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2).I l = if l ∈ footprint t.P v.2 then .init
        else if l ∈ footprint t.P v.1 then .moved else t.I l := rfl
    have hnd := hd v List.mem_cons_self
    show (transfersEff c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs).I l = .moved
    refine transfers_moved c l (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs
      (fun w hw => by rw [footprint_transferEffC]; exact hd w (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw)) ?_
    rw [hI]
    simp only [hnd, ↓reduceIte]
    rcases h with h | ⟨w, hw, hlw⟩
    · left; split <;> first | rfl | exact h
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 hw with rfl | hw
      · left; simp [hlw]
      · by_cases hs : l ∈ footprint t.P v.1
        · left; simp [hs]
        · right; exact ⟨w, hw, by rw [footprint_transferEffC]; exact hlw⟩

/-- Brief, corrective pass, task 4, the statement left open by the previous pass: an `ok` by-value
`spawn` admitted by `Encap5R`, from a state satisfying `KInvCA` and `SyncState`, after which the

controller were a leaf of a transfer source, it would be `Moved` after the step (no destination,
all fresh locals of the child, contains it), while `SyncInv` makes the controller of a live entry
`Init` (WC5.1 corrigé C21 item 7; `spawnVal_syncState`). -/
theorem spawnVal_fixed_sound {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg}
    {ar : ArenaReg} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {vs : List (Nat × Nat)}
    (hk : KInvCA s) (hs : SyncState L s reg) (he : Encap5R k L (s, reg, ar) (.spawnVal c ps ls vs))
    (h : SpawnValStep k s c ps ls vs (.ok s')) {x : SyncEntry} (hx : x ∈ reg)
    (hl' : x.Live s') {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L s x = some ctl)
    (hfix : ControlOf L s' x = some ctl) :
    ¬ Touches L (s, reg, ar) (.spawnVal c ps ls vs) ctl := by
  have hs' := spawnVal_syncState hk h he.1.1 hs
  have hinit : s'.I ctl = .init := by
    have := hs'.1.ctlInit x hx hl'
    rw [hfix] at this
    exact this
  have hlt := ctl_lt hc
  rintro (hle | ⟨v, hv, hmem⟩)
  · exact absurd hlt (Nat.not_lt.2 hle)
  obtain ⟨-, hg⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hg
  have hv1 : v.1 < s.P.length :=
    Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Frames.partOf_le (partOf_of_mem_footprint (t := s.flat) hmem)) hlt
  have hsrc : ctl ∈ footprint (spawnCreate s c ls).P v.1 :=
    (Ern.MemoryModel.Arena.footprint_shapeP (hd := .frame s.nF) hpre.localsOK hv1 ctl).2 hmem
  have hdst : ∀ w ∈ vs, ctl ∉ footprint (spawnCreate s c ls).P w.2 := fun w hw hcw => by
    obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ := hpre.freshDst w hw
    have := Frames.partOf_le (partOf_of_mem_footprint (t := (spawnCreate s c ls).flat) hcw)
    omega
  have hmoved := transfers_moved c ctl (spawnCreate s c ls) vs hdst (.inr ⟨v, hv, hsrc⟩)
  have : (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).I ctl = (transfersEff c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs).I ctl := rfl
  rw [this, hmoved] at hinit

/-! ## Completeness without restriction of kind -/

/-- A move admitted by C22 item 3 (`transfer`, by-value `spawn`) that keeps the controller of an
entry live before and after it (hypothesis 3) does not have it in its enlarged footprint:
`transfer_fixed_sound`, `spawnVal_fixed_sound`. -/
theorem move_not_touch {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (he : Encap5R k L st lbl) (hm : C223Move L (st.1, st.2.1) lbl)
    (hk : KInvCA st.1) (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2.1) {x : SyncEntry} (hx : x ∈ st.2.1)
    (hl : x.Live st.1) (hl' : x.Live st'.1) {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L st.1 x = some ctl)
    (hfix : ControlOf L st'.1 x = some ctl) : ¬ TouchesX L st lbl ctl := by
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg ar c op hop =>
    cases op with
    | transfer src dst =>
      rintro (ht | ht)
      · exact transfer_fixed_sound hk hs he hop hx hl hc hfix ht
      · exact ht
    | _ => exact absurd hm (by simp [C223Move])
  | spawnVal hsv =>
    rintro (ht | ht)
    · exact spawnVal_fixed_sound hk hs he hsv hx hl' hc hfix ht
    · exact ht
  | _ => exact absurd hm (by simp [C223Move])

/-- Brief, corrective pass, task 4, completeness without restriction of kind: at a step `i` taken
under `Encap6`, from a state satisfying `KInvCA` and `SyncState`, while entry `e` is live before
and after the step and its controller is unchanged by the step (hypothesis 3), a step whose enlarged
footprint contains the controller is a protocol step on `e`, hence the event `ctlIdx e lbls i` of
the controller graph. By the restriction, the step is a protocol step of `e`, a move admitted by
C22 item 3 (excluded by `move_not_touch`), or ends the entry. `KInvCA`, `SyncState` and
hypothesis 3 are used only for the moves. -/
theorem completeness6 {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} {i : Nat} (hi : i < lbls.length) (hst : LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1)))
    (he : Encap6 k L (σ i) lbls[i] (σ (i + 1))) (hk : KInvCA (σ i).1)
    (hs : SyncState L (σ i).1 (σ i).2.1) {e : Nat} {x : SyncEntry}
    (hx : (σ i).2.1[e]? = some x) (hl : x.Live (σ i).1) (hl' : x.Live (σ (i + 1)).1)
    {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L (σ i).1 x = some ctl)
    (hfix : ControlOf L (σ (i + 1)).1 x = some ctl) (ht : TouchesX L (σ i) lbls[i] ctl)
    (o : Ords) :
    ∃ c op, ctlOp e lbls[i] = some (c, op) ∧
      (ctlGraph o e lbls).ev? (ctlIdx e lbls i) = some ⟨c, op.kind o⟩ := by
  rcases he.2.apply hx hl hc ht with hp | hm | hd
  · cases hop : ctlOp e lbls[i] with
    | none => exact absurd hop hp
    | some p => exact ⟨p.1, p.2, rfl, ctlGraph_ev o e hi hop⟩
  · exact absurd ht (move_not_touch hst he.1 hm hk hs (List.mem_of_getElem? hx) hl hl' hc hfix)
  · exact absurd hl' hd

/-- `ControlOf` reads only the `guarded` identity of the entry. -/
theorem controlOf_guarded_eq {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {x y : SyncEntry}
    (h : y.guarded = x.guarded) : ControlOf L s y = ControlOf L s x := by
  unfold ControlOf; rw [h]

/-- After a step, a registered entry is still registered with the same `guarded` identity
(`EntryStep`). -/
theorem entry_kept {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') {e : Nat} {x : SyncEntry} (hx : st.2.1[e]? = some x) :
    ∃ y, st'.2.1[e]? = some y ∧ y.guarded = x.guarded := by
  have hst := lstep_entry h e
  unfold EntryStep at hst
  cases hop : ctlOp e lbl with
  | none =>
    rw [hop] at hst
    rcases hst with hst | ⟨hn, -⟩
    · exact ⟨x, by rw [hst, hx], rfl⟩
    · rw [hx] at hn; cases hn
  | some p =>
    obtain ⟨c, op⟩ := p
    rw [hop] at hst
    cases op with
    | acq =>
      obtain ⟨x', hx', -, g, hy, -⟩ := hst
      rw [hx] at hx'; cases hx'
      exact ⟨_, hy, rfl⟩
    | unl =>
      obtain ⟨x', hx', hy⟩ := hst
      rw [hx] at hx'; cases hx'
      exact ⟨_, hy, rfl⟩
    | rst =>
      obtain ⟨x', hx', hy⟩ := hst
      rw [hx] at hx'; cases hx'
      exact ⟨_, hy, rfl⟩

/-- Brief, corrective pass, task 4, completeness without restriction of kind on a `Run6` from the
initial state of Spec 1 §47, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80) and hypothesis 3 (`CtlFixed`): a step
whose enlarged footprint contains the controller of an entry live before and after it is an event
of the controller graph. -/
theorem completeness6_run {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics}
    {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbls : List Label} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hstat : StaticsOK statics) (h0 : σ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []))
    (hr : Run6 k L σ lbls) {e : Nat} (h3 : CtlFixed σ L lbls e) {i : Nat} (hi : i < lbls.length)
    {x : SyncEntry} (hx : (σ i).2.1[e]? = some x) (hl : x.Live (σ i).1)
    (hl' : x.Live (σ (i + 1)).1) {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L (σ i).1 x = some ctl)
    (ht : TouchesX L (σ i) lbls[i] ctl) (o : Ords) :
    ∃ c op, ctlOp e lbls[i] = some (c, op) ∧
      (ctlGraph o e lbls).ev? (ctlIdx e lbls i) = some ⟨c, op.kind o⟩ := by
  have hr5 := run6_run5R hr
  have htr := run5R_prefix hr5 (Nat.le_of_lt hi)
  rw [h0] at htr
  obtain ⟨hk₀, hs₀⟩ := init_inv (k := k) hdd hstat L
  obtain ⟨hk, hs, -, -⟩ := trace_inv hdd htr hk₀ hs₀
  have hst := (hr i hi).2
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyg⟩ := entry_kept hst hx
  obtain ⟨ctl₀, hctl⟩ := h3
  have h1 := hctl i (Nat.le_of_lt hi) (by rw [hx]; rfl)
  have h2 := hctl (i + 1) hi (by rw [hy]; rfl)
  simp only [ctlAt, hx, hy, Option.bind_some] at h1 h2
  rw [hc] at h1
  cases h1
  rw [controlOf_guarded_eq hyg] at h2
  exact completeness6 hi hst (hr i hi).1 hk hs hx hl hl' hc h2 ht o

end Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal

  entry live before and after the step in their enlarged footprint, and keep it. The first half is
  the restriction itself (proposed C22 item 4); the second is proved;
* `spawnVal_fixed_sound`: the statement left open by the previous pass, by-value `spawn` under

* `completeness6`, `completeness6_run`: completeness without restriction of kind, under
  hypothesis 3.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency
open SyncPreserveAux SyncInitAux

/-! ## Exclusion by the restriction -/

/-- The kinds of the three counter-examples of the previous pass: `store`, `alloc`, `issue`. -/
def CexKind : Label → Prop
  | .kernel _ (.store _ _) | .kernel _ (.alloc _ _ _) | .issue _ _ _ _ => True
  | _ => False

/-- A step of a kind `exclu`, `fin de vie` or of a former counter-example is no protocol step and
no move admitted by C22 item 3. -/
theorem kind_not_proto {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label}
    (hkind : ExclKind lbl ∨ FinKind lbl ∨ CexKind lbl) :
    (∀ i, ctlOp i lbl = none) ∧ ∀ st, ¬ C223Move L st lbl := by
  cases lbl with
  | kernel c op =>
    cases op <;> simp_all [ExclKind, FinKind, CexKind, ctlOp, C223Move]
  | _ => simp_all [ExclKind, FinKind, CexKind, ctlOp, C223Move]

/-- Under the restriction of the controller, a step that is no protocol step of entry `i` and no
move admitted by C22 item 3, after which entry `i` is still live, does not have its controller in
its enlarged footprint (proposed C22 item 4). -/
theorem restr_not_touch {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbl : Label}
    (h : CtlRestr L st lbl st') {i : Nat} {x : SyncEntry} (hx : st.2.1[i]? = some x)
    (hl : x.Live st.1) (hl' : x.Live st'.1) {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L st.1 x = some ctl)
    (hp : ctlOp i lbl = none) (hm : ¬ C223Move L (st.1, st.2.1) lbl) :
    ¬ TouchesX L st lbl ctl := fun ht => by
  rcases h.apply hx hl hc ht with h1 | h1 | h1
  · exact h1 hp
  · exact hm h1
  · exact h1 hl'

after the step (WC5.1 corrigé C12, positional `ControlOf`): the kernel steps other than
`transfer` keep the holders of places and the parents (`opStep_facts`); `issue` is a `split` then a

of the registries. -/
theorem cex_ctl_same {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    (hk : KInvCA st.1) (hsep : AdminSep st.1 st.2.1 st.2.2) (hkind : CexKind lbl)
    (he : Encap5R k L st lbl) (h : LStep k L lbl st st') {x : SyncEntry} (hl' : x.Live st'.1)
    {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L st.1 x = some ctl) : ControlOf L st'.1 x = some ctl := by
  have hw : WF3 st.1.flat := hk.1.1.2
  have hb : x.guarded < st'.1.A.length := active_lt hl'
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg ar c op hop =>
    cases op <;> simp only [CexKind] at hkind
    · exact kernel_ctl_same hop he.1.1 (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw hb hc
    · exact kernel_ctl_same hop he.1.1 (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw hb hc

      fun e hm hl₀ heq => hsep e hm E (List.mem_of_getElem? hE) hl₀
        (by show s.flat.Active E.internal; rw [heq]; exact hl₀) heq.symm
    have hw₁ : WF3 s₁.flat := wf3_after_view hk.1.1.1
      (show ViewStep ((KernelOp.split E.internal [region]).Step k) c s (.ok s₁) from hsp)
      fun t' hR => by
        have hR' : SplitStep k E.internal [region] (s.view c) (.ok t') := hR
        refine ⟨split_preserves_wf3 (SC.wf3_view hk.1.1.1 hw) hR', ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hR'; rfl
    have hb₁ : x.guarded < s₁.A.length := by
      have := (opStep_facts (L := L) (reg := reg) hsp hsep' (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw).skel.len

/-- Brief, corrective pass, task 4: under `Encap6`, from a state satisfying `KInvCA`, `SyncState`
and the separation of the registries, to a state satisfying `WF3`, an `ok` step of a kind `exclu`
or `fin de vie` of the previous pass, or of a former counter-example kind, with entry `i` live
before and after it, does not have the controller of entry `i` in its enlarged footprint and does
not change it. The first conclusion is the restriction of the controller (proposed C22 item 4);
the second is `classified_sound` and `cex_ctl_same`. -/
theorem classified6_sound {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label}
    {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} (hk : KInvCA st.1) (hw' : WF3 st'.1.flat)
    (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2.1) (hsep : AdminSep st.1 st.2.1 st.2.2)
    (hkind : ExclKind lbl ∨ FinKind lbl ∨ CexKind lbl) (he : Encap6 k L st lbl st')
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') {i : Nat} {x : SyncEntry} (hx : st.2.1[i]? = some x)
    (hl : x.Live st.1) (hl' : x.Live st'.1) {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L st.1 x = some ctl) :
    ¬ TouchesX L st lbl ctl ∧ ControlOf L st'.1 x = some ctl := by
  obtain ⟨hp, hm⟩ := kind_not_proto (L := L) hkind
  refine ⟨restr_not_touch he.2 hx hl hl' hc (hp i) (hm _), ?_⟩
  rcases hkind with hkind | hkind | hkind
  · exact (classified_sound hk hw' hs hsep (.inl hkind) he.1 h (List.mem_of_getElem? hx) hl hl'
      hc).2

    footprint (transferEffC t c src dst).P q = footprint t.P q :=

theorem move_not_touch {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (he : Encap5R k L st lbl) (hm : C223Move L (st.1, st.2.1) lbl)
    (hk : KInvCA st.1) (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2.1) {x : SyncEntry} (hx : x ∈ st.2.1)

    (hfix : ControlOf L st'.1 x = some ctl) : ¬ TouchesX L st lbl ctl := by
  cases h with

    cases op with
    | transfer src dst =>
      rintro (ht | ht)
      · exact transfer_fixed_sound hk hs he hop hx hl hc hfix ht
      · exact ht
    | _ => exact absurd hm (by simp [C223Move])
  | spawnVal hsv =>
    rintro (ht | ht)
    · exact spawnVal_fixed_sound hk hs he hsv hx hl' hc hfix ht
    · exact ht
  | _ => exact absurd hm (by simp [C223Move])

/-- Brief, corrective pass, task 4, completeness without restriction of kind: at a step `i` taken
under `Encap6`, from a state satisfying `KInvCA` and `SyncState`, while entry `e` is live before
and after the step and its controller is unchanged by the step (hypothesis 3), a step whose enlarged
footprint contains the controller is a protocol step on `e`, hence the event `ctlIdx e lbls i` of
the controller graph. By the restriction, the step is a protocol step of `e`, a move admitted by
C22 item 3 (excluded by `move_not_touch`), or ends the entry. `KInvCA`, `SyncState` and
hypothesis 3 are used only for the moves. -/
theorem completeness6 {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} {i : Nat} (hi : i < lbls.length) (hst : LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1)))
    (he : Encap6 k L (σ i) lbls[i] (σ (i + 1))) (hk : KInvCA (σ i).1)
    (hs : SyncState L (σ i).1 (σ i).2.1) {e : Nat} {x : SyncEntry}
    (hx : (σ i).2.1[e]? = some x) (hl : x.Live (σ i).1) (hl' : x.Live (σ (i + 1)).1)
    {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L (σ i).1 x = some ctl)
    (hfix : ControlOf L (σ (i + 1)).1 x = some ctl) (ht : TouchesX L (σ i) lbls[i] ctl)
    (o : Ords) :
    ∃ c op, ctlOp e lbls[i] = some (c, op) ∧
      (ctlGraph o e lbls).ev? (ctlIdx e lbls i) = some ⟨c, op.kind o⟩ := by
  rcases he.2.apply hx hl hc ht with hp | hm | hd
  · cases hop : ctlOp e lbls[i] with
    | none => exact absurd hop hp
    | some p => exact ⟨p.1, p.2, rfl, ctlGraph_ev o e hi hop⟩
  · exact absurd ht (move_not_touch hst he.1 hm hk hs (List.mem_of_getElem? hx) hl hl' hc hfix)
  · exact absurd hl' hd

/-- `ControlOf` reads only the `guarded` identity of the entry. -/
theorem controlOf_guarded_eq {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {x y : SyncEntry}
    (h : y.guarded = x.guarded) : ControlOf L s y = ControlOf L s x := by
  unfold ControlOf; rw [h]

/-- After a step, a registered entry is still registered with the same `guarded` identity
(`EntryStep`). -/
theorem entry_kept {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') {e : Nat} {x : SyncEntry} (hx : st.2.1[e]? = some x) :
    ∃ y, st'.2.1[e]? = some y ∧ y.guarded = x.guarded := by
  have hst := lstep_entry h e
  unfold EntryStep at hst
  cases hop : ctlOp e lbl with
  | none =>
    rw [hop] at hst
    rcases hst with hst | ⟨hn, -⟩
    · exact ⟨x, by rw [hst, hx], rfl⟩
    · rw [hx] at hn; cases hn
  | some p =>
    obtain ⟨c, op⟩ := p
    rw [hop] at hst
    cases op with
    | acq =>
      obtain ⟨x', hx', -, g, hy, -⟩ := hst
      rw [hx] at hx'; cases hx'
      exact ⟨_, hy, rfl⟩
    | unl =>
      obtain ⟨x', hx', hy⟩ := hst
      rw [hx] at hx'; cases hx'
      exact ⟨_, hy, rfl⟩
    | rst =>
      obtain ⟨x', hx', hy⟩ := hst
      rw [hx] at hx'; cases hx'
      exact ⟨_, hy, rfl⟩

/-- Brief, corrective pass, task 4, completeness without restriction of kind on a `Run6` from the
initial state of Spec 1 §47, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80) and hypothesis 3 (`CtlFixed`): a step
whose enlarged footprint contains the controller of an entry live before and after it is an event
of the controller graph. -/
theorem completeness6_run {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics}
    {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbls : List Label} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hstat : StaticsOK statics) (h0 : σ 0 = (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []))
    (hr : Run6 k L σ lbls) {e : Nat} (h3 : CtlFixed σ L lbls e) {i : Nat} (hi : i < lbls.length)
    {x : SyncEntry} (hx : (σ i).2.1[e]? = some x) (hl : x.Live (σ i).1)
    (hl' : x.Live (σ (i + 1)).1) {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L (σ i).1 x = some ctl)
    (ht : TouchesX L (σ i) lbls[i] ctl) (o : Ords) :
    ∃ c op, ctlOp e lbls[i] = some (c, op) ∧
      (ctlGraph o e lbls).ev? (ctlIdx e lbls i) = some ⟨c, op.kind o⟩ := by
  have hr5 := run6_run5R hr
  have htr := run5R_prefix hr5 (Nat.le_of_lt hi)
  rw [h0] at htr
  obtain ⟨hk₀, hs₀⟩ := init_inv (k := k) hdd hstat L
  obtain ⟨hk, hs, -, -⟩ := trace_inv hdd htr hk₀ hs₀
  have hst := (hr i hi).2
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyg⟩ := entry_kept hst hx
  obtain ⟨ctl₀, hctl⟩ := h3
  have h1 := hctl i (Nat.le_of_lt hi) (by rw [hx]; rfl)
  have h2 := hctl (i + 1) hi (by rw [hy]; rfl)
  simp only [ctlAt, hx, hy, Option.bind_some] at h1 h2
  rw [hc] at h1
  cases h1
  rw [controlOf_guarded_eq hyg] at h2
  exact completeness6 hi hst (hr i hi).1 hk hs hx hl hl' hc h2 ht o

end Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal

import Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.Amend
import Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.Bridge
import Ern.MemoryModel.Arena

/-!
# The classification replayed under the proposed C22 item 4

Brief of milestone 4, slice 2, layer R, corrective pass, task 4
(`formal/reports/spec2-m4-mutexreal.md`, § Passe corrective):

* `classified6_sound`: under `Encap6`, the kinds `exclu` and `fin de vie` of the previous pass and
  the three former counter-examples (`store`, `alloc`, `issue`) do not have the controller of an
  entry live before and after the step in their enlarged footprint, and keep it. The first half is
  the restriction itself (proposed C22 item 4); the second is proved;
* `spawnVal_fixed_sound`: the statement left open by the previous pass, by-value `spawn` under
  hypothesis 3;
* `completeness6`, `completeness6_run`: completeness without restriction of kind, under
  hypothesis 3.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency
open SyncPreserveAux SyncInitAux

/-! ## Exclusion by the restriction -/

/-- The kinds of the three counter-examples of the previous pass: `store`, `alloc`, `issue`. -/
def CexKind : Label → Prop
  | .kernel _ (.store _ _) | .kernel _ (.alloc _ _ _) | .issue _ _ _ _ => True
  | _ => False

/-- A step of a kind `exclu`, `fin de vie` or of a former counter-example is no protocol step and
no move admitted by C22 item 3. -/
theorem kind_not_proto {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label}
    (hkind : ExclKind lbl ∨ FinKind lbl ∨ CexKind lbl) :
    (∀ i, ctlOp i lbl = none) ∧ ∀ st, ¬ C223Move L st lbl := by
  cases lbl with
  | kernel c op =>
    cases op <;> simp_all [ExclKind, FinKind, CexKind, ctlOp, C223Move]
  | _ => simp_all [ExclKind, FinKind, CexKind, ctlOp, C223Move]

/-- Under the restriction of the controller, a step that is no protocol step of entry `i` and no
move admitted by C22 item 3, after which entry `i` is still live, does not have its controller in
its enlarged footprint (proposed C22 item 4). -/
theorem restr_not_touch {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbl : Label}
    (h : CtlRestr L st lbl st') {i : Nat} {x : SyncEntry} (hx : st.2.1[i]? = some x)
    (hl : x.Live st.1) (hl' : x.Live st'.1) {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L st.1 x = some ctl)
    (hp : ctlOp i lbl = none) (hm : ¬ C223Move L (st.1, st.2.1) lbl) :
    ¬ TouchesX L st lbl ctl := fun ht => by
  rcases h.apply hx hl hc ht with h1 | h1 | h1
  · exact h1 hp
  · exact hm h1
  · exact h1 hl'

/-- A former counter-example kind (`store`, `alloc`, `issue`) keeps the controller of an entry live
after the step (WC5.1 corrigé C12, positional `ControlOf`): the kernel steps other than
`transfer` keep the holders of places and the parents (`opStep_facts`); `issue` is a `split` then a
`store` (Spec 1 §77, Part XIV), the `split` of `internal` admitted by `Encap` through the separation
of the registries. -/
theorem cex_ctl_same {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    (hk : KInvCA st.1) (hsep : AdminSep st.1 st.2.1 st.2.2) (hkind : CexKind lbl)
    (he : Encap5R k L st lbl) (h : LStep k L lbl st st') {x : SyncEntry} (hl' : x.Live st'.1)
    {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L st.1 x = some ctl) : ControlOf L st'.1 x = some ctl := by
  have hw : WF3 st.1.flat := hk.1.1.2
  have hb : x.guarded < st'.1.A.length := active_lt hl'
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg ar c op hop =>
    cases op <;> simp only [CexKind] at hkind
    · exact kernel_ctl_same hop he.1.1 (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw hb hc
    · exact kernel_ctl_same hop he.1.1 (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw hb hc
  | @issue s reg ar c i region dst st' hi =>
    obtain ⟨E, s₁, hE, -, -, hsp, hsto, -⟩ := issueStepC_ok hi
    have hsep' : Encap L (s, reg) (.kernel c (.split E.internal [region])) :=
      fun e hm hl₀ heq => hsep e hm E (List.mem_of_getElem? hE) hl₀
        (by show s.flat.Active E.internal; rw [heq]; exact hl₀) heq.symm
    have hw₁ : WF3 s₁.flat := wf3_after_view hk.1.1.1
      (show ViewStep ((KernelOp.split E.internal [region]).Step k) c s (.ok s₁) from hsp)
      fun t' hR => by
        have hR' : SplitStep k E.internal [region] (s.view c) (.ok t') := hR
        refine ⟨split_preserves_wf3 (SC.wf3_view hk.1.1.1 hw) hR', ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hR'; rfl
    have hb₁ : x.guarded < s₁.A.length := by
      have := (opStep_facts (L := L) (reg := reg) hsp hsep' (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw).skel.len
      have h₂ := (opStep_facts (L := L) (reg := reg) hsto trivial (fun _ _ h => by cases h)
        hw₁).skel.len
      have : x.guarded < st'.1.A.length := hb
      omega
    exact kernel_ctl_same hsto (reg := reg) trivial (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw₁ hb
      (kernel_ctl_same hsp hsep' (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw hb₁ hc)
  | _ => simp only [CexKind] at hkind

/-- Brief, corrective pass, task 4: under `Encap6`, from a state satisfying `KInvCA`, `SyncState`
and the separation of the registries, to a state satisfying `WF3`, an `ok` step of a kind `exclu`
or `fin de vie` of the previous pass, or of a former counter-example kind, with entry `i` live
before and after it, does not have the controller of entry `i` in its enlarged footprint and does
not change it. The first conclusion is the restriction of the controller (proposed C22 item 4);
the second is `classified_sound` and `cex_ctl_same`. -/
theorem classified6_sound {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label}
    {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} (hk : KInvCA st.1) (hw' : WF3 st'.1.flat)
    (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2.1) (hsep : AdminSep st.1 st.2.1 st.2.2)
    (hkind : ExclKind lbl ∨ FinKind lbl ∨ CexKind lbl) (he : Encap6 k L st lbl st')
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') {i : Nat} {x : SyncEntry} (hx : st.2.1[i]? = some x)
    (hl : x.Live st.1) (hl' : x.Live st'.1) {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L st.1 x = some ctl) :
    ¬ TouchesX L st lbl ctl ∧ ControlOf L st'.1 x = some ctl := by
  obtain ⟨hp, hm⟩ := kind_not_proto (L := L) hkind
  refine ⟨restr_not_touch he.2 hx hl hl' hc (hp i) (hm _), ?_⟩
  rcases hkind with hkind | hkind | hkind
  · exact (classified_sound hk hw' hs hsep (.inl hkind) he.1 h (List.mem_of_getElem? hx) hl hl'
      hc).2
  · exact (classified_sound hk hw' hs hsep (.inr hkind) he.1 h (List.mem_of_getElem? hx) hl hl'
      hc).2
  · exact cex_ctl_same hk hsep hkind he.1 h hl' hc

/-! ## By-value `spawn` under hypothesis 3 -/

/-- The footprints of a place are kept by a `transfer` (Spec 1 §63: parents are unchanged). -/
theorem footprint_transferEffC (t : SC) (c src dst q : Nat) :
    footprint (transferEffC t c src dst).P q = footprint t.P q :=
  footprint_congr (by simp [transferEffC, SC.set, transferEff])
    (transfer_parentOf (t.view c) src dst) q

/-- Along the transfer phases of the by-value composite, a leaf that lies in no destination and
was `Moved`, or lies in some source, is `Moved` at the end (Spec 1 §63 effect: the source leaves
become `Moved`, only the destination leaves become `Init`). -/
theorem transfers_moved (c l : Nat) : ∀ (t : SC) (vs : List (Nat × Nat)),
    (∀ v ∈ vs, l ∉ footprint t.P v.2) → (t.I l = .moved ∨ ∃ v ∈ vs, l ∈ footprint t.P v.1) →
    (transfersEff c t vs).I l = .moved
  | t, [], _, h => by
    rcases h with h | ⟨v, hv, -⟩
    · exact h
    · cases hv
  | t, v :: vs, hd, h => by
    have hI : (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2).I l = if l ∈ footprint t.P v.2 then .init
        else if l ∈ footprint t.P v.1 then .moved else t.I l := rfl
    have hnd := hd v List.mem_cons_self
    show (transfersEff c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs).I l = .moved
    refine transfers_moved c l (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs
      (fun w hw => by rw [footprint_transferEffC]; exact hd w (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw)) ?_
    rw [hI]
    simp only [hnd, ↓reduceIte]
    rcases h with h | ⟨w, hw, hlw⟩
    · left; split <;> first | rfl | exact h
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 hw with rfl | hw
      · left; simp [hlw]
      · by_cases hs : l ∈ footprint t.P v.1
        · left; simp [hs]
        · right; exact ⟨w, hw, by rw [footprint_transferEffC]; exact hlw⟩

/-- Brief, corrective pass, task 4, the statement left open by the previous pass: an `ok` by-value
`spawn` admitted by `Encap5R`, from a state satisfying `KInvCA` and `SyncState`, after which the
controller of an entry live after the step is unchanged (hypothesis 3), does not touch it. If the
controller were a leaf of a transfer source, it would be `Moved` after the step (no destination,
all fresh locals of the child, contains it), while `SyncInv` makes the controller of a live entry
`Init` (WC5.1 corrigé C21 item 7; `spawnVal_syncState`). -/
theorem spawnVal_fixed_sound {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg}
    {ar : ArenaReg} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {vs : List (Nat × Nat)}
    (hk : KInvCA s) (hs : SyncState L s reg) (he : Encap5R k L (s, reg, ar) (.spawnVal c ps ls vs))
    (h : SpawnValStep k s c ps ls vs (.ok s')) {x : SyncEntry} (hx : x ∈ reg)
    (hl' : x.Live s') {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L s x = some ctl)
    (hfix : ControlOf L s' x = some ctl) :
    ¬ Touches L (s, reg, ar) (.spawnVal c ps ls vs) ctl := by
  have hs' := spawnVal_syncState hk h he.1.1 hs
  have hinit : s'.I ctl = .init := by
    have := hs'.1.ctlInit x hx hl'
    rw [hfix] at this
    exact this
  have hlt := ctl_lt hc
  rintro (hle | ⟨v, hv, hmem⟩)
  · exact absurd hlt (Nat.not_lt.2 hle)
  obtain ⟨-, hg⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hg
  have hv1 : v.1 < s.P.length :=
    Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Frames.partOf_le (partOf_of_mem_footprint (t := s.flat) hmem)) hlt
  have hsrc : ctl ∈ footprint (spawnCreate s c ls).P v.1 :=
    (Ern.MemoryModel.Arena.footprint_shapeP (hd := .frame s.nF) hpre.localsOK hv1 ctl).2 hmem
  have hdst : ∀ w ∈ vs, ctl ∉ footprint (spawnCreate s c ls).P w.2 := fun w hw hcw => by
    obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ := hpre.freshDst w hw
    have := Frames.partOf_le (partOf_of_mem_footprint (t := (spawnCreate s c ls).flat) hcw)
    omega
  have hmoved := transfers_moved c ctl (spawnCreate s c ls) vs hdst (.inr ⟨v, hv, hsrc⟩)
  have : (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).I ctl = (transfersEff c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs).I ctl := rfl
  rw [this, hmoved] at hinit
  cases hinit

/-! ## Completeness without restriction of kind -/

/-- A move admitted by C22 item 3 (`transfer`, by-value `spawn`) that keeps the controller of an
entry live before and after it (hypothesis 3) does not have it in its enlarged footprint:
`transfer_fixed_sound`, `spawnVal_fixed_sound`. -/
theorem move_not_touch {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (he : Encap5R k L st lbl) (hm : C223Move L (st.1, st.2.1) lbl)
    (hk : KInvCA st.1) (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2.1) {x : SyncEntry} (hx : x ∈ st.2.1)
    (hl : x.Live st.1) (hl' : x.Live st'.1) {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L st.1 x = some ctl)
    (hfix : ControlOf L st'.1 x = some ctl) : ¬ TouchesX L st lbl ctl := by
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg ar c op hop =>
    cases op with
    | transfer src dst =>
      rintro (ht | ht)
      · exact transfer_fixed_sound hk hs he hop hx hl hc hfix ht
      · exact ht
    | _ => exact absurd hm (by simp [C223Move])
  | spawnVal hsv =>
    rintro (ht | ht)
    · exact spawnVal_fixed_sound hk hs he hsv hx hl' hc hfix ht
    · exact ht
  | _ => exact absurd hm (by simp [C223Move])

/-- Brief, corrective pass, task 4, completeness without restriction of kind: at a step `i` taken
under `Encap6`, from a state satisfying `KInvCA` and `SyncState`, while entry `e` is live before
and after the step and its controller is unchanged by the step (hypothesis 3), a step whose enlarged
footprint contains the controller is a protocol step on `e`, hence the event `ctlIdx e lbls i` of
the controller graph. By the restriction, the step is a protocol step of `e`, a move admitted by
C22 item 3 (excluded by `move_not_touch`), or ends the entry. `KInvCA`, `SyncState` and
hypothesis 3 are used only for the moves. -/
theorem completeness6 {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} {i : Nat} (hi : i < lbls.length) (hst : LStep k L lbls[i] (σ i) (σ (i + 1)))
    (he : Encap6 k L (σ i) lbls[i] (σ (i + 1))) (hk : KInvCA (σ i).1)
    (hs : SyncState L (σ i).1 (σ i).2.1) {e : Nat} {x : SyncEntry}
    (hx : (σ i).2.1[e]? = some x) (hl : x.Live (σ i).1) (hl' : x.Live (σ (i + 1)).1)
    {ctl : Nat} (hc : ControlOf L (σ i).1 x = some ctl)
    (hfix : ControlOf L (σ (i + 1)).1 x = some ctl) (ht : TouchesX L (σ i) lbls[i] ctl)
    (o : Ords) :
    ∃ c op, ctlOp e lbls[i] = some (c, op) ∧
      (ctlGraph o e lbls).ev? (ctlIdx e lbls i) = some ⟨c, op.kind o⟩ := by
  rcases he.2.apply hx hl hc ht with hp | hm | hd
  · cases hop : ctlOp e lbls[i] with
    | none => exact absurd hop hp
    | some p => exact ⟨p.1, p.2, rfl, ctlGraph_ev o e hi hop⟩
  · exact absurd ht (move_not_touch hst he.1 hm hk hs (List.mem_of_getElem? hx) hl hl' hc hfix)
  · exact absurd hl' hd

/-- `ControlOf` reads only the `guarded` identity of the entry. -/
theorem controlOf_guarded_eq {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {x y : SyncEntry}
    (h : y.guarded = x.guarded) : ControlOf L s y = ControlOf L s x := by
  unfold ControlOf; rw [h]

/-- After a step, a registered entry is still registered with the same `guarded` identity
(`EntryStep`). -/
theorem entry_kept {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') {e : Nat} {x : SyncEntry} (hx : st.2.1[e]? = some x) :
    ∃ y, st'.2.1[e]? = some y ∧ y.guarded = x.guarded := by
  have hst := lstep_entry h e
  unfold EntryStep at hst
  cases hop : ctlOp e lbl with
  | none =>
    rw [hop] at hst
    rcases hst with hst | ⟨hn, -⟩
    · exact ⟨x, by rw [hst, hx], rfl⟩
    · rw [hx] at hn; cases hn
  | some p =>
    obtain ⟨c, op⟩ := p
    rw [hop] at hst
    cases op with
    | acq =>
      obtain ⟨x', hx', -, g, hy, -⟩ := hst
      rw [hx] at hx'; cases hx'
      exact ⟨_, hy, rfl⟩
    | unl =>
      obtain ⟨x', hx', hy⟩ := hst
      rw [hx] at hx'; cases hx'
      exact ⟨_, hy, rfl⟩
    | rst =>
      obtain ⟨x', hx', hy⟩ := hst
      rw [hx] at hx'; cases hx'
      exact ⟨_, hy, rfl⟩

/-- Brief, corrective pass, task 4, completeness without restriction of kind on a `Run6` from the
initial state of Spec 1 §47, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80) and hypothesis 3 (`CtlFixed`): a step
whose enlarged footprint contains the controller of an entry live before and after it is an event
of the controller graph. -/
theorem completeness6_run {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics}

import Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.NonRegression

/-!
# `resetLock` under the proposed C18 item 4

Brief of milestone 4, slice 2, layer R, corrective pass, task 5 (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` v11 §2
decies, "`resetLock` sous C18 amendé"): W-RC step 4 has no `ok` outcome for the amended step, the
failing clause being the controller-access right; its twin, and the `resetLock` steps of W-RL,
W-RL-J and of the positive twin of S11, stay `ok` under the amended form. In an amended execution
every protocol step `acquire(e)`, `unlock(e)`, `resetLock(e)` is made by a frame with a present
effective mode on `ControlOf(e)` (`protocol_authority`).
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.ResetAmend

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal
open Ern.Concurrency.Corpus Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.MutexEdge
open Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.ResetLockRight
open Ern.Concurrency.Traces (L0)

/-! ## Verdicts -/

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v11 §2 decies, W-RC step 4, `c0 (f1) : resetLock(e)`, under the proposed
C18 item 4: no `ok` outcome; the failing clause is the new item 4 (no controller-access right of
`f1`), the clauses C18.1–C18.3 holding (`ResetLockOk`). Under the criterion of the corpus §0:
`reject`. -/
theorem W_RC_4_amended_reject : (∀ st', ¬ ResetLockAmOk L0 rc2 regX 0 0 st') ∧
    ResetLockOk L0 rc2 regX 0 0 (rc2, regX) ∧ ¬ CtrlRight L0 rc2 ⟨3, none⟩ (rc2.view 0).top := by
  have hc : ¬ CtrlRight L0 rc2 ⟨3, none⟩ (rc2.view 0).top := by decide
  refine ⟨fun st' h => ?_, W_RC_4_ok, hc⟩
  have h2 := h.2
  simp only [regX, List.getElem?_cons_zero, OptP] at h2
  exact hc h2

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v11 §2 decies, twin of W-RC: from `MX₃`, `c0 (f0) : resetLock(e)` is `ok`
under the amended form, `f0` having a present effective mode on `lock`. -/
theorem W_RC_twin_amended_ok : ResetLockAmOk L0 x2 regX 0 0 (x2, regX) :=
  ⟨W_RC_twin_ok.1, by decide⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v11 §2 decies, W-RL: the `resetLock(e)` by `c0` after the prefix P is `ok`
under the amended form (`root_M` has a present effective mode on `lock`). -/
theorem W_RL_amended_ok : ResetLockAmOk L0 p4 regX 0 0 (p4, regX) := ⟨W_RL_ok.1, by decide⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v11 §2 decies, W-RL-J: the `resetLock(e)` by `c0` after `terminate` and
`join` is `ok` under the amended form. -/
theorem W_RLJ_amended_ok : ResetLockAmOk L0 jq regX 0 0 (jq, regX) :=
  ⟨W_RLJ_ok.2.2.1, by decide⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` v11 §2 decies, positive twin of S11 (§1 S11): after `terminate` and `join`,
the `resetLock(e)` of the abandoned grant by `c0` is `ok` under the amended form. -/
theorem S11_4_amended_ok : ResetLockAmOk L0 y4 regG6 0 0 (y4, regX) :=
  ⟨S11_4_ok.2.2.1, by decide⟩

/-- W-RL and W-RL-J are amended executions; W-RC is a `Run6` and no amended execution, its step 5
being the `resetLock` without controller-access right. -/
theorem amended_runs : RunAm KM L0 rlσ rlLbls ∧ RunAm KM L0 rljσ rljLbls ∧
    Run6 KM L0 rcσ rcLbls ∧ ¬ RunAm KM L0 rcσ rcLbls := by
  refine ⟨⟨NonRegression.W_RL_run6, by decide⟩, ⟨NonRegression.W_RLJ_run6, by decide⟩,
    NonRegression.W_RC_run6, fun h => ?_⟩
  have := h.2 5 (by decide)
  revert this
  decide

/-! ## Authority of the protocol steps -/

/-- Brief, corrective pass, task 5: an `ok` step `acquire(i)`, `unlock(i)` or `resetLock(i)` by `c`
that satisfies the clause of the proposed C18 item 4 is made by a frame with the
controller-access right on entry `i`: the current frame of `c` has an authority, exercisable in
`Observe`, with a present effective mode on `ControlOf(i)` (`CtrlRight`). For `acquire` it is
C14.3, for `unlock` C17.4, both in the step relation; for `resetLock` it is the amended clause. -/
theorem protocol_authority {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label}
    {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (ham : AmCond L st lbl)
    {c i : Nat} (hp : lbl = .acquire c i ∨ lbl = .unlock c i ∨ lbl = .resetLock c i) :
    OptP (st.2.1[i]?) (fun e => CtrlRight L st.1 e (st.1.view c).top) False := by
  rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · cases h with
    | acquire ha =>
      obtain ⟨-, e, he, ⟨-, -, hcr⟩, -⟩ := ha
      simp only [he, OptP]
      exact hcr
  · cases h with
    | unlock hu =>
      obtain ⟨-, e, g, he, -, -, -, hcr, -⟩ := hu
      simp only [he, OptP]
      exact hcr
  · exact ham

/-- Brief, corrective pass, task 5: in an amended execution, every step `acquire(i)`, `unlock(i)`
or `resetLock(i)` by `c` is made by a frame with a present effective mode on `ControlOf(i)`. -/
theorem runAm_protocol_authority {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (h : RunAm k L σ lbls) {j : Nat} (hj : j < lbls.length) {c i : Nat}
    (hp : lbls[j] = .acquire c i ∨ lbls[j] = .unlock c i ∨ lbls[j] = .resetLock c i) :
    OptP ((σ j).2.1[i]?) (fun e => CtrlRight L (σ j).1 e ((σ j).1.view c).top) False :=
  protocol_authority (h.1 j hj).2 (h.2 j hj) hp

end Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.ResetAmend

    {c i : Nat} (hp : lbl = .acquire c i ∨ lbl = .unlock c i ∨ lbl = .resetLock c i) :
    OptP (st.2.1[i]?) (fun e => CtrlRight L st.1 e (st.1.view c).top) False := by
  rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · cases h with
    | acquire ha =>
      obtain ⟨-, e, he, ⟨-, -, hcr⟩, -⟩ := ha
      simp only [he, OptP]
      exact hcr
  · cases h with
    | unlock hu =>
      obtain ⟨-, e, g, he, -, -, -, hcr, -⟩ := hu
      simp only [he, OptP]
      exact hcr
  · exact ham

/-- Brief, corrective pass, task 5: in an amended execution, every step `acquire(i)`, `unlock(i)`
or `resetLock(i)` by `c` is made by a frame with a present effective mode on `ControlOf(i)`. -/
theorem runAm_protocol_authority {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {σ : Nat → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (h : RunAm k L σ lbls) {j : Nat} (hj : j < lbls.length) {c i : Nat}
    (hp : lbls[j] = .acquire c i ∨ lbls[j] = .unlock c i ∨ lbls[j] = .resetLock c i) :
    OptP ((σ j).2.1[i]?) (fun e => CtrlRight L (σ j).1 e ((σ j).1.view c).top) False :=
  protocol_authority (h.1 j hj).2 (h.2 j hj) hp

end Ern.Concurrency.MutexReal.ResetAmend
